fields.EN: Today's harvest day! I'm so excited!
fields.JP: 今日は待ちに待った収穫の時！
fields.LOCALIZED: Today's harvest day! I'm so excited!

fields.JP: マモルってば気合い入ってるねー

fields.EN:
Of course. I'm starved for something sweet.
I found a seed that looked like a sugar beet,
and I've carefully tended it for months now.
fields.JP:
当然だろ？　俺は甘いものに飢えてるんだ。
砂糖大根の種っぽいものを見つけて、
丹精込めて育てて早数か月
fields.LOCALIZED:
Obviously. I've been sweet-deprived. I found
a seed that looked like a sugar beet.

fields.EN:
Man, that took forever.
Now I've finally got myself a sugar beet!
fields.JP:
くぅ～、長かった。
これでようやく砂糖大根ゲットだぜ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Woohoo. That's done. Now I can devour my
sugar beets!

fields.EN:
Try not to get so carried away you ruin the
pickings, okay?
fields.JP:
気合い入ってるのはいいんだけど、
収穫は丁寧にね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Try not to get so carried away you ruin the
pickings, okay?

fields.EN: I know, I know. Come on!
fields.JP:
わかってるって。
いくぜ！
fields.LOCALIZED: I know, I know. Come on!

fields.JP: やった！　砂糖大根だー！　……って、あれ？
こ、これって砂糖大根、か？

fields.EN:
Damn it! Another dud!
So it wasn't a sugar beet seed again!
fields.JP:
だーっ！　ハズレだ！
また砂糖大根の種じゃなかったのかー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Damn! Wrong plant. I should've known those
seeds were bunk!

fields.JP: そういうこともあるよ。元気出して

fields.EN:
Still, how many times has this happened now?
We grow some mystery seed,
and it turns out not to be a sugar beet...
fields.JP:
つっても、もうこれで何度目だ？
謎の種を育ててみて、
砂糖大根じゃなかったのって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But how many times is that?! We plant all
these seeds and can't grow one measly
sugar beet.

fields.EN: There's no way for us to tell until it grows.
fields.JP:
実際に育ててみないと、
なんの種かわからないからね。
仕方ないよ
fields.LOCALIZED: There's no way for us to tell until it grows.

fields.EN:
Besides, turnips are yummy. They can pickle
them or put them in soup.
fields.JP:
それにほら、カブだっておいしいよ？
スープにしてもいいし、お漬物にしてもいいし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Besides, turnips are yummy. They can pickle
them or put them in soup.

fields.EN:
I'm telling you, I work the fields every day
because I want sugar beets.
Turnips are good too, but... *sigh*
fields.JP:
俺は砂糖大根がほしくて
日々農作業をがんばってるんだっての。
ま、カブもうまいけどさ。……はぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The only reason I toil on this lousy farm
is for sugar beets, but I guess turnips
will have to do. *sigh*...

fields.JP: また種を探すところからだね

fields.EN:
Yeah. There's nothing we need to rush now,
so let's just take our time...
fields.JP:
だな。
今は急ぐこともねーし、気長にやるか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Great. It's not like I've got somewhere
to be...

fields.EN: You must be tired. Want some water?
fields.JP: 疲れたでしょ。お水飲む？
fields.LOCALIZED: You must be tired. Want some water?

fields.EN:
*glug, glug*... Ah! I was parched. I can
feel the life coming back to me.
fields.JP:
んぐ、んぐ……ぷはーっ！　うまい！
五臓六腑に染み渡るぜ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
*glug, glug*... Ah! I was parched. I can
feel the life coming back to me.

fields.JP: ふふ、大げさなんだから
なんか、毎日のどかだねー

fields.EN: Every day's bright, just like Hikari.
fields.JP: ヒカリみてーな毎日だな

fields.EN:
Haha, I mean it's nice that things are peaceful.
Sitting here like this, it's hard to believe
what things used to be like.
fields.JP:
ははっ、平和でいいってことだよ。
こうしてると、昔が嘘みたいに思えてくるな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha. I'm saying that it wouldn't be the
good life without you. It's almost hard to
believe how hard we had it before.

fields.JP: これからもこんな日々が続いてほしいね

fields.EN:
(Long indeed. It's true those towers are all
gone, but there's no telling what's ahead.)
fields.JP:
（これからも、か……。
　たしかに監獄塔はなくなったけど、
　一寸先は闇ともいうし）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Long indeed. It's true those towers are all
gone, but there's no telling what's ahead.)

fields.EN:
(We finally have peace, and I'm already
 worrying about what comes next. Guess I can't
 help it after so long living through sudden upheavals.)
fields.JP:
（って、せっかく平和になったってのに、
　すぐに先のことを心配しちまう。長いこと
　急転直下な毎日だったから仕方ねーか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(For now, it's peaceful. I can't get too caught
up in what I can't change. But can you blame
me? Dog eat dog is all I know.)

fields.EN:
(...But I don't know how long this peace will last.
 I don't want to waste even one second
 of the time I have with Hikari now...)
fields.JP:
（……でも、この平和がいつまで続くか
　わからない。ヒカリと過ごす今このときだって
　一秒でも無駄にしたくねーな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But...peace is temporary. I don't want to
waste a second of it without Hikari.)

fields.JP: ……ん？　じろじろ見てどうしたの

fields.EN:
Oh, are you thirsty? Or were you going to say
we should find seeds?
fields.JP:
あ、もしかしてお水のおかわり？
それとももう新しい種を探しに行くの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, are you thirsty? Or were you going to say
we should find seeds?

fields.EN:
(I don't want to waste my time with Hikari.
 If that's how I feel, then maybe I should just...)
fields.JP:
（ヒカリとの時間を無駄にしたくない。
　それなら、いっそ……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Gotta make the most of my time with her.)

fields.JP: な、なな、いきなりなに言ってるの！

fields.EN:
It's not about whether I want to or not!
W-We haven't even clearly established
whether we're dating yet!
fields.JP:
嫌とかどーとかじゃなくて！
そ、そもそも付き合ってるかどうかも
曖昧な状態なんだよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not the right question! The right
question is when did we start dating?!

fields.EN:
And could you think about the situation a little?!
We're just relaxing in a field like this,
with no tension at all...!
fields.JP:
というか、もうちょっとシチュエーションを
考えて！　こんな畑でのどかにしてて、
緊張感もなーんにもなくて……！
fields.LOCALIZED: I mean, goodness. You had to do this now!

fields.EN: Oh...? But...I guess now's not too bad.
fields.JP:
……あれ？
でも、なんだか……こういうのも
悪くない、かも？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh...? But...I guess now's not too bad.

fields.EN:
I realized I don't want to have regrets.
The time I get to spend with you, and the future too,
aren't guaranteed to just keep being there.
fields.JP:
俺さ、後悔したくないって思ったんだ。
お前と過ごせる時間も、これからもずっと、
当たり前のようにあるとは限らない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't want to regret anything. The future
is never guaranteed. Let's spend the rest
of our lives together.

fields.EN:
So I don't want to waste even a little
of the time I have with you.
fields.JP:
それならお前との時間を
少しでも無駄にしたくないんだ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't bear another day without you by my
side.

fields.EN:
...You really surprised me.
I can see you've been thinking about a lot,
but you jump way too far ahead, Mamoru. ...Still...
fields.JP:
……もう、びっくりした。
いろいろ考えてるのはわかったけど、
マモルは飛躍しすぎだよ。……でも
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, this is unexpected. I had a feeling you
had a lot on your mind, but this is something...

fields.JP: ダ、ダメなわけ、ないでしょ……？
い、いいのか！？　マジで！？

fields.EN:
You're the one who asked me, aren't you?
Don't make me confirm something so embarrassing...
fields.JP:
自分から言ってきたんでしょ？
恥ずかしいこと確認しないでよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're the one who asked! Don't act so
surprised! You're making me blush...

fields.EN: WOOOOHOOO! Time to plan a wedding!
fields.JP:
いよっしゃー！！
そうと決まれば結婚式だ！
fields.LOCALIZED: WOOOOHOOO! Time to plan a wedding!

fields.JP:
当たり前だろ？
好きだぜ、ヒカリ！

fields.EN:
Huh?! Wasn't that a really sloppy confession?
I love you too, Mamoru!
fields.JP:
ええっ！？　なんかすごく雑な告白じゃない？
私もマモルのこと好きだけど！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?! This was your plan all along, wasn't it?
I love you too, Mamoru!

fields.JP: さあ、結婚式の準備だー！
マモル、ヒカリ、おめでとう！

でも、おめでたいことはおめでたいんだけど……
うーん、なんというか……
なんだよ、気に食わねーのか？

fields.EN:
Well, you asked me to be the officiant.
I don't know what to say...
fields.JP:
いや、いきなり牧師役をやれって言われても
戸惑うよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, you asked me to be the officiant.
I don't know what to say...

fields.EN: Mamoru, we may be rushing things.
fields.JP: マモル、やっぱり急すぎるんじゃないかな
fields.LOCALIZED: Mamoru, we may be rushing things.

fields.EN:
You know what they say: no time like the present.
We can't exactly hold a grand ceremony right now,
and if we wait around, we might miss our chance.
fields.JP:
でも善は急げって言うだろ。
それに今この状況じゃ立派な式なんて無理だし、
変に待つとタイミング逃しそうだと思ってさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know what they say, light hands for idle
work. We can't wait all day for the right time.
Otherwise, it'll never happen.

fields.EN:
All right, I guess I have no choice.
You and I go way back, Mamoru, so I'll do it.
fields.JP:
仕方ないな。
まあ僕とマモルの仲だし、引き受けるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine. Between us two, I knew I would before
you even asked.

fields.EN: It means a lot, Jack. Thank you.
fields.JP: ごめんね。ありがとう、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED: It means a lot, Jack. Thank you.

fields.JP: ちょーっと待つざます！

fields.EN: Huh? What are you all doing here...?
fields.JP: あれ？　なんでお前ら……
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? What are you all doing here...?

fields.EN:
It was sudden, and we're only having a simple ceremony,
so I only invited Kaede, Itsuki, and Takumi.
Otsuu, Ningyohime, and Hameln came too?
fields.JP:
急だったし、簡単な式を挙げるだけだから、
カエデとイツキとタクミしか呼ばなかったのに。
おつうと人魚姫とハーメルンまで来たのか
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's last minute, so I only invited Kaede, Itsuki,
and Takumi to our little affair. But now Otsuu,
Little Mermaid, and Hameln are here too!

fields.EN:
Yeah, we happened to run into Otsuu-chan and the others
on the way here, so I told them about the ceremony.
fields.JP:
いやー、来る途中でおつうちゃんたちに
ばったり会ってさ。式のこと話しちゃった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we just happened to run into them on
the way here. So I told them about your
wedding.

fields.EN: But it's not like we were told to keep it hush.
fields.JP: 別に口止めもされていなかったしな
fields.LOCALIZED: But it's not like we were told to keep it hush.

fields.EN: Yeah! The more the merrier with weddings!
fields.JP:
祝い事は大勢で祝ったほうが
いいに決まってるからね～
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah! The more the merrier with weddings!

fields.JP: マモルさん、ヒカリちゃん、おめでとう！

fields.EN:
You may not remember, but you share a strong bond
with Hime and me. Not inviting us is awfully distant
of you.
fields.JP:
記憶はないかもしれないけど、
君は僕や姫と強い縁があるんだ。
呼ばないなんて水臭いよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Although your memories may be lost,
our bond is unbreakable as ever! If only
that courtesy extended to being invited...

fields.EN:
We played together so much, and you leave me out?
What's the meaning of this?!
fields.JP:
ワレだってあんなに一緒に遊んだ仲なのに、
のけ者にするとはなにごとだー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You act like all our time spent playing
together was for nothing!

fields.EN: Are you talking about Tag of Hell...?
fields.JP: 遊びって、あの地獄の鬼ごっこのことか……
fields.LOCALIZED: Are you talking about Tag of Hell...?

fields.EN:
For us, that wasn't a game at all.
We were risking our lives, nya.
fields.JP:
ボクらの中では、あれは遊びじゃなくて
命懸けだったけどにゃー
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was no game. We made out with our
lives.

fields.EN: I'll celebrate too. You should be grateful!
fields.JP: ワレも祝ってやるぞ。喜ぶがいい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll celebrate your matrimony! After you
deify me!

fields.EN: It's a little embarrassing, but I'm really happy!
fields.JP: ちょっと照れるけど、嬉しいぜ！
fields.LOCALIZED: You guys. You're making me blush.

fields.EN:
It really does make me happy to have everyone
celebrating with us.
fields.JP:
やっぱりみんなに祝ってもらえるって
嬉しいよねー
fields.LOCALIZED: I think it goes without saying we all approve.

fields.EN: Hey, should we go through the ceremony too, Itsuki?
fields.JP:
あたしたちも形式だけやっちゃう？
イツキ

fields.EN: Hey, the others might hear you!
fields.JP: お、おまっ、それは内緒じゃないのか！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, the others might hear you!

fields.JP: え……カエデさん、イツキさん？　まさか……

fields.EN:
Y-Yeah... We hadn't told you,
but the other day I promised to marry her too.
fields.JP:
あ、ああ……。言っていなかったが、
先日僕もこいつと結婚の約束をしたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well...we have yet to update you all, but
we too are now engaged as of yesterday.

fields.JP:
きゃー、そうだったの？　すごい！
おめでとう！
マジかよ！　ぜんっぜん気づかなかった！
思わぬところにカップル誕生だね

fields.EN: Why don't we throw a joint wedding for us all?
fields.JP:
ねえねえ、だったら私たちと一緒に
結婚式やっちゃおうよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Why don't we throw a joint wedding for us all?

fields.EN:
...So I'm serving as the officiant
for two couples now?
Feels like twice the responsibility...
fields.JP:
……ということは、僕が二組のカップルに対して
牧師役を務めるってこと？
責任の重さが倍になったような……
fields.LOCALIZED:
...So now I gotta officiate two weddings at the
same time? That wasn't in the contract...

fields.EN:
Oogh... All four of you sure have grown up.
I hope yous guys are happy forever!
fields.JP:
ううぅ……四人とも立派になって。
みんな幸せにおなり～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oogh... All four of you sure have grown up.
I hope yous guys are happy forever!

fields.JP: タクミにはそーゆー相手はおらぬのか

fields.EN: Nooope. Hameln-chan, introduce me to someone.
fields.JP: いなーい。ハーメルンちゃん、誰か紹介して
fields.LOCALIZED:
Noooo. I'm still a free agent. Why don't you
introduce me to one of your friends?

fields.EN: Ugh... That's a lot of responsibility...
Good thing Otsuu-chan had some cute clothes.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんがかわいらしいお洋服を
持っててよかったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aren't you glad you got that tuxedo recently,
Otsuu?

fields.EN:
It felt silly at first, but the timing couldn't be
better.
fields.JP: なんか恥ずかしいけど、役に立ってよかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It felt silly at first, but the timing couldn't be
better.

fields.EN:
Ahem! All right, we'll begin the vows now...
First, Kaede-san and Itsuki-san.
fields.JP:
コホン！　えー、ではこれより誓いの言葉を……
まずはカエデさんとイツキさん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ahem! Uh, how about we start with vows...?
Take it away, Kaede and Itsuki.

fields.EN:
Do you, Itsuki, vow to love and cherish
Kaede here as your wife,
in sickness and in health?
fields.JP:
新郎イツキ、あなたはここにいるカエデを、
病めるときも健やかなるときも、妻として愛し、
慈しむことを誓いますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you, Itsuki, take Kaede to be your wife
wife from this day forward, in sickness and
in health, till death do you part?

fields.EN:
And do you, Kaede, vow to love and cherish
Itsuki here as your husband,
in sickness and in health?
fields.JP:
新婦カエデ、あなたはここにいるイツキを、
病めるときも健やかなるときも、夫として愛し、
慈しむことを誓いますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And do you, Kaede, take Itsuki to be your
husband from this day forward, in sickness
and in health, till death do you part?

fields.JP: では次に、マモルとヒカリも……

fields.EN:
Do you, Mamoru, take Hikari to be your
wife from this day forward, in sickness
and in health, till death do you part?
fields.JP:
新郎マモル、あなたはここにいるヒカリを、
病めるときも健やかなるときも、妻として愛し、
慈しむことを誓いますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you, Mamoru, take Hikari to be your
wife from this day forward, in sickness
and in health, till death do you part?

fields.EN:
And do you, Hikari, take Mamoru as your
husband from this day forward, in sickness
and in health, till death do you part?
fields.JP:
新婦ヒカリ、あなたはここにいるマモルを、
病めるときも健やかなるときも、夫として愛し、
慈しむことを誓いますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And do you, Hikari, take Mamoru as your
husband from this day forward, in sickness
and in health, till death do you part?

fields.EN:
(Hikari... Before I knew it, you were always
 by my side, supporting a rough guy like me...)
fields.JP:
（ヒカリ……。気づいたらいつも一緒にいて、
　こんなガサツな俺を支えてくれた……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hikari. I can hardly remember what life was like
before I met you. I know you practically as well
as I know myself.)

fields.EN:
(Now, it all makes sense. We were destined to
be together.)
fields.JP:
（今になって、やっとわかった。
　ヒカリとの出会いは運命だったんだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Now, it all makes sense. We were destined to
be together.)

fields.EN:
I don't know what will happen to the world
from here on. But the 'Hikari' that lights my heart...
fields.JP:
これからも世界はどうなるかわからねー。
ただ、俺の心を照らしてくれる『ヒカリ』は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know what's waiting for us here, but you
are the light of my life.

fields.EN: Hehe. You're the light of mine, too
fields.JP: ふふ、私の光もここにあるよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. You're the light of mine, too

fields.EN:
I love you, Mamoru. Here's to the rest of our
lives.
fields.JP: 大好き、マモル。この先もずっと一緒だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I love you, Mamoru. Here's to the rest of our
lives.

fields.JP: （ふぅ……無事に役目を果たせてよかった）

fields.EN:
(Mamoru and Hikari, and Kaede and Itsuki.
Everyone beamed from ear to ear.)
fields.JP:
（マモル、ヒカリ……。
　カエデさん、イツキさん……。
　みんな本当に幸せそうだったな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Mamoru and Hikari, and Kaede and Itsuki.
Everyone beamed from ear to ear.)

fields.EN: (But what Mamoru said to Hikari moved me.)
fields.JP:
（……だけど、さっきマモルがヒカリに言った
　言葉は胸に刺さったな）
fields.LOCALIZED: (But what Mamoru said to Hikari moved me.)

fields.EN:
'We don't know what will happen to the world
from here on,' was it...? He's absolutely right.
fields.JP:
これからも世界はどうなるかわからねー、
だっけ……。本当にその通りだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no telling what we'll find up here.
He's exactly right.

fields.EN:
(Is it really okay for me to stay like this?
 Using being busy as an excuse and leaving
 my own feelings unattended forever...)
fields.JP:
（僕はこのままでいいのかな。
　忙しさを言い訳に、いつまでも
　自分の気持ちを放っておいて……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder why I'm so sentimental all of a
sudden. I guess I haven't had time to process
my feelings since things settled down.)

fields.EN:
(I'd started to think this peace would last forever,
 and that I could tell her how I feel whenever
 I finally decided to...)
fields.JP:
（この平和がずっと続いて、自分の気持ちも
　伝えようと思えばいつだって伝えられる
　ような気がしていたけど）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But there's nothing dangerous for us to worry
about anymore up here. Now's the perfect time
to work up the courage...)

fields.EN:
(But what if something happens to the world again
 and I never get another chance to tell her...?
 I don't want that. I'd regret it for sure...!)
fields.JP:
（もしもまた世界になにかあって、
　二度とこの想いを伝えられなくなったら……。
　そんなの嫌だ。きっと後悔する……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If something bad were to happen, and
I let the chance slip by me again...
No, I won't let it happen! Never!)

fields.EN:
Thanks for leading by example, Mamoru.
No more excuses.
fields.JP:
マモルのおかげで気づくことができた。
僕も覚悟を決めなきゃいけないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks for leading by example, Mamoru.
No more excuses.

fields.EN: Next time, I'll tell her how I feel...!
fields.JP: 今度、僕の気持ちを彼女に伝えよう……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The next time I see her, I'll give it to her
straight!

fields.JP: アリス！　来てくれたんだね

fields.EN:
Your invitation took me by surprise.
Is something wrong?
fields.JP:
急に話があるなんて呼び出されたから、
驚いたわ。どうしたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your invitation took me by surprise.
Is something wrong?

fields.EN: Well, why don't we take a stroll?
fields.JP:
ちょっとね……。
ねえ、少し歩かない？
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, why don't we take a stroll?

fields.EN:
Sure. We haven't had much time lately
to relax together like this, either.
fields.JP:
いいわよ。最近はこんな風に
あなたとゆっくりする時間もなかったものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure. Can hardly think of the last time we
could leisure around like this.

fields.EN: Have you gotten used to life as it is now?

Yes. I'm still thrown off by not having
as much power as before, but with a little ingenuity
and everyone working together, we can manage.
fields.JP:
ええ。
昔より力が出ないことにはまだ戸惑うけど、
工夫してみんなで協力すれば乗り切れるし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sometimes. There are moments I forget that
I don't have powers anymore, but that's small
in the grand scheme of things.

fields.EN:
Our focus now is to get our lives back on track.
Can't just sit and complain.
fields.JP:
今は少しでも早く生活の基盤を
整えることが先決だもの。
泣き言なんて言っていられないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our focus now is to get our lives back on track.
Can't just sit and complain.

fields.JP: （相変わらずアリスは真面目だなぁ）

fields.EN:
It's the opposite of how things used to be.
Now you're the strong one, Jack.
It feels kind of strange.
fields.JP:
昔とは逆で、
今ではすっかりジャックのほうが力持ちね。
なんだか不思議な感じだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But unlike before, I feel like you're two steps
ahead of me, Jack. How bizarre.

fields.EN:
Yeah, it really is.
As one of the few men here, I need to pull my weight.
fields.JP:
本当だね。
数少ない男手として、僕もしっかりしないと
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know, right? Someone's gotta step up and be
the man around here.

fields.EN: Just as I'd expect. You're admirable, Jack.
fields.JP: さすがね。偉いわ、ジャック

fields.EN:
I think you're the admirable one, Alice.
You're always earnest, hardworking, and kind.
fields.JP:
僕はアリスのほうこそ偉いと思うよ。
いつも真面目で、頑張り屋で、それに優しくて
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're one to talk, Alice. Everyone can count
on you because you never give up. Plus you've
got a perfect smile.

fields.EN:
You flatter me...but it sure is nice to hear you
say it, Jack.
fields.JP:
褒めすぎよ。
……でもジャックにそう言ってもらえるなんて、
嬉しいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You flatter me...but it sure is nice to hear you
say it, Jack.

fields.EN:
I'm a lucky girl. Being here with you now,
after everything we've been through.
fields.JP:
わたしは幸せ者ね。
いろんなことがあったけど、今はこうして
あなたと二人で穏やかな時間を過ごせている……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm a lucky girl. Being here with you now,
after everything we've been through.

fields.EN:
Sitting there in that prison cell, I never thought
this day would come.
fields.JP:
監獄に捕まっていたときには
想像もできなかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sitting there in that prison cell, I never thought
this day would come.

fields.EN:
Seriously. It's a miracle we made it out.
Fate must have our number.
fields.JP:
うん。僕たちが生きて一緒にいられるなんて、
本当は奇跡みたいなものなのかもね。
運命に感謝しないと
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seriously. It's a miracle we made it out.
Fate must have our number.

fields.EN:
Fate has nothing to do with it. We earned our
happiness with blood, sweat, and tears.
fields.JP:
運命じゃないわ。
今の幸せは、わたしたちみんなで
力を合わせて手に入れたものだもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fate has nothing to do with it. We earned our
happiness with blood, sweat, and tears.

fields.EN:
Especially thanks to all the work you put in, Jack.
Without you, I don't think we'd have
the life we have now.
fields.JP:
特に、ジャックががんばってくれたおかげね。
あなたがいなければ、
きっと今の生活はなかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Especially you, Jack. All your hard work paid
off. None of us would be here without you.

fields.EN:
I didn't do anything that amazing.
I was just doing everything I could, every time.
fields.JP:
僕はそんなすごいことはしていないよ。
いつだって、ただ必死だっただけなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aw, shucks. I didn't do anything special.
I just did whatever was asked of me.

fields.EN:
But... if I managed to keep going,
it was because ever since we were little,
there was a girl by my side cheering me on.
fields.JP:
でも、そうだな……。
僕ががんばれたとすれば、それは幼い頃から
いつも傍で僕を応援してくれた子がいたからだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But...there was one person through it all who
gave me courage to keep going.

fields.EN:
You've always supported me, Alice.
I could keep going because you were there.
So...
fields.JP:
アリスはずっと僕を支えてきてくれた。
君がいたから僕はがんばれたんだ。
だから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's always been you and me, Alice.
You're my anchor, so...

fields.EN:
I love you, Alice. Not just as a best friend.
But as a woman.
fields.JP:
僕はアリスが好きだよ。
幼馴染としてだけでなく、女の子として
fields.LOCALIZED:
I love you, Alice. Not just as a best friend.
But as a woman.

fields.EN: So, um...why don't the two of us go out?
fields.JP:
えっと、それで、あー……。
お付き合いをできればいいな、と……
fields.LOCALIZED: So, um...why don't the two of us go out?

fields.EN:
(Oh man, this confession is starting to tank.
Quick, follow it up somehow...)
fields.JP:
（せっかくの告白なのに、緊張しすぎて
　だんだんかっこ悪くなってきちゃった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh man, this confession is starting to tank.
Quick, follow it up somehow...)

fields.EN:
I-I'm very happy.
But is it really all right to get carried away
when things are still like this...?
fields.JP:
と、とても嬉しいわ。
でも今みたいな状況で浮かれてしまって
いいのかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's so sweet of you to say. So much to
take in.

fields.EN:
No need to answer right away. I'll wait for
you. If you're not interested, then we can
stay best frie—
fields.JP:
すぐに返事がもらえなくても、僕は待つよ。
もしも断られても、僕は君の幼馴染として……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No need to answer right away. I'll wait for
you. If you're not interested, then we can
stay best frie—

fields.EN: I would never say no to you!
fields.JP:
断るわけないじゃないっ！
……あ
fields.LOCALIZED: I would never say no to you!

fields.JP: （ん？　あれ、それってつまり……）

fields.EN: Yes... I love you too, Jack.
fields.JP:
そ……そうよ。
わたしだってジャックのことが好き
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes... I love you too, Jack.

fields.EN: I love you! I always have!
fields.JP: 大好きよ！　ずっと昔っから！
fields.LOCALIZED: I love you! I always have!

fields.EN:
Actually, I used to dream about the day
you'd confess your feelings to me!
fields.JP:
むしろこうしてジャックに告白してもらえる日を
夢見ていたくらいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
In fact, I've been dreaming of the day that you
confess your love for me my entire life!

fields.EN:
(Wait, really?! Wow. No pressure or anything.
My face feels hot... This is awesome!)
fields.JP:
（そ、そうだったの？
　うわ、嬉しい。照れる。でも嬉しい……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wait, really?! Wow. No pressure or anything.
My face feels hot... This is awesome!)

fields.EN:
I-I'd been holding it back all this time...
And then you went and said something
that made me so happy...
fields.JP:
もう……ずっと抑えていたのに。
ジャックがそんな嬉しいこと言って
くれるから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
My, I've held back these feelings for years,
and now I melt because you feel the same.

fields.EN: Alice... Let me say it properly one more time.
fields.JP: アリス……改めて言わせてもらうね

fields.EN: I love you. Would you go out with me?
fields.JP:
好きだよ、アリス。
僕と付き合ってくれないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED: I love you. Would you go out with me?

fields.EN:
Of course. I would love nothing more.
I love you, Jack!
fields.JP:
わたしでよければ、喜んで……。
大好きよ、ジャック！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course. I would love nothing more.
I love you, Jack!

fields.EN:
I've never gone swimming in the sea before.
Let's have lots of fun together!
fields.JP:
海水浴なんて初めてだわ。
たくさん楽しみましょうね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is my first time swimming. Here goes
nothing!

fields.EN:
(I've never seen Alice in a swimsuit before.
 She's so cute... But it'd be rude to stare.
 Still, she's so cute...)
fields.JP:
（アリスの水着姿なんて初めてだな。
　かわいい……でもあんまりじろじろ見たら
　失礼だよね。でもかわいい……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I've never seen Alice in a bikini before.
She's so pretty. Come on man, don't stare!
...Aw, but she looks cute!)

fields.EN:
I heard you're supposed to warm up before going
into the sea. I looked up how to do it,
so let's start together...
fields.JP:
海に入る前は準備運動をしなきゃいけないそうよ。
やり方は調べてきたから、さっそく一緒に……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I heard it's good to stretch before swimming
to avoid cramps. I looked up some exercises.
All together now...

fields.JP: （アリスにじーっと見られているような……？）

fields.EN: Jack, you have a nice body.
fields.JP: ジャック……いい体してるわね
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack, you have a nice body.

fields.EN:
Oh, sorry. I didn't mean it in a strange way.
I just thought your build had gotten
a lot more toned than it used to be.
fields.JP:
あ、ごめんなさい。
変な意味じゃなくて、昔よりも体つきが
だいぶ引き締まってると思ったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, sorry. I wasn't trying to be rude. I just
noticed you're more toned than usual.

fields.EN:
Yeah, I've been doing a lot of physical work lately.
It's trained me up quite a bit.
fields.JP:
ああ、たしかに近頃は肉体労働が多いからね。
だいぶ鍛えられたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh well, could be all that heavy lifting they
got me doing. Yeah, they put me to work out
there.

fields.EN:
Hehe, that's reassuring.
Looks like I'll be relying on you for heavy work
from now on, Jack.
fields.JP:
ふふ、頼もしいわ。
これからは力仕事ではジャックに
頼りっきりになってしまいそうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. My big, strong man. Seems like you'll
be the go-to guy when it comes to labor.

fields.EN:
You think? If that's the case, don't ever
hesitate to put my skills to the test!
fields.JP:
そうかな？
まあ、そのときは遠慮なく言ってよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You think? If that's the case, don't ever
hesitate to put my skills to the test!

fields.EN:
(I never thought the day would come when people
 relied on me for heavy work.
 I'm kind of happy about it...)
fields.JP:
（僕が力仕事で頼りにされる日が来るなんてなぁ。
　ちょっと嬉しいかも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't believe we're forming a society where
I'm tasked with physical labor. At least it's
nice to be needed...)

fields.EN: Hey, Jack... may I touch you?
fields.JP: ねえジャック、触ってもいいかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, would you mind if I touched your abs?

fields.EN:
(She touched me out of nowhere
 and I made a weird noise.)
fields.JP: （い、いきなり触られて変な声出ちゃったよ）
fields.LOCALIZED: (She reached out of the blue. It startled me.)

fields.EN:
Whoa... That's tough. Looks like someone has
been working out.
fields.JP:
はぁ……やっぱりすごく硬いわ。
こんなに筋肉がついたのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa... That's tough. Looks like someone has
been working out.

fields.EN:
Your abs are defined too...
I never noticed when you had clothes on.
You look slender, but you're surprisingly muscular.
fields.JP:
腹筋も割れてるし……
服を着ているときは気づかなかったわ。
細身に見えて、意外と筋肉質なのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's definition. You can almost see them
through your shirt. Perhaps there's more
hiding behind that lean physique.

fields.EN: Wait. Now you're making me self-conscious.
fields.JP:
ま、待って。
さすがに恥ずかしくなってきたんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED: Wait. Now you're making me self-conscious.

fields.EN: Oh, sorry. I got a little carried away.
fields.JP:
ご、ごめんなさい。
わたしとしたことが、はしたなかったわね
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, sorry. I got a little carried away.

fields.EN:
To think that Jack, who was so slender
he looked like a girl when we were children,
has grown into such a fine man... I got emotional.
fields.JP:
子供のころは女の子みたいに華奢だった
ジャックが今ではこんなに立派になったなんて、
感無量で、つい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess I just hadn't realized how much you've
matured these last few months. Now look at you.

fields.EN: (She sounds like my guardian or something.)
fields.JP: （保護者みたいなこと言ってるなぁ）

fields.EN:
...Even if you looked like a girl,
you were always more dependable than anyone
and supported me from the very beginning.
fields.JP:
……女の子みたいでも、
あなたは昔から誰よりも頼りになって、
わたしの支えになってくれていたけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But even back then, you were still as reliable
as ever. I knew I could count on you.

fields.EN:
Aw, shucks. Well, if it seems like I had my act
together, just know it was because I tried to
impress you.
fields.JP:
照れるな……。
今だから言えるけど、あのころはアリスの前で
格好つけたかったっていうのもあったんだと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aw, shucks. Well, if it seems like I had my act
together, just know it was because I tried to
impress you.

fields.EN: You've always been special to me.
fields.JP: 昔から、君は僕にとって大切な存在だったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: You've always been special to me.

fields.EN:
I'm so happy...
In that sense, I guess we've loved each other
all along, haven't we?
fields.JP:
嬉しい……。
そういう意味ではわたしたち、
昔から相思相愛だったということね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aw. You have no idea how happy that makes
me. I suppose our connection has been there
from the start.

fields.EN:
It feels like a dream that you and I
actually became lovers, Jack.
fields.JP:
こうしてジャックと恋人同士になれたなんて、
夢みたいだわ
fields.LOCALIZED: To be within touching distance of your heart...

fields.EN:
I feel the same.
You've grown into such a beautiful woman, Alice.
I almost feel unworthy to have you as my girlfriend.
fields.JP:
僕だって同じだよ。
アリスもすっかりきれいな女性になって、
こんな人が恋人だなんてもったいないくらいだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Same, Alice. You are beautiful. Hard to think
a guy like me could like a girl like you.

fields.EN:
Thank you...
But at some point, I completely stopped
growing taller.
fields.JP:
ありがとう……。
だけどわたしは、あるときから
全然身長が伸びなくなってしまったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you... At some point though, it feels
like I stopped growing.

fields.EN:
I just feel so petite all the time. I guess I'll
never look like Charlotte...
fields.JP:
なにより、こんなに貧相な体つきで……。
シャーロットみたいになれる未来は
期待できそうにないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just feel so petite all the time. I guess I'll
never look like Charlotte...

fields.EN:
With a body like mine, maybe you don't feel
any sexual attraction toward me...
or get excited by me at all...?
fields.JP:
ジャックだってわたしみたいな体じゃ
性的な魅力を感じたり、
興奮したりしないんじゃないかしら……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
With this body, I bet you don't find me attractive
at all, do you...?

fields.EN: (Where in the world did THAT come from?!)
fields.JP: （な、なんかすごいこと言われた！）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Where in the world did THAT come from?!)

fields.EN:
(But I can't just leave Alice feeling down.
 If anything, this is the perfect chance
 to tell her how I truly feel...!)
fields.JP:
（でもアリスが落ち込んでるのを放っておけない。
　むしろこれは僕の本当の気持ちを伝える
　いい機会なんだ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't leave her hanging. In fact, this is
the perfect chance to lay on the charm.)

fields.EN: It might be something you're self-conscious about, but...
fields.JP:
君にとってはコンプレックスなのかも
しれないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure everyone's got something about their
body they wish they could change...

fields.EN:
E-Even if you don't feel confident about your figure,
I really like it!
fields.JP:
き、君が自信を持てないスタイルだとしても、
僕はすごく好きだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if it were up to me, I wouldn't change a
thing!

fields.EN:
I mean, your body really does excite me, and, um...
it makes me imagine all kinds of things!
fields.JP:
だからアリスの体ですごく興奮したり、そのー、
いろいろ想像しちゃったりする！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I mean, I get excited every time I see you.
My mind starts wandering all over the place!

fields.EN:
(Whoa, that probably made me sound like a pervert!
 I was trying to cheer Alice up, but now I'm embarrassed
 like I just exposed all my preferences!)
fields.JP:
（うわぁ、ヘンタイみたいだったかも！
　アリスを元気づけるためとはいえ、
　自分の性癖をさらけ出すみたいで恥ずかしい！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Whoa. I sound like a freak. I just wanted to tell
Alice how pretty she is, but now I feel like she
thinks I'm a perv!)

fields.EN:
Um... I'm sorry.
I think I was saying something strange.
But what you said made me happy, Jack.
fields.JP:
あの……ごめんなさい。
わたし変なこと言っていたみたいね。
でもジャックの言葉、嬉しかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, I'm sorry. I just never thought someone
could look at me that way. I'm happy you feel
that way.

fields.EN:
I love everything about you, so don't feel the
need to knock yourself.
fields.JP:
アリスが嫌いって言うところも、僕は好きだよ。
だから自分のことをそんなに卑下しないで
fields.LOCALIZED:
I love everything about you, so don't feel the
need to knock yourself.

fields.EN: Right. Thanks to you, I feel more confident.
fields.JP:
……ええ。あなたのおかげで、
自分の体にも少し自信が持てたわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Right. Thanks to you, I feel more confident.

fields.EN:
(Thank goodness. I rambled for a second
there. I'm glad Alice cheered up.)
fields.JP:
（うんうん、よかった。
　僕もだいぶ恥ずかしいこと言っちゃったけど、
　アリスが元気になってくれたなら本望だ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Thank goodness. I rambled for a second
there. I'm glad Alice cheered up.)

fields.EN:
Okay. Well, let's dive in! Oh, but you said we
should stretch first, right?
fields.JP:
よーし、じゃあ気を取り直して泳ごうか！
あ、その前に準備運動だっけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay. Well, let's dive in! Oh, but you said we
should stretch first, right?

fields.EN: Yeah, I'll show you! Let's do it together!
fields.JP: 教えてあげるわ。一緒にやりましょ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah, I'll show you! Let's do it together!

fields.EN:
Hmm... How should I stage
my surprise proposal to Alice?
fields.JP:
うーん、
アリスへのサプライズプロポーズの
演出はどうしようかなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm. How should I propose to Alice?

fields.EN:
For now, it's reassuring that Tsuu and
Ningyohime-san agreed to help me.
fields.JP:
ひとまず、つうと人魚姫さんに
協力を取り付けられたのは心強いな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm grateful Otsuu and Little Mermaid agreed
to help.

fields.EN:
I wonder how Alice pictured her proposal
going. Hm... Well, not the worst problem
to have. Hehehe.
fields.JP:
どんな演出をしたらアリスは喜ぶだろう。
悩むなぁ……。幸せな悩みだけど。ふふふ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder how Alice pictured her proposal
going. Hm... Well, not the worst problem
to have. Hehehe.

fields.EN: Oh, Tsuu, Ningyohime-san. Is something wrong?
fields.JP: あれ、つうと人魚姫さん。どうかしたの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, Otsuu, Little Mermaid. What's the matter?

fields.EN:
Um... there's something we need
to apologize to you for, Jack-san...
fields.JP:
あのね……。わたしたち、ジャックさんに
謝らなきゃいけないことがあるの……
fields.LOCALIZED: Um. Both of us came here to apologize.

fields.JP: え？　バレたというと……

fields.EN:
(By 'found out,' they mean Alice found out
 about the proposal! Ah, man...)
fields.JP:
（バレたって、アリスにプロポーズのことが
　バレたってことか！　あちゃ～……）

fields.EN:
I happened to overhear Otsuu-san and
Ningyohime-san talking, and I was so surprised
I ended up pressing them for answers.
fields.JP:
おつうさんと人魚姫さんが話しているのを
偶然耳にして、びっくりしちゃって
思わず二人に問いただしてしまったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I happened to overhear Otsuu and Little
Mermaid talking about it, so I started pressing
for answers.

fields.EN:
By the time we realized, I thought it would be
silly to keep it secret for much longer.
fields.JP:
もうほとんどバレていたから、
これ以上隠し通すわけにもいかず……
fields.LOCALIZED:
By the time we realized, I thought it would be
silly to keep it secret for much longer.

fields.EN:
Jack-san, I'm sorry. I'm so sorry!
If only we'd been more careful
when we discussed the plan...
fields.JP:
ジャックさん、ごめんね。ごめんね！
わたしたちがもっと気をつけて
打ち合わせをしていれば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm so sorry, Jack. Really. We should have
been more aware of where we were talking...

fields.EN:
That's fine. Sorry for putting the pressure on
you two.
fields.JP:
いや、大丈夫だよ。
こっちこそ気を遣わせてごめんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's fine. Sorry for putting the pressure on
you two.

fields.JP: でも、せっかくのサプライズが……

fields.EN: I'll figure out the rest myself. No worries.
fields.JP:
こうなったらこうなったで、
あとは僕一人でなんとかするよ。
気にしないで
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll figure out the rest myself. No worries.

fields.JP: ……わかった。力になれなくてごめん

fields.EN:
(This is awkward.
 I need to be the one to bring it up, at least.)
fields.JP:
（気まずいな。
　とにかく僕から話を切り出さないと）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This is awkward. I'm the one whose surprise
was blown.)

fields.EN:
...Haha. Well, that's what happened.
I guess doing something as a surprise
really is difficult.
fields.JP:
……あはは、まあ、そういうわけなんだ。
サプライズでなにかするのってやっぱり難しいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, sure, the cat's out of the bag.
Probably should've expected that.

fields.EN:
Um... I feel terrible.
Finding out this way means I've wasted
everyone's consideration for me...
fields.JP:
その……なんだか申し訳ないわ。
こんな形で知ってしまって、
みんなの気遣いを無駄にしてしまって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um. I feel terrible. I didn't mean for this.
I've gone and ruined the whole thing.

fields.EN:
I suppose I should have pretended not to know,
but once I'd heard it, I just couldn't stop myself
from confirming it...
fields.JP:
知らないふりをすればよかったんでしょうけど、
聞いてしまった以上、どうしても確かめずには
いられなかったの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I could have just pretended not to hear it,
but I went ahead and imposed myself.

fields.EN:
(Now Alice is bummed. Man, if I knew this was
gonna be this much trouble, I never would've
attempted a surprise...)
fields.JP:
（アリスが落ち込んじゃってるよ。
　こんなことなら、下手なサプライズなんて
　企画しなきゃよかったかも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Now Alice is bummed. Man, if I knew this was
gonna be this much trouble, I never would've
attempted a surprise...)

fields.EN:
Alice, you didn't do anything wrong.
Neither did Tsuu or Ningyohime-san. No one did.
fields.JP:
アリスは悪くないよ。
つうも人魚姫さんも、誰も悪くない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice, this isn't your fault. Nor is it yours,
Otsuu and Little Mermaid.

fields.EN:
So uh, Alice... I've been thinking a lot about
our relationship, and I think we're ready to
take the next step.
fields.JP:
あー……それで、アリス。
いろいろ考えて、僕たちの関係に
きちんとけじめをつけたいと思ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So uh, Alice... I've been thinking a lot about
our relationship, and I think we're ready to
take the next step.

fields.EN:
I guess you already know, but for me, that
means being married to you.
fields.JP:
もう知ってると思うけど、
結婚、という形で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess you already know, but for me, that
means being married to you.

fields.EN:
(Huh? That's not the expression of someone
 who's happy.)
fields.JP: （あれ？　嬉しいっていう表情じゃないぞ）

fields.EN:
I love you Jack, but when it comes to marriage,
I'm not so sure I'm ready.
fields.JP:
わたし、あなたのことが大好きよ。
でも結婚となると、気が引けてしまうの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I love you Jack, but when it comes to marriage,
I'm not so sure I'm ready.

fields.EN:
Everyone is working so hard to rebuild the world.
I'd feel guilty being the only one
getting to be happy...
fields.JP:
今は世界を立て直すために
みんなががんばっているのに、
自分ばかり幸せになるなんて悪くて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're all working hard to rebuild life up
here. I feel guilty asking everyone to attend
our wedding.

fields.EN:
Otsuu-san and Ningyohime-san are already busy
with their own work, yet they stayed up late
preparing the surprise for me.
fields.JP:
現におつうさんや人魚姫さんは仕事だって
忙しいのに、夜遅くまでサプライズのための
準備をがんばってくれていたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I mean, look at Otsuu and Little Mermaid.
Even they found it hard to find time to help
you plan the proposal.

fields.EN:
Which is coincidentally what I overheard
them talking about...
fields.JP:
そこでたまたま、
二人の会話を聞いちゃったんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which is coincidentally what I overheard
them talking about...

fields.EN:
To think that I could be the cause of someone
having to work even harder saddens me.
fields.JP:
ええ……。わたしのために誰かの
手を煩わせているのかと思うと、
申し訳なくなってしまったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
To think that I could be the cause of someone
having to work even harder saddens me.

fields.EN:
(Alice is so kind. Even at a time like this,
 she's thinking about everyone else...)
fields.JP:
（アリスは優しいな。こんなときまで
　他の人のことを考えているんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(How thoughtful of her. I never even considered
what she's saying.)

fields.EN:
You have no idea how happy it makes me to
see how seriously you take us being together.
Marrying you would be a dream.
fields.JP:
ジャックがわたしとのことを
真剣に考えてくれていて、すごく嬉しいわ。
結婚なんて夢みたいな話よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You have no idea how happy it makes me to
see how seriously you take us being together.
Marrying you would be a dream.

fields.EN:
But there are things we need to handle first.
I am perfectly fine with how things are now.
fields.JP:
でも今はまだ大変なときだし、
わたしは今のままでも十分幸せよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But there are things we need to handle first.
I am perfectly fine with how things are now.

fields.EN:
So perhaps we should delay our wedding
for a while. Just while we settle in.
fields.JP:
だから結婚とかを考えるのはまだ早いっていうか、
もっと先でもいいんじゃないかと思うの
fields.LOCALIZED:
So perhaps we should delay our wedding
for a while. Just while we settle in.

fields.EN:
(I guess Alice is right. I'm fine with how things
are too. Maybe asking for more is selfish.)
fields.JP:
（……だけどアリスの言う通りだな。
　僕だって今でも幸せなのに、
　これ以上を求めるのは贅沢すぎるのかも）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess Alice is right. I'm fine with how things
are too. Maybe asking for more is selfish.)

fields.EN:
(That's right. It's not like she rejected me.
I should be happy with what I have.)
fields.JP:
（そうだ。
　なにもプロポーズを断られたわけじゃない。
　今あるものに満足しないと……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right. It's not like she rejected me.
I should be happy with what I have.)

fields.EN:
Got it. Guess I jumped the gun a little.
Sorry.
fields.JP:
わかったよ。
僕が一人で先走った感じになっちゃって、
ごめんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Got it. Guess I jumped the gun a little.
Sorry.

fields.EN: But whatever comes next, we do together.
fields.JP: これからのことは、また改めて二人で考えよう
fields.LOCALIZED: But whatever comes next, we do together.

fields.EN:
I suddenly feel exhausted.
I think I'll rest for a little while now.
fields.JP:
なんだか急に疲れちゃったな。
今からちょっと休むことにするよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Man, I'm beat. I'm gonna call it a night.

fields.EN:
Then I'll leave your room.
...Get some good rest.
fields.JP:
じゃあ、わたしは部屋を出るわね。
……ゆっくり休んで
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right, it's getting to be that time.
Sweet dreams.

fields.EN:
(Well, that was a disaster. But it's fine.
Alice feels the same as I do. Someday...)
fields.JP:
（うまくいかないものだな。でも大丈夫。
　アリスだって気持ちは同じはずだ。
　だから、いつかはきっと……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, that was a disaster. But it's fine.
Alice feels the same as I do. Someday...)

fields.JP: 赤ずきんさん、来てくれてありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED: Red Riding Hood! Thanks for meeting me.

fields.EN:
Why did you call me all the way out here?
Training on the beach?
fields.JP:
こんなところに呼び出すなんてどうしたの？
砂浜でトレーニング？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So what's the occasion? Why don't we
work out on the beach?

fields.EN:
I hadn't even thought of that...
As expected of you, Akazukin-san.
fields.JP:
その発想はなかったな……。
さすが赤ずきんさん
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't even think of that. Good idea,
Red Riding Hood.

fields.EN:
The sea is so beautiful, so...
could we talk while we take a little walk?
fields.JP:
あの、せっかく海もきれいだし、
少し散歩しながら話せないかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, when the beach looks this good,
we'd be crazy not to take a walk.

fields.EN:
It doesn't have to be a walk.
We could go running instead, you know?
fields.JP:
別に散歩じゃなくて
ランニングでもいいんだよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We don't have to walk. Why don't we race
to the end of the shore?

fields.JP:
なーんて、冗談だってば！
あはははは！

fields.EN:
(Knowing Akazukin-san,
 I think she was probably half serious...)
fields.JP:
（赤ずきんさんのことだから
　たぶん半分くらい本気だったと思う……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Knowing Red Riding Hood she's dead
serious.)

fields.EN:
I'm glad you seem well, Akazukin-san.
Have you gotten used to life as it is now?
fields.JP:
赤ずきんさんが元気そうで安心した。
今の生活にはもう慣れた？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Happy to see you're doing well. Settling in
well up here?

fields.EN:
Yeah! It's still hard, of course.
But it's fun clearing the wasteland
and steadily expanding our land.
fields.JP:
うん！　まあ大変ではあるけどね。
荒地を開拓して自分たちの土地を
どんどん増やすのは楽しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm! It's harder than I thought. You know,
rebuilding civilization and all. But I love a
good challenge.

fields.EN:
More than anything, thinking that this life
is something precious that's been entrusted to us
makes it feel worth working hard for...
fields.JP:
なにより、今の生活があたしたちに
託された大切ななにかだと思うと、
がんばりがいがあるんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But honestly, as tough as it gets sometimes,
we worked damn hard to be here. And that
makes it worth trying.

fields.EN:
Anyway, I'm just glad all of us
can finally live together in peace!
fields.JP:
ま、こうしてみんなで平和に暮らせるように
なってよかったねってこと！
fields.LOCALIZED: But look at us now, nothing can stop us!

fields.EN:
You've always been energetic,
but lately you seem even more alive than before.
fields.JP:
昔から元気だったけど、
最近はさらに生き生きとしてるね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like all this sun's made you even
brighter than usual.

fields.EN:
A lot happened before I got to where I am now.
How do I put it... I feel like I finally
found who I really am.
fields.JP:
これでもいろいろあって今に至ったからさ。
なんていうのかな……やっと自分っていうものを
見つけられた気がするんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've had a lot of time to think, and I'm
starting to feel like I finally found my place.

fields.EN:
The two of us have a lot to catch up on,
don't we?
fields.JP:
離れ離れになっている間に、
いろいろあったんだよね……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The two of us have a lot to catch up on,
don't we?

fields.EN:
Well, yeah.
It's embarrassing, so I'm not telling you about it, Jack!
fields.JP:
まーね。
情けないからジャックには教えてあげないけど！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe. But you won't hear it from me,
on account of all the crap I went through!

fields.EN:
But I want to know.
I mean... I want to know the parts of you
I don't know yet, Akazukin-san.
fields.JP:
でも、僕は知りたいな。
その……僕が知らない赤ずきんさんのことも
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I wanna know. You know...that side of
you I haven't seen yet.

fields.EN:
Huh? W-What's gotten into you?
It's rare for you to say something like that...
fields.JP:
えっ？　ど、どうしたの？
そんなこと言うなんて珍しい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? What's gotten into you? You sound
like you're possessed...

fields.JP: だって僕は、赤ずきんさんが好きだから……
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, it's because I love you...

fields.EN:
(I-I finally said it!
 My face feels like it's going to twitch from nerves!
 But don't look away, me! Keep looking at her!)
fields.JP:
（つ、ついに言ったぞ！
　緊張で顔が引きつりそう！
　でも目を逸らしちゃ駄目だ、僕！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Holy crap! I really just said that!
Quick, look away!)

fields.JP: あ……あはは、もー、冗談キツ……

fields.EN:
N-No way...
I gave up on trying to get anyone's approval
and started living however I wanted...
fields.JP:
いや……嘘でしょ？
だってあたしなんて、もう誰かに認められることも
放棄して、好き勝手生きてるような奴で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh... Really? I mean, I gave up on finding
my person a long time ago. That's why I'm
living for me now.

fields.EN:
Living however you want means
being honest about your own feelings
and living freely, right?
fields.JP:
好き勝手生きるっていうのは、
つまり自分の気持ちに正直に、
自由に生きるってことでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you're living for yourself, that means
you've found what makes you happy,
right? Living for yourself.

fields.EN: I... love that kind of Akazukin-san.
fields.JP:
僕はそんな赤ずきんさんが、
好き、なんです……
fields.LOCALIZED: I love that about you, Red Riding Hood.

fields.EN:
You saved me. You gave me courage.
At first, I was pretty in awe of you.
fields.JP:
あのとき赤ずきんさんに救ってもらって、
たくさんの元気をもらって、
最初のころはただ尊敬するばかりだった
fields.LOCALIZED:
You saved me. You gave me courage.
At first, I was pretty in awe of you.

fields.EN:
I was worried about you after everything that happened,
but when I saw you again after so long,
you seemed even more attractive than before, and, um...
fields.JP:
その……あんなことがあって心配してたけど、
久しぶりに会ったら前よりも一層魅力的に
なっていて、えっと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... I got worried thinking about all the
dangers your were in. But seeing you now
made all that worth it. Um...

fields.EN:
I realized right away my feelings for you.
Deeply and truly.
fields.JP:
やっぱり僕は赤ずきんさんのことを
好きなんだって、再確認できたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I realized right away my feelings for you.
Deeply and truly.

fields.EN:
...Thank you.
But I'm probably not the kind of person
you're looking for, Jack.
fields.JP:
……ありがとう。
でも、たぶんあたしはジャックが
求めてるような人じゃないよ
fields.LOCALIZED: ...Thank you. But I'm not who you think I am.

fields.EN:
I can't put on that big-sister act like before,
or stand at the front and lead everyone along anymore.
fields.JP:
もう前みたいにお姉さんぶって振る舞うのも、
先頭に立ってみんなを引っ張っていこうとか、
そういうのもできなくて
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm done being a role model and the leader
for everyone. I can't do it anymore.

fields.EN:
If you left me to myself, I'd train all day.
I'm really just someone who loves training, so...
fields.JP:
放っておいたら一日中でも体を鍛えてるような、
ただのトレーニング大好きな奴で、だから……
fields.LOCALIZED: Without you, I'd just train all day. So...

fields.EN:
None of that matters.
I'm not asking you to fill some kind of role
for me, Akazukin-san.
fields.JP:
そんなのはどうでもいいよ。
僕は赤ずきんさんになにか役割みたいなものを
求めているわけじゃないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't care about amy of that. I don't want
you to be anything.

fields.EN:
You seem like you live however you please,
but you're actually always considerate of others,
and you can't ignore someone who's in trouble...
fields.JP:
気ままに生きているようで、
実は周りの人を気遣っていて、
困っている人を放っておけなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You act super cool in front of others, but
you're always the first to lend a hand.
Everyone knows how kind you are.

fields.EN:
Watching you, I can't help loving the person you are.
That's the Akazukin-san I want.
fields.JP:
見ていると心根が愛おしくなる、
そんな『赤ずきん』さんがいいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's what drew me to you. That's the
you I fell for.

fields.EN: (Do I sound like an idiot? It was all true...)
fields.JP:
（か、かっこつけすぎたかな？
　でもこれは僕の本心だし……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Do I sound like an idiot? It was all true...)

fields.EN: (What? I made her cry?! Aw, damn it.)
fields.JP:
（えっ、泣かせちゃった！？
　な、なにか悪いこと言ったかな）
fields.LOCALIZED: (What? I made her cry?! Aw, damn it.)

fields.JP: あ、あのっ、ごめんなさい！　えっと、その……

fields.EN: No. It's not your fault. Um...
fields.JP:
ち、違くて……。
えっと、ジャックは悪くなくて、その……
fields.LOCALIZED: No. It's not your fault. Um...

fields.EN: Argh. It's not coming out right!
fields.JP: ……うー。いい言葉が出てこない！
fields.LOCALIZED: Argh. It's not coming out right!

fields.EN:
Fine! If I can't put it into words,
I'll show you with my body!
I'm going to hug you!
fields.JP:
もういい！
言葉が出ないなら体で表現する！
抱きついてやる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Forget it! Since I can't find the words,
I'll use my body! Hug me!

fields.EN: I've loved you all along too!
fields.JP: あたしもずっと大好きだった！

fields.EN:
I could never lie about something like that.
Don't you know me, Jack?
fields.JP:
あたしはこういう冗談は言えない性質なの！
ジャックだって知ってるでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I could never lie about something like that.
Don't you know me, Jack?

fields.EN:
(Right, that's who she is...
 I fell in love with Akazukin-san because she's
 always so straightforward and gives everything her all...)
fields.JP:
（ああ、そうだった……。
　いつでもまっすぐで全力な赤ずきんさんが、
　僕は好きだったんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Oh, there she is. I love when she's excited.)

fields.EN:
Akazukin-san...
Will you stay with me forever?
fields.JP:
赤ずきんさん……。
これからはずっと一緒にいてくれる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood... Wanna be together
forever?

fields.EN:
Of course. I wouldn't let you go even if you
wanted to.
fields.JP:
もちろんだよ。嫌になったって言っても
離れてあげないんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course. I wouldn't let you go even if you
wanted to.

fields.EN:
Geez... Now I'm going to lean on you all I want.
Don't go getting disillusioned with me over it!
fields.JP:
もう……こうなったらいっぱい甘えてやる。
それで幻滅したりしないでよね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sheesh... Hope you're ready to spoil me.
You better get used to it, buster!

fields.EN:
(Today was supposed to be a thrilling beach date
 with Akazukin-san! So how did it come to this...?)
fields.JP:
（今日は赤ずきんさんとウキウキ海水浴デート！
　のはずだったのに、なんでこんなことに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Man, today was supposed to be a relaxing
beach date with Red Riding Hood. How did
we get here...?)

fields.EN:
Jack, stop being so dramatic. We only
swam for two hours. You look winded.
fields.JP:
ジャックってば大げさだなぁ。
二時間ぶっ通しで泳いだだけで
そんなバテバテになっちゃうなんて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, stop being so dramatic. We only
swam for two hours. You look winded.

fields.EN: Anyone would...if they swam for two hours.
fields.JP: 二時間ぶっ通しは、普通バテるよ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Anyone would...if they swam for two hours.

fields.EN:
(Akazukin-san looks dazzling in her swimsuit...
 But this pounding in my chest isn't romantic excitement.
 I think it's actual palpitations and shortness of breath...)
fields.JP:
（ああ、赤ずきんさんの水着姿がまぶしい……。
　でもこの胸のドキドキは、トキメキではなく
　動悸息切れのたぐいだと思う……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Boy, Red Riding Hood looks so cute in
her swimsuit. My heart's pounding out
of my chest. I'm outta breath.)

fields.EN:
Mm. I thought this would be a piece of
cake for you.
fields.JP:
んー、これくらいの泳ぎなら
大丈夫かと思ったんだけどな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mm. I thought this would be a piece of
cake for you.

fields.EN:
Haha... I may have underestimated
your bottomless stamina, Akazukin-san...
fields.JP:
はは、赤ずきんさんの無限の体力を
ちょっと舐めていたかも……
fields.LOCALIZED: Haha. Guess I underestimated how fit you are.

fields.EN:
All right, looks like you can't swim any more.
Then let's make the next one the last.
fields.JP:
仕方ない、もう泳ぐのは無理そうだね。
それなら次で最後にしよっか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine. If we're nearing the end of our swim,
then let's make the next one count.

fields.EN:
Let's swim out to that little island over there,
and then we'll call it a day!
fields.JP:
あそこに見える小島までひと泳ぎして、
おしまいにしよう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
First one to reach the island wins, then
we'll call it!

fields.EN:
(A long-distance swim at the very end?!
 And wait, we're still swimming after all!)
fields.JP:
（最後の最後で遠泳！？
　っていうか結局泳いでるんだけど！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(All the way over there?! I thought we were
finishing up!)

fields.EN:
Wait. We'll need a boat to make it there.
My arms won't paddle that far.
fields.JP:
あの小島って、普段は船で行ってる距離だよ……？
さすがにギブです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait. We'll need a boat to make it there.
My arms won't paddle that far.

fields.EN:
Whaaat? It's just the two of us out here.
I was thinking we could have a seaside
rendezvous.
fields.JP:
えー。せっかく二人っきりで海に来たんだから、
ジャックと一緒にあそこまで行きたいのにー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whaaat? It's just the two of us out here.
I was thinking we could have a seaside
rendezvous.

fields.EN:
I know! Jack, why don't you hop on my back?
I'll swim us over!
fields.JP:
そうだ！　ジャックはあたしの背中に
つかまっていればいいよ。
あたしが引っ張って泳ぐからさ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know! Jack, why don't you hop on my back?
I'll swim us over!

fields.JP: そ、それはラクそうだけど……

fields.EN:
(That would be pathetic. I would die of
embarrassment.)
fields.JP:
（女の子に引っ張ってもらう僕って、
　すごく情けないというか
　間抜けな絵面じゃないかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That would be pathetic. I would die of
embarrassment.)

fields.EN:
(No, more importantly, swimming that far
 might actually be dangerous.)
fields.JP:
（いや、それよりもあんな遠くまで泳ぐのは
　危ないかもしれない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Actually, it's a safety hazard for her to pull
us out there.)

fields.EN: Akazukin-san, maybe we should call it for today...
fields.JP: 赤ずきんさん、やっぱり今日は……
fields.LOCALIZED: Red Riding Hood. Let's call it a day.

fields.EN: Hahaha. Sorry. I pulled you so hard we fell.
fields.JP:
あはは、ごめん、ごめん。
あたしが急に引っ張ったせいで
一緒に転んじゃったね
fields.LOCALIZED: Hahaha. Sorry. I pulled you so hard we fell.

fields.EN: Are you all right, Akazukin-san...? Wait...
fields.JP: 赤ずきんさんこそ大丈夫……って

fields.EN:
(Oh man. She's on top of me. This is way
inappropriate.)
fields.JP:
（あ、赤ずきんさんが僕にまたがる格好に……！
　このアングルはちょっとまずい）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh man. She's on top of me. This is way
inappropriate.)

fields.JP: えっと、大丈夫そうならもう……

fields.EN: Jack... you've gotten more muscular than before.
fields.JP: ……ジャック、前より筋肉ついてきたね
fields.LOCALIZED: You've been working out, haven't you Jack?

fields.EN:
Huh? Well, I have been doing a lot of labor
lately.
fields.JP:
え？　まあ、そうだね。
最近は肉体労働も多いから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Well, I have been doing a lot of labor
lately.
You mind if I touch your arm?

fields.EN:
(Ooh, that tickles a little...
 But Akazukin-san's hands are so soft...)
fields.JP:
（う、ちょっとくすぐったい……。
　でも赤ずきんさんの手、柔らかいな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh. That tickles... Red Riding Hood's got
soft hands.)

fields.EN: Look at Mister Muscles. So toned and warm...
fields.JP:
やっぱり引き締まってるね。
それに、あったかい……
fields.LOCALIZED: Look at Mister Muscles. So toned and warm...

fields.EN:
(Well, after being made to swim that much,
 of course I'm hot...)
fields.JP:
（そりゃ、あれだけ泳がされたら
　熱くもなるよ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, that might be the sunburn.
Of course I'm warm out here...)

fields.JP: えへへ……ジャックあったかーい

fields.EN:
Um, Akazukin-san?
Could you move away a little...
fields.JP:
あの、赤ずきんさんっ？
ちょっと離れて……
fields.LOCALIZED: Um, Red Riding Hood. Could you get off me?

fields.EN:
No. we're on a date. I'm allowed to hog
you all to myself.
fields.JP:
やだー。今日はデートなんだから
あたしがジャックを独占していいんだもーん
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. we're on a date. I'm allowed to hog
you all to myself.

fields.EN:
You're always so busy and so popular.
I never get a moment alone with you.
fields.JP:
ジャックはいつも忙しいし、人気者だし、
こうしてジャックを独り占めできる機会なんて
滅多にないんだからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're always so busy and so popular.
I never get a moment alone with you.

fields.EN:
Today's Jack belongs to me,
so no complaining even if I squeeze you tight!
fields.JP:
今日のジャックはあたしのものなんだから、
ぎゅーってされても文句言わないの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So today, you're mine. Don't you dare
complain about it either!

fields.EN:
(Akazukin-san is completely in clingy mode now.
 Not that I'm complaining, of course.)
fields.JP:
（赤ずきんさん、すっかり甘えんぼモードだ。
　もちろん嬉しいけどね？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Red Riding Hood's in a doting mood again.
But that's not so bad, right?)

fields.EN: Mm. Jack, I just love you!
fields.JP: んー、ジャック好きー。大好きー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Mm. Jack, I just love you!

fields.EN: How about you, Jack? Do you love me?
fields.JP: ねえ、ジャックは？　あたしのこと好き？
fields.LOCALIZED: How about you, Jack? Do you love me?

fields.JP: もー、恥ずかしがらないでちゃんと言ってよ

fields.EN: Yeah, of course. I love you.
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah, of course. I love you.

fields.EN: Hurrah! You deserve a treat for being honest.
fields.JP:
あたしも！
正直に言えたジャックにご褒美あげるね
fields.LOCALIZED: Hurrah! You deserve a treat for being honest.

fields.EN: What?! You're kissing me in public?!
fields.JP: キ、キス？　こ、こんなところで……！
fields.LOCALIZED: What?! You're kissing me in public?!

fields.JP: ちょっと待って、赤ずきんさん！

fields.EN: Boo. I wanted to kiss some more.
fields.JP: ぶー。もっとキスしたかったのに……
fields.LOCALIZED: Boo. I wanted to kiss some more.

fields.JP: だ、誰かに見られたらどうするの！

fields.EN:
No one comes out here.
Besides, today's Jack belongs to me,
so don't say things like that!
fields.JP:
こんなところ誰も来ないよ。
それより今日のジャックはあたしのもの
なんだから、そーゆーこと言わないの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no one around. Quit squirming and
kiss me already!

fields.EN: (What kind of ridiculous logic is that?!)
Okay. We've had our break. Now can we swim?
fields.JP:
さあ、休憩できたね。
これでまた泳げるでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay. We've had our break. Now can we swim?

fields.EN:
We've still got plenty of fun waiting tonight too...
Come on, let's go!
fields.JP:
まだまだ夜もお楽しみはあるんだから……
早く行こう！
fields.LOCALIZED: The day's still young. Hurry, let's go!

fields.EN: Please, just a few more minutes!
fields.JP: せ、せめてもう少し休ませて～！
fields.LOCALIZED: Please, just a few more minutes!

fields.EN:
A few years later.
The new village was developing smoothly,
and life had begun to stabilize—
fields.JP:
数年後。
新しい村づくりも順調に進み、
生活も安定してきたころ――。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A few years later...
Their village was beginning to flourish,
and the settlement became a haven for all.

fields.EN:
Wow. I didn't know the woods went this deep.
Looks like ruins in here.
fields.JP:
へー、森の奥にこんなとこがあったんだ。
ずいぶん古そうな建物だなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow. I didn't know the woods went this deep.
Looks like ruins in here.

fields.EN: Jack's waiting, so I gotta hurry.
fields.JP:
おっと、早く中に入らないと。
ジャックを待たせちゃ悪いもんね
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack's waiting, so I gotta hurry.

fields.EN:
Huh? Why are Tsuu and Ningyo here?
Where's Jack?
fields.JP:
あれ、なんでおつうと人魚がいるの？
ジャックは？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. What are you two doing here, Otsuu
and Little Mermaid? Where's Jack?

fields.EN:
Jack will come when he's ready. No need
to fret.
fields.JP:
ジャックは準備が終わってから来るよ。
まあ細かいことは気にしないでくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack will come when he's ready. No need
to fret.

fields.JP: そうそう。気にしない、気にしない

fields.EN:
Why are you holding blindfolds? And why
are you creeping towards me?
fields.JP:
って、なんで目隠し持ってるの？
なんでこっちにじりじり近づいてくるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why are you holding blindfolds? And why
are you creeping towards me?

fields.JP: おねーちゃん、大人しくしててね

fields.EN:
Hey, why are you blindfolding me?
I hope for your sake it isn't something
stupid...
fields.JP:
ちょっと、なんで目隠しするの？
あんたたちのことだから
変なことはしないと思うけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, why are you blindfolding me?
I hope for your sake it isn't something
stupid...

fields.EN:
It's fine.
We're just going to take some of your clothes off.
fields.JP:
大丈夫だ。
ちょっと服を脱がせたりするだけだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Everything's fine. Now for a wardrobe change.

fields.EN:
What? Wardrobe?! Just what is going on here?!
Out with it!
fields.JP:
えっ！？　なにそれ！
それはさすがに説明してくれないと困るよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What? Wardrobe?! Just what is going on here?!
Out with it!

fields.EN:
Don't struggle, you'll tear it!
Otsuu-chan worked so hard to make it!
fields.JP:
暴れないで、破れちゃう！
おつうちゃんが苦労して作ったやつなのにー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sit still, or it'll rip! Otsuu worked hard on this
all day.

fields.EN:
Akazukin, we won't do anything bad to you,
so hold still and let us take your clothes off!
fields.JP:
赤ずきん、悪いようにはしないから
大人しく服を脱がせてくれ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood, I promise it's for your own
good, so let us take your clothes off!

fields.JP: ぎゃー！　ヘンタイー！

fields.EN:
Even with her calling us perverts,
we somehow managed to get her changed...
fields.JP:
ヘンタイと罵られながらも、
なんとか着替えさせたぞ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Took us long enough, but the deed is done.

fields.EN: Your explanation is what made her misunderstand!
fields.JP: あんたの説明が誤解を招いたんでしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe you should've been upfront from
the start!

fields.JP: おねーちゃん、とってもきれいだよ！

fields.EN: You think...? I don't know if this is my style.
fields.JP:
そ、そうかな……。
あたしなんかがこんなの着ても
似合わないんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED: You think...? I don't know if this is my style.

fields.EN:
Hime says you're beautiful.
Are you doubting her words?
fields.JP:
姫がきれいだと言っているのに、
その言葉を疑うのかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You dare question my princess? She called
you marvelous.

fields.EN:
You really are beautiful today.
I guarantee it.
fields.JP:
今日の君は本当にきれいだよ。
僕が保証する
fields.LOCALIZED: And I must say, she's right.

fields.EN:
Well, we'll take our leave now.
I'd rather not get kicked by a horse.
fields.JP:
さて、僕たちはこれで退場するよ。
馬に蹴られてはたまらないからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we'll be off now. I'm done poking the
bear.

fields.EN: Sis, have some confidence in yourself!
fields.JP: おねーちゃん、自信もってね！

fields.EN:
...This dress really is beautiful.
Almost too beautiful—I feel a little restless in it.
fields.JP:
……ホント、きれいなドレス。
きれいすぎてちょっと落ち着かないけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
This dress is gorgeous. I hardly do it justice.
It's too pretty.

fields.EN:
Jack! Oh, look at you. Or should I say,
look at us?
fields.JP:
ジャック！　なにその恰好……って、
あたしも人のこと言えないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack! Oh, look at you. Or should I say,
look at us?

fields.EN:
Sorry for surprising you.
That dress looks wonderful on you.
fields.JP:
驚かせてごめんね。
そのドレス、すごく似合ってるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry for the runaround. You look even
prettier than I dreamt you would.

fields.EN:
Haha, Otsuu and Ningyo said so too.
This is kind of embarrassing.
fields.JP:
あはは、おつうと人魚も言ってくれたよ。
なんか照れちゃうな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha. Otsuu and Little Mermaid were
just as gaga about it. Now I'm blushing.

fields.EN:
So what's this about? Some elaborate
game of dress-up?
fields.JP:
それで、なんの用なの？
こんな格好までさせちゃってさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So what's this about? Some elaborate
game of dress-up?

fields.EN:
Yeah... There's something
I wanted to tell you properly, Akazukin-san.
fields.JP:
うん……。改めて赤ずきんさんに
伝えたいことがあったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah... I actually wanted to tell you something.

fields.EN:
The reason Alice, the others, and I all met
and made it this far is because of you
from the very beginning, Akazukin-san.
fields.JP:
僕やアリスや他のみんなが出会って、
今ここまで来られたのは、もともとは
全部赤ずきんさんのおかげだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You found me, Alice, and the rest of us.
We wouldn't be here without you, Red
Riding Hood.

fields.EN:
At first I respected you.
Little by little, I started thinking of you
like a dependable older sister.
fields.JP:
始めは尊敬の気持ちがあって、
徐々に頼りがいのあるお姉さんみたいに
思うようになっていった
fields.LOCALIZED:
At first I really looked up to you, but the
closer we got, the more things I found to
admire.

fields.EN:
Hehe...
But once we started dating, I learned
that you have a delicate, girlish side too, Akazukin-san.
fields.JP:
だけど付き合ってみて、
赤ずきんさんが繊細で女の子らしい
ところもあるってわかっていった
fields.LOCALIZED:
And then we started dating, and I discovered
this whole delicate side of you.

fields.EN:
Even when you look like you've moved past everything
and seem cheerful, you still worry about everyone,
and sometimes get depressed under the covers...
fields.JP:
いろんなことが吹っ切れて元気そうになったように
見えても、実はまだみんなのために悩んだり、
たまに布団の中で落ち込んでいたり……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know how far you've come, but I also know
how exhausted you are taking care of the
others too. I see you holed up in bed.

fields.EN:
Thankfully those days are few and far
between now. All thanks to you.
fields.JP:
前ほどは落ち込まなくなったよ。
それに、あたしにはジャックがいるからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thankfully those days are few and far
between now. All thanks to you.

fields.EN: That means so much to me.
fields.JP: そ、そう言ってもらえると嬉しいな
fields.LOCALIZED: That means so much to me.

fields.EN:
How should I put it...?
Every time you overcome another trial, Akazukin-san,
you become more and more attractive to me.
fields.JP:
なんていうのかな……。
赤ずきんさんは試練を乗り越えるたびに、
どんどん魅力的になっていくんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This might sound weird. But the more you
lead, the more attracted I am to you.

fields.EN:
After we started dating, you began leaning on me too,
and the contrast with how you usually are
is something I'm really drawn to...
fields.JP:
付き合ってからは僕に甘えてくれたりして、
そういう普段とのギャップにも
すごく惹かれたりして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ever since we started going out, you've let
your guard down. I love seeing this new
side to you. It makes me smile.

fields.EN:
I want to keep watching that Akazukin-san
from closer than anyone, forever...
In other words...!
fields.JP:
そんな赤ずきんさんを、これからも
一番近くでずっと見ていたくて……。
つまり……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want to be the one by your side, forever!
So...!

fields.JP: ぼ、僕と結婚してください！

fields.EN:
(I just put it all out there! But she's not
reacting.)
fields.JP:
（がんばって伝えたぞ！
　なんか赤ずきんさんの反応は薄いけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I just put it all out there! But she's not
reacting.)

fields.EN: I'm over the moon, but...you beat me to it
fields.JP:
嬉しいなぁ。
……でも先越されちゃったか
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm over the moon, but...you beat me to it

fields.EN:
Ta-da.
I had something like this ready.
fields.JP:
じゃーん。
こんなものを用意していたんだけど

fields.EN: Hehe. I wanted to propose to you too, Jack.
fields.JP:
へへ……実はあたしもジャックに
プロポーズしたいなーって思ってたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. I wanted to propose to you too, Jack.

fields.EN:
I even got rings for us both, but I kept
waiting for the perfect time. So you
beat me to it.
fields.JP:
指輪まで用意しちゃったんだけど、
タイミングを見計らってるうちに
ジャックに先を越されちゃったってわけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I even got rings for us both, but I kept
waiting for the perfect time. So you
beat me to it.

fields.JP: え、あ、その、そう……だったんだね

fields.EN:
So put this ring on my finger. You know which
one, right?
fields.JP:
この指輪、あたしの指にはめて。
どこにはめればいいかは、わかるよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So put this ring on my finger. You know which
one, right?

fields.JP: その通り！　さっそくお願い

fields.EN:
Thanks! Now it's my turn to place it on yours.
Here we go.
fields.JP:
ありがと！　じゃあ今度は
あたしがジャックの左手の薬指に、っと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks! Now it's my turn to place it on yours.
Here we go.

fields.JP: ありがとう、赤ずきんさん

fields.EN: It really does feel like we're married now.
fields.JP: なんかこうすると本当の夫婦みたいだね
fields.LOCALIZED: It really does feel like we're married now.

fields.JP:
な……なってくれますか？
本当の夫婦に……

fields.EN:
Of course! I already can't stand the thought
of living without you.
fields.JP:
なるに決まってるでしょ！
あたしはもうジャックなしには
生きていけないんだからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course! I already can't stand the thought
of living without you.

fields.EN:
Now that the statute of limitations has passed,
I'll tell you the truth: when I first rescued you,
I thought you looked pretty unreliable.
fields.JP:
もう時効だから本当のこと言うけど、
最初にジャックを助けたときは
頼りなさそうな奴だなーなんて思ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's high time that I told you the truth too.
When we first met, I thought you were a
real screw-up.

fields.EN:
But now look at you. Mister Dependable.
As usual, it goes to show that I'm a poor
judge of character.
fields.JP:
あのジャックが今ではこんな頼れる男に
なったんだから、相変わらずあたしは
人を見る目がなかったってことかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
But now look at you. Mister Dependable.
As usual, it goes to show that I'm a poor
judge of character.

fields.EN:
But I've never been happier to be wrong in
my life. Who knew I could fall so deep in love.
fields.JP:
あたしがジャックにベタ惚れしちゃうなんて、
嬉しい誤算だったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I've never been happier to be wrong in
my life. Who knew I could fall so deep in love.

fields.EN:
If you're head over heels, then so am I.
I can't even imagine a life without you anymore,
Akazukin-san...
fields.JP:
ベタ惚れなら、僕も同じだよ。
もう赤ずきんさんがいない人生なんて
考えられないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I've fallen just as deep in love as you.
It's hard to think of what life was like before.

fields.EN: So it's you and me, forever?
fields.JP: ずっと一緒にいてくれる？
fields.LOCALIZED: So it's you and me, forever?

fields.EN: Forever. I promise never to let you go.
fields.JP:
もちろんだよ。
絶対に君の手を離さないって約束する
fields.LOCALIZED: Forever. I promise never to let you go.

fields.EN: Thank you. I love you, Jack.
fields.JP: ありがとう。愛してる、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED: Thank you. I love you, Jack.

fields.EN:
...Yeah... I'm going to be happy.
Please keep watching over me from now on...
fields.JP:
……うん……幸せになるよ。
どうかこれからも見守っていてね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow... This is happiness. Never let me go,
Jack.

fields.EN:
(The day has finally come...
 Today I'm finally going to confess to Oyayubihime!)
fields.JP:
（ついにこの日が来た……。
　今日こそは親指姫に告白するぞ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The time has finally come. I get to confess
my true feelings to Thumbelina!)

fields.EN:
(Oyayubihime is so responsible that I figured
 she'd arrive before the time we agreed on,
 so I came forty minutes early myself.)
fields.JP:
（しっかり者の親指姫のことだから、
　呼び出した時間より早めに来るはずと思って、
　四十分も早く来ちゃったよ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Knowing how well-kept she is, I had a
feeling she'd be early, so I came forty
minutes earlier.)

fields.EN:
(Was that too soon...? I'd rather be the
one waiting instead of making her wait.)
fields.JP:
（さすがに早すぎたかな？
　でも親指姫を待たせるよりはずっといいよね。
　早く来ないかなぁ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Was that too soon...? I'd rather be the
one waiting instead of making her wait.)

fields.EN:
(...Thirty minutes have passed and she's
not here. Well, plenty of time before we
are supposed to meet.)
fields.JP:
（……三十分経ってもまだ来ない。
　いや、それでも待ち合わせの時間までは
　まだ十分もあるんだけどね？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(...Thirty minutes have passed and she's
not here. Well, plenty of time before we
are supposed to meet.)

fields.EN:
(Hmm. I thought Oyayubihime would arrive
quite a bit early, but maybe I guessed wrong... Hm?)
fields.JP:
（うーん。
　親指姫ならだいぶ早めに来ると思っていたけど、
　予想が外れたかな……ん？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm. I thought for sure that she would
have been here by now... Hm?)

fields.EN:
(A familiar pair of red twin-tails
 is bobbing into view from behind that rock...)
fields.JP:
（あの岩の陰から、
　見覚えのある赤毛のツインテ―ルが
　ぴょこぴょこ見えている……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I see a red-haired girl with pigtails over
by those rocks.)

fields.EN:
You scared me! Give me a warning next
time, you jerk!
fields.JP:
い、いきなりびっくりするじゃない！
声かけるんなら、かけるって言ってよね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You scared me! Give me a warning next
time, you jerk!

fields.JP: えーと、なにをしてたの？

fields.EN:
Well, I came early, but you came earlier than
I did. Ugh. Why'd you get here so fast?!
fields.JP:
時間に遅れないように早めにきたら、
それより早くあんたが来ていたの。
なんでこんなに早く来るのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I came early, but you came earlier than
I did. Ugh. Why'd you get here so fast?!

fields.EN: Because of that, I felt awkward and stuck!
fields.JP:
おかげでなんとなく気まずくて、
出て行きづらくなっちゃったでしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Because of that, I felt awkward and stuck!

fields.EN:
Sorry, sorry. I knew you'd come early, so
I wanted to beat you here so you wouldn't
have to wait.
fields.JP:
ごめん、ごめん。
君はしっかりしてるから早く来ると思って、
待たせないように僕も早めに来たんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry, sorry. I knew you'd come early, so
I wanted to beat you here so you wouldn't
have to wait.

fields.EN:
Wait... You did all that for me?
Ugh. You didn't have to...
fields.JP:
え……なによ、わたしのためだったの？
余計な気遣いなんだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait... You did all that for me?
Ugh. You didn't have to...

fields.EN:
I guess it can't be helped. So what did
you want?
fields.JP:
まあ、そういうことなら仕方ないわね。
それで、こんなところに呼び出して
なんの用なのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess it can't be helped. So what did
you want?

fields.EN:
I wanted to take a stroll with you and
chat. Is that okay?
fields.JP:
少し散歩がてら話がしたくて。
いいかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wanted to take a stroll with you and
chat. Is that okay?

fields.JP: は、話っ？　べ、別にいいけど……

fields.EN:
(Huh? Oyayubihime is acting kind of suspicious today...
 Or am I imagining it?)
fields.JP:
（あれ？　なんか今日の親指姫、
　どこか挙動不審のような……。
　でも気のせいかな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? Why's Thumbelina acting so weird?
Did I imagine that?)

fields.EN: Sand can be hard to walk in. You okay?
fields.JP: 足元、砂で歩きにくいけど大丈夫？
fields.LOCALIZED: Sand can be hard to walk in. You okay?

fields.EN:
Oh, right... Just fine. The beach is nice...
Yup.
fields.JP:
あ、ええ……。へ、平気よ。
海がすごいいい感じだし……うん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, right... Just fine. The beach is nice...
Yup.

fields.EN:
(She's acting awkward. I wonder what's
wrong.)
fields.JP:
（やっぱりなんか不自然だな。
　どうしたんだろう……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's acting awkward. I wonder what's
wrong.)

fields.JP: ねえ、もしかして緊張してる？

fields.EN:
Wha? What the hell?! Why would I be
nervous around you?!
fields.JP:
ふえっ？　なな、なによそれ！
誰があんた相手に緊張しなきゃなんないのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha? What the hell?! Why would I be
nervous around you?!

fields.EN:
(No, she's definitely nervous, right?
 If I point it out, she'll probably get mad again...)
fields.JP:
（いや、やっぱり緊張してるよね？
　指摘したらまた怒られそうだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, that confirms it. But I need to act
delicately from here...)

fields.EN: Well, um... I'm perfectly fine... Ugh.
fields.JP:
わたしは、その……別に普通で……。
うー……。…………
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, um... I'm perfectly fine... Ugh.

fields.EN:
ARGH! If you got something to say,
say it!
fields.JP:
あーもうっ！
要件があるんならさっさと言いなさい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
ARGH! If you got something to say,
say it!

fields.EN:
(D-Don't tell me she's figured out
that I'm going to confess. Wait, seriously?)
fields.JP:
（ま、まさかこれ、告白のことを察してるのかな。
　え、うそ本当に？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wait. Is she expecting me to say something
in particular? What the... Really?)

fields.EN:
(Wh-Wh-What do I do?!
 If that's true, now I'm getting nervous too...!)
fields.JP:
（うわ、どどどっ、どうしよう！
　だとしたらこっちまで緊張してきた……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Crap. Now what do I do?! My hands
are getting super sweaty!)

fields.EN:
(But if she already knows about the confession,
then all the more reason I have to steel myself!
Calm down. Calm down, me...)
fields.JP:
（あー、でも告白のことがバレてるなら、
　なおさら覚悟を決めるしかない！
　落ち着け、落ち着け僕……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But if she's expecting some kind of
confession, then I should give her one!
Come on, man.)

fields.EN:
At first I wondered if you hated me.
But when I saw how you looked out for your sisters
and everyone around you, I realized how kind you are.
fields.JP:
最初は嫌われているのかなって思ってた。
でも妹たちや周りの人を気遣う様子を見て、
優しい子なんだってわかったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought you hated me before, but seeing
how you treat your sisters made me realize
you just give out tough love.

fields.EN:
There was a point actually where I started
to hope you'd give the same to me.
fields.JP:
実を言うと、僕にもあんな風に
接してほしいなってうらやましく
思ったりもしたな
fields.LOCALIZED:
There was a point actually where I started
to hope you'd give the same to me.

fields.EN:
But you're just a little bad at being honest,
and little by little I realized you were
looking out for me in all kinds of ways too...
fields.JP:
でも君は少し素直じゃないだけで、
僕にもいろいろ気を遣ってくれていることに
少しずつ気づいていって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But even though you never said it outright,
I always knew you had my back.

fields.EN:
Then I realized I'd never once seen you
lean on anyone else.
fields.JP:
そうしたら、君が他の人に甘えているところを
見たことがないってことにも気がついたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Eventually, I realized that you just like to
handle stuff yourself.

fields.EN:
Watching you stay on guard without relying on anyone,
I started wondering if there was some way
I could support you.
fields.JP:
誰にも甘えずに気を張っている
君を見ているうちに、なにか力に
なれないかなって思うようになった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sometimes you hang yourself out to dry
working so hard. I wondered to myself
how I could alleviate that burden.

fields.EN:
After giving it more thought, I began to
realize that I had feelings for you.
fields.JP:
なんでそんな風に思うんだろうって
考えたら、ああ、君のことが好きなんだ
って自覚できたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
After giving it more thought, I began to
realize that I had feelings for you.

fields.EN:
Hmph... You really are strange.
Actually, you're a masochist. To like someone
who spits insults like me all the time...
fields.JP:
ふん……。あんたも物好きね。
っていうかドМね。わたしみたいに
悪態つきまくる奴が好きだなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph... Now he's a psychologist.
Classic man. I can't believe you like
a foul-mouthed girl like me.

fields.EN: Haha. The heart wants what the heart wants.
fields.JP:
ははっ。それで君を好きになれたなら、
僕は別にいいけどね
fields.LOCALIZED: Haha. The heart wants what the heart wants.

fields.JP: や、やっぱりあんたって変な奴だわ

fields.EN: Sorry, I lied. I should be honest with you.
fields.JP:
うそ……ごめん。
わたしもいい加減、素直にならなきゃね……
fields.LOCALIZED: Sorry, I lied. I should be honest with you.

fields.EN:
When we were separated, I only made it
through by thinking of you.
fields.JP:
あんたと離れ離れになっていた間、
絶望しないでいられたのは、
あんたのおかげだったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
When we were separated, I only made it
through by thinking of you.

fields.EN:
Whenever you came to mind,
it felt like hope would well up inside me...
Yeah. It made my heart feel lighter.
fields.JP:
あんたのことをふと思い出すと、
希望が湧いてくる気がして……。
うん。心が楽になったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Every time you came to mind, I felt hope.
Yes. It strengthed my will.

fields.EN: Jack, I love you back. I think.
fields.JP:
ジャック、わたしもあんたが好きよ。
……たぶん
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack, I love you back. I think.

fields.EN:
The 'probably' was unnecessary.
But... thank you...!
fields.JP:
たぶんは余計だよ。
でも、ありがとう……！
fields.LOCALIZED: You think, huh? Thanks I guess!

fields.EN:
(Huh? Oyayubihime is resting her head
 against my chest...)
fields.JP: （え、なに？　親指姫が僕の胸に頭を……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? Thumbelina's leaning her head against
my chest.)

fields.EN: I can't see your face that way.
fields.JP: あのー、それじゃ顔が見えないよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: I can't see your face that way.

fields.EN: I'm doing it so you can't see!
fields.JP: 見えないようにしてるんでしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm doing it so you can't see!

fields.EN:
I never expected us both to feel this way.
Honestly, I don't know how to handle
feeling this happy and fulfilled.
fields.JP:
こ、こんな両想いとか、正直嬉しすぎて
胸がいっぱいで、どんな顔すればいいのか
全然わかんないの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I never expected us both to feel this way.
Honestly, I don't know how to handle
feeling this happy and fulfilled.

fields.EN: Ugh. Let me just savor this for a while!
fields.JP: もうっ、しばらくの間こうしていなさい！
fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh. Let me just savor this for a while!

fields.EN:
(I love that part of her that can't quite be honest too...
 But if I said that, she'd probably get mad,
 so I'd better keep quiet.)
fields.JP:
（そんな素直じゃないところも
　好きなんだけど……そんなこと言ったら
　怒られそうだから黙っていよう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I kind of like how coy she gets... I should
just sit and enjoy this moment.)

fields.EN:
(I'm glad I managed to tell her how I really feel.
 ...I love you, Oyayubihime.)
fields.JP:
（ちゃんと想いを伝えられてよかった。
　……大好きだよ、親指姫）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm glad I could get those feelings off my
chest. I love you, Thumbelina.)

Ugh Jack. Talking to you is like talking to
a wall.

fields.EN: Aren't you the stubborn one here, Oyayubihime?
fields.JP: そういう君こそ頑固じゃない？　親指姫
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you calling me stubborn? Look who's
talking!

fields.JP: （青い海！　白い砂浜！　輝く太陽！）

（こんなに素晴らしい海水浴デートの環境が
　整っているのに、僕と親指姫はかれこれ
　二十分はこうして揉めている……）

fields.EN:
(Because Oyayubihime wrapped herself in a towel
 and refuses to show me her swimsuit!
 Ahh, I just want to enjoy the beach already!)
fields.JP:
（なぜなら親指姫がタオルを巻いちゃって
　水着姿を見せてくれないから！
　あー、早く海を満喫したいのにー！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The reason being that Thumbelina's been
wrapped in her towel and won't take it off
to swim. Argh! I just wanna enjoy the beach!)

fields.EN:
It's no better than wearing my underwear!
I can't be seen in practically nothing! Never!
fields.JP:
水着なんてほぼ下着じゃない！
そんな恰好するなんてハレンチだわ。
無理よ、無理！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's no better than wearing my underwear!
I can't be seen in practically nothing! Never!

fields.EN:
But everyone wears swimsuits to the beach.
Can't you just get over it?
fields.JP:
海に来たら誰でも水着を着るのは普通だよ。
いい加減、観念したら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But everyone wears swimsuits to the beach.
Can't you just get over it?

fields.EN:
You want to see me in a swimsuit that badly?
Aren't you a pervert...?!
fields.JP:
そこまでしてわたしの水着姿を見たいなんて、
あんたヘンタイじゃない……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're such a pervert. You just want to see
me in nothing, don't you?

fields.JP: そんなことないって！　むしろ……

fields.EN:
(Honestly, her being wrapped in a towel
 fuels my imagination even more than the swimsuit...
 Yeah, I think it's strangely sexy...)
fields.JP:
（水着姿よりもタオルを巻いてるほうが、
　なんか妄想を掻き立てられるというか……うん、
　妙に色っぽいと思うんだけどなぁ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I think being covered up leaves more to
the imagination...which I like more.)

fields.EN:
(But I can't tell her that. Otherwise, she'll
call me a pervert for eternity. Just gonna
keep my mouth shut.)
fields.JP:
（なんて考えてるってバレたら、
　本当にヘンタイの烙印を押されそうだから
　黙っておくけど）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But I can't tell her that. Otherwise, she'll
call me a pervert for eternity. Just gonna
keep my mouth shut.)

fields.EN:
Anyway, if you wanna enjoy the beach,
