you should ditch the towel. Don't you
want to swim?
fields.JP:
と、とにかく、海に入るなら
どのみちタオルは取らないと。
それとも、海に入らなくてもいいの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyway, if you wanna enjoy the beach,
you should ditch the towel. Don't you
want to swim?

fields.EN:
Ugh... I don't want that.
I was looking forward to playing in the sea.
fields.JP:
う……それは嫌。
海で遊ぶのは楽しみだったのよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rgh... I want to take a dip. I was looking
forward to seeing the beach.

fields.EN:
...Fine.
Then I'll only be in my swimsuit
while I'm actually in the water.
fields.JP:
……仕方ないわね。
それなら、海の中でだけ水着になるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine... I'll show off my bathing suit.
But only at the beach.

fields.EN:
Only at the beach? Besides that, what're
you gonna do with your towel?
fields.JP:
海の中でだけ？
ここから海まで、タオルはどうするの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Only at the beach? Besides that, what're
you gonna do with your towel?

fields.EN:
Close your eyes, and I'll walk us to the
water. That solves everything!
fields.JP:
ジャックが目をつぶって、
わたしが海まで連れて行ってあげるわ。
それで万事解決よ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Close your eyes, and I'll walk us to the
water. That solves everything!

fields.EN: What a weird way to solve it...

Quit complaining! I'll take off my towel,
just close your eyes.
fields.JP:
文句言わないの！
じゃあタオル取るから、あんたは目をつぶってて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Quit complaining! I'll take off my towel,
just close your eyes.

fields.EN: My eyes are closed. This good?
fields.JP: 目をつぶったよ。これでいい？
fields.LOCALIZED: My eyes are closed. This good?

fields.EN: Okay. My towel's off. Grab my hand.
fields.JP:
ええ、わたしもタオルを取ったわ。
それじゃあ手を繋いで、と……
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay. My towel's off. Grab my hand.

fields.EN:
(Oyayubihime's hand is so small.
 Come to think of it, this might be
 the first time we've held hands...)
fields.JP:
（親指姫の手、小さいなぁ。
　そういえば初めて手を繋いだかも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Her hands are so petite. This is our first
time holding hands.)

fields.EN: Keep going. One, two. One, two.
fields.JP: じゃあ、歩くわよ。いち、に、いち、に
fields.LOCALIZED: Keep going. One, two. One, two.

fields.JP: わ、わ……目が見えないと歩くだけでも怖いな

fields.EN:
I'm guiding you so you won't trip.
We're almost at the water.
fields.JP:
わたしが手を繋いでるんだから転ばないわよ。
ほら、その調子。もうすぐ海に到着よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm guiding you so you won't trip.
We're almost at the water.

fields.EN: Hehe. Go ahead and open your eyes.
fields.JP: ふふ、もう目を開けてもいいわよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. Go ahead and open your eyes.

fields.EN:
Once we're in the water, having a swimsuit
isn't too bad.
fields.JP:
海に入っちゃえば
水着もあんまり恥ずかしくないものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once we're in the water, having a swimsuit
isn't too bad.

fields.EN:
(Oh, Oyayubihime in a swimsuit...!
 She's as cute as I thought.)
fields.JP:
（おお、親指姫の水着だ……！
　やっぱりかわいいなぁ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh. There she is... She's even cuter than
I pictured.)

fields.EN:
(I can still see her swimsuit even in the water,
 but I guess that's fine by Oyayubihime's standards.
 I really don't understand where she draws the line.)
fields.JP:
（海に入っていても結局水着は見えてるけど、
　そこらへんは親指姫的にはセーフなんだな。
　基準がよくわからないや）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can kinda make out her swimsuit underwater.
But that works for Thumbelina. I don't get 
her sometimes.)

fields.JP: じろじろ見て、どうしたのよ

fields.EN:
Oh. Just realizing this is our first time holding
hands. It made me smile.
fields.JP:
あ、えーと、君と手を繋いだのって
何気に初めてだったなーって思ったんだ。
ちょっと嬉しくて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. Just realizing this is our first time holding
hands. It made me smile.

fields.EN:
What are you talking about?! Holding hands
is perfectly normal behavior! We are dating...
after all.
fields.JP:
な、なに言ってるの！
手を繋ぐなんて別に普通でしょ！
つ、付き合って……いるんだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you talking about?! Holding hands
is perfectly normal behavior! We are dating...
after all.

fields.JP: あーもうっ、こんな話はおしまい！

fields.EN: Oh, hey! I'm getting you back!
fields.JP: わっ、やったな！　おかえしだ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, hey! I'm getting you back!

fields.JP:
なによ、やる気？
えいっ！
あははっ、こっちからもいくぞー！
（あれ。なんか楽しくなってきた）

ぜえ……ぜえ……はぁ。
思ったより熱中しすぎちゃったわ……

fields.EN: Sure, but at least it was fun.
fields.JP: うん……。でも楽しかったね
fields.LOCALIZED: Sure, but at least it was fun.

fields.EN: Truly. Who knew the beach was so nice?
fields.JP:
そうね。
海がこんなに楽しいものだったなんて
知らなかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Truly. Who knew the beach was so nice?

fields.EN:
...Well, maybe being with you has something
to do with it.
fields.JP:
……まあ、あんたと一緒に来たからって
いうのもあるのかもね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Well, maybe being with you has something
to do with it.

fields.EN:
(...Come to think of it, Oyayubihime is already
 out of the water, but she isn't embarrassed
 about her swimsuit anymore.)
fields.JP:
（……そういえば親指姫、もう海から出てるのに
　水着が恥ずかしくないんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I just realized that Thumbelina's out of the
water, but she's not self-conscious anymore.)

fields.EN:
(Even looking again, it really suits her.
 But if I say that, she'll probably get mad again.
 Not that getting yelled at is all bad...)
fields.JP:
（改めて見ても似合ってるなぁ。
　でもそんなこと言ったらまた怒られるかな。
　怒られるのも悪くないけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's even cuter than I imagined.
But she'd be mad if I told her that.)

fields.EN: Oh. Your swimsuit's really cute. I like it.
fields.JP:
えっと、その水着、似合ってるね。
かわいいよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh. Your swimsuit's really cute. I like it.

fields.EN:
W-What?!
That's what you were thinking about?
You lech! Pervert!
fields.JP:
はっ、はあ！？
あんたそんなこと考えてたの？
スケベ！　ヘンタイ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?! That's what you're thinking?!
Some nerve you have!

fields.EN:
Haha, that's harsh.
It's the girl I love in a swimsuit, you know?
Of course I'm happy I get to see her like this.
fields.JP:
あはは、ひどいなぁ。
だって好きな子の水着姿なんだよ？
見られて嬉しいに決まってるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha. Don't shoot the messenger.
Can't a guy like his girlfriend's outfit?
Of course I'm gonna tell you.

fields.EN:
...You know, I notice you express your desire
more frequently now that we're dating.
fields.JP:
……あんた、付き合うようになってから
欲望に忠実になったんじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
...You know, I notice you express your desire
more frequently now that we're dating.

fields.EN:
It annoys me, but I'll allow it. I guess there
are worse things than you checking me out.
fields.JP:
別に嫌じゃないのが、しゃくに障るけど……。
ま、まぁあんたに見られるなら
悪くないっていうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It annoys me, but I'll allow it. I guess there
are worse things than you checking me out.

fields.EN:
Oyayubihime, let's go on another date together.
Let's visit all kinds of places besides the sea!
fields.JP:
親指姫、また一緒にデートしようね。
海以外にもいろんなところに行こう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's plan another date soon, Thumbelina.
There's so much for us to do together!

fields.EN: ...Fine. If you insist, then I'll deal!
fields.JP:
……仕方ないわね。
あんたがそう言うなら、付き合ってあげる！
fields.LOCALIZED: ...Fine. If you insist, then I'll deal!

fields.EN:
A few years later.
The new village was developing smoothly,
and life had begun to stabilize—
fields.JP:
数年後。
新しい村づくりも順調に進み、
生活も安定してきたころ――。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A few years later...
Their village was beginning to flourish,
and the settlement became a haven for all.

fields.EN:
What is this place, a church?
It's pretty run-down...
fields.JP:
なによここ、教会？
ずいぶん傷んでるわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is it me or is this church crap? This place
should be demolished...

fields.EN:
What is Jack thinking,
calling me out to a place like this?
fields.JP:
ジャックのヤツ、わたしをこんなところに
呼びつけてどういうつもりかしら
fields.LOCALIZED: Damn you, Jack. Why'd you call me out here?

fields.EN:
Huh? What's the meaning of this?
What do you mean "speed-changing"?!
fields.JP:
へ？　なんであんたたちがここに……
っていうか早着替えって？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? What's the meaning of this?
What do you mean "speed-changing"?!

fields.JP: ちょっ、いきなりなんなのよ！

fields.EN:
Hey, keep still! You'll rip it! I worked 
hard on this!
fields.JP:
暴れないでくれ！
せっかくの力作が破れてしまうだろ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, keep still! You'll rip it! I worked 
hard on this!

fields.JP:
お着替え、お着替えっと。
えーと、えーと……

fields.EN:
I don't really know what's going on, but you called
yourselves masters of quick-changing. Aren't you
pretty bad at the procedure for this?!
fields.JP:
よくわかんないけどあんたたち、
早着替えの達人とか言ってたくせに
段取り悪くない！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know what's going on out there,
but if this is your definition of speedy is
totally different from mine!

fields.EN: Way to miss the forest for the trees.
fields.JP: 突っ込むところはそこなのか……
fields.LOCALIZED: Way to miss the forest for the trees.

fields.EN:
All right, perfect!
If I do say so myself, this came out really well.
fields.JP:
よし、完璧だ！
我ながらいい出来だな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyways, you're done! You look ravishing,
if I do say so myself.

fields.EN:
Wow... This gown is so intricate.
But why would you dress me in this?
fields.JP:
すごい……。たしかに凝ったドレスね。
でもなんでわたしにこれを……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow... This gown is so intricate.
But why would you dress me in this?

fields.JP: それはあいつから聞いてくれ

fields.EN: Well, that's our cue to leave.
fields.JP:
それじゃあ、
わたしたちはこれで失礼しまーす
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, that's our cue to leave.

fields.EN:
Oh, that's an outfit I haven't seen before.
Why did you call me to a place like this
and suddenly have me changed? What are you up to?
fields.JP:
あら、見慣れない恰好してるわね。
こんなところに呼び出していきなり
着替えさせるなんて、どういうつもりよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, thanks for giving me the formal dress
memo. What's this all about? Why all the
hoops to jump through?

fields.EN:
Sorry for the surprise. It means a lot you
came.
fields.JP:
うん、驚かせてごめん。
でも来てくれてありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry for the surprise. It means a lot you
came.

fields.EN:
You look incredibly beautiful, Oyayubihime.
The different atmosphere suits you so well
I can't take my eyes off you.
fields.JP:
すごくきれいだよ、親指姫。
いつもと雰囲気が違って、見惚れちゃったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're beautiful, Thumbelina. Once again,
you're even prettier than I imagine.

fields.JP:
……ふん。
その称賛は素直に受け取っておくわ

fields.EN:
So how long's it been since we met?
Remember how it happened?
fields.JP:
もう君と出会ってからだいぶ経つんだね。
初めて会ったときのこと、覚えてる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So how long's it been since we met?
Remember how it happened?

fields.EN:
You mistook me for the youngest among
my sisters...not that I blame you.
fields.JP:
たしか、三姉妹の末っ子扱いされたわね。
わたしの見た目じゃ仕方ないけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mistook me for the youngest among
my sisters...not that I blame you.

fields.EN:
Sorry. I made you angry back then, didn't I?
And even after that, you always acted so prickly...
fields.JP:
ごめん。あのときは怒らせちゃったよね。
そのあとも、いつもツンツンした態度で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry. I know it offended you back then.
You haven't let me forget it...

fields.EN:
H-Hey, phrasing it like that makes me sound
like I'm always getting angry!
fields.JP:
な、なんかその言い方じゃ、
わたしが怒りっぽいやつみたいじゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey! Quit making me sound awful!

fields.EN:
Not even. I know the kindness that hides
beneath your sassy veneer.
fields.JP:
でも君が本当は優しい子だって、
もちろん今ではちゃんと知ってるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not even. I know the kindness that hides
beneath your sassy veneer.

fields.EN:
I always wanted to be someone who could help you.
But in reality, you were the one
who kept helping me.
fields.JP:
僕は君の力になりたいと思っていた。
でも実際は君に助けられてばかりだったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've always thought highly of you. Because
I knew how highly you think of me.

fields.EN:
Even when you give me an attitude, you
encourage me to do my best. That gave
me courage...
fields.JP:
君はちょっとキツイ態度をしながらも、
いつも僕の傍にいて励ましてくれた。
それがなにより僕の力になっていて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even when you give me an attitude, you
encourage me to do my best. That gave
me courage...

fields.JP:
親指姫、これからも僕と一緒にいてほしい。
僕は君が好きで、君のことが必要なんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thumbelina, I can't stand the thought of
going another day without you beside me.
I love you, and I need you for all time.

fields.JP: ねえ……これってもしかして、プロポーズ？

fields.EN:
HOW DARE YOU SURPRISE ME!
This is awful! What was your plan if I died
from shock?!
fields.JP:
こんなサプライズするなー！
びっくりするでしょ！　びっくりしすぎて
死んじゃったらどうすんのよー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
HOW DARE YOU SURPRISE ME!
This is awful! What was your plan if I died
from shock?!

fields.EN:
(She scolded me...
 But it doesn't look like she actually hates it.)
fields.JP:
（怒られた……。
　でも嫌がられてはいないみたいだな）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Is she upset? It doesn't seem genuine...)

fields.EN:
Grr... It annoys me to admit it,
but of course I don't hate it.
fields.JP: ぐぬぬ……。悔しいけど、嫌なわけないでしょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
GRRR. As much as I hate to admit it,
this is the happiest moment of my life.

fields.JP: じゃあ、プロポーズを受けてくれる？

fields.EN: Ugh... Aren't you skipping a step?
fields.JP: あんたねぇ……その前に言うことがあるでしょ
fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh... Aren't you skipping a step?

fields.EN:
You're proposing because you want to
marry me, right? So why do you want to
marry me? Go on, say it!
fields.JP:
結婚したいからプロポーズしたんでしょ？
だったらどうして結婚したいと思ったの？
ほら、ちゃんと言って！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're proposing because you want to
marry me, right? So why do you want to
marry me? Go on, say it!

fields.EN:
(She's right. I didn't say... I was too nervous
to bring it up.)
fields.JP:
（そういえば言ってなかったな。
　緊張しすぎてすっ飛ばしちゃった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's right. I didn't say... I was too nervous
to bring it up.)

fields.EN:
Oyayubihime, I love you.
Will you marry me?
fields.JP:
親指姫、君を愛してるよ。
僕と結婚してくれますか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Thumbelina, I love you. Will you marry me?

fields.EN: You pass! I'll marry you, Jack.
fields.JP:
よしっ、合格！
結婚してあげるわ、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED: You pass! I'll marry you, Jack.

fields.EN:
Besides, I love you back. I can't think of
a better groom than you.
fields.JP:
そもそも、わたしだってジャックが
大好きなんだから。あんた以外に
結婚したい相手なんていないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Besides, I love you back. I can't think of
a better groom than you.

fields.EN:
Wow... An actual proposal. Color me
surprised. Never a dull moment with you.
fields.JP:
……もう、いきなりプロポーズなんて、
ホントびっくりした。
あんたといると退屈しないで済むわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow... An actual proposal. Color me
surprised. Never a dull moment with you.

fields.EN:
Jack, from now on I'll love you with everything I have.
And we'll be as happy as we possibly can together!
fields.JP:
ジャック、これからもめいっぱい愛してあげる。
それで一緒にめいっぱい幸せになるわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, I'll love you until the universe dies.
You better not give up loving me!

fields.EN: Yeah. I'm sure the two of us can do it!
fields.JP: うん。僕たちならきっとできるよ！

fields.EN:
Jack-san!
S-Sorry to keep you waiting...!
fields.JP:
ジャックさん！
お、お待たせしてすみません……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack! I hope I didn't keep you long!

fields.EN: But you're on time. I just made it.
fields.JP:
ちゃんと約束通りの時間だよ？
僕もついさっき来たばかりなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: But you're on time. I just made it.

fields.EN:
Sorry for the sudden call. I had to tell
you something.
fields.JP:
今日は急に呼び出してごめんね。
実は、君に話があってさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry for the sudden call. I had to tell
you something.

fields.EN:
(Ah, I'm getting a little nervous.
 But if I stay calm and talk, I'll be fine...)
fields.JP:
（あー、ちょっと緊張してきた。
　でも落ち着いて話せば大丈夫……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Shoot. My palms are sweaty. Just keep
cool, and talk it out...)

fields.EN: How about a walk? The weather's perfect.
fields.JP:
ねえ、少し歩かない？
風が気持ちいいよ
fields.LOCALIZED: How about a walk? The weather's perfect.

fields.JP: そうですね。歩きましょう！

fields.EN: How've you been? Fitting in okay?
fields.JP: 最近はどう？　今の生活は大変じゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED: How've you been? Fitting in okay?

fields.EN:
It is hard.
Shirayuki is still as clumsy as ever...
fields.JP:
やっぱり大変ですよ。
白雪ってば相変わらずドジばっかりで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I certainly have had my share of
challenges. Such is the life of a klutz.

fields.EN:
But compared with when I was separated
from Jack-san, the difficulties now
are nothing at all!
fields.JP:
でもジャックさんと離れ離れになっていた
ときのことを思えば、今の大変さなんて
全然へっちゃらです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But compared to when we were separated,
this is nothing!

fields.EN:
That's true.
I was full of anxiety back then too.
fields.JP:
たしかにね。
僕もあのころは不安ばっかりだったなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's a good point. Those days were nothing
but stress.

fields.EN:
We went through a lot,
but I'm glad we can finally live
peaceful everyday lives like this.
fields.JP:
大変な思いもしたけど、
こうして平和な日常が送れるように
なってよかったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But all that stress was worth it.
Now we're safe on the surface.

fields.EN:
Jack-san felt the same kind of anxiety too.
...I see. Hehe.
fields.JP:
ジャックさんも同じように
不安だったんですね。
……そっか、ふふ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were stressed too? I had no idea.
Hehe... That makes two of us.

fields.EN:
(Uh oh. Awkward silence. Quick, man.
Change the subject. Hm. Uh...)
fields.JP:
（会話に間が空いちゃったな……。
　なにか気の利いた話題でもないかな。
　えーと、うーんと……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Uh oh. Awkward silence. Quick, man.
Change the subject. Hm. Uh...)

fields.EN:
...Speaking of anxiety, it reminds Shirayuki
of how she was before she met Jack-san.
fields.JP:
……不安っていうと、ジャックさんと出会う前の
白雪のことを思い出します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Speaking of stress, I think the moment I felt
freed from its grasp was when I met you.

fields.EN:
I was stressed because I thought I was a lost
cause. I was terrified of my own reflection.
fields.JP:
自分にやれることなんかなにもないって
思うとすごく不安でしたし、鏡に映る自分の姿
だっていつも怖かったです
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was stressed because I thought I was a lost
cause. I was terrified of my own reflection.

fields.EN:
But after meeting Jack-san, Shirayuki realized
that if you want to become the person you want to be,
you have to work toward it.
fields.JP:
だけどジャックさんに出会って、
なりたい自分になるには、そうなるように
努力するのが大事なんだって気づきました
fields.LOCALIZED:
But after we met, I realized it's important to
work hard to become the person you aspire
to be.

fields.EN:
Because Jack-san was there, even Shirayuki
was able to move forward little by little.
Meeting Jack-san changed everything.
fields.JP:
ジャックさんがいたから、こんな白雪でも
少しずつ前に進めるようになったんです。
ジャックさんと会えてすべてが変わりました
fields.LOCALIZED:
Because of you, I overcame my stress.
You changed everything.

fields.EN:
Jack-san woke Shirayuki, who had been asleep
all that time. You're almost like a prince...
fields.JP:
それまでずっと眠り続けていた白雪を
目覚めさせてくれて、ジャックさんは
まるで王子様みたいな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It feels like I've been asleep my whole life,
but now I'm awake. You're my Prince Charming.

fields.JP: そ、そんな、王子様だなんて……

fields.EN: To Shirayuki, Jack-san really is her prince.
fields.JP:
白雪にとっては、
ジャックさんが王子様なんですよ

fields.EN:
Shirayuki can't lead people like Oyayubi-neesama,
and she doesn't have the power to heal everyone
like Nemu-chan does.
fields.JP:
白雪は親指姉さまみたいに誰かを
引っ張ることはできないし、ネムちゃんみたいに
みんなを癒す力もありません
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't lead like Thumbelina, and I'm not
as mellow as Sleepy.

fields.JP: ついでに個性もないですし……
（あ、それまだ気にしてたんだ）

fields.EN:
But thanks to you, I can accept myself for
who I am.
fields.JP:
でもそんな自分でもいいんだって思えたのは、
ジャックさんのおかげなんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
But thanks to you, I can accept myself for
who I am.

fields.EN:
Watching Jack-san keep working without giving up
for everyone's sake supported Shirayuki's heart
and gave her the courage to move forward.
fields.JP:
みんなのために諦めず努力し続ける
ジャックさんの姿は、白雪の心を支えてくれて、
前に進む勇気をくれました
fields.LOCALIZED:
You led our group with such verve that
I came to rely upon you. But I'm braver
for it.

fields.JP:
そんな素敵なジャックさんが、
白雪は大好きなんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's the man you are, and that's the reason
I've fallen for you.

fields.EN:
(Huh? I called her to confess my own
feelings. How'd she spin this around?)
fields.JP:
（あ、あれ？　僕が告白しようとしてたのに、
　なんか逆に告白された……のか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? I called her to confess my own
feelings. How'd she spin this around?)

fields.EN:
S-Somehow Shirayuki ended up
doing all the talking. Sorry...
fields.JP:
な、なんだか白雪ばっかり
しゃべりすぎちゃいましたね。
すみません……
fields.LOCALIZED: I think I said too much. Forgive me...

fields.EN:
Well, I just didn't know you had feelings for
me.
fields.JP:
だって、その……好きって言われたから
驚いちゃって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I just didn't know you had feelings for
me.

fields.EN:
Oh no... Shirayuki went and blurted out
her true feelings without thinking!
How embarrassing...!
fields.JP:
や、やだ白雪ったら、
つい本当の気持ちを言っちゃいました！
恥ずかしい……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh goodness. I bared my heart out like
a fool. How embarrassing!

fields.EN:
Um... that must be a bother, right?
Having Shirayuki tell you she likes you...!
fields.JP:
あの、迷惑ですよね。
白雪に好きって言われたって……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can only imagine how you feel.
I wouldn't want me either!

fields.EN: That's not it! I love you too!
fields.JP:
そんなことないよ！
僕も君が好きなんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED: That's not it! I love you too!

fields.EN:
(I-I said it!
 It kind of came out on momentum, but I said it!)
fields.JP:
（い、言った！
　なんか勢いに任せた感じになっちゃったけど！）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I said it. No turning back now!)

fields.JP:
え……えええっ？
ジャックさんが、し、白雪を！？

fields.EN: Ow. I tripped in a state of panic.
fields.JP:
いたた……。
わたわたしてたら、ちょっと転んじゃいました
fields.LOCALIZED: Ow. I tripped in a state of panic.

fields.EN:
(What would princely Tsuu do
 at a time like this? Let's see...)
fields.JP:
（こんなとき、王子様なつうなら
　どうするかな？　えーと……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What would the princely Otsuu do at a time
like this?)

fields.JP: あっ、ありがとう、ございます……

fields.EN:
Um... are you really okay with Shirayuki?
She does clumsy things all the time...
fields.JP:
あの……本当に白雪なんかでいいんでしょうか？
ドジなこともしょっちゅうしちゃうんですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um. Are you sure you want to do this?
My klutziness is a burden.

fields.EN: Of course. I love you for who you are.
fields.JP:
もちろんだよ。
僕は君らしい君が好きなんだから
fields.LOCALIZED: Of course. I love you for who you are.

fields.EN:
And I know you're not just clumsy.
I know you're a wonderful girl too.
fields.JP:
それに君がただドジなだけじゃない、
素敵な子だってこともちゃんと知ってるしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're not just a klutz. You're the most
wonderful girl I know.

fields.EN:
...You're so kind.
That's why Shirayuki fell in love with you.
fields.JP:
……優しい方ですね。
だから白雪も好きになったんですよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not to mention, incredibly thoughtful.
That's what I like most about you.

fields.EN:
Shirayuki's wish to be together with Jack-san
actually came true...
I'm so happy right now.
fields.JP:
ジャックさんと一緒にいたいっていう
願いが叶っちゃうなんて……。
今、とっても幸せです
fields.LOCALIZED:
My wish came true. I wanted this for so long.
I could turn into a puddle.

fields.EN:
So Jack-san really was
Shirayuki's prince after all.
fields.JP:
やっぱりジャックさんは、
白雪の王子様だったんですね

fields.EN:
I don't know if I can be a cool prince,
but I want to stay with you so I can make
Shirayukihime smile even more.
fields.JP:
かっこいい王子様になれるかはわからないけど、
白雪姫をもっと笑顔にできるように、
一緒にいたいと思うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know if I'm as charming as you think,
but whatever makes you smile. I want what
you want.

fields.EN:
Shirayuki does too!
Please take care of me from now on!
fields.JP: 白雪もです！　よろしくお願いしますね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Lovely! This is the best day of my life!

fields.JP: 海ですね、ジャックさん

fields.EN:
I know things have been hectic, but I'm glad
we could squeeze in a date. I can't wait!
fields.JP:
僕たちもいろいろ忙しいけど、
デートする時間を作れてよかったね。
今日はいっぱい楽しもう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know things have been hectic, but I'm glad
we could squeeze in a date. I can't wait!

fields.EN: So can I ask you something?
fields.JP: ところで、ひとつ聞いていい？
fields.LOCALIZED: So can I ask you something?

fields.EN:
Why are you still wrapped in a towel?
You are wearing a swimsuit underneath, right?
fields.JP:
なんでタオル巻いてるの？
下にちゃんと水着着てるよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why are you wrapped in a towel still?
Don't you have a swimsuit?

fields.EN:
Well, you see, I suspect my swimsuit's a size
too small. I'm embarrassed to show you.
fields.JP:
そ、それが……。
水着のサイズが思ったよりもぴちぴちで……。
見せるのが恥ずかしくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, you see, I suspect my swimsuit's a size
too small. I'm embarrassed to show you.

fields.JP: （ぴちぴち！？　う……見てみたい……）

fields.EN:
It looks like the size was too small.
B-Because Shirayuki is fat after all...
An ordinary swimsuit wasn't enough...
fields.JP:
サイズが小さかったみたいです。
や、やっぱり白雪はおでぶですから……。
普通の水着じゃいけなかったんです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seemed a bit tight. All because I'm chubby.
Normal swimsuits don't fit.

fields.EN:
You're not fat, Shirayukihime.
Um... I don't mind your kind of figure
at all, actually.
fields.JP:
白雪姫はおでぶじゃないよ。
そのー、僕は君みたいな感じとか
全然気にならないんだけどな
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're not chubby, Snow White. Um, not
that I'd mind if you were.

fields.EN: Really...? You promise not to laugh?
fields.JP: ほ、本当ですか……？　笑いませんか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Really...? You promise not to laugh?

fields.EN:
I won't. The things you're worried about
really don't bother me at all.
fields.JP:
しないよ。君が心配するようなことは、
僕は本当に気にしてないから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course not. Don't worry. You gotta get
out of your head.

fields.EN:
Okay... Well, I guess I can't swim with this
towel on.
fields.JP:
わ……わかりました。
タオルを巻いたままでは海に入れませんし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay... Well, I guess I can't swim with this
towel on.

fields.EN:
(The swimsuit is definitely tight, but
 Shirayukihime has this perfectly soft, curvy figure...
 My heart's racing!)
fields.JP:
（たしかに水着がきつめだけど、
　白雪姫の体型が絶妙なむちむちさで……
　ドキドキする！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Her swimsuit's a teensy bit tight, but it really
complements her physique. Act natural!)

fields.EN:
Y-You're staring so intensely with that scary face...
You really are disappointed in Shirayuki's figure,
aren't you...?!
fields.JP:
こ、怖い顔でそんな食い入るように
見るなんて……やっぱり白雪の体つきに
幻滅されたんですね……っ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
All that staring...is starting to scare me.
I knew it. You think I'm disgusting.

fields.JP:
いやですーっ！
見ないでくださいー！！

fields.EN:
(Shirayukihime's body-check landed!
 Well, she probably meant to hug me,
 but that actually hurt quite a bit...!)
fields.JP:
（白雪姫の体当たりがヒット！
　いや、本人的には抱きついたんだろうけど、
　けっこう効いた……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Snow White body slammed me! She might've
been going in for the hug, but she knocked me
to the ground.)

fields.EN:
C-Calm down, Shirayukihime.
I'm not disappointed at all...
fields.JP:
お、落ち着いて、白雪姫。
別に幻滅なんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Calm down, Snow White. I could never be
disgusted...

fields.EN:
Nooo!
Don't look at Shirayuki like this!
fields.JP:
いやいやいや～！
こんな白雪を見ないでください～！
fields.LOCALIZED: No no no! Quit staring at my rolls!

fields.EN:
I-I couldn't help it!
Food tastes so good after work lately,
I keep getting seconds!
fields.JP:
だって仕方なかったんです～！
最近お仕事上がりのご飯が美味しくて、
ついついおかわりしちゃうんです～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just can't help it! I love to eat!
You can't blame a girl for going for 
seconds after a hard day's work!

fields.EN:
Shirayuki knows she needs to exercise,
but she gets sleepy right away and never manages it...!
Shirayuki is such a bad girl!
fields.JP:
運動しなきゃって思うんですけど、
すぐ眠くなっちゃって全然できなくて……！
白雪ってばダメな子なんです～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know I need to work out, but I'm too tired!
I'm the worst!

fields.EN:
O-Okay, I understand, so calm down!
And your chest is pressing against me!
fields.JP:
わ、わかったから、ちょっと落ち着いて！
あと胸が当たってるー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, I got it. Just take it easy. You're
starting to smother me!

fields.EN:
Yes...
I'm sorry I lost control...
We got tired before we even entered the sea.
fields.JP:
はい……。
取り乱しちゃってすみませんでした……。
海に入る前に疲れちゃいましたね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Sorry. I lost myself for a moment.
I've got myself worked up and we're not
even at the beach yet.

fields.EN:
Haha, that happens sometimes.
Let's rest for a while.
fields.JP:
はは、まあそんなときもあるよ。
しばらく休もう
fields.LOCALIZED: Haha. Things happen. Just roll with it.

fields.EN: Could we stay here like this for a while?
fields.JP:
少しの間、こうしてくっついていても
いいですか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Could we stay here like this for a while?

fields.EN:
With how busy every day is,
Shirayuki has always wanted to be alone with Jack-san
and stay close like this.
fields.JP:
忙しい毎日の中で、
ジャックさんと二人でこうしたいなって、
ずっと思っていたんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
We lead such busy lives. I'd rather savor
my time with you now.

fields.EN:
Of course it is. It's unlike you to be so forward,
but you won't hear any complaints from me.
fields.JP:
ダメなわけないよ。
君が積極的だからちょっと驚いたけど、
嬉しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course it is. It's unlike you to be so forward,
but you won't hear any complaints from me.

fields.EN:
Actually, Shirayuki wants to be a little more forward
about what she wants to do with Jack-san...
fields.JP:
実は白雪は、ジャックさんと
どうしたいのかという気持ちを、
もう少し積極的に出したいと思っていて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Being forthcoming with you is something
I care about.

fields.EN:
S-So if Jack-san has any wishes like that too,
please tell Shirayuki what they are.
fields.JP:
だ、だからジャックさんも、
なにかそういう希望とかあれば
ぜひおっしゃってほしいんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
So Jack, if there's anything I can do to
make you happy, please. Let me know.

fields.JP: きっ、ききき、キス！？　ですか？

fields.EN: Oh, sorry! Was that too bold?
fields.JP:
あっ、ごめん！
いきなりそんなこと言ったら困るかな……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, sorry! Was that too bold?

fields.EN: Oh no, that's not what I mean! Um uh, uh...
fields.JP:
そ、そうではなくて！
えーっと、えーっと、えーっと……
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh no, that's not what I mean! Um uh, uh...

fields.JP: じゃあ、次に会うときということで……！

fields.EN:
O-Of course... W-Wait,
Shirayuki, what a bold thing to say...!
fields.JP:
も、もちろん……って、
あわわ、白雪ってばなんて大胆なことを……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course... Bold of me to suggest, don't
you think?!

fields.EN:
(Shirayukihime is cute when she panics too.
 Wait, am I fine with literally anything she does...?)
fields.JP:
（慌てる白雪姫もかわいいなぁ。
　って、なんでもいいのか僕は……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Her blush is so adorable. I'd do whatever
she asked of me.)

fields.EN: It's a deal. Can't wait until next time.
fields.JP:
じゃあ、約束だよ。
次を楽しみにしているね
fields.LOCALIZED: It's a deal. Can't wait until next time.

fields.EN:
A few years later.
The new village was developing smoothly,
and life had begun to stabilize—
fields.JP:
数年後。
新しい村づくりも順調に進み、
生活も安定してきたころ――。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A few years later...
Their village was beginning to flourish,
and the settlement became a haven for all.

fields.EN:
Is this the place where Shirayuki
is supposed to meet Jack-san... ?
fields.JP:
ジャックさんとの待ち合わせ場所は
ここでいいんでしょうか……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Is this where Jack wanted to meet?

fields.EN: It's an old church. It certainly has character.
fields.JP:
それにしてもこの教会、なんだかボロ……
いえ、雰囲気のある場所ですね……
fields.LOCALIZED: It's an old church. It certainly has character.

fields.EN: I'll say. It's practically a ruin.
fields.JP: うんうん、たしかにボロい教会だな
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll say. It's practically a ruin.

fields.EN:
I-I changed what I was saying halfway through,
so please pretend you didn't hear it!
And why is Otsuu-san here... ?
fields.JP:
と、途中で言い換えたんですから、
聞かなかったことにしてください！
というか、なんでおつうさんが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, that's rude! I'm going to pretend like
I didn't hear that! What are you doing here,
Otsuu?

fields.EN:
Ningyohime-san too...
Did Jack-san call both of you here?
fields.JP:
人魚姫さんまで……。
お二人もジャックさんに呼ばれたんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED: You too, Little Mermaid? Did Jack call you?

fields.EN: Something like that, but we'll skip the explanation!
fields.JP: そんなとこだけど、説明は省く！
fields.LOCALIZED: Maybe he did, maybe he didn't. Unimportant.

fields.EN: Shirayuki-chan, excuse us for a sec!
fields.JP: 白雪ちゃん、ちょっと失礼～！

fields.EN:
Eek! A-A blindfold?
You are not going to stuff me into a burlap sack
and kidnap me like this, are you?!
fields.JP:
ひゃっ！　め、目隠しですか？
まさかこのまま麻袋に詰められて
誘拐されてしまうのでは……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aah! Why are you blindfolding me?!
Is this your idea of a sick prank?!

fields.JP: いやですー！　やめてくださーい！

fields.EN: We're not kidnapping you, so stop struggling!
fields.JP: 誘拐じゃないから暴れるな！
fields.LOCALIZED: We're not abducting you, so relax!

fields.EN:
Hold still!
Otsuu-chan went to all the trouble of making this,
and you'll tear it!
fields.JP:
動かないでいて！
おつうちゃんがせっかく作ったのに、
破れちゃうよー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Keep still or it'll rip! Otsuu worked on this
all day!

fields.JP:
えっ？　あ、はい！
すみません……？
よし、そのままじっとしていてくれよ
できた！　着替えさせ完了！

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan, that was fast!
Shirayuki-chan, it looks great on you!
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん手際いい！
白雪ちゃん、よく似合ってる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nice work, Otsuu! You look beautiful, Snow
White!

fields.JP:
え、え……？
あの、このドレスは……
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? Um. What's this dress for?

fields.EN:
I made it myself.
Well... here's to your happiness.
fields.JP:
僕の手製さ。
まあ、お幸せにってことだよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I tailored it myself. It's all for you.

fields.EN: Well, that's our cue to leave.
fields.JP: じゃあ、わたしたちはこれで……
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, that's our cue to leave.

fields.EN: Shirayuki has no idea what is going on...
fields.JP:
白雪にはなにが起きているのか、
さっぱりです……
fields.LOCALIZED: I have no idea what's going on...

fields.JP:
ジャックさん！
あれ？　その恰好って……

fields.EN:
Tsuu prepared this tuxedo for me.
Together with your dress.
fields.JP:
タキシード、つうに用意してもらったんだ。
君のドレスと一緒にね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I asked Otsuu to make me a tuxedo.
After your dress, of course.

fields.EN:
Oh. This dress is...um. You don't think I look
awful?
fields.JP:
あ、あの、このドレスはその、
や……やっぱり似合わないでしょうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. This dress is...um. You don't think I look
awful?

fields.EN:
Of course not! You always look cute,
but doubly so today. No. You're gorgeous.
fields.JP:
まさか！　君はいつもかわいいけど、
今日は一段とかわいい……ううん、きれいだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course not! You always look cute,
but doubly so today. No. You're gorgeous.

fields.EN:
But a flashy outfit like this is far too much
for plain Shirayuki...
fields.JP:
ですがこんなきらびやかな恰好、
地味な白雪にはとても……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I'm so dull. This flashy dress looks silly
on me.

fields.EN:
Plain, huh?
You said that when we first met too.
You even accepted me as a fellow 'plain person.'
fields.JP:
地味、か。
出会ったころにもそんなことを言っていたね。
僕のことも『地味仲間』として認めてくれたっけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dull? You said that about yourself the first
time we met. Practically verbatim.

fields.EN:
Saying something like that is distinctive enough.
I thought you were an interesting girl.
fields.JP:
そんなことを言うなんて、十分個性的だよね。
おもしろい子だなって思ったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But that's crazy talk to me. You're one of
the most interesting people I know.

fields.EN:
Forget I said anything! In fact, I'm mad at
myself for making such a rude comment.
fields.JP:
そ、それは忘れてください！
今思えばなんて失礼な……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Forget I said anything! In fact, I'm mad at
myself for making such a rude comment.

fields.EN: Hehe. We've been through a lot.
fields.JP: ふふ、あれからもいろんなことがあったね
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. We've been through a lot.

fields.EN:
As we spent time together as companions,
I realized you're a broad-minded girl
who can accept anyone.
fields.JP:
仲間として一緒に過ごすうちに、
君は誰でも受け入れることができる
心の広い子なんだってわかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems like spending time with the others
has really brought you out of your shell.

fields.EN:
The more I got to know you, the more I found
to like.
fields.JP:
深く付き合って、知れば知るほど、
君に惹かれていった
fields.LOCALIZED:
The more I got to know you, the more I found
to like.

fields.EN:
Whether you're plain or distinctive doesn't matter.
I love the girl named Shirayukihime.
fields.JP:
地味だとか個性的だとかは、関係ない。
僕は白雪姫っていう子が大好きなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But life's more than being interesting or not
being dull. To me, you're perfect.

fields.EN:
Shirayukihime...
Um... I want to keep being with you from now on.
Will you marry me...?
fields.JP:
白雪姫。
その……僕はこれからも君と一緒にいたい。
結婚してくれないかな……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White, um... I want us to be together
forever. Will you marry me...?

fields.EN:
Is it really all right for Shirayuki
to be this happy...?
I can hardly believe it...
fields.JP:
し、白雪が、
こんなに幸せでいいんでしょうか……っ。
信じられなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED: Do I really deserve this? I can't believe it.

fields.EN:
Then I'll say it as many times as it takes
until you believe me. I love Shirayukihime.
I want to live my life with you.
fields.JP:
それなら信じてくれるまで何度でも言うよ。
僕は白雪姫が大好きだ。
君と生きていきたいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then I'll repeat it every day until you do.
I love you, Snow White. I can't picture my
life with anyone else.

fields.JP: どうか答えを聞かせて

fields.EN:
...Shirayuki loves Jack-san too.
Always... forever and ever and ever!
I want you to stay with me...!
fields.JP:
……白雪も、ジャックさんを愛しています。
ずっと……ずっとずっとずーっと！
一緒にいてほしいです……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I love you too, Jack. I always have...
And I won't let this chance slip by!

fields.EN:
Shirayuki may be like this,
but I swear I will keep loving you forever!
fields.JP:
こんな白雪ですが、
末永く愛し続けることを誓います！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I may not be much, but I promise to love you
for all of eternity!

fields.EN:
I swear too.
...I love you, Shirayukihime.
fields.JP:
僕も、誓います。
……愛してるよ、白雪姫
fields.LOCALIZED: I promise too... I love you, Snow White.

fields.EN:
Nemurihime! I am glad you came.
You did not get sleepy on the way here, did you?
fields.JP:
眠り姫！　来てくれて嬉しいよ。
途中で眠くなったりしなかった？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleeping Beauty! Thanks for coming out.
Did coming here tire you out?

fields.JP:
んー、んー……。
昔ほどじゃ、ない……

fields.EN:
I see. That's great to hear. Well, I asked you
to meet me here because I had something
to tell you.
fields.JP:
そっか、よかった。
今日は話があって呼んだんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. That's great to hear. Well, I asked you
to meet me here because I had something
to tell you.

fields.EN:
(She looks a little sleepy.
 Come to think of it, isn't this usually
 her nap time?)
fields.JP:
（ちょっと眠そうだな。
　そういえばいつもは昼寝してる時間だっけ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She looks exhausted. Now that I mention
it, this is her nap time.)

fields.EN:
(I hoped to walk the beach with her, but
I don't want to push her too hard.)
fields.JP:
（二人で浜辺を歩こうかと思ってたけど、
　それよりもゆっくりさせてあげたいな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I hoped to walk the beach with her, but
I don't want to push her too hard.)

fields.EN:
(That's it!
 I'll spread my handkerchief out on the sand...)
fields.JP:
（そうだ！
　ここは砂浜にハンカチを敷いて、と……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I know. I can lay this blanket out on the
sand.)

fields.EN:
Nemurihime, sit here.
Let us talk while we look out at the ocean.
fields.JP:
眠り姫、ここに座って。
海を眺めながら話でもしよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleeping Beauty, take a seat. Why don't
we watch the ocean while we talk?

fields.EN:
The sea breeze feels nice.
...Have you gotten used to your new life?
fields.JP:
潮風が気持ちいいね。
……今の生活にはもう慣れた？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The ocean breeze is heavenly. How are
you faring up here?

fields.EN:
Mm... Busy, but...
lots of plants... fun...
fields.JP:
ん……。忙しい、けど……
いろんな植物……楽しい……
fields.LOCALIZED: Mm... Busy, but...I love all the plants.

fields.EN:
Even though you are busy, whenever you find time,
you enjoy finding and studying all kinds of plants...
Is that what you mean?
fields.JP:
忙しいけど、時間を見つけては
いろんな植物を見つけて調べたりするのが
楽しい、……ってこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You've been busy with setting up the village,
but tending to your plants has helped you
unwind?

fields.EN:
(All right, I got it!
 I seem to be starting to understand what she means
 almost as well as Oyayubihime and the others...)
fields.JP:
（よしっ、当たってた！
　親指姫たち並みに、彼女の言いたいことが
　わかるようになってきたみたいだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(All right, I guessed right! I'm starting to
understand her almost as well as her
sisters.)

fields.EN:
Hm? Oh, some seaweed washed ashore.
That is a plant too, so are you interested in it?
fields.JP:
ん？　ああ、海岸にワカメが
流れ着いてるね。あれも植物だから
興味あるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Oh, you're right. It washed ashore.
There are more plants next to it. Do you
want to take a closer look?

fields.JP:
ん……。形、おもしろい……。
あと、食べれる……

fields.EN:
Good idea. Let's grab some and take them
home.
fields.JP:
たしかにね。
あとで拾って帰ろうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good idea. Let's grab some and take them
home.

fields.EN:
The ocean is so vast.
I bet there are plants and creatures we've never seen
besides just seaweed.
fields.JP:
海って広いよね。
きっとワカメ以外にも、見たこともない
植物や生き物がいるんだろうなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The ocean's endless. I bet there's even more
stuff down there than up here.

fields.EN:
Back then, we never thought a day would come
when we could look at the ocean like this.
fields.JP:
昔はこんな風に海を見られる日が
来るなんて思わなかったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Never in my wildest dreams did I ever think
I'd see the sea for myself.

fields.EN:
When we were separated, I was scared of
never seeing you again.
fields.JP:
君と離れ離れになっていたときは、
もう二度と会えないんじゃないかって
不安になったこともあったけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
When we were separated, I was scared of
never seeing you again.

fields.EN:
It may be late to say it, but I'm truly happy
that we managed to gain this peaceful everyday life
together with you.
fields.JP:
こうして君との平穏な日常を手に入れる
ことができて、今さらだけど本当に嬉しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But now that we've got peace, I'm learning
to enjoy moments as they come.

fields.EN:
(How strange... When I am with Nemurihime,
 even silence feels comfortable...)
fields.JP:
（不思議だな……。眠り姫と一緒だと、
　沈黙すらも心地よく感じる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(How bizarre. Even sitting in total silence
with Sleeping Beauty comforts me.)

fields.EN: (That settles it, once and for all.)
fields.JP: （やっぱり、僕はこの子のことを……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (That settles it, once and for all.)

fields.EN:
(Oops! I blurted it out. Well, I guess that
just means it felt natural to say it!)
fields.JP:
（お、思わず言ってしまった！
　いや、もともと言うつもりだったけど、
　なんか流れで驚くほどサラっと言った！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oops! I blurted it out. Well, I guess that
just means it felt natural to say it!)

fields.EN: (I can't back down now. Time to finish this!)
fields.JP: （もう後戻りはできない。このまま告白だ！）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I can't back down now. Time to finish this!)

fields.EN:
So, um... I want you to be my girlfriend.
...What do you think?
fields.JP:
だからその……僕の恋人になってほしいんだ。
……どうかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So...I'd like to go out with you some time.
What do you say?

fields.EN:
(I can't gauge her expression. Was that a yes
or a no?)
fields.JP:
（わ、悪い感触ではない。
　けど……今の返事はどっちなんだろう？
　はいなのか、いいえなのか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't gauge her expression. Was that a yes
or a no?)

fields.EN: (Is that blush in her cheeks? She's so cute.)
fields.JP:
（あれ、眠り姫が珍しく照れてる。
　なんかかわいい……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Is that blush in her cheeks? She's so cute.)

fields.JP:
……ジャック。
ボクも……大好き……

fields.EN:
You're kind... dependable...
I'll be your girlfriend...
fields.JP:
優しくて……頼れる……。
ボク、恋人……なる……

fields.EN:
Kind and dependable, huh? Haha, that is embarrassing...
But I am happy.
fields.JP:
優しくて頼れる、か。はは、照れるな……。
でも嬉しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kind and reliable? Haha. That's a first.
But seriously, thank you.

fields.EN:
Well then, I guess that means we're dating!
I promise always to be by your side.
fields.JP:
こ、これからは恋人として、よろしくね！
もう君に寂しい思いはさせないからさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, I guess that means we're dating!
I promise always to be by your side.

fields.EN:
(We finally managed to make time
 for a beach date! And a swimsuit!)
fields.JP:
（時間をやりくりしてやっと実現した
　海水浴デート！　そして水着！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We finally found time for our beach date!
She looks stunning in that bathing suit!)

fields.EN:
(Especially around the chest... No, no!
 It would be rude to look at her lustfully!)
fields.JP:
（特に胸の部分が……って、いけない、いけない。
　いやらしい目で見たら失礼だぞ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But it's so revealing... Oh man, oh man.
I can't get caught staring!)

fields.EN: Oh, is that a floaty tube? You had one?
fields.JP:
あれ？　それ、浮き輪？
持ってきていたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, is that a floaty tube? You had one?

fields.EN:
Hahaha. You're ready to roll. Looks like
someone was excited for the beach date.
fields.JP:
あはは、けっこうアグレッシブだなぁ。
海に来るの、楽しみだったんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha. You're ready to roll. Looks like
someone was excited for the beach date.

fields.JP: それじゃあ、一緒に泳ごうか！

fields.EN:
I'm glad.
Wow, I'm amazed at how good you got at swimming
in such a short time...
fields.JP:
よかったね。
いやー、この短時間で泳ぎも本当に
上手になって驚いたよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Happy to hear it. You're a better swimmer
than I thought.

fields.EN:
(After a while she got out of her floaty.
Which means I was charge of watching it...)
fields.JP:
（途中から浮き輪もいらなくなって、
　ずっと僕が預かってたくらいだし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(After a while she got out of her floaty.
Which means I was charge of watching it...)

fields.EN:
Did all that swimming tire you out?
Why don't we lay on the shore?
fields.JP:
いっぱい泳いで眠くなっちゃった？
じゃあ岸に戻って休もうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did all that swimming tire you out?
Why don't we lay on the shore?

fields.EN:
C-Cheating?!
I'm not cheating on you!
fields.JP:
う、浮気！？
僕は浮気なんてしてないよ

fields.EN: Oh. Thank goodness. You scared me.
fields.JP:
い、言い間違えたのか。
びっくりした……
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh. Thank goodness. You scared me.

fields.EN:
I see. If you rest your body on the float ring
and float on the sea, you can take it easy.
fields.JP:
なるほど。浮き輪の上に体を預けて
海に浮かべば、らくちんってわけか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. So you want to float on the ring
while I hold it? Easy peasy.

fields.EN:
(Yeah... Since the float ring is transparent,
 I can see some rather risqué parts of Nemurihime
 very clearly...)
fields.JP:
（うん……。浮き輪が透明なせいで、こう、
　眠り姫のきわどい部分がよく見えるな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But since the floating ring is see-through,
she's practically half-naked in front of me.)

fields.EN:
(Ugh, what a lecherous guy I am.
 But sorry, I still end up looking.
 As a healthy guy, I just can't tear my eyes away...)
fields.JP:
（くっ、僕はなんていやらしい奴なんだ。
　でもごめん、やっぱり見てしまう。
　健全な男子として目が離せない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No, Jack! Bad Jack! But I can't help but
look! It's perfectly healthy to be curious!)

fields.EN:
(...Wait!
 I can see things I shouldn't...!
 No! I need to turn my face away.)
fields.JP:
（……って！
　見えちゃいけないものが……！
　だめだ！顔の方を向こう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh no! Things I shouldn't see! I can't!
She needs to face the other way.)

fields.JP: ジャックも……一緒に休む……

fields.EN:
...She already fell asleep even though we're out on the sea.
As expected of Nemurihime.
fields.JP:
……海の上なのにもう寝ちゃった。
さすが眠り姫だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're at the beach, and she's already
knocked out. That's Sleeping Beauty
for ya.

fields.EN:
(Maybe she thought I wanted to join her
from all that staring I did.)
fields.JP:
（僕がじーっと見てたから、
　僕も一緒に浮き輪を使いたがってると
　思われたのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe she thought I wanted to join her
from all that staring I did.)

fields.EN:
(Dating her is the dream. It's warm out.
What a gorgeous day.)
fields.JP:
（こんな子が僕の恋人だなんて、夢みたいだ。
　日差しもあったかくて……気持ちいいな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Dating her is the dream. It's warm out.
What a gorgeous day.)

fields.JP: （いけない、僕までつられて眠く……なって……）

fields.EN:
Oh no!
We drifted all the way offshore while we were asleep!
Nemurihime, wake up!
fields.JP:
うわっ、大変だ！
寝てるうちに沖まで流されちゃった！
眠り姫、起きて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh no! The tide washed us somewhere
else! Wake up, Sleeping Beauty!

fields.JP: むにゃ……？　もう……寝れない……

fields.EN:
Forget the nonsensical sleep talk, this is serious!
We've drifted offshore!
fields.JP:
意味不明な寝言はいいから、大変だよ！
僕たち沖に流されちゃったんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're in a daze! Wake up! We've washed
away!

fields.EN:
For now, let's hold onto the float ring
and swim back to shore!
fields.JP: とにかく浮き輪につかまって岸まで泳ごう！

fields.EN:
(Somehow the two of us made it back to
shore. Nearly drowned out there.)
fields.JP:
（その後、僕と眠り姫は
　なんとか岸まで泳ぎ着いた。
　わりとぎりぎりの生還だった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Somehow the two of us made it back to
shore. Nearly drowned out there.)

fields.EN:
(To top it off, we were scorched beneath
the sun. That meant a long break from the
beach...)
fields.JP:
（ちなみに二人ともめちゃくちゃ日焼けをした。
　海はしばらくこりごりだと思ったのは、
　言うまでもない――）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(To top it off, we were scorched beneath
the sun. That meant a long break from the
beach...)

fields.EN:
A few years later.
The new village was developing smoothly,
and life had begun to stabilize—
fields.JP:
数年後。
新しい村づくりも順調に進み、
生活も安定してきたころ――。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A few years later...
Their village was beginning to flourish,
and the settlement became a haven for all.

fields.EN:
Sorry for calling you out to this run-down
church. I bet you're wondering what this
is all about.
fields.JP:
ま、いきなりこんなボロい教会に
呼び出されたら戸惑うのも当然だよな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry for calling you out to this run-down
church. I bet you're wondering what this
is all about.

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan, even if it's true,
you shouldn't call it run-down.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん、本当のことでも
ボロいとか言っちゃダメだよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Otsuu, let's not frighten them, dear.

fields.EN:
Nemu-chan, sorry for a second.
I am going to blindfold you, okay?
fields.JP:
ねむちゃん、ちょっとごめんね。
目隠しするよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Sorry Sleepy. I need to blindfold you, okay?

fields.EN:
Oh, I thought you might struggle,
but you're surprisingly calm.
It would help if you stayed still like that.
fields.JP:
お、暴れるかと思ったけど意外と大人しいな。
そのままじっとしていてくれると助かる
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're taking this a lot better than I thought
you would. If only everyone was this easy.

fields.EN:
Then we don't have to worry about
Otsuu-chan's masterpiece tearing.
fields.JP:
これならおつうちゃんの力作も
破れちゃう心配ないね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So don't we have to worry your masterpiece
ripping, eh Otsuu?

fields.EN:
Nemu-chan, you look beautiful!
You look wonderful!
fields.JP:
ねむちゃんきれい～！
すごーく素敵だよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleepy, you're simply divine! Goodnes.
So pretty!

fields.EN:
Hehe. Glad I could be of service.
We'll be on our way then.
fields.JP:
ふふ、気に入ってもらえたみたいでなによりだ。
さて、僕たちはこれで失礼しようかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. Glad I could be of service.
We'll be on our way then.

fields.EN: Nemurihime. Thank you for coming today.
fields.JP: 眠り姫。今日は来てくれてありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleeping Beauty. Thanks for everything
today.

fields.EN: You look amazing in that dress.
fields.JP: そのドレス、よく似合ってるよ
fields.LOCALIZED: You look amazing in that dress.

fields.EN:
R-Really? Does it suit me too?
Haha, did you fall in love with me all over again?
Just kidding...
fields.JP:
そ、そう？　僕も似合ってるかな。
はは、惚れ直しちゃった？　なーんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You think? Does it feel like you're falling in
love with me all over again?

fields.EN:
(Wow, I said it myself, but now that she agreed
 I'm incredibly embarrassed.
 What is wrong with me...?)
fields.JP:
（うわぁ、自分で言っておいて
　肯定されたらめちゃくちゃ照れるとか、
　僕ってなんなんだ、もう……）

fields.EN:
(But Nemurihime really is beautiful...
 I'm dressed up for the occasion today too,
 so I need to nail this confession!)
fields.JP:
（でも眠り姫、すごくきれいだな……。
　僕も今日はこんな格好で決めてるんだし、
　告白のほうもビシッと決めないと！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Sleeping Beauty is a vision. Now that we're
both dressed up, this is the perfect chance
to confess my love!)

fields.EN: I have something to tell you.
fields.JP: 今日は改めて君に伝えたいことがあるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: I have something to tell you.

fields.EN:
Before that... thank you for everything.
Because you heal us, you've been a huge help
to both me and everyone else.
fields.JP:
その前に……いつもありがとう。
君に癒してもらえるおかげで、
僕もみんなもすごく助かっているよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Before I begin, I want to start by thanking
you for always being there for me. You
give me inner peace.

fields.EN:
Your healing power has helped me ever since back then.
Even though you're younger, you're so embracing
that I ended up relying on you too.
fields.JP:
君の癒しの力には昔から助けられっぱなし
だったな。年下なのに包容力があって、
僕もついつい甘えちゃったりしたね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's like just being around you puts my mind
at ease. You're younger, but I have much to
learn from you. Any time.

fields.EN:
At first I thought you were a quiet, mysterious girl,
but you're actually thoughtful,
and a little lonely too...
fields.JP:
始めは無口で不思議な子だと思ったけど、
実は思慮深くて、ちょっと寂しがり屋な
ところもあって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
At first I thought you were dark and
mysterious, but now I realize you're just
a deepthinker who's a bit of a loner.

fields.EN: I love you for who you are.
fields.JP: 僕はそんな君が大好きなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: I love that side of you.

fields.EN:
You've given me so much energy and healing until now,
so from now on, I want to be the one
who supports you.
fields.JP:
これまで君にたくさん元気をもらって、
癒されてきたぶんも、これからは
僕が君の力になっていきたいと思っている
fields.LOCALIZED:
Because you've never let me down, I want
to be your pillar for the rest of our lives.

fields.EN:
I know I've got some improving to do, but
the feeling is completely real.
fields.JP:
まだまだ頼りないかもしれないけど、
この気持ちだけは本物だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know I've got some improving to do, but
the feeling is completely real.

fields.JP:
んー……んー……。
……ジャック、頼りがい……ある……

fields.EN:
If you say that,
then I'll have to work even harder from now on.
fields.JP:
そう言ってもらえるなら、
これからももっとがんばらないとね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you say, then it only makes my work
harder.

fields.EN: ...Nemurihime, will you stay with me forever?
fields.JP:
……眠り姫、これからも僕とずっと一緒に
いてくれるかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleeping Beauty, wanna keep this love train
going?

fields.EN: I want you to marry me.
fields.JP: 僕と結婚してほしいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: I'd love nothing more than to marry you.

fields.EN:
Yes. I want us to spend the rest of our
lives together.
fields.JP: うん。結婚して、一緒に生きてほしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. I want us to spend the rest of our
lives together.

fields.JP: ボク……ジャックのお嫁さん……なる……！
うん。大胆で、その、びっくりしちゃった

fields.EN: Mm... I'm your bride now, so it's okay...
fields.JP: ん……。お嫁さんだから、いいの……

fields.EN:
Nemurihime... I swear I'll stay by your side
for the rest of my life and keep waking you up.
fields.JP:
眠り姫……一生君の傍にいて、
起こし続けることを誓うよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I promise never to leave your side again.

fields.JP:
ボクも……。
ずっと、ずっと……愛してる……！

fields.EN:
(I'm getting nervous now...
 I wonder if Kaguyahime will come.)
fields.JP:
（なんか今になって緊張してきた……。
　かぐや姫は来てくれるかな）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I'm getting nervous. I hope Kaguya comes.)

fields.EN:
(It's almost time to meet, but knowing her,
 I should probably be prepared for her
 not to arrive on time.)
fields.JP:
（そろそろ待ち合わせの時間だけど、
　まあ彼女のことだから、時間通りには
　来ないって覚悟しておいたほうがいいよね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's almost time, but knowing her, she
hasn't even left her house.)

fields.EN:
Why are you surprised? Aren't you the one
who summoned me? How odd.
fields.JP:
なんですか、そのリアクションは～。
自分で呼んでおいて驚くなんて、
変な人ですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why are you surprised? Aren't you the one
who summoned me? How odd.

fields.EN:
(Kaguyahime actually arrived on time...
 Maybe spears will fall from the sky tomorrow.)
fields.JP:
（かぐや姫が時間通りに来るなんて……。
　明日は槍でも降るんじゃないか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Kaguya's on time for once. Next you'll
tell me it'll rain frogs tomorrow.)

fields.EN: You're not thinking something rude, are you?
fields.JP: なにか失礼なこと考えてませんか～？
fields.LOCALIZED: You're not thinking something rude, are you?

fields.EN: Oh, not at all. Uh. Thanks for meeting me.
fields.JP:
い、いや、そんなことないよ。うん。
来てくれてありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, not at all. Uh. Thanks for meeting me.

fields.EN:
Seriously. Thanks is the least I deserve.
Getting here took some effort.
fields.JP:
本当、感謝してほしいですね～。
ここまで来るのにどれだけ苦労したことか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seriously. Thanks is the least I deserve.
Getting here took some effort.

fields.EN:
We don't have any vehicles right now,
so I have no choice but to go everywhere
on my own two feet.
fields.JP:
今は乗り物がないので、どこへ行くにも
自分の足で移動するしかないんですよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Since I don't have my Bamboo One anymore,
I have to trek around on foot.

fields.EN:
And a beach is so hard to walk on because of the sand.
So hard to walk on... Ah, what a pain.
fields.JP:
しかも浜辺なんて、足元が砂で歩きにくくて
歩きにくくて……ああ、めんどくさいです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
And the beach? Ugh. Solid ground is hard
enough, but sand? Aah. Too much work.

fields.EN:
Sorry, sorry. I should've chosen a better
location.
fields.JP:
ごめん、ごめん。
他の場所に呼べばよかったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry, sorry. I should've chosen a better
location.

fields.EN:
But I'm happy you're here. How've you been?
Getting used to things here?
fields.JP:
でもこうして君と会えて嬉しいな。
最近はどう？　今の生活には慣れた？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I'm happy you're here. How've you been?
Getting used to things here?

fields.JP: まあ、ぼちぼちというところです～

fields.EN:
I mostly do desk work,
but I have to walk around more than before,
so I get tired quickly. It's rough.
fields.JP:
わらわはデスクワーク中心ですけど、
前よりは歩かなければいけないことも多いので、
すぐ疲れてしまって大変ですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I mainly do clerical work, but even that
involves walking. It's certainly tiresome.

fields.EN:
Why don't you exercise to build up your
stamina?
fields.JP: 運動して体力つけたら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why don't you exercise to build up your
stamina?

fields.EN:
No thank you. I want to reduce, not add,
cumbersome tasks.
fields.JP: これ以上めんどくさいのはお断りです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
No thank you. I want to reduce, not add,
cumbersome tasks.

fields.JP: はは、相変わらずだなぁ

fields.EN:
But even while saying that,
you always end up working hard anyway.
That's the kind of person you are.
fields.JP:
でも、そんなこと言いながらも
なんだかんだでがんばってくれるんだよね。
君って人は
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's what you say, but I know you work
hard. Don't downplay yourself.

fields.EN: Well, I only work out of necessity.
fields.JP:
……だとすれば、仕方なく
がんばってるだけですけど～？
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, I only work out of necessity.

fields.EN:
Yeah. I know just how high a hurdle it is
for someone who really wants to laze around
to make herself work hard.
fields.JP:
うん。本当はだらけていたい君が
がんばるっていうことが、どれだけ
ハードルが高いことなのか知ってるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. I know you wanna slack off, but I also
know how exhausting working all the time is.

fields.EN:
Even when it's a pain, you work hard,
you're dependable when it matters,
and you're actually sensitive too...
fields.JP:
めんどくさくてもがんばってくれて、
いざというときは頼りになって、
しかも実は繊細なところがあって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I appreciate everything you do. I know I can
count on you even when things get hard.
All that, and you're so dainty...

fields.JP: そ、その……そんな君だから……
僕は君が、す、好きになったんだ

fields.EN: You mean... as a companion, right...?
fields.JP: それは、な……仲間として、ですよね……？

fields.EN:
I care about our friendship, but I mean
romantically too. I have feelings for you.
fields.JP:
仲間としてはもちろんだけど、
一人の女の子として……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I care about our friendship, but I mean
romantically too. I have feelings for you.

fields.JP:
これまで一緒にいろんな苦労をして、
たくさんの危機を乗り越えてきたよね

fields.EN:
Before I knew it, I couldn't help myself.
You're very special to me.
fields.JP:
そんな中で、だんだん君に惹かれていって……。
気づいたときには特別な存在になっていたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Before I knew it, I couldn't help myself.
You're very special to me.

fields.EN: What...? Why are you saying all this now?!
fields.JP:
な、なんで……！
なんで今そんなこと言うんですか～！
fields.LOCALIZED: What...? Why are you saying all this now?!

fields.EN:
There's still much to do! And now you're
dabbling in all this mushy talk!
fields.JP:
い、今だってまだ大変なときなのに、
好いた惚れたみたいな話……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's still much to do! And now you're
dabbling in all this mushy talk!

fields.EN: Well, there's no better time than the present.
fields.JP: い、今だから言いたかったんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, there's no better time than the present.

fields.EN:
We don't know what might happen to the world from now on.
If I kept thinking I'd tell you someday,
it might all end before I ever got to say it.
fields.JP:
今後も世界になにが起きるかわからない。
いつか言おうと思っていたら、結局
言えないままで終わってしまうかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
We don't know how things will go for us up
here. I knew in my heart I needed to tell you.
I couldn't wait another minute.

fields.EN:
That's why I thought I absolutely had to
tell you how I feel now.
fields.JP:
それなら、この想いはどうしても今
伝えておかなきゃいけないって思ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who knows how long peace will last?
Can't let this chance pass me by.

fields.EN:
...You have developed romantic feelings
for me. Are you serious?
fields.JP:
……わらわを女の子としてって……、
それ、本気なんですか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
...You have developed romantic feelings
for me. Are you serious?

fields.EN:
Of course. I love you, and I want to be
with you.
fields.JP:
本気だよ。
君のことが好きだし、これからも一緒にいたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course. I love you, and I want to be
with you.

fields.EN:
*sigh*... No need to spill your heart out.
I'm not going anywhere.
fields.JP:
……はあぁ～。
改まってそんなこと言わなくても、
わらわはどこにも行きませんよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh*... No need to spill your heart out.
I'm not going anywhere.

fields.EN:
Well, I might as well be honest with you too.
I expect to be pampered. Are you sure that's
what you want?
fields.JP:
そ、その言っておきますけど、
わらわはわがままですよ～？
本当にいいんですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I might as well be honest with you too.
I expect to be pampered. Are you sure that's
what you want?

fields.EN:
Including your selfish side, I...
I fell in love with you, Kaguyahime...!
fields.JP:
わがままなところも含めて、
君を……その、かぐや姫を好きになったんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: I even love that side of you!

fields.EN:
Your outrageous selfish demands can be a little troublesome,
but they can be fun too.
fields.JP:
君の突拍子もないわがままは、
ちょっと困るけど、楽しかったりするし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can't say it hasn't amused me when you
relish being spoiled. I'll take it as a sign
of what's to come.

fields.EN:
The strength and kindness you show sometimes,
and that dignified side of you, make my heart race...
Kaguyahime, you're special to me.
fields.JP:
たまに見せる強さや優しさ、
凛とした一面にドキドキして……。
かぐや姫は僕にとって特別なんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
When your heroic side comes out, my heart
skips a beat. Your strength and kindness
make you special to me.

fields.EN:
Now that life is easier, I realized you're all
I think about. I'm blushing just thinking
about it.
fields.JP:
こうして平和になってから、
気がつけば君のことばかり考えていた。
……な、なんか照れるな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that life is easier, I realized you're all
I think about. I'm blushing just thinking
about it.

fields.EN:
...You really are an idiot, Jack.
Though maybe I'm quite an idiot too
for thinking I want to date someone like you.
fields.JP:
……やっぱりジャックはお馬鹿ですね～。
そんな人と付き合ってあげようと思うわらわも、
けっこうお馬鹿なのかもしれませんけど～
fields.LOCALIZED:
...You really are a dummy. But perhaps I'm
the bigger dummy for wanting to love you.

fields.EN:
Hehe, let's keep getting along from now on.
I'll stay with you foreeever.
fields.JP:
ふふ、これからもよろしくお願いしますね～。
ず～っと、一緒にいてあげます～
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. I look forward to the days to come.

fields.EN:
The sky! The sea!
A beach date!
fields.JP:
空だ！　海だ！
海水浴デートだー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Look! The sky! The beach! Beach day!

fields.JP: テンション高いですね～

fields.EN:
Well, duh. We finally made time in our
busy schedules to go on a date.
fields.JP:
そりゃテンションも上がるってなもんだよ。
忙しい合間を縫って僕と君の予定を合わせて、
ようやく実現したデートなんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, duh. We finally made time in our
busy schedules to go on a date.

fields.EN:
And I really was happy because I never expected
Kaguyahime to be the one to invite me.
fields.JP:
しかもかぐや姫のほうから誘ってくれるなんて
予想外だったから、本当に嬉しかったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not to mention, you invited me. That was
a pleasant surprise.

fields.EN:
Even the thought of going on a date tires me,
but I figure as a couple, we are obligated to
partake in date activities.
fields.JP:
出かけるのはめんどくさいですけど、
付き合ってるからにはカップルらしいことでも
しておこうかと思っただけです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even the thought of going on a date tires me,
but I figure as a couple, we are obligated to
partake in date activities.

fields.EN:
By the way, what do you think of me in a swimsuit?
I've been waiting for your comment this whole time.
fields.JP:
ところでわらわの水着姿はどうですか～？
さっきからコメント待ちだったんですけど～
fields.LOCALIZED:
What do you make of my swim attire?
I've been awaiting your flattery.

fields.JP: ……うん。その……すごく似合ってるよ……

fields.EN:
(What do I do? Kaguyahime's bare skin is so dazzling
 I can barely look straight at her. Of course she'd be
 in a swimsuit on a beach date, but still...!)
fields.JP:
（どうしよう、かぐや姫の肌がまぶしすぎて
　直視できない。海でデートするんだから、
　水着姿になることくらい当然なのに……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What do I do? I can't even look her in the
eye because she's so pretty. This is a beach
date, of course she'd wear a swimsuit!)

fields.EN:
Are you nervous? You're my boyfriend after
all. You can ogle all you want.
fields.JP:
照れてるんですか～？
そなたはわらわの『彼氏』なんですから、
思う存分ガン見してもいいんですよ～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you nervous? You're my boyfriend after
all. You can ogle all you want.

fields.JP: べ、別にそんな、でも……えっと

fields.EN: Very well. I'll quit toying with you.
fields.JP:
さてと、ジャックをからかうのは
これくらいにして……
fields.LOCALIZED: Very well. I'll quit toying with you.

fields.EN: (Ugh, she really was teasing me after all.)
fields.JP: （うぅ、やっぱりからかわれてたんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Is this all a game to her...?)

fields.EN:
Please spread a sheet out on the beach.
I want to lie down.
fields.JP:
砂浜にシートを敷いてください～。
寝そべりたいので～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please lay the blanket flat on the sand.
I wish to nap whilst I tan.

fields.JP: あ、うん。ちょっと待ってて

fields.EN:
Thank you. I've gone and tuckered myself
out, so pardon me for needing rest.
fields.JP:
どうも～。
もうここまで来るだけで疲れてしまって、
限界だったんですよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you. I've gone and tuckered myself
out, so pardon me for needing rest.

fields.EN:
If you're so tired, then why'd you invite me
on a date?
fields.JP:
そんなに疲れていたんだ。
でもどうして急にデートしようなんて
言い出したの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you're so tired, then why'd you invite me
on a date?

fields.EN:
Every single day outside of work, Jack,
you've done nothing but laze around in my room, haven't you?
fields.JP:
ジャックは仕事以外では毎日毎日、
わらわの部屋でだらだらしてばかり
だったでしょう～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, the only thing you've done apart from
working is hover around my room.

fields.EN:
I couldn't stand watching you like that...
Rather, I just started to pity you.
fields.JP:
そんなそなたを見てられなかった……もとい、
哀れになっただけです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I couldn't bear to watch you subject yourself
to that torture anymore. I almost felt pity.

fields.EN: So you're doing all this for me?
fields.JP: つまりそれって、僕のために……？
fields.LOCALIZED: So you're doing all this for me?

fields.EN: No, it's for me. Don't get it twisted.
fields.JP:
わらわのためですよ～。
勘違いしないでくださいね～
fields.LOCALIZED: No, it's for me. Don't get it twisted.

fields.EN:
(I know she knows it's for me. That's so
sweet of her.)
fields.JP:
（とか言って、やっぱり僕のためだよね？
　嬉しいなぁ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I know she knows it's for me. That's so
sweet of her.)

fields.EN:
What are you grinning about?
If you're free, do this for me.
fields.JP:
なにをにやけてるんですか～？
ヒマならこれをお願いします～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you daydreaming again...? If you're bored,
take this.

fields.EN:
Apparently it's something called tanning oil.
When I told Miko I was going to the sea with Jack,
she made it for me.
fields.JP:
サンオイルというものらしいです～。
ジャックと海に行くと話したら、
視子が作ってくれました～
fields.LOCALIZED:
They call it sunblock, apparently. Miko gave
it to me after I informed her of our beach
plans.

fields.EN:
She suggested I put this on to ensure a
clean tan. But I can't tell how effective it
is.
fields.JP:
これを肌に塗ると、
きれいに日焼けできるそうですよ～。
ま、どれほど効果があるかわかりませんけど～
fields.LOCALIZED:
She suggested I put this on to ensure a
clean tan. But I can't tell how effective it
is.

fields.EN: Wow, something that convenient exists...? Hm?
fields.JP: へぇ、そんな便利なものが……ん？
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't even know what it's for... Hm?

fields.EN:
(Why'd she hand it to me? What do I do
with it?)
fields.JP:
（かぐや姫はなんでこれを僕に渡したんだ？
　お願いしますとか言ってたけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why'd she hand it to me? What do I do
with it?)

fields.EN: Wait... Do you want me to apply this on you?
fields.JP: ……まさか、僕がこれを君に塗るの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Wait... Do you want me to apply this on you?

fields.EN:
Well, obviously. Especially on my back.
I can't reach back there.
fields.JP:
まさかもなにも、それしかないじゃないですか～。
特に背中なんて自分じゃ塗れませんし～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, obviously. Especially on my back.
I can't reach back there.

fields.JP: そんなわけなので、お願いしますね～

fields.EN:
(Oh, this is bad. I'm getting nervous...
 But this is for Kaguyahime.
 There's nothing indecent about it...)
fields.JP:
（あれ、まずいぞ。緊張してきた……。
　でもこれはかぐや姫のためなんだ。
　別にやましいことじゃないんだから……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Crap. My hands are getting clammy.
Just remind yourself that it's for Kaguya.
No ulterior motives here.)

fields.EN:
(Right, I don't have any ulterior motive.
 This is purely for Kaguyahime...)
fields.JP:
（そう、僕に下心なんてない。
　ただ純粋にかぐや姫のために……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Nope, not a single one. Just doing this
strictly for Kaguya.)

fields.EN:
How long do you plan to make me wait?
On with it.
fields.JP:
いつまで待たせる気ですか～。
早くしてください～
fields.LOCALIZED:
How long do you plan to make me wait?
On with it.

fields.JP: わ、わかった。じゃあ、やるよ？

fields.EN:
No... There's almost a cooling effect to
it. It soothes the skin.
fields.JP:
いいえ～……。
ちょっとひんやりしてるけど、
ぺちょっとしてて、いい気持ちです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
No... There's almost a cooling effect to
it. It soothes the skin.

fields.EN:
Now hurry up and rub that slippery stuff
all over me, please~
fields.JP:
さ、早くそのぬるぬるを
ぬりぬりしてくださいな～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Would you be a dear and cover me in
that stuff?

fields.JP: 変な言い方しないでよ……

fields.EN:
(S-Soft... and so smooth.
 Her skin is beautiful.)
fields.JP:
（わ、柔らかい……それにすべすべしてる。
　きれいな肌だなぁ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's so soft, and slippery. Her skin is
flawless.)

fields.EN:
Aah. I can't tell you how relaxing this
feels. One could become addicted to it.
fields.JP:
はふぅ……、なんとも言えない心地よさ……。
クセになっちゃいそうです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aah. I can't tell you how relaxing this
feels. One could become addicted to it.

fields.EN:
When you've finished my back, please make
your way down.
fields.JP: 背中が終わったら、その下もお願いしますね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
When you've finished my back, please make
your way down.

fields.EN:
My butt and thighs.
If it's hard to apply it to my butt,
you can move my swimsuit aside.
fields.JP:
お尻と太ももです～。
お尻に塗りにくいなら、
水着をずらしていいですから～
fields.LOCALIZED:
My glutes and thighs. If my swimsuit gets
in the way, just move it.

fields.EN:
(I-Is this really okay?
 I know Kaguyahime is the type not to care about things like this,
 but her butt is still...)
fields.JP:
（ほ、本当にいいのかな。
　かぐや姫がそういうのに頓着しないタイプなのは
　わかってるけど、さすがにお尻なんて……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is she sure...? I know Kaguya's pretty
blunt, but butt-touching is something else!)

fields.EN:
Geez, why are you getting embarrassed now?
You're my boyfriend. It should be fine to rub
your girlfriend's butt once or twice, shouldn't it?
fields.JP:
も～、なにを今さら照れてるんですか～？
彼氏なら、彼女のお尻の一つや二つ、
揉んだっていいじゃないですか～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh. Why do you look so flustered?
You're my boyfriend. It's just a butt.

fields.EN:
Okay! I'll do it just so you stop pointing
all that stuff out. It only makes me more
nervous.
fields.JP:
わ、わかったよ！
塗るから、もうそれ以上言わないで。
なんか余計に恥ずかしくなってきた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay! I'll do it just so you stop pointing
all that stuff out. It only makes me more
nervous.

fields.EN:
It's also nice to be massaged. Aah.
Pure ecstasy.
fields.JP:
塗られる感触も気持ちいいものです～。
ごくらく、ごくらく～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's also nice to be massaged. Aah.
Pure ecstasy.

fields.EN:
I could just fall asleep right here. Please
carry me home if I do.
fields.JP:
気持ちよくてわらわは寝ちゃうかもしれないので、
帰りはおんぶしてくださいね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I could just fall asleep right here. Please
carry me home if I do.

fields.EN:
Lazing around outside like this once in a while
isn't so bad either.
fields.JP:
たまにはこうして、
外でだらだらするのも悪くないですね～
fields.LOCALIZED: I love a good day spent outdoors.

fields.EN:
A few years later.
The new village was developing smoothly,
and life had begun to stabilize—
fields.JP:
数年後。
新しい村づくりも順調に進み、
生活も安定してきたころ――。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A few years later...
Their village was beginning to flourish,
and the settlement became a haven for all.

fields.EN: Is this a church...? Looks beat-up in here.
fields.JP:
ここは教会……？
またずいぶんとぼろぼろですね～
fields.LOCALIZED: Is this a church...? Looks beat-up in here.

fields.EN:
I wonder why Jack called me here.
I've nearly hit my energy quota for the day.
fields.JP:
こんなところに呼び出して、
ジャックはなんの用なんでしょう……。
もう移動だけで疲れてしまいました～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder why Jack called me here.
I've nearly hit my energy quota for the day.

fields.EN:
Otsuu and Ningyo...?
Why are you two here?
fields.JP:
おつうに人魚……？
なぜあなたたちがここに～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, Little Mermaid...?
What are you guys doing here?

fields.EN: You'll find out soon. Come this way.
fields.JP:
それはこれからわかるさ。
こっちに来てもらおうか
fields.LOCALIZED: You'll find out soon. Come this way.

fields.JP: かぐやちゃん、ごめんね！

い、いきなり目隠しなんかして、
どういうつもりですか～！？

fields.EN: Hehe. If you sit still, we won't hurt you.
fields.JP:
ふふふ。大人しくしていれば
悪いようにはしないさ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. If you sit still, we won't hurt you.

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan,
that makes you sound like a villain...
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん、
それじゃ悪者みたいなセリフだよ……

fields.EN: Aah! Why are you undoing my clothes?!
fields.JP:
あ～れぇ～！
なんか服を脱がされてる感じですよ～！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Aah! Why are you undoing my clothes?!

fields.EN:
Whoa. Stop moving around! This took
a lot of effort to make!
fields.JP:
うわ、暴れるなって！
これ作るの大変だったんだからな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa. Stop moving around! This took
a lot of effort to make!

fields.JP: きゃー、大人しくしていてー！
できたよ、かぐやちゃん！

fields.EN:
A wedding dress!
Otsuu-chan made it for you.
fields.JP:
ウェディングドレス！
おつうちゃんが作ってくれたんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED: A wedding dress! Otsuu made it for you.

fields.EN:
I thought a shiromuku would suit Kaguya better,
but I just couldn't gather the materials,
so I made a dress instead.
fields.JP:
本当は白無垢のほうがかぐやに似合うかと
思ったんだけど、どうしても素材が
集まらなかったからドレスにしたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I really wanted to design you a kimono, but
I ran out of materials, so I made a dress.

fields.EN: No... It is very skillfully made...
fields.JP:
いえ……そんな。
とてもお上手で……
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh... Please. This dress is so fetching...

fields.EN:
Yeah. We'll take our leave now
so we don't get in the way.
fields.JP: うん。邪魔者はこれで失礼するよ
……あの二人はなにがしたかったんでしょう

fields.EN:
This gown is impeccably made. I don't
understand. Must thank them again later.
fields.JP:
……でも、きれいなドレス……。
よくわかりませんけど、
あとでお礼を言ったほうがいいでしょうね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
This gown is impeccably made. I don't
understand. Must thank them again later.

fields.JP: ジャック！　遅いで……す……？

fields.EN:
Tsuu made it for me.
I'm not used to wearing something like this,
so it's a little embarrassing.
fields.JP:
つうに作ってもらったんだ。
ちょっと慣れなくて照れるけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu tailored it for me. It's not my usual
style, so I'm a little shy to wear it.

fields.EN:
...Kaguyahime, you look beautiful.
Seeing you in a wedding dress
feels like a dream.
fields.JP:
……かぐや姫、きれいだよ。
君のウェディングドレス姿が見られるなんて
夢みたいだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya, you're beautiful. Seeing you in
a wedding dress is a dream come to life.

fields.EN:
W-Well, thank you...
Otsuu and Ningyo are here because you put them up to this, right?
fields.JP:
そ、それはどうも……。
おつうと人魚はそなたの差し金ですね～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, thanks... So this is Otsuu and Little
Mermaid's doing, I presume?

fields.EN:
Calling me out to a place like this
and making me dress like this...
just what are you planning?
fields.JP:
こんなところに呼び出して、
こんな格好をさせて……いったい
どういうつもりですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
They summoned me here and swapped out
my wardrobe. What's the meaning of this?

fields.EN: I wanted to tell you something.
fields.JP: 君に伝えたいことがあるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: I wanted to tell you something.

fields.EN:
Hey, remember? When we first met,
you weren't cooperative at all,
and you treated me pretty coldly too.
fields.JP:
ねえ、覚えてる？　僕たちが出会ったころ、
君は全然協力的じゃなかったし、
僕もすごく邪険にされたりしてさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you remember when we first met?
You were totally uncooperative. I thought
you hated me.

fields.JP: もう、そんな昔のことを……

fields.EN:
But you were carrying all kinds of secrets and things from your past,
and you were always struggling with them. Once I learned that,
my impression of you started to change.
fields.JP:
でも君はいろんな秘密や過去を背負って、
ずっと悩んでいたんだよね。それを知って、
君に対する印象が変わっていったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But that was because you had a whole life
you lived before. Knowing what you went
through, my view of you changed.

fields.EN:
You may look like you're always lazing around,
but no matter what happened, you faced every problem seriously.
I really respect that about you, Kaguyahime.
fields.JP:
君はだらけているようでいて、どんなときも
問題に対して真剣に向き合っていた。
そんなかぐや姫を、僕は尊敬しているよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You come off lazy, but that's only because
you focus your attention on things that have
actual weight. You've gained my respect.

fields.EN:
Even while saying 'what a pain,'
you still looked out for everyone around you.
Whenever I was in trouble, you were always there to help me.
fields.JP:
それに『めんどくさい』って言いながらも、
周りのことを気にしてくれていた。
僕が困ったときはいつも君に助けられた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even when things get strenuous or chaotic,
you're right there to help. It meant a lot
whenever I was in a bind.

fields.EN:
After we started going out,
I just came to love you more and more...
fields.JP:
付き合うようになってから、
僕はますます君のことが好きになって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
After we started going out, I realized thow
much I love that side of you.

fields.EN: So um, with all that said, I love you!
fields.JP:
つまりその、い、いろんなところを含めて、
君を愛してる……！
fields.LOCALIZED: So um, with all that said, I love you!

fields.EN:
So I want you to keep living by my side,
forever!
fields.JP:
だからこれからもずっと、
僕と一緒に生きてほしいんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please, let's keep building our future
together!

fields.EN:
(Was that a sigh?! Oh man. Did my proposal
fail?!)
fields.JP:
（ため息！？
　まさかプロポーズ失敗！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Was that a sigh?! Oh man. Did my proposal
fail?!)

fields.EN:
You went through all this effort to tell me
that?
fields.JP:
それを言うためだけに、
わざわざこんな凝った真似を
したんですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You went through all this effort to tell me
that?

fields.EN: Oh, yeah... Was that a bad thing?
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, yeah... Was that a bad thing?

fields.EN:
Hehe. You're a peculiar one, Jack.
You proposed to the laziest woman around.
fields.JP:
ふふ、ジャックは物好きですね～。
こんな面倒くさがりで、ごろごろしてばかりの
わらわにプロポーズなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. You're a peculiar one, Jack.
You proposed to the laziest woman around.

fields.EN:
You might not have realized, but it's me
who's been saved by you.
fields.JP:
……そなたはわかってないかもしれませんが、
わらわこそ、そなたにはいつも助けられて
いるんですからね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
You might not have realized, but it's me
who's been saved by you.

fields.EN:
The reason why I made it this far was
because you never abandoned me.
I'm just grateful, you know?
fields.JP:
わらわが今までやってこられたのは、
そなたがわらわを見捨てなかったからです。
……これでも感謝しているんですよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
The reason why I made it this far was
because you never abandoned me.
I'm just grateful, you know?

fields.EN: So um, I don't mind accepting your offer...
fields.JP:
だから、その……。
そなたの申し出を受けても構いません……
fields.LOCALIZED: So um, I don't mind accepting your offer...

fields.EN:
You'd better brace yourself. Now I'm never
letting you go.
fields.JP:
こうなった以上、覚悟しておいてくださいね～。
もう離してあげるつもりはないですよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
You'd better brace yourself. Now I'm never
letting you go.

fields.EN: Because I love you too, Jack...
fields.JP: わらわも、そなたを愛しているんですから……
fields.LOCALIZED: Because I love you too, Jack...

fields.EN: Sorry to keep you waiting, Jack-san.
fields.JP: お待たせしましたわ、ジャックさん

fields.EN: Cinderella! Sorry for calling you out so suddenly.
fields.JP:
シンデレラ！
急に呼び出して、ごめんね
fields.LOCALIZED: Cinderella! Sorry for all the trouble.

fields.EN: No. I was hoping to see you too, Jack-san.
fields.JP:
いいえ。わたくしもジャックさんに
会いたいと思っていましたの
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, don't fret. I wanted to see you.

fields.EN:
I'm happy to see you too.
How have you been lately? Are you getting used to your new life?
fields.JP:
僕も会えて嬉しいよ。
最近はどう？　今の暮らしには慣れた？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You have no idea how happy I am to see
you. How've been? Getting used to things
up here?

fields.EN:
I've been terribly busy.
Starting a new life really does come with all kinds of difficulties.
fields.JP:
大忙しですわ。
やはり新しい暮らしを始めるというのは、
なにかと大変なものですわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Busy, to say the least. I hardly have time
for myself.

fields.JP:
それでもがんばればがんばっただけ
幸せが待っていると思うと、
がんばるのも苦ではありませんわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But good things to those who wait, so it
doesn't trouble me to work hard.

fields.JP: そうだね。僕もわかるなぁ

fields.EN:
But things have finally settled down a little lately,
and I've got some breathing room—enough to come see you like this, Jack-san.
fields.JP:
でも、このごろは一段落ついて
少し余裕も出てきましたわ。
こうしてジャックさんに会いに来られるくらいには
fields.LOCALIZED:
But my schedule's finally freeing up now
that things are normalizing, which means
I make more time for you.

fields.EN: Then could we talk for a bit while we walk around here?
fields.JP:
それならこの辺りを歩きながら、
少し話せるかな
fields.LOCALIZED: Why don't the two of us take a walk?

fields.EN:
The breeze feels wonderful.
I never imagined the day would come when
we could live above ground like this.
fields.JP:
風が気持ちいいですわね。
昔は、地上でこんなふうに暮らせる日が
来るなんて思いもしませんでしたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That breeze sure feels nice. Seems funny to
feel wistful about how everything unfolded.

fields.EN: It was definitely a team effort.
fields.JP: みんなでがんばってきたおかげだよ
fields.LOCALIZED: It was definitely a team effort.

fields.EN:
When we were separated, it occurred to me
that I may never see you again, but now look
at us. Together at last.
fields.JP:
少しの間離れ離れになって、
もう会えないかもしれないと思ったことも
あったけど、無事に再会できたし
fields.LOCALIZED:
When we were separated, it occurred to me
that I may never see you again, but now look
at us. Together at last.

fields.EN:
There's no telling what's coming next,
but I know we'll be just fine.
fields.JP:
これからも大変なことがあったって、
僕たちなら乗り越えられるさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no telling what's coming next,
but I know we'll be just fine.

fields.JP: それで、その……シンデレラ

fields.EN:
When I picture my future, you're the first
person who comes to mind.
fields.JP:
これからのことを考えたとき、
真っ先に君の顔が思い浮かんだんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
When I picture my future, you're the first
person who comes to mind.

fields.EN:
This may not really be the right time to say it,
but I don't want to regret staying silent
if someday I lose the chance to say it at all...
fields.JP:
本当なら今みたいなときに言うべきことじゃ
ないかもしれないけど、言えなくなってから
後悔はしたくない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I probably could have timed this better,
but if I held it any longer, I might burst.

fields.EN:
Peace isn't guaranteed. We know better
than anyone not to take it for granted.
That's why I'm telling you this.
fields.JP:
あのときみたいなことが、
いつ再び起きないとも限らない。
だから大事なことは今伝えておきたいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Peace isn't guaranteed. We know better
than anyone not to take it for granted.
That's why I'm telling you this.

fields.EN:
Cinderella, I-I like you.
Will you stay with me from now on...?
fields.JP:
シンデレラ、す、好きです。
これからも僕と一緒にいてくれますか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella, I love you. Will you go out with
me?

fields.EN:
Ohohohohoho. Jack-san,
you really are quite the jokester, aren't you~?
fields.JP:
おほほほほほほ。ジャックさんったら、
ご冗談がお上手でございますですから～
fields.LOCALIZED: Ohohoho. Jack, you're a real jokester.

fields.EN:
This must be a prank. Why else would
something this good happen to me?
fields.JP:
わたくしに、こんな幸せが訪れるなんて
あるはずがございませんことよ～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
This must be a prank. Why else would
something this good happen to me?

fields.EN:
That's not true. You will be happy.
After everything you've been through,
you deserve to be as happy as possible!
fields.JP:
そんなことないよ。君は幸せになる。
これまで苦労してきた分、
めいっぱい幸せにならないと！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not a prank. I want to make you happy.
That's what we've building. Happiness!

fields.JP: だ、だから……僕と一緒に、幸せになろう！
fields.LOCALIZED: So please...let me make you happy!

fields.EN: But are you sure? A girl like me...?
fields.JP: でも……あの、本当にわたくしなんかで……？
fields.LOCALIZED: But are you sure? A girl like me...?

fields.JP: シンデレラがいいんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED: You're the only girl I need, Cinderella.

fields.EN:
You often lose heart because you lack confidence,
but when it's for someone else, you're always the first
to reach out and help them.
fields.JP:
君は自信が持てなくてよく落ち込んでいるのに、
人のためなら誰よりも先に手を差し伸べて
助けてくれる
fields.LOCALIZED:
None of your insecurities measure up to
the person you are. The helpful, humble
hard worker. You're really something.

fields.EN:
