Your kindness empowers me. Now that
things are slowing down, it's given me
time to think about you. Just you.
fields.JP:
君の優しさが僕の心を強くしてくれた。
平和になった今、気がついたら
そんな君のことばかり考えていたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your kindness empowers me. Now that
things are slowing down, it's given me
time to think about you. Just you.

fields.EN:
This is a dream come true, yet I'm afraid
I could wake at any minute. Splendid...
fields.JP:
まるで夢のようですわ……。
覚めてしまわないか心配になるくらい、
素敵な夢……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is a dream come true, yet I'm afraid
I could wake at any minute. Splendid...

fields.EN:
Well, you're not going to wake up.
Because this isn't a dream. It's real.
Let's build a life together.
fields.JP:
覚めないよ。夢じゃないんだから。
現実で、一緒に幸せになろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, you're not going to wake up.
Because this isn't a dream. It's real.
Let's build a life together.

fields.EN:
...Yes!
If I'm with you,
I'm sure I can be happy.
fields.JP:
……っ、はい！
あなたと一緒なら、
わたくしはきっと幸せになれますわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay! At your side, we can conquer anything!

fields.EN: Jack-san, what do you think of my swimsuit?
fields.JP:
ジャックさん、
わたくしの水着はいかがでしょうか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack, how do you fancy my swimsuit?

fields.EN:
Would something more mature and stylish
have been better...?
fields.JP:
もっと大人っぽくおしゃれな感じのほうが
よかったでしょうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you think I have picked a more modest
design?

fields.JP: そんなことないよ。すごく素敵だね

fields.EN: (It's almost hard to know where to look...)
fields.JP: （ちょっと目のやり場に困るくらい……）

fields.EN:
I'm glad you like it.
I got this swimsuit ready for our beach date today.
fields.JP:
褒めていただけて嬉しいですわ。
今日の海デートのために用意していた水着ですの
fields.LOCALIZED:
What a relief. I deliberated all day about
what to wear on our seaside date.

fields.EN:
We're both so busy,
so ever since we finally managed to make time for a date,
I've been looking forward to it so much...
fields.JP:
わたくしたちはなにかと多忙ですもの、
ようやく時間の都合をつけてデートに行ける
ことになってから、ずっと楽しみにしていて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Things have been non-stop. Even sitting feels
like a luxury at times. I've been looking forward
to it all.

fields.EN:
So have I. We're at the beach for crying
out loud. Nothing but good times ahead.
fields.JP:
僕もだよ。せっかくの海なんだから、
今日はたくさん楽しもうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So have I. We're at the beach for crying
out loud. Nothing but good times ahead.

fields.EN:
Agreed. We can swim, build sand castles,
or even hunt for pretty seashells!
fields.JP:
そうですわね。
泳いだり、砂のお城を作ったり、
それからキレイな貝殻も拾いたいですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Agreed. We can swim, build sand castles,
or even hunt for pretty seashells!

fields.EN:
Wouldn't it be lovely to fashion accessories
from shells? I can make souvenirs for the 
others!
fields.JP:
拾った貝殻でアクセサリーを作れたら
素敵ですわよね。それからみんなへの
お土産にもいいですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wouldn't it be lovely to fashion accessories
from shells? I can make souvenirs for the 
others!

fields.EN: You said it. Let's do it all!
fields.JP: よーし、じゃあそれを全部やっちゃおう！
fields.LOCALIZED: You said it. Let's do it all!

fields.JP: はい！　がんばりましょう！

fields.EN:
It's a walkie-talkie Haru-san made.
We can use it to talk even when we're far apart.
fields.JP:
ハルさんが作った通信機だよ。
離れていてもこれでやり取りができるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
One of Haru's transmitters. It allows us to
communicate from long distance.

fields.EN:
When I told Haru-san I was going out today,
he made me bring it in case something happened.
fields.JP:
今日出かけるって話したら、
なにかあったときのためにって
ハルさんに持たされちゃったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I told him I was going out, and he gave it
to me in case of emergency.

fields.EN: But I'm on a date right now...
fields.JP: 今はデート中なんだけどな……
fields.LOCALIZED: But I'm on a date right now...

fields.EN:
Well, if he needs to get ahold of you, fine.
You're welcome to speak with him. I'll be
searching for seashells.
fields.JP:
用事があるなら仕方ありませんわ。
通信に出てください。わたくしは
貝殻でも探して待っていますから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, if he needs to get ahold of you, fine.
You're welcome to speak with him. I'll be
searching for seashells.

fields.EN: Sorry Cinderella, I'll make it quick.
fields.JP:
ごめんね、シンデレラ。
通信はすぐ終わらせるから
fields.LOCALIZED: Sorry Cinderella, I'll make it quick.

fields.EN:
This is Jack.
Haru-san, did you need something? Over.
fields.JP:
こちらジャックです。
ハルさん、なにかご用ですか？
どうぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack here, over. You need anything, Haru?
Over.

fields.EN:
Yeah, Jack, sorry.
I actually lost the reference sheet
for what we're supposed to gather today...
fields.JP:
ああ、ジャックかすまない。
実は今日採取するものの資料を
紛失しちまってだな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey Jack, sorry. Bad news. I lost the harvest
index list...

fields.EN:
What?! So you don't know
what we're supposed to gather today?
fields.JP:
え！　じゃあ今日なにを採取すればいいのか
わからないってことですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?! So we don't know which plants to
pick when?

fields.EN:
Yeah, you mind running me through your
list? Sorry for crashing your date.
fields.JP:
そうなんだ。
だから一つずつ確認してもいいか？
デート中に悪いな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, you mind running me through your
list? Sorry for crashing your date.

fields.EN:
H-How do you know...?!
No, really, don't worry about it!
fields.JP:
なな、なんで知って……！
いや、別に気にしなくていいですから！
fields.LOCALIZED: H-How did you know...? I mean, sure!

fields.EN: Let me grab my bag... Here it is.
fields.JP:
えーと、たしかカバンの中に
資料が入っていたはず……あった
fields.LOCALIZED: Let me grab my bag... Here it is.

fields.JP: じゃあ、確認いきますよー？

fields.EN:
(Oh man. This is taking forever. I'm still not
done...)
fields.JP:
（あ～、確認にけっこう時間かかっちゃってる。
　まだ終わらない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh man. This is taking forever. I'm still not
done...)

fields.EN:
(Cinderella's completely in a bad mood.
Of course she is after I kept her waiting this long.
She's already picked up every seashell around here.)
fields.JP:
（シンデレラ、完全にご機嫌斜めだよ。
　こんなに待たせちゃったら当然だよね。
　貝殻なんか拾いつくしちゃったし）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Cinderella seems livid. Understandable
since I kept her waiting. Looks like she
gathered a bunch of seashells.)

fields.EN:
(Huh? Cinderella's hugging me. Maybe she
needs some close contact.)
fields.JP:
（？　シンデレラが急にくっついてきた。
　スキンシップしたいのかな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? Cinderella's hugging me. Maybe she
needs some close contact.)

fields.EN:
(Ah... It's touching me...!
There's something soft pressing against my arm...)
fields.JP:
（あ……当たってる……！
　僕の腕に、なんか柔らかい感触が……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Ooh... She's hugging me tight!
I think we might be too close for comfort!)

fields.EN:
That call is taking forever,
so I finally got bored.
You don't mind if I cling to you a little, do you?
fields.JP:
なかなか通信が終わらないものですから、
さすがに退屈しちゃいましたわ。
くっつくくらい、構いませんでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Making up for all that time you spent away
from me. This is the least I can do, right?

fields.EN: This is sweet, but I can't concentrate.
fields.JP:
で、でも今はちょっと待ってほしいな。
なんていうか、集中力が……
fields.LOCALIZED: This is sweet, but I can't concentrate.

fields.JP: 集中力が、どうかしましたの？

fields.EN:
(Everything fiber of my being is focused
on her chest brushing up against my arm.)
fields.JP:
（しゅ、集中力が、胸の感触に
　持っていかれてしまう……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Everything fiber of my being is focused
on her chest brushing up against my arm.)

fields.EN: Hm? Oh... Don't mean to intrude.
fields.JP:
ん？　……ああ、そうか。
邪魔したみたいだな
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm? Oh... Don't mean to intrude.

fields.EN:
(Oh, thank you Haru for getting the hint!
Thank you! But also super embarrassing!)
fields.JP:
（ハルさんなにか察してくれた……！？
　ありがとうございます！
　でもそれはそれでかなり照れくさい！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh, thank you Haru for getting the hint!
Thank you! But also super embarrassing!)

fields.EN:
We're all set here now. That really helped.
Take your time and enjoy yourselves over there.
fields.JP:
こっちはもう大丈夫だ。おかげで助かった。
そっちはゆっくり楽しんできてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Leave the rest to me. Thanks, kid. You're
a big help. Enjoy your date. Over and out.

fields.JP:
はー……。シンデレラ、
ハルさんの用事はやっと終わったよ。
待たせてごめんね

fields.EN:
Seriously. It's supposed to be a date...
Next time, please don't bring such an unromantic
walkie-talkie along on our date, all right?
fields.JP:
本当ですわ。せっかくのデートですのに……。
もう次からは、無粋な通信機なんて
デートには持ってこないでくださいね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Promise me something. On our next date,
you'll leave the transmitter at home, okay?

fields.EN: Right. So, um...you're on my arm.
fields.JP:
わかったよ。
……ところで、さっきから、そのー、
僕の腕に……
fields.LOCALIZED: Right. So, um...you're on my arm.

fields.EN:
That's why I'm linking arms with you and staying close.
You left me alone even though we're on a date,
so this much is only fair, isn't it?
fields.JP:
ですから、腕を絡めてくっついているんですわ。
デートなのに放っておかれたんですから、
これくらいは当然でしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Consider it your punishment for ignoring
me our whole date. It's the least you can do.

fields.EN:
But you're pressing way too close...
All sorts of things are touching me...
fields.JP:
だけど密着しすぎっていうか、
いろいろ当たってるんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you're too close. You're practically
smothering me.

fields.JP: わざと当てているんですもの

fields.EN:
(That's so bold! Of course I don't dislike it!
But what do I do? Her chest is so soft, it feels amazing—
no, that's not the point; what am I supposed to do...?!)
fields.JP:
（そんな大胆な！　もちろん嫌じゃないけど！
　でもどうしよう、胸が柔らかい、すごくいい、
　じゃなくて僕はどうすれば……っ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's so bold! I guess I don't mind, but
what do I do? Her chest is so soft, so nice.
How do I deal with this...?)

fields.EN:
You're troubled, aren't you, Jack-san?
It's written all over your face.
fields.JP:
困っていますわね、ジャックさん。
動揺が全部顔に出てしまっていますわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You have panic written all over your face,
Jack.

fields.EN: Rgh... I really was panicking. Don't mock me.
fields.JP:
う……、だって本当に困ったんだ。
からかわないでよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Rgh... I really was panicking. Don't mock me.

fields.EN:
Hehe, it can't be helped.
I'll forgive you this time.
fields.JP:
ふふ、仕方ないですわね。
今回は許してさしあげますわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. Very well. You've escaped my grasp
this time.

fields.JP:
（あ、かわいい……。
　惚れた弱みっていうか、僕もシンデレラに
　ベタ惚れしてるなぁ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's so charming. She has me wrapped
around her finger. Guess this is love.)

fields.EN:
Jack-san, let's play in the sea!
And after making me wait, you're going to spend
plenty of time with me!
fields.JP:
ジャックさん、海で遊びましょう！
待たされたぶんも、たくさん付き合って
もらいますわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, time to explore the beach! You owe
me a whole day's worth of adventures for
ignoring me!

fields.EN:
I'm going to stay glued to you all day today,
and I won't let go!
fields.JP:
今日はもうずーっとくっついて、
離しませんことよ！

fields.EN:
A few years later.
The new village was developing smoothly,
and life had begun to stabilize—
fields.JP:
数年後。
新しい村づくりも順調に進み、
生活も安定してきたころ――。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A few years later...
Their village was beginning to flourish,
and the settlement became a haven for all.

fields.EN:
This chapel has seen better days...
Why would Jack invite me here?
fields.JP:
なんだかさびれた教会ですわね……。
ジャックはなぜこんなところに
呼び出したのでしょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
This chapel has seen better days...
Why would Jack invite me here?

fields.EN: I've been waiting for you, Cinderella.
fields.JP: 待っていたぞ、シンデレラ
シンデレラさん、こんにちは

fields.EN:
Oh, Otsuu-san and Ningyohime-san.
How do you do?
fields.JP:
あら、おつうさんに人魚姫さん。
ごきげんよう
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, Otsuu and Little Mermaid. How do you do?

fields.EN: Did Jack invite you both here as well?
fields.JP:
ジャックはあなたたちも
ここに呼び出していたのですわね
fields.LOCALIZED: Did Jack invite you both here as well?

fields.EN:
Well, yes...but we'll exchange pleasantries
later. You're coming with us.
fields.JP:
まあそうなんだが……話はあとだ。
ちょっと来てもらおうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, yes...but we'll exchange pleasantries
later. You're coming with us.

fields.EN:
It's fine. Just stay calm, and we'll be done
with you in a jiffy.
fields.JP:
大丈夫だよ。
大人しくしていればすぐ終わるから
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's fine. Just stay calm, and we'll be done
with you in a jiffy.

fields.EN: What the? What is that?! That thing!
fields.JP:
ま……まさかこれはアレですか！？
アレですの！？
fields.LOCALIZED: What the? What is that?! That thing!

fields.EN:
Is this one of those, 'Lend me your face—meet me behind
the church!' situations?!
fields.JP:
ちょっとツラ貸せや、教会裏まで来いや！
とかいう展開ですのー！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is this some kind of sick ritual? Is this
how I die?!

fields.EN:
No, it's not.
You really haven't changed—you go negative immediately.
fields.JP:
違うから。
すぐネガティブになるのは相変わらずだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Enough. We don't have time for the drama
right now.

fields.EN:
We don't have time to waste.
...Hime, let's use force.
fields.JP:
もう時間が惜しい。
……姫、実力行使でいこう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Quickly now, Princess. Time for some
hasty maneuvers.

fields.EN: Brilliant! I'll blindfold her right away!
fields.JP: 了解！　目隠しいきまーす！
fields.LOCALIZED: Brilliant! I'll blindfold her right away!

fields.EN:
Aah! It's dark!
I can't see anything!
fields.JP:
きゃー！　暗いですわー！
なにも見えませんわー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Aaaaaaah! My eyes! I can't see!

fields.EN:
Hey, sit still! You're going to tear it.
I worked damn hard on this!
fields.JP:
ええい、じたばたするな！
せっかく作ったのに破れるだろうが！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, sit still! You're going to tear it.
I worked damn hard on this!

fields.EN:
Huh? Tear what? I wouldn't want to put your
hard work to waste.
fields.JP:
え？　破れるって……。
なにかわかりませんけど、
破れるのはもったいないですわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Tear what? I wouldn't want to put your
hard work to waste.

fields.JP: シンデレラさん、じっとしていてね

fields.EN: Wow! It's a beautiful wedding gown!
fields.JP: まあ、なんて素敵なウェディングドレス……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Wow! It's a beautiful wedding gown!

fields.EN: You like? I think it's my masterpiece.
fields.JP: だろ？　僕の自信作だ
fields.LOCALIZED: You like? I think it's my masterpiece.

fields.EN: You're even more beautiful than usual, Cinderella-san!
fields.JP: いつも以上にきれいだよ。シンデレラさん！

fields.EN: Thank you, but what is it all for?
fields.JP:
ありがとうございます。
でも、なぜこれを……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Thank you, but what is it all for?

fields.EN: Ask him yourself. We'll leave you to it.
fields.JP:
それはあいつから聞けばいい。
じゃあ、僕たちはこれで失礼するよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Ask him yourself. We'll leave you to it.

fields.EN: Him? Oh, that reminds me... Where's Jack?
fields.JP:
あいつ？
……そういえば、ジャックがまだですわね
fields.LOCALIZED: Him? Oh, that reminds me... Where's Jack?

fields.JP: あら？　ジャック、その姿って……

fields.EN:
I had Tsuu make it to match your dress.
It wouldn't look right if I were the only one
dressed the same as always.
fields.JP:
君のドレスと揃えてつうに作ってもらったんだ。
僕だけいつもと同じじゃ、様にならないからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu designed it for me, along with
the dressed. The occasion called for it.

fields.EN:
That dress looks incredible on you, Cinderella.
You look like a real princess.
fields.JP:
……シンデレラ、そのドレスよく似合ってるよ。
今日の君は本当にお姫様みたいだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That dress looks incredible on you, Cinderella.
You look like a real princess.

fields.JP: お姫様だなんて、そんな……

fields.EN: Hey Cinderella, can I tell you something?
fields.JP:
ねえ、シンデレラ。
僕の気持ちを聞いてくれる？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey Cinderella, can I tell you something?

fields.EN:
My feelings?
...For you to say that so formally... could it be...?
fields.JP:
気持ち？
……こんな改まって言うなんて、まさか
fields.LOCALIZED: Tell me something? You sound stern.

fields.EN: Are... Are you going to break up with me?
fields.LOCALIZED: Are... Are you going to break up with me?

fields.EN:
I wouldn't dress up like this just to do that.
You're not as bad as you used to be, but you still
go straight to negative thoughts, don't you?
fields.JP:
こんな格好してまでそれはないから。
昔ほどじゃないけど、やっぱりすぐ
後ろ向きな思考になっちゃうんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why would I do all this just to break up with
you? You don't have to assume the worst.
You've made such strides.

fields.EN:
But, um...
I love you including that negative side of you, you know.
fields.JP:
でも、あの……。
そういうネガティブなところも含めて、
僕は君のことが好きなんだけどさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I mean, sure. You might not be the cheeriest
person around, but I love you all the same.

fields.EN:
I think I was able to make it this far
because I met you.
fields.JP:
僕は君に出会えたから、
ここまでやってこられたんだと思う
fields.LOCALIZED: You're the reason I'm on the surface at all.

fields.EN:
When we first met, I thought you were the cleaning lady.
And even though you looked like a refined young lady, I was
surprised by how strangely ordinary you could be.
fields.JP:
初めて会ったときは掃除の人かと
思っちゃったし、お嬢様みたいなのに
妙に庶民的なところもあって驚いたけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
When we first met, I thought you were a maid.
Then I found you're just a really down-to-earth
nobleperson. It surprised me.

fields.EN: Is this supposed to be a compliment?
fields.JP: 微妙にけなしてませんこと……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Is this supposed to be a compliment?

fields.EN:
The more I've gotten to know you, the more
attracted I am to you.
fields.JP:
君のことを知っていくうちに、
どんどん君を好きになっていったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The more I've gotten to know you, the more
attracted I am to you.

fields.EN:
Even though you're timid and negative, you always try
your hardest. Seeing you like that gave me courage
again and again.
fields.JP:
君は怖がりでネガティブなのに、
いつも懸命にがんばろうとしていた。
その姿に何度も勇気づけられたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure you get scared or negative from time
to time, but you always try your best. That
inspires me.

fields.EN:
And I came to want to protect you
with everything I have.
fields.JP:
そしてそんな君を、精一杯守って
あげたいって思うようになったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want nothing more than to spend my life
keeping you safe.

fields.EN:
(I'm so nervous. My voice could crack at any
minute. But I have to finish strong...!)
fields.JP:
（緊張する。こ、声が裏返りそう。
　でもここは精一杯かっこよく……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm so nervous. My voice could crack at any
minute. But I have to finish strong...!)

fields.EN:
I want to be with you forever, Cinderella.
I love you so much.
fields.JP:
ぼ、僕はシンデレラとずっと一緒にいたい。
……愛してるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want to be with you forever, Cinderella.
I love you so much.

fields.EN:
Someone as negative and vain as me...
to hear you say something like that...
I can't believe I could ever be this happy...
fields.JP:
ネガティブで見栄っ張りなわたくしなんかが、
そんなことを言っていただけるなんて……。
こんな幸せなことがあるなんて……っ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I'm so fake and negative. You really
see the best in me. I never knew I could
be this happy.

fields.EN:
You have to become as happy as you possibly can.
From now on, you'll live happily forever,
and it'll be a true happily ever after.
fields.JP:
君はめいっぱい幸せにならなきゃ駄目だよ。
これからはずっと幸せに暮らして、
めでたしめでたしってなるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're gonna be the happiest couple ever.
And we'll have our happily ever after.

fields.JP: シンデレラ、どうか返事を聞かせて
……もちろん返事は決まっていますわ

fields.EN: I love you too, Jack! Let's be together forever!
fields.JP:
わたくしも、ジャックを愛していますわ。
ずっと一緒にいたい……！
fields.LOCALIZED: I love you too, Jack! Let's be together forever!

fields.EN:
Thank you...
Cinderella, I swear I'll love you forever.
fields.JP:
ありがとう……。
シンデレラ、君をずっと愛することを誓うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a plan... I vow to love you forever,
Cinderella.

fields.EN:
Jack, me too... I vow to love you until the end
of time.
fields.JP:
ジャック……わたくしもですわ。
あなたを愛し続けることを誓います……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, me too... I vow to love you until the end
of time.

fields.EN:
(It's almost time to meet. I hope Gretel
comes soon.)
fields.JP:
（……もうすぐ約束の時間だ。
　グレーテルは来てくれるかな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's almost time to meet. I hope Gretel
comes soon.)

fields.EN:
(Part of me would feel relief if she didn't
make it, even if I invited her here... No.
don't be an idiot. Why am I chickening out?)
fields.JP:
（僕から呼んだくせに、来なければ来ないで、
　ホッとしそうな気がする……。馬鹿だな。
　今になって怖気づくなんて……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Part of me would feel relief if she didn't
make it, even if I invited her here... No.
don't be an idiot. Why am I chickening out?)

fields.EN:
(But I can't move forward if I drag on like
this. Gotta just deal with it.)
fields.JP:
（でもこの迷いを引きずったままじゃ、
　たぶん僕は前に進めない……。
　もう決着をつけないといけないんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But I can't move forward if I drag on like
this. Gotta just deal with it.)

fields.EN:
Hey Gretel... Incredible. You made it on
the dot.
fields.JP:
やあ、グレーテル……。
さすが、時間ぴったりだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey Gretel... Incredible. You made it on
the dot.

fields.EN:
Of course. Arriving early wastes my time,
arriving late wastes yours. Inefficient.
fields.JP:
当然よ。早く来すぎて自分の
時間を浪費するのも、遅刻して相手の
時間を浪費するのも、非効率的だわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course. Arriving early wastes my time,
arriving late wastes yours. Inefficient.

fields.EN:
Well let's cut the idle chat, and get to the
chase.
fields.JP:
さて、前置きはこれくらいにして
本題に入りましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well let's cut the idle chat, and get to the
chase.

fields.EN:
You summoned me to a remote area.
There must be some greater meaning.
fields.JP:
わざわざこんな人目のないところに
呼び出すということは、なにか特別な
要件があると考えてよさそうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You summoned me to a remote area.
There must be some greater meaning.

fields.EN:
(I'm nervous. What am I supposed to say?
I need to say it soon, but I just can't
put it into words...)
fields.JP:
（緊張する。なんて言えばいいんだ？
　早く言わないといけないのに、
　うまく言葉にならない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm so nervous. What should I say?
I need to hurry and see it, but I can't
think of the words.)

fields.EN:
It seems you're poorly prepared. How unlike
you. Why don't we revisit this topic later?
fields.JP:
なにを話すか整理しきれていないようね。
あなたらしくないけど、そういうことなら
整理できてから改めて話してちょうだい
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems you're poorly prepared. How unlike
you. Why don't we revisit this topic later?

fields.EN:
...This really is unusual.
You can be indecisive, but even for you,
I've never seen you this unclear.
fields.JP:
……本当に、珍しいわね。
あなたは優柔不断なところもあるけれど、
それにしてもこんなにもはっきりしないなんて
fields.LOCALIZED:
I must say, this is a surprise. I know you can
be wishy-washy, but this something else.

fields.EN:
My guess is that you want me to listen
because talking it through will help you
organize your thoughts. Is that right?
fields.JP:
思うにあなたの希望は、
考えを整理したいから話を聞いてほしい
……というところかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I assume this means you need some time to
think, and you'd prefer if I waited to listen?

fields.JP: では、話してみるといいわ

fields.EN:
(Maybe it's wrong for me to ask Gretel
for advice about something like this. But...)
fields.JP:
（こんなことをグレーテルに相談するなんて、
　本当は間違っているのかもしれない。でも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I know consulting Gretel this way is silly,
but what else can I do...?)

fields.EN:
You see. I've developed feelings for this
girl.
fields.JP: 実は、僕はある女の子に恋をしているんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You see. I've developed feelings for this
girl.

fields.EN:
But I did something horrible to someone
who means a lot to her. She doesn't blame
me for it, but I know how much it hurt her.
fields.JP:
でも僕はその子の大切な人にひどいことを
してしまった。彼女は僕を責めないけど、
本当はきっとつらかったと思う……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I did something horrible to someone
who means a lot to her. She doesn't blame
me for it, but I know how much it hurt her.

fields.EN:
So I decided not to tell her how I feel,
and to keep those feelings buried inside me.
fields.JP:
だからその子への想いは伝えないで、
僕の胸の内にしまっておこうと思ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So I've been struggling to think of how
to admit how I feel about her...

fields.EN:
But when I thought that we could be separated again
at any time, like we were back then, I couldn't stop
thinking about her.
fields.JP:
だけどあのときみたいに、いつみんなが
離れ離れになるかわからないと思ったら、
彼女のことが気になって仕方なくなった
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it hit me when all of us were separated
that I never wanted to be burdened with 
regret. That made me yearn for her even more.

fields.EN:
Now I feel like I'll regret it if I don't confess
my feelings to her...
fields.JP:
そうしたら、この気持ちを伝えなければ
後悔すると思えてきて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now I feel like I'll regret it if I don't confess
my feelings to her...
What matters is that I know...

fields.JP:
（駄目だ。やっぱり、いったん濁そう。
　今の僕にはうまく話せそうにない。
　整理してからまた話すってことにして……）

fields.EN: You're talking about me and Hansel-niisan, aren't you?
fields.JP:
あなたが言っているのは、
私とヘンゼル兄さんの話かしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were referring to Hansel and me, weren't
you?

fields.EN: I thought about your vague story.
fields.JP:
あなたの要領を得ない話を聞いて、
私なりに考えてみたわ
fields.LOCALIZED: I thought about your vague story.

fields.EN:
Among the girls around you, when you said you'd done
something terrible to someone important to her,
Akazukin was the first person who came to mind.
fields.JP:
あなたの身の回りにいる女の子で
「大切な人にひどいことを」と聞いて、
真っ先に思い浮かんだのは赤ずきんよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
At first I suspected you were talking about
Red Riding Hood, given all she's dealt with.

fields.EN:
The Professor was someone important to Akazukin.
But seeing how conflicted you are, it doesn't seem
like you're talking about her.
fields.JP:
博士は赤ずきんにとって大切な人だったから。
ただあなたのその葛藤する様子を見ると、
彼女のことではないようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Professor was important to her, but
the way you struggle with turmoil over the
outcome makes it clear she's not the one.

fields.EN:
The Professor's evil was obvious, so it's hard to believe
you'd agonize over it this much.
fields.JP:
博士が悪であったことは明白なのだから、
あなたがそこまで思い悩むとは考えにくいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Without a doubt the Professor was evil.
There is less cause for you to feel guilt
for having vanquished him.

fields.EN:
Besides, if that were what you wanted advice about,
there would be someone better suited than me
to talk to, wouldn't there?
fields.JP:
さらにそんなことを相談するなら、
他に私より適任がいるでしょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
And you wouldn't have come to me to
discuss the matter if it were. That leaves
one better candidate.

fields.EN:
You went out of your way to tell me, yet you also had
a reason to hesitate. I simply inferred that the girl
must be me.
fields.JP:
わざわざ私に言う、なおかつ言うのを
躊躇する理由があるとすれば、
私のことだろうと推論したまでよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thus I've deduced the answer, confirmed
by the way you squirm when I suggest that
it is, in fact, me.

fields.EN:
(Gretel's so logical. Now I feel even dumber
for stressing about it...)
fields.JP:
（相変わらずグレーテルは論理的だな。
　ぐずぐずと悩んでいる自分が
　余計に情けなく思えてくる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Gretel's so logical. Now I feel even dumber
for stressing about it...)

fields.EN:
Given all that, the only people around you who fit
those conditions are me and Hansel-niisan.
fields.JP:
以上を踏まえて、あなたの身の回りで
今の条件に当てはまる人物は
私とヘンゼル兄さんしか思い当たらないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
All things considered, the only people who fit
the situation you describe are me and Hansel.

fields.EN: (Did she find out in the worst possible way...?)
fields.JP: （これは……最悪な形でバレちゃったかな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This was arguably the worst way I could
have told her.)

fields.EN:
(Maybe all I wanted was to confess to Gretel
so I could escape even a little of my guilt.)
fields.JP:
（僕はグレーテルに懺悔することで
　罪の意識から少しでも逃れたかった
　だけなのかもしれない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe I needed to atone for how things
went for us before...)

fields.EN:
(I do love Gretel, but I worry that I'm not
doing it for her. I'm selfish for putting myself
first.)
fields.JP:
（口ではグレーテルを好きだと言いながら、
　グレーテルのためを思っていないなんて……。
　僕は自分の気持ちを優先した最低な奴だ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I do love Gretel, but I worry that I'm not
doing it for her. I'm selfish for putting myself
first.)

fields.JP: ふふふ……とても興味深いわ

fields.EN:
Maybe you'd call it your innate humanity.
You always put other people first,
and you've always worked hard for their sake.
fields.JP:
持って生まれた人間性というのかしら。
あなたはいつも他人のことを第一に考え、
他人のために努力をしてきたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe that's one of your quirks. Always
preoccupied with how other people feel.

fields.EN:
Even when it means putting yourself in danger...
Your actions may look foolish at first glance,
but I think they've moved other people's hearts.
fields.JP:
時に自らを危険にさらしてでも……。
一見すると愚かとも取れるあなたの行動が、
他の人間の心を動かしてきたと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if it means risking your own life.
To the layperson your actions seem foolish,
but such the force of your convictions.

fields.EN:
When you don't know what result an action will lead to,
I could never act the way you do.
fields.JP:
自らの行動がどのような結果に繋がるか
未知数の状態で、私ならあなたのような
行動はとてもできないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your methods are unpredictable, but
effective. I'm not quite there yet.

fields.EN:
For someone as kindhearted as you, who agonizes endlessly
over other people, to tell me all this
'for your own salvation'...
fields.JP:
そんな人のことでいつまでも悩むような
お人よしのあなたが、「自分が救われるために」
私自身にこんな話をするなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
To think someone could be thoughtful
enough to seek forgiveness in the name
of romantic feelings...

fields.EN:
Either you agonized over it so much that you made
a bad judgment... or I misjudged what kind of person
you were from the start.
fields.JP:
あなたが葛藤しすぎて判断を誤ったか、
私があなたという人間を元から見誤っていたか
のどちらかということね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your overthinking has led you astray.
Perhaps I underestimated you.

fields.EN:
By the way, you're mistaken about one thing.
I don't care that Hansel-niisan was killed.
fields.JP:
ちなみにあなたは一つ思い違いをしているわ。
私はヘンゼル兄さんが殺されたことは
気にしていないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
And one more thing, I do not consider the
way Hansel's life ended murder.

fields.EN:
I told you then, but given our circumstances,
it couldn't be helped.
fields.JP:
あのときも話したけれど、あれはお互いの立場、
状況的に仕方のなかったことだという結論に
至ったはずよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I told you then, but given our circumstances,
it couldn't be helped.

fields.EN:
It's more constructive not to keep dwelling forever
on things that can't be changed by thinking about them.
Apparently you're different, though.
fields.JP:
考えても仕方のないことは、
いつまでも引きずらないのが建設的。
どうやらあなたは違うみたいだけれど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thinking of alternate possibilities is futile.
The past is a stone better left unturned.
But you may disagree.

fields.JP: ……グレーテルには敵わないや

fields.EN: (She's spot on. Gretel is so astute.)
fields.JP:
（見事に言い当てられたな……。
　グレーテルの指摘した通りだ）
fields.LOCALIZED: (She's spot on. Gretel is so astute.)

fields.EN:
(The guilt of having killed Hansel was always
entwined with my feelings of love for Gretel...)
fields.JP:
（僕がグレーテルを好きだという気持ちには、
　ヘンゼルを殺してしまった罪の意識が
　いつも付きまとっていた……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Part of my feelings for Gretel have been
tangled up in how things ended with Hansel.)

fields.EN:
(I wanted Gretel to help me let go of that
guilt so I could feel better, which is why I
asked her to speak with me.)
fields.JP:
（その気持ちを少しでも楽にするために、
　許してもらうために、グレーテルに
　こんなことを話してしまうなんて……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wanted Gretel to help me let go of that
guilt so I could feel better, which is why I
asked her to speak with me.)

fields.EN:
(I pretended to look out for her, but it was
selfish of me. I'm a scumbag...)
fields.JP:
（グレーテルを気遣うふりをして、
　結局は自分のことばかりじゃないか。
　僕はどうしようもない人間だ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I pretended to look out for her, but it was
selfish of me. I'm a scumbag...)

fields.EN: It's fine, Jack. I forgive you.
fields.JP:
いいわ、ジャック。
あなたを許してあげる
fields.LOCALIZED: It's fine, Jack. I forgive you.

fields.JP: その代わり、条件があるわ

fields.EN: Would you like to date me?
fields.JP: 私と男女交際をしない？

fields.EN:
Oh? You said you were in love with me,
so I assumed you wanted us to date.
fields.JP:
あら、あなたが私に恋をしていると
聞いたから、てっきり男女交際を
望んでいるのかと思ったのだけれど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. I thought I heard you mention having
feelings for me, so logically the next course
of step would be for us to date.

fields.EN:
N-No, that's true, but...
I just didn't expect you to say that
after where this conversation had gone.
fields.JP:
い、いや、その通りだけど……。
今の話の流れでそんなことを言われるとは
思わなかったもので
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I do, but...how did we get here?
That was a big tangent.

fields.EN:
I used 'asking for advice' as a pretext to seek forgiveness
from the girl I love just so I could save myself...
I'm a terrible person, you know?
fields.JP:
僕は自分が救われるために、好きな女の子に
相談という名目で許しを得ようとした
最低な奴なんだよ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I tried asking for forgiveness from a woman
just to make myself feel better. Doesn't that
make me a selfish bastard...?

fields.EN:
Even more reason. Love makes us irrational.
I'm quite excited to learn more about this
mysterious phenomenon.
fields.JP:
だからこそよ。
あなたがそこまで判断を誤る
「恋」や「愛」に興味が湧いたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even more reason. Love makes us irrational.
I'm quite excited to learn more about this
mysterious phenomenon.

fields.EN:
I have no experience with it, so the time
has come to see it through my own eyes.
fields.JP:
私は恋愛のことを知らないから、
それならこの身をもって体験すれば
いいと思ったのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have no experience with it, so the time
has come to see it through my own eyes.

fields.EN: Wow... You never fail to surprise.
fields.JP:
な、なんていうか……。
君は相変わらず規格外だね
fields.LOCALIZED: Wow... You never fail to surprise.

fields.EN: I'll take that as a compliment.
fields.JP: 褒め言葉と受け取っておくわ
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll take that as a compliment.

fields.EN:
Back then, Hansel-niisan entrusted me to you all...
That means he acknowledged you.
fields.JP:
あのときヘンゼル兄さんは、
あなたたちに私を託してくれた……。
あなたを認めていたということよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hansel's the one who tasked me with
tracking you all. Fate conspired behind
the scenes.

fields.JP: そうなのかもしれないけど……

fields.EN: But you still feel guilty, don't you?
fields.JP:
わかっていても、
罪悪感は消えないのでしょうね
fields.LOCALIZED: But you still feel guilty, don't you?

fields.EN:
Even with that guilt, you still fell in love with me.
When I think that your feelings were strong enough
to surpass that guilt... hehe.
fields.JP:
それでもあなたは私に恋をした。
罪悪感を超えるほどの強い想いを
抱いたのだと思うと……ふふ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That doesn't deter my love for you.
Those feelings far supersede whatever
grief I might be facing.

fields.EN:
I've seen first-hand how consuming
emotions can be.
fields.JP:
今までも感情が理屈を超える場面を
何度も目の当たりにしてきたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've seen first-hand how consuming
emotions can be.

fields.EN:
The strongest example of this being love
and infatuation. It defies logic. I must know
what it's like.
fields.JP:
中でも特に強い感情である「恋」や「愛」……。
実に興味深いわ。ぜひ私も体験したい
fields.LOCALIZED:
The strongest example of this being love
and infatuation. It defies logic. I must know
what it's like.

fields.EN:
(S-So this is intellectual curiosity, right?
She probably doesn't actually love me...)
fields.JP:
（こ、これは知的好奇心ってことだよね？
　たぶん彼女は僕を好きというわけでは……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So is this all just some experiment?
Or does she really love me?)

fields.EN:
Gretel, I'm happy to hear that, but I don't
know if that's a good reason for us to date.
fields.JP:
……グレーテル。
申し出は嬉しいんだけど、そういう理由で
交際するのはよくないと思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel, I'm happy to hear that, but I don't
know if that's a good reason for us to date.

fields.EN:
Then what was everything you've said up to now about?
You're full of contradictions today.
fields.JP:
それでは今までの話はなんだったのかしら？
今日のあなたは矛盾だらけね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then what was the purpose of this
conversation? You're such a hypocrite.

fields.EN:
But if you feel guilty about Hansel-niisan,
and about trying to seek forgiveness for your own sake...
fields.JP:
でも、ヘンゼル兄さんのことや、
自分のために許しを乞おうとしたことで
罪悪感を覚えるのなら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if you wish for penance over my brother's
death...

fields.EN: Then you shouldn't be able to refuse me.
fields.JP: あなたは拒否できないはずよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Then you have no choice but to take me.

fields.EN:
If you date me, I'll forgive you.
If you refuse, then that's the end of it.
fields.JP:
交際するのなら、私はあなたを許すわ。
断るのなら、それまでよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you date me, then I forgive me. But if
you deny my advance, then we're done.

fields.EN:
I bear no grudge against you. But you would
feel better if I forgave you, no?
fields.JP:
別に私はあなたを恨んでいないけれど、
あなたは私に「許す」と言われることで
救われるのでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I bear no grudge against you. But you would
feel better if I forgave you, no?

fields.EN:
(What is this...? Before I even understood what was
happening, I somehow feel like I got completely
wrapped up in her logic.)
fields.JP:
（なんだろう……。よくわからないうちに
　いつの間にか絡めとられた気がする）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What's going on...? It feels like she's just
resolving everything herself.)

fields.EN:
(...But this logical, slightly strange, endlessly curious girl...
I...)
fields.JP:
（……でも、論理的でちょっと変わってて、
　知的好奇心旺盛なこの子のことが、僕は……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But her reasoning is kinda suspect.
For the most curious girl in the world,
I gotta run with it.)

fields.EN:
Um Gretel. My reasons for telling you might
be selfish, but my feelings are real, so...
fields.JP:
その、グレーテル……。
僕はどうしようもない奴かもしれないけど、
君が好きな気持ちは本物だよ。それで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um Gretel. My reasons for telling you might
be selfish, but my feelings are real, so...

fields.EN: Would you go out with me?
fields.JP: つ、付き合ってくれるかな
fields.LOCALIZED: Would you go out with me?

fields.EN:
Negotiation concluded.
Then let's start dating.
fields.JP:
交渉成立ね。
それでは交際しましょうか

fields.EN: (That was quick! And dry! But that's Gretel!)
fields.JP:
（すごいあっさり！　ドライ！
　でもグレーテルらしい！）
fields.LOCALIZED: (That was quick! And dry! But that's Gretel!)

fields.EN:
I'm still endlessly interested in humans... no, in you, Jack.
It looks like this will be an enjoyable relationship.
fields.JP:
まだまだ人間……いえ、ジャックに興味が
尽きないわ。楽しい交際になりそうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose my fascination in humans—
or should I say you, Jack—is neverending.
This is the beautiful start to our relationship.

fields.EN:
...Thanks, Gretel.
This feels kind of strange, but... let's do our best together.
fields.JP:
……ありがとう、グレーテル。
なんか変な感じだけど、よろしくね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you, Gretel. This bit might have been
a little rocky, but it's beautiful indeed.

fields.EN:
(Time for a beach date with Gretel!
Our schedules haven't lined up until now.)
fields.JP:
（今日はグレーテルと海水浴デートだ！
　お互い忙しいから時間を合わせるのが
　大変だったなぁ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Time for a beach date with Gretel!
Our schedules haven't lined up until now.)

fields.EN:
(Gretel is surprisingly open and carefree
as a significant other.)
fields.JP:
（グレーテルはこっちが拍子抜けするほど
　普通に、「恋人」としていろんなことを
　楽しんでくれている）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Gretel is surprisingly open and carefree
as a significant other.)

fields.EN:
(Her curiosity is, as expected, a lot to handle,
but nothing makes me happier than seeing
her smile.)
fields.JP:
（たまに好奇心が強すぎてついていけない
　ときもあるけど、恋人が楽しそうなら
　こっちも嬉しくなるな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Her curiosity is, as expected, a lot to handle,
but nothing makes me happier than seeing
her smile.)

fields.JP: （そしてなにより変わったことは……ん？）

fields.EN: Hey, where'd Gretel go? She was just here...
fields.JP:
そういえば、グレーテルはどこに行ったんだ？
さっきまでこの辺りにいたはずなのに……
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, where'd Gretel go? She was just here...

fields.JP: さて、魚を獲りましょうか

fields.EN:
Okay, wait a second. We're not here to fish
for food, are we? I thought we're on a date.
fields.JP:
いやいや、ちょっと待って。
今日は食料調達に来たわけじゃないよね？
海水浴デートだよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, wait a second. We're not here to fish
for food, are we? I thought we're on a date.

fields.EN:
Oh, correct. I suppose it was a force of
habit to immediately find nourishment.
fields.JP:
ああ、そうだったわね。
つい習慣で、海を見たら食糧のことを
真っ先に考えてしまったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, correct. I suppose it was a force of
habit to immediately find nourishment.

fields.EN:
(Wait. Why is Gretel sopping wet?
Did she already jump in the water...?)
fields.JP:
（あれ？　よく見たらグレーテルがずぶ濡れだ。
　もう海に入ったのかな？
　……いや、それよりも）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wait. Why is Gretel sopping wet?
Did she already jump in the water...?)

fields.EN:
(A beautiful girl with water dripping from her...
Seeing her swimsuit soaked and dripping like that
is making my heart race...)
fields.JP:
（水も滴る美少女かぁ……。
　水着姿で水が滴ってるとか、
　なんだかドキドキしてくる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wait... She looks breathtaking in that
swimsuit.)

fields.EN: Jack. Why are you staring at me?
fields.JP: ジャック？　私を凝視して、どうしたの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack. Why are you staring at me?

fields.EN:
Yeah. Gretel, you look really cute in your swimsuit.
It suits you.
fields.JP:
ああ、うん。
グレーテルの水着姿がかわいくて、
その、似合ってると思ってさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. Just thought your outfit was real
cute. Couldn't help myself.

fields.JP: つまり欲情したということ？

fields.EN:
Gah! I mean, not entirely... But it's not
just about that.
fields.JP:
うぐ……。か、完全に違うという
わけではないけど、そこまで露骨な
感情でもなかったというか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gah! I mean, not entirely... But it's not
just about that.

fields.EN:
How puzzling. You've already seen and touched
my naked body several times, yet this appearance
still excites you.
fields.JP:
不可解ね。もうすでに何度か
私の裸体を見て触っているはずなのに、
この姿で高揚するなんて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Strange. No doubt we've seen and been
near each other in more suggestive places,
yet this arouses you.

fields.EN: Anyway Gretel, why are you drenched?
fields.JP:
そ、そんなことより、
グレーテルはなんで全身濡れてるの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Anyway Gretel, why are you drenched?

fields.EN:
Oh, that's right. I found something you
might find interesting, Jack. This way.
fields.JP:
そうだったわ。
ジャック、おもしろいものを発見したのよ。
こっちへ来て
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, that's right. I found something you
might find interesting, Jack. This way.

fields.EN:
(Right... The biggest thing that's changed about her
is that she started sharing her intellectual curiosity
with me.)
fields.JP:
（そう……彼女がなにより変わったことは、
　自分の知的好奇心を共有してくれるように
　なったことだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Of course... The biggest change was seeing
up close the lengths Gretel travels for her
curiosity.)

fields.EN:
(Her eye for unusual things is amazing as ever,
but when Gretel looks this happy, she's just
an ordinary cute girl...)
fields.JP:
（相変わらず目の付け所がすごいけど、
　グレーテルが楽しそうにしてる姿は
　普通のかわいい女の子そのものだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(As usual, she uses unusual methods,
but for the first time, I see Gretel enjoying
herself just like any ordinary girl would.)

fields.EN:
Oh... The drop-off is quite deep relative
to its distance from the shore.
fields.JP: おお……、岸に近くてもけっこう深いね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh... The drop-off is quite deep relative
to its distance from the shore.

fields.JP: 息を大きく吸い込みなさい

fields.EN:
(She dragged me in the water! I can't breathe!
I wasn't ready!)
fields.JP:
（い、いきなり海の中に引っ張りこまれた！
　息が！　心の準備がー！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She dragged me in the water! I can't breathe!
I wasn't ready!)

fields.EN:
*gasp* *pant, pant*... Oh. I thought I'd
drown.
fields.JP:
ぷはっ！　はぁ、はぁ……あー、
溺れるかと思った……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*gasp* *pant, pant*... Oh. I thought I'd
drown.

fields.EN:
What are you doing? I told you to take a
deep breath.
fields.JP:
なにをしているの。
息を大きく吸うように言ったでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you doing? I told you to take a
deep breath.

fields.EN: You didn't warn me in time!
fields.LOCALIZED: You didn't warn me in time!

fields.EN:
So you'll be fine with adequate warning?
Then back under we go.
fields.JP:
いきなりでなければいいのね？
それなら、もう一度海の中に入ってみなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you'll be fine with adequate warning?
Then back under we go.

fields.EN: Okay, fine. I'll take a breath...
fields.JP: わかったよ。今度はちゃんと息を吸って……
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay, fine. I'll take a breath...

fields.EN:
(Wow... So this is what it's like under the sea...
Everything sparkles. It's so beautiful...)
fields.JP:
（わぁ……これが海の中なんだ……。
　きらきらしてる。すごくきれい……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Whoa... So this is the bottom of the ocean.
Sparkles everywhere. So pretty...)

fields.EN:
(Previously I was so focused on fishing and
fetching seashells that I never really thought
to see it what lies beneath.)
fields.JP:
（これまでは魚や貝を獲りに来るばかり
　だったから、海の中がこんな風に
　なってるなんて知らなかった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Previously I was so focused on fishing and
fetching seashells that I never really thought
to see it what lies beneath.)

fields.EN:
(Wow... Gretel's good at diving.
Her long hair flows with the water.
She's mystical...)
fields.JP:
（あ……グレーテルも潜ってる。
　長い髪が水の中でゆらゆら揺れて、
　なんだか幻想的な……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wow... Gretel's good at diving.
Her long hair flows with the water.
She's mystical...)

fields.EN: (Rgh! Crap! I'm running out of air...)
fields.JP: （うっ？　やばい！　急に息が苦しく……っ）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Rgh! Crap! I'm running out of air...)

fields.EN:
Phew. That was close. I was so mesmerized
down there that I almost drowned.
fields.JP:
はー、危なかった。
海の中の景色に見惚れて、
ついつい長居しちゃいそうになった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Phew. That was close. I was so mesmerized
down there that I almost drowned.

fields.JP:
……あれ、グレーテルはまだ上がって
きてないんだ

fields.EN:
(Gretel is drifting there with such a peaceful look...
Doesn't it get hard for her to stay underwater
that long?)
fields.JP:
（グレーテル、安らかな顔で漂ってる……。
　ずっと海の中で苦しくならないのかな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Gretel's just floating down there.
Hope she's okay.)

fields.JP:
（でも……こうしているグレーテルの姿、
　すごくきれいだな……）
はぁ……はぁ……ああ、よかった……

fields.EN:
You looked like you were enjoying yourself.
Was this the interesting thing you found?
fields.JP:
気持ちよさそうにしてたね。
君が見つけたおもしろいものって、
このこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You looked engrossed down there.
Find anything good?

fields.EN:
Yes. I discovered that being underwater
grants me pure tranquility. This is quite
the breakthrough.
fields.JP:
ええ、水の中は他のどんな場所よりも
落ち着くわ。これは大発見よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. I discovered that being underwater
grants me pure tranquility. This is quite
the breakthrough.

fields.EN:
Oh, uh... Pretty, I guess. A whole different
world.
fields.JP:
あ……そうだね。きれいだったよ。
なにか別世界みたいで
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, uh... Pretty, I guess. A whole different
world.

fields.EN:
(I can't just outright tell her how smitten
I was watching her swim down there.)
fields.JP:
（純粋に海が好きなグレーテルに対して、
　君に見惚れていたなんて言いづらい……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't just outright tell her how smitten
I was watching her swim down there.)

fields.EN:
The ocean is an incomparable marvel.
It conquers my senses, I surrender to its
fulfillment.
fields.JP:
水の中は不思議だわ。
思考よりも感覚が支配されて、
すべてが満たされたように感じる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The ocean is an incomparable marvel.
It conquers my senses, I surrender to its
fulfillment.

fields.EN: I wonder why...it comforts me so.
fields.JP:
なぜなのかしらね。
だけど、とても心地よかったわ……
fields.LOCALIZED: I wonder why...it comforts me so.

fields.EN:
(Trying to reason everything out logically...
That's just like Gretel.)
fields.JP:
（どんなことでも理屈で考えようとするなんて、
　やっぱりグレーテルらしいな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There she goes, already searching for the
logical explanation.

fields.JP:
海水を舐めてみたのよ。
やはりしょっぱいわね

fields.EN:
If only the water were sweet,
the sea would be the perfect world...
But I suppose things never work out that conveniently.
fields.JP:
これで水が甘ければ、
海は至高の世界なのだけれど……
そううまくはいかないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If seawater was sweet, the world would be
a nicer place. But this is but a fantasy.

fields.EN:
(I'm taken by how Gretel has a childlike side
to her too. It's really heartwarming.)
fields.JP:
（グレーテルでもそんな子供みたいなこと
　言うんだな。なんかかわいいなぁ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm taken by how Gretel has a childlike side
to her too. It's really heartwarming.)

fields.EN:
Well, if it's salty so be it. We can swim and
fish to our heart's content.
fields.JP:
しょっぱいならしょっぱいで仕方ないわ。
ひとまず、泳ぎながら魚でも獲りましょうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, if it's salty so be it. We can swim and
fish to our heart's content.

fields.EN: But we're supposed to be on a date.
fields.JP: え、でも今日はデートだよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: But we're supposed to be on a date.

fields.EN:
There's no rule that says we cannot fish
while on a date.
fields.JP:
デートで食料調達をしてはいけないという
決まりはないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no rule that says we cannot fish
while on a date.

fields.EN:
Look. I happened to find a harpoon for catching fish.
I want to try it out.
fields.JP:
見てちょうだい。
魚を獲るための銛をたまたま発見したの。
これを試してみたいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look. I happened upon a rod which we can
use to spear fish. I'd like to test it out.

fields.EN: Let's dive to hunt for supper.
fields.JP: さあ、海に潜って魚を獲りましょう
fields.LOCALIZED: Let's dive to hunt for supper.

fields.EN:
H-Hold on!
Today is my first time ever diving in the sea, you know?
Diving down and catching fish is a bit...
fields.JP:
ちょ、ちょっと待って！
僕、海に潜ったの今日が初めてなんだよ？
潜って魚を獲るなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, wait! This is my first time diving.
I can't dive or catch fish.

fields.EN:
It's fine. I haven't either. But you have more
stamina than I do. I'm sure you're fit.
fields.JP:
大丈夫。私もしたことはないわ。
でも私よりあなたのほうが体力もあるし、
向いているでしょうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's fine. I haven't either. But you have more
stamina than I do. I'm sure you're fit.

fields.EN: I have high hopes for you, Jack.
fields.JP: あなたの働きに期待しているわ、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED: I have high hopes for you, Jack.

fields.EN:
(She has high hopes for me?! This sure is
pressure! I wasn't expecting this...)
fields.JP:
（期待されてる！　プレッシャー！
　これは予想外の展開だ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She has high hopes for me?! This sure is
pressure! I wasn't expecting this...)

fields.EN:
(But I guess that's to be expected with
Gretel...)
fields.JP:
（でも、こういう変わったところも含めて
　グレーテルって子なんだよなぁ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But I guess that's to be expected with
Gretel...)

fields.EN:
Roger.
I'll do my best to make sure you're satisfied.
fields.JP:
了解。
君が満足できるよう、がんばってみるよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Roger, I'll try my best to make you proud.

fields.EN: Hehehe. This is going to be good.
fields.JP: ふふ、今日はいい日になりそうね
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehehe. This is going to be good.

fields.EN:
A few years later.
The new village was developing smoothly,
and life had begun to stabilize—
fields.JP:
数年後。
新しい村づくりも順調に進み、
生活も安定してきたころ――。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A few years later...
Their village was beginning to flourish,
and the settlement became a haven for all.

fields.EN:
This is... a church, it seems.
What could Jack want, calling me to a place like this?
fields.JP:
ここは……教会のようね。
ジャックはこんなところに呼び出して
なんの用なのかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
This looks like...a church. What business
could Jack have with me here

fields.EN:
At times like this, he's usually planning
something strange...
fields.JP:
こういうときは、大概おかしなことを
計画しているのよね……

fields.EN: What a coincidence meeting you here, Gretel-san!
fields.JP: こんなところで奇遇だね、グレーテルさん！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, hey Gretel! What a coincidence.

fields.EN:
That's the kind of line you say somewhere
where running into each other by chance would actually
be plausible.
fields.JP:
そういうセリフは、偶然出くわしても
おかしくない場所で言うものよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your tone of voice leads me to doubt if it
really is a coincidence.

fields.EN:
Now, don't sweat the small stuff. Why don't
you put this blindfold on?
fields.JP:
細かいことは気にするな。
とりあえず目隠しをつけてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, don't sweat the small stuff. Why don't
you put this blindfold on?

fields.EN:
I don't understand...
I think you should pay a little more attention
to the small details yourself.
fields.JP:
意味がわからないわ……。
あなたはもう少し細かいことを
気にしたほうがいいと思うわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
On the contrary. I think the small details
are the most important.

fields.EN: Come on, just trust us and try the blindfold.
fields.JP:
まあまあ、騙されたと思って
目隠しつけてみて
fields.LOCALIZED: Come now, it's just harmless fun. Put it on.

fields.EN:
If I already know I'm going to be tricked,
I'm certainly not putting on a blindfold.
fields.JP:
騙されるとわかっていれば
目隠しなんてつけないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If it's harmless, then I don't need to blind
myself.

fields.EN:
But something tells me Jack put you up to
this.
fields.JP:
……でも、あなたたちがジャックになにか
頼まれたということは察しがつくわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But something tells me Jack put you up to
this.

fields.JP:
仕方がないから、
ここは言うことを聞いてあげましょう

fields.EN:
Uh. If you could just sit still, we'll be
done in a jiffy.
fields.JP:
えーと、大人しくしていたら
すぐに終わるから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh. If you could just sit still, we'll be
done in a jiffy.

fields.EN: I am. So hurry it up.
fields.JP:
大人しくしているでしょう。
早くしてちょうだい
fields.LOCALIZED: I am. So hurry it up.

fields.JP: じゃーん！　できあがりー！
うんうん。似合ってるぞ、グレーテル

fields.EN:
So this is a dress. Not exactly aerodynamic,
is it...
fields.JP:
これはドレスというやつね。
しかしずいぶん動きづらいわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So this is a dress. Not exactly aerodynamic,
is it...

fields.EN:
Well, our work is done here. We'll be on our
way now
fields.JP:
さて、これで僕たちの役目は終わりだ。
邪魔者は退散するよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, our work is done here. We'll be on our
way now

fields.JP: グレーテルさん、またね！

fields.EN:
Jack, you're here, aren't you? Why don't
you come out?
fields.JP:
……ジャック、いるんじゃないの？
出てきたらどう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, you're here, aren't you? Why don't
you come out?

fields.EN:
I wasn't totally certain, so I called out as a 
bluff. You fell right into my trap.
fields.JP:
本当にいるかどうかは確信が持てなかったから、
カマをかけてみたのよ。
見事に引っかかってくれたけれど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wasn't totally certain, so I called out as a 
bluff. You fell right into my trap.

fields.EN:
(N-No, this isn't the time to get depressed.
I have to tell her properly what I came here to say!)
fields.JP:
（って、落ち込んでる場合じゃないぞ。
　ちゃんと伝えたいことを伝えないと！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Damn it, the surprise was ruined. But can't
worry about that. Gotta tell her how I feel!

fields.EN:
Y-You're always overflowing with intellectual curiosity.
Whenever something makes you wonder, you say it out loud
or act on it right away. You're really proactive.
fields.JP:
き、君はいつも知的好奇心が旺盛で、
疑問に思ったことはなんでも口に出したり
行動に移したり、積極的だよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're the smartest person I know.
And your quest for knowledge inspires me.
It seems like you always know what to ask.

fields.EN:
I think that's proof that you try to face both yourself
and other people head-on.
fields.JP:
それって、自分にも他人にも
まっすぐ向き合おうとする証拠だと思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It goes to show that you're never one to back
down from a challenge.

fields.EN:
Even when that led you to face a cruel reality,
you never denied it. You accepted it seriously
and without flinching away...
fields.JP:
その結果として残酷な現実に直面しても、
君は否定することなく、真剣に、
潔く受け止めていた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No matter what horrors we dealt with down
below, you didn't even flinch. I didn't know
someone could be so strong.

fields.EN: It wasn't long before I fell for you.
fields.JP: 僕は君のそういうところに惹かれたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: It wasn't long before I fell for you.

fields.EN:
I still feel a lot of guilt for what transpired
with Hansel...
fields.JP:
ただ、やっぱり今でも僕は
ヘンゼルのことで罪悪感がある……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I still feel a lot of guilt for what transpired
with Hansel...

fields.EN:
But at the same time, the more time we
spend together, the greater my desire to
make you happy.
fields.JP:
でも同時に、グレーテルを幸せに
したいっていう気持ちも、
一緒にいればいるほど増してきた
fields.LOCALIZED:
But at the same time, the more time we
spend together, the greater my desire to
make you happy.

fields.EN:
Hansel entrusted you to us.
That's exactly why I think making you happy
is my responsibility. So...!
fields.JP:
ヘンゼルは君を僕たちに託してくれた。
だからこそ、君を幸せにすることは
僕の責任だと思うんだ。だから……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hansel swore me to it. That's why I'm making
it my life's mission to make you happy, so...!

fields.EN:
I want you to make clear whether you want to 
be the one to make me happy or if you want 
to make me happy out of responsibility.
fields.JP:
あなた自身が私を幸せにしたいのか、
責任を感じるから私を幸せにしたいのか、
どちらなのかはっきりさせてほしいわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want you to make clear whether you want to 
be the one to make me happy or if you want 
to make me happy out of responsibility.

fields.EN:
For the time being, your confession is based
off of hearsay and fantasy.
fields.JP:
それに今のところ、すべてあなたの思い込み、
妄想の話に過ぎないわよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
For the time being, your confession is based
off of hearsay and fantasy.

fields.EN:
Dead men tell no tales, after all.
There's no way to prove what Hansel-niisan
actually thought, is there?
fields.JP:
まさに死人に口なし。
ヘンゼル兄さんがどう思ったかなんて
証明できないでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
My brother is dead. He cannot speak for
himself. It betrays Hansel to declare what
his final wishes were...

fields.EN:
...But Hansel-niisan was always happy
whenever he saw me smile.
fields.JP:
……だけど、ヘンゼル兄さんは
私が笑っているといつも喜んでくれたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But...Hansel did know better than most what
makes me happy.

fields.EN:
If I stay by your side, there's a good chance
I'll be able to keep smiling from now on...
fields.JP:
あなたの隣にいれば、私はこの先も
笑顔でいられる可能性が高い……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we are together, there's a high chance
things will bode well for us.

fields.EN:
With that in mind, perhaps there is merit to
your absurd argument...
fields.JP:
そう考えれば、あなたの荒唐無稽な言い分も
間違いではないのかもしれないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
With that in mind, perhaps there is merit to
your absurd argument...

fields.EN: You can keep thinking the way you do, Jack.
fields.JP:
あなたはあなたの考え方のままでいいのよ。
ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED: I accept you the way you are, Jack

fields.EN:
It's fine not to know what you don't know.
If you think about that 'unknown' and use it next time,
you're bound to discover something new eventually.
fields.JP:
わからないことはわからなくていい、
その『わからない』を考えて次に活かせば、
いずれはなにか新しい発見があるはずよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There is so much for you to learn. It will
endeavor us to innovation, and provide
discoveries worth a lifetime.

fields.EN:
If I put that in the kind of words you people use... yes.
I suppose you'd call it 'living with hope.'
fields.JP:
こういうことを
あなたたち風に表現すれば、そう……。
希望を持って生きる、かしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
In your people's terms, it would be an...
olive branch, I believe it's called.

fields.EN:
More importantly, Jack, besides that vague
'responsibility' you keep talking about,
you have another responsibility already, don't you?
fields.JP:
それよりジャック、
あなたの言う曖昧な責任なんかよりも、
あなたにはまだ別の責任があるじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nevertheless Jack, you have responsibilities
beyond these nebulous ambitions.

fields.EN:
After being dragged out of that candy house,
I came to learn about all kinds of fascinating things.
fields.JP:
あのお菓子の家から引っ張り出されたあと、
私は様々な興味深いものを知ることになったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
After you rescued me, I learned where my
biggest curiosities lie.

fields.EN:
Jail. Friendship. Humanity. Infatuation and,
most of all, love. But reality is a greater
teacher of these things than literature.
fields.JP:
ジェイルについて、仲間について、人間について、
愛や恋について……。本で得た知識が現実とは
違っていたことも山ほどあったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jail. Friendship. Humanity. Infatuation and,
most of all, love. But reality is a greater
teacher of these things than literature.

fields.EN:
There are still so many things in this world I don't know.
It's a vast, frightening, fascinating world.
fields.JP:
この世界はまだまだわからないことだらけよ。
広くて、恐ろしくて、興味深い世界
fields.LOCALIZED:
So much of this world is still unknown.
It's a vast, morbid, and wondrous.

fields.EN:
You took me out of that peaceful little candy-house world
and into this vast world, Jack.
So I'm going to hold you responsible.
fields.JP:
穏やかな箱庭のようなお菓子の家から
広い世界へ連れ出したジャックには、
責任を取ってもらうわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You saved me and showed me a place
beyond what I could conceive.
But this means you are now responsible...

fields.EN:
Until the day my life ends, keep facing me
and keep talking things through with me.
That's the duty imposed on you.
fields.JP:
私の命が尽きるその日まで、
私と向き合い、対話し続けてちょうだい。
それがあなたに課せられた義務よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Until the day I die, I order you to be my main
counsel in all matters. That is now your duty.

fields.EN:
Which means...you want to be with me
forever?
fields.JP: それは……一生一緒にいてくれるってこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which means...you want to be with me
forever?

fields.EN:
Even if you say you don't want to,
I intend to make you fulfill that duty.
fields.JP:
あなたが嫌だと言っても、
義務を果たすよう迫るつもりよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if you stop wanting me, I will make it
your responsbility.

fields.EN:
(I can't make Gretel say any more than this.
I have to be the one to say it properly...)
fields.JP:
（これ以上はグレーテルに言わせちゃ駄目だ。
　ちゃんと僕が言わないと……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I need to cut Gretel off before this gets more
out of hand.)

fields.EN:
I don't know how much meaning there is in
a contract called marriage, but if you promise
to keep talking things through with me...
fields.JP:
結婚という契約にどれほどの意味が
あるかはわからないけれど、
私と対話し続けると約束するのなら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I do not know what this marriage contract
entails. But if you promise to counsel me in
all matters going forward...

fields.EN: I would love to marry you.
fields.LOCALIZED: I would love to marry you.

fields.EN:
...I promise. I swear it.
I'll keep talking things through with you.
And I'll keep loving you...!
fields.JP:
……約束する。誓うよ。
僕は君と対話し続ける。
君を愛し続ける……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I promise...I'll listen to anything you have
to say forever. Anything to make you happy!

fields.EN:
There is still so much I don't understand about love
and romance. But there is one thing I'm certain of:
this feeling of mine...
fields.JP:
愛も恋も、まだまだわからないことばかりよ。
ただ一つ確かなのは、私のこの気持ち……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Infatuation, love. These are among the many
disciplines I will master. This much, I know.

fields.EN: I already love you more than enough.
fields.JP: 私はもう十分、あなたを愛しているわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, who better to teach you than me!

fields.EN:
(I'm supposed to meet Rapunzel here today,
but did I get here too early...?)
fields.JP:
（今日はラプンツェルとここで会う約束だけど、
　早く来すぎたかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm supposed to meet up with Rapunzel!
Am I too early...?

fields.JP: ん？　じゃっく、だいじょうぶ？

fields.EN:
R-Rapunzel... You shouldn't charge people
like that. You could really hurt someone.
fields.JP:
ラ、ラプンツェル……。
勢いをつけて人に抱き着いちゃダメだよ？
攻撃みたいになっちゃうからね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
R-Rapunzel... You shouldn't charge people
like that. You could really hurt someone.

fields.JP: わかった！　こーげきしない！

fields.EN: Hehe. I couldn't wait to see you, Jack!
fields.JP:
えへへー、ラプンツェルね、
じゃっくにあえるの
すごくたのしみだったんだー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. I couldn't wait to see you, Jack!

fields.EN:
Right. Things have been moving non-stop
up here. How are you handling things?
fields.JP:
お互い、今はまだ忙しいもんね。
最近はどう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. Things have been moving non-stop
up here. How are you handling things?

fields.EN:
All sorts of stuff! I'm a good helper,
and student too!
fields.JP:
いろんなことしてるよ！
おてつだいとか、べんきょーとか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All sorts of stuff! I'm a good helper,
and student too!

fields.EN:
Just the other day, I went with Gretty to investigate
geology? And water quality? And stuff like that!
fields.JP:
こないだもね、ぐれーといっしょに
ちしつ？　とか、すいしつ？　とか
しらべにいったんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just the other day I learned...geology?
And water quality! With Gretty! Then we
'splored!

fields.EN:
Geology and water-quality surveys, huh?
It's nice to hear you're helping Gretel out
and that the two of you are getting along.
fields.JP:
地質と水質の調査か。
ラプンツェルがグレーテルの手伝いをするなんて、
仲良くやれてるみたいでよかったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, geology and water quality. Glad to
hear Gretel's taking you under her wing.

fields.EN:
And, and, Tsuu is teaching me tailoring?
Shirayuki and Cinderella are doing it too!
fields.JP:
あとね、つうーに、ようさい？
ならってるよ。しらゆきとシンデレラも
いっしょなんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and Otsuu taught me tailoring?
And Snow White and Cinderella too!

fields.EN:
You're learning tailoring too, huh?
Tsuu really is good at that sort of thing,
so she's perfect as a teacher.
fields.JP:
洋裁もやってるんだ。
たしかにつうはそういうの得意だから、
先生役にぴったりだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah. So you're getting into tailoring.
Otsuu knows her ways around a needle,
so you're in good hands.

fields.EN:
And, and, at Clara's I turned screws!
I tied things up really tight with rope, and carried
the big whoosh thing together with Merun!
fields.JP:
あとね、あとね、くららのとこでねじまわしたよ。
ひもでぎゅーってしばったり、ぶわーってやつ
めるんといっしょにはこんだりしたの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh! And, and! I played with tools at Clara'ss!
I tied knots and carried stuff with Hammy!

fields.EN:
(Hmm... I have no idea what she actually helped with.
Well, anyway, it sounds like she's helping everyone.)
fields.JP:
（うーん、なんの手伝いをしたのか
　全然わからない……。まあとにかく
　みんなの手伝いをしてるってことだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Uh. That sounds dangerous. At least
she's helping.)

fields.EN:
Sounds like you've been a busy bee.
On top of studying too!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルは手伝いができて偉いなぁ。
しかも勉強までしてるなんて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sounds like you've been a busy bee.
On top of studying too!

fields.EN:
Gretty and Miko are teaching me!
Shira's learning with me too!
fields.JP:
ぐれーとみこにおそわってる！
シラもいっしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! Gretty and Miko teach me!
Pyre's one of my classmates.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel can add and subtract and multiply now!
I'm learning division right now!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルね、たしざんと
ひきざんとかけざんできるんだよ！
いまはわりざんやってる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know addition and subtraction now.
Next up is division!

fields.EN: Oh, impressive. Do you like studying?
fields.JP: へぇ、それはすごいね。勉強は楽しい？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, impressive. Do you like studying?

fields.EN: Yeah! It's exciting to learn new things!
fields.JP:
うん！
しらないことしるの、わくわくする！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah! It's exciting to learn new things!

fields.EN:
(Come to think of it, Gretel said Rapunzel and Shira
absorb knowledge quickly and are both very smart.)
fields.JP:
（そういえばグレーテルが言ってたな。
　ラプンツェルとシラは知識の吸収が早くて
　賢い子だって）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Ah. Gretel mentioned to me recently that
Rapunzel and Pyre are both sharp learners.)

fields.EN:
(I'm really glad the world has become a place where
children can study in peace... When things aren't peaceful,
there's no room to focus on studying.)
fields.JP:
（子供たちが安心して勉強できる
　世界になって本当によかった……。
　平和じゃないと勉強にまで手が回らないもんね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's a blessing that we can finally set up a
real school up here. We're all a few grades
behind.)

fields.EN: You're the reason I get to do fun stuff!
fields.JP:
いまラプンツェルがこんなにたのしいのは、
じゃっくのおかげ！
fields.LOCALIZED: You're the reason I get to do fun stuff!

fields.EN:
I keep thinking. Remember when you gave
me that snack when we first met?
fields.JP:
いっぱいかんがえたんだ。
さいしょにじゃっくとあって、
おかしくれたでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I keep thinking. Remember when you gave
me that snack when we first met?

fields.EN:
Jack gave me sweets, I became friends with everyone,
and that's how Rapunzel became who she is now!
fields.JP:
じゃっくにおかしもらって、
みんなとなかよくなって、
いまのラプンツェルになったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
After that, I met the others, and now
they're all my friends!

fields.JP: だからありがと！　じゃっく！
ラプンツェル……こんなに成長して……

fields.EN:
(When we first met, I thought this girl was some
mysterious Märchen... Ahh, this really gets to me.)
fields.JP:
（初めて会ったときは謎のメルヒェンかと
　思ったこの子が……ああ、感無量だな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't believe this girl was practically feral
when we first met. This is moving.)

fields.EN:
(I'm the one who's glad I met Rapunzel back then.
I ought to thank fate for bringing us together.)
fields.JP:
（僕こそ、あのときラプンツェルに
　出会えてよかったな。運命に感謝しなきゃね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I should thank her for way back when.
Fate brought us together.)

fields.EN:
Tsuu taught me about repaying kindness!
So Rapunzel is gonna repay Jack too!
fields.JP:
つうーに、おんがえしっておそわったよ。
だからね、ラプンツェルもじゃっくに
おんがえしするの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu taught me what debt means!
So I owe you!

fields.EN: Really? You don't have to do that.
fields.JP: 恩返し？　別にしなくていいんだよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Really? You don't have to do that.

fields.EN: No, I wanna! I'll repay you by being your wife!
fields.JP:
ううん、する！
ラプンツェル、おれいに
じゃっくのおよめさんになる！
fields.LOCALIZED: No, I wanna! I'll repay you by being your wife!

fields.EN:
(That went in a direction I really didn't expect...
Well, she's still a kid, after all.)
fields.JP:
（予想の斜め上でちょっと驚いた……。
　でもまあ、子供の言うことだしね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That was out of nowhere... What are they
teaching her over there...?)

fields.EN:
(And compared with how things used to go straight
to talk about having babies, the idea of being a wife
is actually a lot milder.)
fields.JP:
（それに前だったら子供を産むとかいう話に
　直結だったことを考えれば、お嫁さんって
　いう発想はだいぶマイルドだよな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This is like that time she offered to have
my babies. Well, at least she's managing
her expectations this time.)

fields.EN: Hahaha, a wife, huh? Yeah, yeah.
fields.JP: あはは、お嫁さんかぁ。うん、うん

fields.EN: Does that make us a couple?
fields.LOCALIZED: Does that make us a couple?

fields.EN:
Let's leave that for later.
You're going to meet all sorts of people from now on, Rapunzel,
and I think you'll have all sorts of things to think about.
fields.JP:
それはまだ先にしよう。
ラプンツェルはこれからいろんな人に会って、
いろんなことを考えると思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why don't we talk about this later?
I think both of us have lots of life to live
still. A lot's up in the air.

fields.EN:
Let's think about you becoming a wife again
after you've grown up, okay?
fields.JP:
お嫁さんのことは、
また大人になってから考えようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's revisit this conversation when the
time is right.

fields.EN:
Mmm... okay.
I'll think about it when I'm a grown-up.
fields.JP:
むー……わかった。
おとなになったら、かんがえる
fields.LOCALIZED: Grr... Fine. Guess I'll just wait...

fields.EN:
(When she grows up, huh...
Rapunzel will probably become a real beauty
when she's an adult.)
fields.JP:
（大人になったら、か……。
　ラプンツェルが大人になったら、
　きっと美人になるんだろうな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Phew, that was a close one. I'm sure
she'll make someone a happy husband.)

fields.EN: What's the matter, Jack? Whatcha thinking?
fields.JP:
じゃっく、どしたの？
かんがえごとー？
fields.LOCALIZED: What's the matter, Jack? Whatcha thinking?

fields.JP: ああ、いや、なんでもないよ

fields.EN:
Then let's walk together!
The sea is pretty, the ground is all sand,
and it looks fun!
fields.JP:
じゃあ、いっしょにあるこ！
うみがきれーで、じめんがすなで、
おもしろそー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then let's walk together! The ocean is
pretty. All the sand too. This is'll be fun!

fields.EN: Hahaha. You sure seem happy, Rapunzel.
fields.JP: あはは、ラプンツェル嬉しそうだね
fields.LOCALIZED: Hahaha. You sure seem happy, Rapunzel.

fields.EN:
Well, I've come to play with you.
I'm really happy!
fields.JP:
だって、じゃっくとあそびにきたんだもん。
すっごくうれしいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I've come to play with you.
I'm really happy!

fields.EN: Let's hurry and go into the water! WOOHOO!
fields.JP:
はやくうみはいろう、うみ！
やっほー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Let's hurry and go into the water! WOOHOO!

fields.EN:
We need to stretch and prepare before
we go in.
fields.JP: 海に入る前に、まずは準備運動しなきゃ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We need to stretch and prepare before
we go in.

fields.EN: What, that's too much work! I wanna go.
fields.JP:
そんなの、めんどくさいー。
はやくうみはいりたいよー
fields.LOCALIZED: What, that's too much work! I wanna go.

fields.EN:
No. You need to do the proper steps, or we 
won't play in the water.
fields.JP:
だーめ。
ちゃんと準備運動してからじゃないと
海で遊ばせないからね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. You need to do the proper steps, or we 
won't play in the water.

fields.EN:
Booo. Fine... Oh, Miko said the same thing
too.
fields.JP:
ぶー……わかった……。
そーいえば、みこもいってたし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Booo. Fine... Oh, Miko said the same thing
too.

fields.EN:
Miko say cold place make blood presh
up high, stress to heart. No good!
fields.JP:
きゅうにつめたいみずにはいると、
けつあつがあがって、しんぞうやきんにくの
ふたんになるからだめ、って！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Miko say cold place make blood presh
up high, stress to heart. No good!

fields.EN:
(Wow. She says it haltingly, but what she's saying
is actually pretty technical.)
fields.JP:
（おお、たどたどしい言い方なのに
　言ってる内容は専門的だ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Even though she has trouble forming
words sometimes, she's getting better
at retaining information.)

fields.EN:
(Rapunzel keeps soaking up new knowledge lately.
She's getting smarter and smarter.)
fields.JP:
（最近のラプンツェルはどんどん新しい知識を
　吸収して、賢くなっていってるな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Rapunzel's been soaking up all this
knowledge. She's a real star.)

fields.EN:
(It's almost like she's trying to fill a hole
or something...)
fields.JP:
（まるで満たされなかったなにかを
　埋めようとするみたいに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's almost like she's trying to fill a hole
or something...)

fields.EN:
(In the past there was no time to study.
Looks like she's had it in her the whole
time. I'm so proud of her.)
fields.JP:
（昔は勉強どころじゃなかったけど、
　本当のこの子はこんなに頭がよかったんだ。
　僕まで誇らしい気分になってくるな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(In the past there was no time to study.
Looks like she's had it in her the whole
time. I'm so proud of her.)

fields.EN:
Say Rapunzel, I thought I heard you mention
that studying was fun.
fields.JP: ラプンツェル、勉強が楽しいって言ってたよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say Rapunzel, I thought I heard you mention
that studying was fun.

fields.JP: うんっ！　たのしいよ！
でもでも！　でーーもーー！！

じゃっくといるほうが、
もーっとたのしいー！

fields.EN:
Hahaha. I enjoy hanging out with you
too, Rapunzel.
fields.JP: はは、僕もラプンツェルといるのは楽しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha. I enjoy hanging out with you
too, Rapunzel.

fields.EN: Today's Rapunzel is different from usual, you know?
fields.JP: きょうのラプンツェル、いつもとちがうよ？

fields.EN: My swimsuit! What do you think?
fields.LOCALIZED: My swimsuit! What do you think?

fields.EN:
Oh... You're right. You're in a swimsuit.
Looks nice.
fields.JP:
あー……、そうだよね。水着だね。
似合ってるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh... You're right. You're in a swimsuit.
Looks nice.

fields.EN:
(I never expected Rapunzel to worry about something
like this, just like an ordinary girl would...)
fields.JP:
（まさかラプンツェルがそんな
　普通の女の子みたいなことを
　気にするなんて思わなかった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I never thought Rapunzel cared very much
about her appearance.)

fields.EN: Something wrong? That was random of you.
fields.JP: そんなこと聞くなんて、突然どうしたの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Something wrong? That was random of you.

fields.EN:
Shira told me...
'Jack doesn't see you as a girl,' she said...
fields.JP:
シラにいわれたの。
「あんたじゃっくからおんなのことして
みられてないのよ」って……
fields.LOCALIZED: Pyre said...you don't think I'm a woman.

fields.EN: I don't know...why that made me so sad.
fields.JP:
そしたら、なんでかわかんないけど、
ちょっと……しょぼんってなっちゃった……
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't know...why that made me so sad.

fields.EN:
Hey, Jack. Is that true?
You don't see Rapunzel as a girl...?
fields.JP:
ねー、じゃっく。そうなの？
ラプンツェルのこと、おんなのことして
みてないの……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Is it true? You don't think I'm a woman?

fields.EN:
(As a girl, huh... She is cute, but even seeing her
in this swimsuit, I still don't quite...)
fields.JP:
（女の子としてかぁ。
　たしかにかわいいけど、
　この水着姿を見ても、やっぱりまだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(A woman... She's cute, but I don't see
her that way.)

fields.EN:
Hmm... Well...
Rather than a girl, you're more like a cute little sister to me...?
fields.JP:
うーん、そうだな……。
女の子というより、かわいい妹みたいな……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... Right. Not so much a woman as much
as a cute little sister, I guess.

fields.JP:
（ま、まずい。
　ラプンツェルを傷つけちゃったか？）

fields.EN:
I-I do think you'll grow into a beautiful woman
when you're older, you know?
fields.JP:
お、大きくなったらきれいな女の人に
なりそうだなー、と思うよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I think when you're older, you'll have
no trouble finding a boyfriend.

fields.JP: おおきくなったら？　いまは、だめ……？
じゃ、じゃあ、あと数年経ったら！

あと何年かしてラプンツェルが大きく
なったとき、また同じ質問をしてくれたら、
そのときはちゃんと答えるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So maybe after you've matured a little bit,
you can ask me again and we'll take it from
there.

fields.JP: ラプンツェルがおおきくなったら……

fields.EN:
(Maybe I'm just running away from the question,
but it's true that it'll be easier for me to answer
once she's grown a little more.)
fields.JP:
（逃げかもしれないけど、
　彼女がもう少し成長したら
　僕も返答しやすくなるのは確かだよね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I might be dodging the question, but
I think it's better for both of us if we wait
it out a bit.)

fields.EN:
(By then Rapunzel might have forgotten this conversation,
and she might have found someone better suited to her...)
fields.JP:
（そのころにはラプンツェルも今の会話なんて
　忘れてるかもしれないし、もっといい相手が
　見つかってるかもしれない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(By then, Rapunzel may have forgotten this
conversation. Besides, she might find someone
better suited..._

fields.JP:
んー……わかった！
ラプンツェルがおおきくなるまで、まつ！

fields.EN:
In return, let's come to the sea together every year
until then! Okay?
fields.JP:
そのかわり、それまでまいとし
いっしょにうみにこよう！　ね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But promise me we'll go to the beach
every year until! 'Kay?

fields.JP:
やったー！
じゃっくだいすきー！

fields.EN:
(Haha. I wonder what kind of 'love' she means.
She really is still very much a child...)
fields.JP:
（はは、どういう意味の大好きなんだろうな。
　やっぱりまだまだ子供みたいだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Haha. I wonder what she means by that.
I don't know if she heard me at all...)

fields.EN:
After overcoming their hardships and gaining a peaceful life,
a great deal of time passed—and then, one day...
fields.JP:
苦難の末に平穏な生活を手に入れ、
だいぶ月日が流れたあるとき――。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Their years of hardship yielded bountiful
fruit, and they ushered in a new era of peace.

fields.EN: A yucky, old church... Why'd Jack call me here?
fields.JP:
ぼろぼろの教会……。
ジャックはなんでラプンツェルを
こんなところに呼び出したんだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED: A yucky, old church... Why'd Jack call me here?

fields.EN:
Today's an important day: it's been one whole year
since Jack and I started dating. I wish he'd called me
to somewhere prettier, though!
fields.JP:
今日はジャックと付き合い始めて一周年の
大事な日だから、もっときれいな場所に
呼び出してほしかったのに！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack and I have been close a while now.
A whole year! He better wanna celebrate!

fields.EN:
Maybe he wants to explore? I'm not a kid
though...
fields.JP:
もしかして、この教会で探検ごっこ
しようって誘ってくれたとか？
ラプンツェルも、もう子供じゃないんだけどなー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe he wants to explore? I'm not a kid
though...

fields.EN:
...But if I'm with Jack, maybe playing around
like a kid would still be fun! Hehehe.
fields.JP:
……でもジャックと一緒なら、
子供みたいに遊ぶのも楽しいかも！
えへへー
fields.LOCALIZED:
But...with Jack, I'd play all day, anyday.
Hehehe.

fields.EN:
I wonder how many years it's been since I started
making moves on Jack... When I was a kid,
he never took me seriously at all.
fields.JP:
ジャックにアプローチするようになってから、
もう何年経ったんだろう……。
子供のころは全然相手にされなかったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder how many years have passed
since Jack and I started dating. He never
thought to approach me when I was a kid.

fields.EN:
And now Jack is the one who invites me on dates.
That's huge progress, isn't it?
fields.JP:
それが今ではジャックのほうからデートに
誘ってくれるようになったんだから、
大進歩だよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But now Jack is the one in charge.
He's got a real knack for planning dates.
Ah, growth.

fields.JP: ジャック、今会いにいくよ……

fields.EN:
Huh? Where's Jack?
It's just Tsuu and Ningyo?
fields.JP:
あれ、ジャックは？
つうーとにんぎょだけ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? Where's Jack? It's just you two?

fields.JP: その質問の答えはあとだ

fields.EN: Rapu-chan, I'm going to blindfold you, okay?
fields.JP: ラプちゃん、目隠しするね
fields.LOCALIZED: Rappy, I'm going to blindfold you, okay?

fields.EN: Hehe, this tickles. We playing a game?
fields.JP:
ふふっ、くすぐったいよー！
なにこれ、新しい遊び？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe, this tickles. We playing a game?

fields.EN: Something like that. Sit still, okay?
fields.JP:
まあそんなところだ。
大人しくしていてくれよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Something like that. Sit still, okay?

fields.EN:
Good girl, Rapu-chan!
That makes this easy.
fields.JP:
ラプちゃんおりこうさん！
おかげでやりやすいよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Good girl, Rappy! This'll be a breeze.

fields.EN: Good girl? I'm not a kid...
fields.JP:
おりこうさんって、ラプンツェルもう
そんな子供じゃないのになぁ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Good girl? I'm not a kid...

fields.EN: We're done. You look great in it.
fields.JP:
さ、できたぞ。
似合うじゃないか
fields.LOCALIZED: We're done. You look great in it.

fields.EN: Wow, a dress! I never wore one before!
fields.JP:
わあー、ドレスだー！
こんなの初めて着たよー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Wow, a dress! I never wore one before!

fields.EN: Okie dokes. All done. Rest is up to him.
fields.JP:
さて、支度は整った。
あとはあいつに任せよう
fields.LOCALIZED: Okie dokes. All done. Rest is up to him.

fields.JP: ラプちゃん、お幸せにね！
コホン！　あー、ラプンツェル

fields.EN: Oh, hey Jack! You're dressed differently!
fields.JP:
あっ、ジャック！
いつもと違う恰好してる！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, hey Jack! You're dressed differently!

fields.EN:
Me too! Look, look! They put me in a dress!
Do I look pretty?
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルもなんだ。
見て見て、ドレス着せてもらったの！
きれい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Me too! Lookie lookie! They put a dress
on me? Do I look pretty?

fields.EN:
Y-Yeah. You look really beautiful.
And so grown-up...
fields.JP:
う、うん。すごくきれいだよ。
それに大人っぽくて……

fields.EN:
We've known each other for years...
You've become quite the lady.
fields.JP:
いや、もう本当に大人になったのか……。
君と出会ってから何年も経つもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We've known each other for years...
You've become quite the lady.

fields.JP: うん……。いろんなことがあったね

fields.EN:
Remember? When we first met, you were a real wild child.
You even treated me like emergency food.
fields.JP:
覚えてる？　初めて会ったころの君は
そりゃーもうすごい野生児で、
僕も非常食扱いされたっけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Remember? When we first met, you tried
to eat me.

fields.EN:
There was even a time when you kept pestering me
about wanting children, remember?
fields.JP:
子供が欲しいってせっつかれたときも
あったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You also told me want to have babies
with me too.

fields.EN:
That was my Blood Libido! It wasn't my fault!
I had no idea what I was saying either!
fields.JP:
あ、あれはリビドーだから仕方ないの！
意味もよくわかってなかったし！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was my Blood Libido! It wasn't my fault!
I had no idea what I was saying either!

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, that was embarrassing.
Haha. Well, those were the old days!
fields.JP:
今思えば、かなり恥ずかしいこと
言ってたんだなー……あはは。
まー、若気の至りってことで！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, that was embarrassing.
Haha. Well, those were the old days!

fields.EN:
Hahaha. You're still plenty young now,
so it's funny hearing you say that.
fields.JP:
ははっ。
今も十分若いのに、君がそれを言うなんてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haha. We all have stuff in the past that
we're embarrassed about!

fields.EN:
Your childlike innocence saved us again and again
whenever everyone was starting to get gloomy.
fields.JP:
君の子供らしい無邪気さには、
みんなが暗くなりがちなときに
何度も救われたな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your carefree attitude is what got us
through the rough times.

fields.EN:
You just light up the room anywhere you
go.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルがいるだけで、
みんなが自然と笑顔になるんだ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
You just light up the room anywhere you
go.

fields.EN:
And that part of you hasn't changed, even
after all these years.
fields.JP:
成長した今も、君のそういうところは
変わってないね
fields.LOCALIZED:
And that part of you hasn't changed, even
after all these years.

fields.EN: Hehe. You think? You're making me blush.
fields.JP:
えへへ……そうかなー？
ちょっと照れるな
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. You think? You're making me blush.

fields.EN:
Um... I know I treated you like a child over and over
back then, but now you've grown into a fine adult woman...
fields.JP:
その……昔は僕もさんざん君のことを
子供扱いしたけど、もう立派な大人の女性に
なったわけで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... I know I was a brat to you back then.
But I've grown up a ton.

fields.EN:
As you kept making moves on me, I gradually stopped
seeing you like a little sister and started becoming
conscious of you as a woman... yeah.
fields.JP:
君にアプローチしてもらってるうちに、
妹みたいな感覚から、だんだん異性として
意識してしまって……うん
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you never gave up on me. You let me
find my way and become the man
I am today.

fields.EN:
(Now's your chance! Don't stutter!
Say it to her loud and clear!)
fields.JP:
（し、しっかりしろ、僕！　照れるな！
　今日こそラプンツェルにはっきり言うんだ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Now's your chance! Don't stutter!
Say it to her loud and clear!)

fields.EN: I love you, Rapunzel. Will you marry me?
fields.JP:
……好きだよ、ラプンツェル。
僕と結婚してくれないかな
fields.LOCALIZED: I love you, Rapunzel. Will you marry me?

fields.EN: You know I'd never joke about that.
fields.JP:
僕にこの手の冗談は言えないって、
君もよく知ってるでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED: You know I'd never joke about that.

fields.EN:
W-Wow, what do I do?!
That surprised me! But I'm so happy!
fields.JP:
わ、わ、どうしよう！
びっくりした！　でもすごい嬉しい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, whoa! What do I do? This is a shock!
But my face is getting hot.

fields.EN:
I've always had a crush on you, Jack.
And after spending all this time together,
those feelings got stronger.
fields.JP:
あのね、ラプンツェルはちっちゃい頃から
ジャックといるのが楽しくて、ジャックのこと
好きー、ずっと一緒にいたいーって思ってたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've always had a crush on you, Jack.
And after spending all this time together,
those feelings got stronger.

fields.EN:
It hurt my feelings that you never took me
seriously, like I was just a kid. It frustrated
me back then.
fields.JP:
昔は子供扱いして全然相手に
してくれないから、つらくて
むかむかしちゃった時期あったけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
It hurt my feelings that you never took me
seriously, like I was just a kid. It frustrated
me back then.

fields.EN:
But hearing that you feel the same way?
Worth it!
fields.JP:
今はジャックも同じ気持ちってことだよね？
やったー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
