But hearing that you feel the same way?
Worth it!

fields.EN:
I never imagined you'd keep feeling that way
for such a long time.
fields.JP:
まさかこんな長い間、想い続けてくれる
なんて思わなかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't think you'd remember it back
then.

fields.EN: Hehehe! Rapunzel doesn't go back on her word!
fields.JP: えへへー、ラプンツェルに二言はないんだもん！

fields.EN:
Since we met, my eyes were pulled open.
I learned so much, but my feelings for you
never changed.
fields.JP:
ジャックと出会ってからいろんな知識や常識を
身につけたけど、やっぱりジャックのこと好きで、
一緒にいたいって気持ちは変わらなかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Since we met, my eyes were pulled open.
I learned so much, but my feelings for you
never changed.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel... Let me say it again.
I want you to become my family.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル……改めて言うよ。
僕と家族になってほしいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel... Once and for all, let's start a
family together.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel wants to become family with Jack too!
I want to make children with Jack!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルもジャックと家族になりたい！
ジャックと子供作りたい！
fields.LOCALIZED: I wanna start one too! Let's get started!

fields.EN: I know properly how babies are made now, you know?
fields.JP:
どうやったら子供ができるか、
今はちゃんと知ってるよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: If you know what I mean...?

fields.EN:
(Seriously...
When did she learn to say things like such a little devil...?)
fields.JP:
（なんていうか、もう……。
　いつの間にこんな小悪魔みたいなことを……）

fields.EN:
Maybe we don't have to rush having kids...
Why don't we enjoy our lives first?
fields.JP:
こ、子供のことはまたおいおい考えるとして、
最初は僕たち二人で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe we don't have to rush having kids...
Why don't we enjoy our lives first?

fields.EN:
Rapunzel, you're always so energetic,
and you brighten everything for me.
With you around, I can keep smiling forever.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルはいつも元気で、
僕を明るく照らしてくれる。
君がいれば僕はずっと笑顔でいられるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're so full of light, Rapunzel. It never
fails to steal my heart.

fields.EN:
It's the other way around. Because Jack is here,
Rapunzel can always keep smiling!
fields.JP:
それは逆だよ。ジャックがいるから、
ラプンツェルはいつも笑顔でいられるんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. You got it wrong, Jack. You give me
the light I need to be myself.

fields.JP:
……ありがとう。
愛してるよ。ラプンツェル
fields.LOCALIZED: That's so sweet... I love you, Rapunzel.

fields.JP: ラプンツェルも、ジャックのこと愛してるー！

fields.EN:
(I wonder if Hameln will come like she promised...
I'm getting more and more nervous while I wait.)
fields.JP:
（ハーメルンは約束通り来てくれるかな……。
　待ってる間にどんどん緊張してきた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder if Hameln's coming out today...
I'm getting nervous.)

fields.JP:
ふはーっはっはっは！
ワレ、しゃんじょうっ！！

fields.EN:
(Ah. The moment I saw the same old Hameln,
all my nervousness just flew away.)
fields.JP:
（あ、いつものハーメルンを見たら
　緊張がどっかに吹っ飛んだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh. She hasn't changed a bit. That's
a relief.)

fields.EN:
I'm glad to see you're as energetic as ever.
Sorry for calling you out here so suddenly.
fields.JP:
相変わらず元気そうでよかったよ。
急に呼び出して、ごめんね
fields.LOCALIZED: Glad to see you're well. Thanks for coming out.

fields.EN:
I don't mind. I have a generous heart, after all!
And if you called me to the sea, are we about
to go swimming and play?!
fields.JP:
別に構わんぞ。ワレは心が広いからな！
海に呼び出したということは、
もしや今から泳いで遊ぶのか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't mind. Just one of my stupendous
kind acts. So you called me to the beach.
To swim, I assume?

fields.EN:
Well, we're not wearing the right stuff.
We can swim another day.
fields.JP:
さすがに服のままじゃ無理だよ。
泳ぐのはまたの機会ってことで
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we're not wearing the right stuff.
We can swim another day.

fields.EN:
Why don't we take a walk? The ocean's
real pretty.
fields.JP:
その代わり、浜辺を散歩しない？
海がきれいだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why don't we take a walk? The ocean's
real pretty.

fields.EN:
Hm. I prefer a brisk dip in the ocean over
just looking at it...
fields.JP:
むう。きれいな海を愛でるより
泳ぎたかったのだがな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm. I prefer a brisk dip in the ocean over
just looking at it...

fields.EN:
Oh well. Guess I was tired anyway.
I'll spare you with a light walk.
fields.JP:
まあいい。
たしかにワレも最近は疲れ気味だからな。
今日は散歩だけで我慢してやるぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh well. Guess I was tired anyway.
I'll spare you with a light walk.

fields.EN:
I've heard from Mamoru how hard you've been working.
He says you've been making a huge impa—doing a great job
on civil-engineering sites, right?
fields.JP:
ハーメルンががんばってるって話は
マモルから聞いてるよ。土木系の現場で
大あば……大活躍してるんだって？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mamoru tells me how hard you've been
working. I hear it's driving you nuts.
Working in the fields and all.

fields.EN:
What, you already knew?
Calling it a 'gweat shuccess' is embarrassing!
fields.JP:
なんだ、知っておったのか。
だいかちゅやくだなんて、照れるではないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. You asked about me, huh? Working hyard.
Don't flatter me.

fields.EN:
There is nothing I cannot create once I set my mind to it!
Praise me! Fwahahahaha—bwegh, *cough*!
fields.JP:
ワレにかかれば創造できぬものなど
ないということだ！　ワレを称えよ！
ふはーっはっはっはっ、ぶへっ、ぶほっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can anything I set my mind to! Worship me!
Fwahahaha! *cough*!

fields.EN:
(She's supposed to be a frail ordinary girl now,
without the power she had before, yet she has incredible vitality...
Where does all that energy come from?)
fields.JP:
（もう前みたいな力はないか弱い女の子の
　はずなのに、すごいバイタリティ……。
　その元気はどこから湧いてくるんだろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She might not have powers anymore,
but she's still the classic Hameln. Where
does it all come from?)

fields.EN:
(...No, maybe power has nothing to do with it.
This relentlessly positive side of her
is what makes Hameln most amazing.)
fields.JP:
（……いや、力は関係ないのかも。
　このとことん前向きなところが、
　ハーメルンの一番のすごさなんだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Or...maybe it never came from her powers.
That's just her positivity. That's what I like
about Hameln.)

fields.EN: (She's so unique. I think I'm crushing...)
fields.JP:
（こんな女の子は他にいない。
　やっぱり僕は、ハーメルンのことを……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (She's so unique. I think I'm crushing...)

fields.JP: む？　なにを笑っておるのだ？

fields.EN:
It's been a while since I've seen you but I 
was just thinking you haven't changed.
fields.JP:
久しぶりに会ったけど
相変わらずだなって思ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's been a while since I've seen you but I 
was just thinking you haven't changed.

fields.EN:
You're carefree. You're never fake. When 
I'm with you, my anxiety just melts.
fields.JP:
天真爛漫で裏表がなくて、
ハーメルンといると不安なんて言葉が
馬鹿らしくなってくるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're carefree. You're never fake. When 
I'm with you, my anxiety just melts.

fields.EN: Yeah, totally... Hey? Are you praising me?
fields.JP:
うんうん、……うん？
それは褒めておるのか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah, totally... Hey? Are you praising me?

fields.EN:
Our life settled down. But there's still so
much to do, so I get anxious sometimes.
fields.JP:
今はだいぶ生活も落ち着いてきたけど、
まだまだ先は見えない状況で、
たまに不安になったりするんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our life settled down. But there's still so
much to do, so I get anxious sometimes.

fields.EN:
Even so, just looking at you melts all
those worries away.
fields.JP:
でもそんなときにハーメルンの顔を見ると、
不安なんて吹き飛んじゃって、元気になれる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even so, just looking at you melts all
those worries away.

fields.EN:
Maybe that's why. Before I knew it, you
were always on my mind.
fields.JP:
だからかな。
いつの間にか君のことばっかり
考えるようになっていて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe that's why. Before I knew it, you
were always on my mind.

fields.EN: And I realized I've fallen in love with you...
fields.JP: 気がついたら、君を好きになっていたんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED: And I realized I've fallen in love with you...

fields.EN:
Who knows how long our lives will be?
I don't want to live another day without
telling you...
fields.JP:
こ、この世界だっていつどうなっちゃうか
わからないよね。それなら伝えられるときに
この気持ちを伝えたいって思ったわけで
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who knows how long our lives will be?
I don't want to live another day without
telling you...

fields.JP: それで、その……好きなん、だけど……

fields.EN: (This is so lame! I need a do-over...)
fields.JP:
（な、なんだこのかっこ悪い告白は！
　あああ、できることならやり直したい……！）
fields.LOCALIZED: (This is so lame! I need a do-over...)

fields.JP: ……これはもしや、告白とゆーやつにゃのか？

fields.EN:
So it's true! I've seen this kinda stuff in manga
before, but never real life...
fields.JP:
こ、これが告白……！
マンガで見たことはあったが、
実際に自分で体験すると、こう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So it's true! I've seen this kinda stuff in manga
before, but never real life...

fields.EN: Dis makes my heart go nyuts!
fields.JP: しゅ、しゅごくドキドキしてくるのだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Dis makes my heart go nyuts!

fields.EN: (Huh... She doesn't seem to hate the idea...?)
fields.JP: （あれ、嫌がられてはいないような……？）

fields.EN:
Jack...why the confession? You don't wanna be
my servant?
fields.JP:
ジャ……ジャックよ。なぜ告白なのだ？
ワレの家来ではダメなのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack...why the confession? You don't wanna be
my servant?

fields.EN:
(Can't let her down with a weak closer.
Gotta finish strong!)
fields.JP:
（曖昧な答えじゃ、
　きっとハーメルンには伝わらない。
　ここは勇気を出して、はっきりと……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Can't let her down with a weak closer.
Gotta finish strong!)

fields.EN:
No, I don't wanna be your servant.
I want us to be equals. As lovers.
fields.JP:
……家来じゃなく、
僕はハーメルンと対等な恋人になりたいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I don't wanna be your servant.
I want us to be equals. As lovers.

fields.EN:
LOOOOOVERS?! Like holding hands and
kissing and all that stuff!
fields.JP:
ここ、恋人っ！？
恋人とゆーと、手を繋いだり
キッスしたりする、アレか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
LOOOOOVERS?! Like holding hands and
kissing and all that stuff!
Yeah...you got a problem with that?

fields.EN: Hm. Lovers huh? Big, big deal...
fields.JP:
むぅ……こ、恋人か。
これは大変なことになったぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm. Lovers huh? Big, big deal...

fields.EN:
Being a servant's one thing, but I've never
had a lover. Got no clue how that works...
fields.JP:
家来ならともかく、
ワレは恋人なんて持ったことがない。
どう接したらいいか見当もつかん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Being a servant's one thing, but I've never
had a lover. Got no clue how that works...

fields.JP: （ぶつぶつ言いながら考えこんじゃった……）

fields.EN:
So lovers get to... Oh my gosh...
Not that I mind. Is that my heart pounding
like crazy?
fields.JP:
仮にだ。マンガで描かれる恋人同士のような
ことをジャックとすると想像して……むむ、
嫌ではないな……むしろドキドキする
fields.LOCALIZED:
So lovers get to... Oh my gosh...
Not that I mind. Is that my heart pounding
like crazy?

fields.EN: I see... So what I feel for Jack is...
fields.JP: そうか……ワレはジャックのことが……
fields.LOCALIZED: I know...what it means now, Jack.

fields.EN:
*ahem*! How do I say this...? I, too, hajsh
feejings... Uh, so uh...
fields.JP:
コホン！　あー、アレだ。
ワレも貴様を憎からじゅ思っていると……
そのー……だからだな。あー……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*ahem*! How do I say this...? I, too, hajsh
feejings... Uh, so uh...

fields.EN: I-I'm saying I like you too, Jack!
fields.JP: ワ、ワレもジャックが好きだと言っておる！
fields.LOCALIZED: I have feelings for you, Jack!

fields.JP: ハーメルン……！　ほ、本当に？

fields.EN:
Hey, don't make me say it again!
The Demon King never retracts a statement!
fields.JP:
ええい、聞き直すな！
魔王が発言を撤回するわけなかろう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, don't ask again! The Demon King
doesn't repeat herself!

fields.EN: Thank you! That makes me so happy.
fields.JP: ありがとう！　嬉しいなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED: Thank you! That makes me so happy.

fields.EN:
Do not get all giddy! Now that you are my
lover, I'm going to retrain you!
fields.JP:
う、浮かれるでない！
ワレの恋人になったからには、
てってーてきに鍛え直してくれるわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do not get all giddy! Now that you are my
lover, I'm going to retrain you!

fields.JP:
しゅでに試練は始まっておるのだから、
気を抜くでないぞー！

fields.EN: Oh, this is a wonderful day to swim!
fields.JP:
おおっ！
すばらしい海水浴日和ではないか！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, this is a wonderful day to swim!

fields.EN:
Glad we could hit the beach. Both of
us have been so busy.
fields.JP:
二人で海水浴に来られて嬉しいね。
お互い忙しくて、日程を合わせるのが
大変だったもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Glad we could hit the beach. Both of
us have been so busy.

fields.EN:
Indeed. It can't be helped.
Being this busy is proof that peace has returned!
Fwahahahaha!
fields.JP:
うむ。まあ仕方あるまい。
こうして多忙なのも、平和になった証拠なのだ！
ふははははっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. Can't be helped. Much to do in the
new world! Fwahaha!

fields.EN:
(Well anyways, Hameln's swimsuit...
It's unique, but it's cute on her.)
fields.JP:
（それはそうと、ハーメルンの水着……。
　変わったデザインだけどかわいいな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well anyways, Hameln's swimsuit...
It's unique, but it's cute on her.)

fields.EN:
(She has this healthy kind of sex appeal... No, no!
We came here just to have fun today.
I shouldn't be looking at her with dirty thoughts!)
fields.JP:
（健康的な色気が……って、ダメだダメだ！
　今日は普通に遊びに来たんだから、
　いやらしい目で見るもんじゃないよ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's mesmerizing... Oh no! We came
for a date. I can't be a perv!)

fields.EN: Hey Jack, what's the look for?
fields.JP:
むー？　ジャックよ、
一人で変な顔をしてどうしたのだ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey Jack, what's the look for?

fields.EN:
Oh... yeah. I was thinking your swimsuit really suits you.
I like the unusual design too.
fields.JP:
あ……うん。
君の水着が似合ってるなーと思って。
なんか不思議なデザインなのもいいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, well... Your swimsuit is real nice.
Super pretty.

fields.EN: Right? Right? It suits me, doesn't it!
fields.JP: そうだろう、そうだろう。似合うだろう！
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't you think? Keep up the compliments!

fields.EN:
I told Gretel about our beach date and she
suggested I wear this!
fields.JP:
貴様と海に行くと言ったら、
グレーテルがこーゆー水着がいいだろうと
教えてくれたのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I told Gretel about our beach date and she
suggested I wear this!

fields.EN:
(Knowing it was Gretel's advice makes me suspicious
there might be some ulterior motive... No, no.
I shouldn't doubt one of my companions.)
fields.JP:
（グレーテルのアドバイスだと思うと、
　なにか裏がありそうで警戒してしまう……。
　いや、仲間を疑うなんてよくないことだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Gretel's advice has to be taken with a grain
of salt. Who knows what she's plotting?)

fields.EN:
(It really is cute and suits her, though.
Maybe Gretel was simply giving honest advice...)
fields.JP:
（現にこんなにかわいいし、似合ってるん
　だよなぁ。グレーテルは純粋にアドバイス
　しただけなのかもしれない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But Hameln does look adorabe. Maybe
Gretel recommended it genuinely...)

fields.JP:
よーし、今日は遊ぶぞ！
ワレに続けー！

fields.EN: Oh wait! We need to stretch first...
fields.JP: あっ、待って！　まず準備運動を……
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh wait! We need to stretch first...

fields.EN:
(Oh no! I yanked on her bikini! It's coming
undone!)
fields.JP:
（し、しまった！
　ついハーメルンの水着の紐を掴んでしまった！
　そして解けてしまったー！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh no! I yanked on her bikini! It's coming
undone!)

fields.EN:
Sorry, Hameln! I'll close my eyes so you
can fix it.
fields.JP:
ハーメルン、ごめん！
僕はこうして目をつぶってるから、
今のうちに水着を直しちゃって！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry, Hameln! I'll close my eyes so you
can fix it.

fields.EN:
Aww, my swimsuit came off.
This is a problem.
fields.JP:
あーあー、
ワレの水着が脱げてしまったではないか。
しかし困ったぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: Aw. The top came off. Can't be helped.

fields.EN:
Gretel helped me put this swimsuit on,
so I can't put it back on by myself.
fields.JP:
この水着はグレーテルに手伝って
もらったから、一人では着られぬのだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Gretel tied it for me, so I can't fix it.

fields.EN: Jack, you do it. Since you yanked it.
fields.JP:
ジャック、貴様も手伝え。
脱がせた責任を取るのだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack, you do it. Since you yanked it.

fields.EN: But if my eyes are closed...
fields.JP: でも目をつぶったままだと……
fields.LOCALIZED: But if my eyes are closed...

fields.JP: 目を開ければよかろう？

fields.EN: (Then I'll see all sorts of things!)
fields.JP:
（そしたら君のあられもない姿が
　ばっちり見えちゃうから！）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Then I'll see all sorts of things!)

fields.EN: I'll do it with my eyes closed.
fields.JP:
そ、その、僕は目をつぶったままで
がんばって手伝ってみるよ……
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll do it with my eyes closed.

fields.EN:
? You're making this needlessly troublesome.
Well, do as you like.
fields.JP:
？　面倒なことをする奴だな。
まあ好きにしろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? That's just more work. Whatever
floats your bun.

fields.EN:
Here, I'll hold this side down,
so you hold onto this string.
fields.JP:
ほれ、ワレはこっちを押さえているから
貴様はこの紐を持っているのだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Here, I'll hold it down. Just tie it.

fields.EN:
Pull the string through the loop... Perfect.
Now you tie it.
fields.JP:
で、こっちからこの紐を回して、
こっち側に通してだな……よし。
ジャック、さっきの紐とこれを結ぶのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Pull the string through the loop... Perfect.
Now you tie it.

fields.EN: Oh, so just tie it, then tug like this?
fields.JP:
えーと、この紐とこの紐を結ぶのか。
もう少し引っ張ったほうがいいかな……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, so just tie it, then tug like this?

fields.EN: Oh,  I'm sorry! Was it too tight?
fields.JP:
わっ、ごめん！
きつかった？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh,  I'm sorry! Was it too tight?

fields.EN:
Y-You fool! If you pull that hard,
it's going to dig in!
fields.JP:
た、たわけ！
そんな強く引っ張ったら食い込むだろーが！
fields.LOCALIZED: You idiot... Pull like that, and it'll wedge!

fields.JP:
（く、食い込む……。
　どこに食い込んだんだろう……）

fields.EN:
If it digs in somewhere like that,
even the Demon King can't help letting out a weird voice...
fields.JP:
あんなところに食い込んだら、
いかに魔王とはいえ変な声が出てしまうのは
仕方ないことなんだぞ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not my fault I'm squealing! Even the
Demon King can wedge.

fields.EN: Um, to loosen the string... like this?
fields.JP: ええと、紐を緩めるには……こうかな？

fields.EN:
You idiot! Wrong string! Argh, you clumsy
buffoon!
fields.JP:
ば、馬鹿、その紐は違う！
ええい、この不器用がー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You idiot! Wrong string! Argh, you clumsy
buffoon!

fields.EN: Phew, finally it's back to normal.
fields.JP: ふー。やっと元通りになったぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: Phew, finally it's back to normal.

fields.JP: よーし！　今度こそ泳ぐのだー！

fields.EN:
Hold on! That swimsuit looks like it's easy to 
come off, so it's dangerous going in the water.
fields.JP:
ちょっと待った！　その水着、
かなり脱げやすいみたいだから
海に入ったら危ないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hold on! That swimsuit looks like it's easy to 
come off, so it's dangerous going in the water.

fields.EN: If it washes away in the water...
fields.JP:
また脱げて、しかも水着が
流されちゃったりしたら……
fields.LOCALIZED: If it washes away in the water...

fields.EN:
W-Why are you so calm about that?!
If that happened, I'd have to keep my eyes closed again!
fields.JP:
な、なんで平然としてるの！
そんなことになったら僕は
また目をつぶってなきゃいけないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
How come that doesn't bother you?!
You just want to embarrass me.

fields.EN:
Don't worry so much. I don't care if you see
me naked...
fields.JP:
そんなに気にすることなかろう。
別に貴様になら見られても構わんのだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry so much. I don't care if you see
me naked...

fields.EN:
I mind!
Th-That'd be way too stimulating for me!
fields.JP:
僕が構うの！
さ、さすがに刺激が強すぎるよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I mind! It stimulates me too much!

fields.EN:
I said I don't mind, you overly serious fool.
Though I don't dislike that side of you either...
fields.JP:
ワレはいいと言っておるのに、生真面目な奴め。
そーゆーところも嫌いではないがな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I said I don't mind. You're so serious...
Well, what I like about you...

fields.EN:
Very well. If you say so, I guess I wont
swim today.
fields.JP:
仕方がない。貴様がそうまで言うのなら、
今日は海で泳ぐのは我慢してやるとするか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very well. If you say so, I guess I wont
swim today.

fields.EN:
You'd better be gweatly grateful to such an understanding lover!
Wahahahahaha!!
fields.JP:
理解ある恋人に、しぇいじぇい感謝するがよい！
わーっはっはっはっはっは！！
fields.LOCALIZED: You best thank your lover! Wahahaha!

fields.EN: Oh, my swimsuit almost fell off again...
fields.JP: おっと、笑ったらまた水着がずれそうに……
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, my swimsuit almost fell off again...

fields.EN:
(As expected by Gretel...it wasn't an
ordinary swimsuit.)
fields.JP:
（やっぱりグレーテルが勧めた水着だけあって、
　普通じゃなかった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(As expected by Gretel...it wasn't an
ordinary swimsuit.)

fields.EN:
A few years later.
The new village was developing smoothly,
and life had begun to stabilize—
fields.JP:
数年後。
新しい村づくりも順調に進み、
生活も安定してきたころ――。
fields.LOCALIZED:
A few years later...
Their village was beginning to flourish,
and the settlement became a haven for all.

fields.EN:
Hmm. What a run-down building.
I have no idea what Jack is thinking,
calling me to a place like this.
fields.JP:
ふーむ、なんともオンボロな建物だな。
こんなところに呼び出すとは、
ジャックの考えていることはわからん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm. This building is run-down. Why'd Jack
invite me here? What a weirdo.

fields.EN:
*gasp* ...What if there's something trying
to defeat me here?! Is jat true?!
fields.JP:
はっ。……もしやここに
ワレを倒そうとする悪いやつがおるのか！？
そうにゃのか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
*gasp* ...What if there's something trying
to defeat me here?! Is jat true?!

fields.EN:
Then I must steel myself before I face them!
Come, fair and square! Fight me!!
fields.JP:
となれば気を引き締めて挑まねばなるまい！
いざ尋常に！　勝負だー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Must be careful! Keep a level head! Victory
is certain!

fields.JP: 勝負ってなんのことだ？

fields.EN:
What, it's Otsuu and Ningyo.
Where is the enemy?
fields.JP:
なんだ、おつうに人魚ではないか。
敵はどこにおるのだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, hey Otsuu, Little Mermaid.
Where's our enemy?

fields.EN: Haa-chan, I think you've misunderstood something...
fields.JP: ハーちゃん、なにか誤解してそうだね……
fields.LOCALIZED: Hammy, I think you're mixed up...

fields.EN:
Explaining probably won't get through to her, and we're short on time.
Operation: use force!
fields.JP:
説明しても通じそうにないし、時間も惜しい。
実力行使作戦だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We don't have the time or energy to
explain! Let's just go!

fields.EN:
I don't think that counts as an operation, but okay!
Blindfold coming right up!
fields.JP:
それは作戦って言わないと思うけど了解！
目隠しいきまーす！
fields.LOCALIZED: If you say so, sure! I'll blindfold her!

fields.EN: NOWAAA! What is the meaning of this?!
fields.JP:
のわーっ！？
いきなり目隠しとはどーゆー了見なのだ！？
fields.LOCALIZED: NOWAAA! What is the meaning of this?!

fields.EN:
You myast be manipurated by the enemy!
Wake up, you guys!
fields.JP:
あっ、さては貴様ら、
敵にあやちゅられておるのか！？
目を覚ますのだー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You myast be manipurated by the enemy!
Wake up, you guys!

fields.EN:
We're not being controlled, and there is no enemy!
We'll be done soon, so stop struggling!
fields.JP:
操られてないし敵もいない！
すぐ終わるから暴れるな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are no enemies, including us.
I'm almost done, just sit still.

fields.EN:
Haa-chan, calm down!
You'll tear the thing Otsuu-chan made!
fields.JP:
ハーちゃん落ち着いて。
おつうちゃんが作ったやつが
破れちゃうー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Keep still, Hammy! You'll rip it! Otsuu
worked so hard on it!

fields.EN: How can I kyeep still? GAAAAH!
fields.JP:
この状況で落ち着いてなどいられるか！
ふんがーっ！
fields.LOCALIZED: How can I kyeep still? GAAAAH!

fields.JP:
あいたっ！
頭突きが当たった！

fields.EN: I'm fine, Hime. But that hurt...

How dare you assault the great Demon King!
YAAAAH!
fields.JP:
この魔王たるワレに狼藉を働こうとは
いい度胸なのだ！
とうりゃあぁーっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How dare you assault the great Demon King!
YAAAAH!

fields.JP: だから、あーばーれーるーなー！！

fields.EN: Oh, brother... She resisted more than I thought.
fields.JP:
た、大変だったね……。
思った以上に暴れられちゃった……
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, brother... She resisted more than I thought.

fields.EN:
But you look stunning. It was worth the
challenge.
fields.JP:
でもすごくきれい。
がんばって着せた甲斐があったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you look stunning. It was worth the
challenge.

fields.EN:
Th-This is...?
What is this white outfit?
fields.JP:
こ、これは……？
この白い衣装はなんなのだ？
fields.LOCALIZED: What is this...? What have you done to me?

fields.EN:
It's a white ceremonial gown. A wedding
dress.
fields.JP:
純白の婚礼衣装。
ウェディングドレスだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a white ceremonial gown. A wedding
dress.

fields.EN:
WYAHT! A wedding dress?! I've seen
one in manga before!
fields.JP:
にゃにっ、ウェディングドレス！？
前にマンガで見たことがあるぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
WYAHT! A wedding dress?! I've seen
one in manga before!

fields.EN: Oh, so this is a wedding dress. Hmm, hmm...
fields.JP: ほー、これがそうなのか。ふむふむ……
fields.LOCALIZED: So, the time has come, has it...?

fields.EN:
Well then. I'm exhausted after Hameln rampaged so much,
so we're heading home now.
fields.JP:
さてと。ハーメルンが大暴れしたせいで
疲れたから、僕たちはもう帰るとするよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've had my fill of Hameln for the day,
so we'll be off.

fields.EN: We'll leave the two of you to take your time together~
fields.JP: あとはお二人でごゆっくり～

fields.EN:
Ah, I see...
'You two' means Jack and me.
fields.JP:
ああ、そうか……。
ジャックとワレのお二人でということか

fields.EN:
And what's with that unusual outfit you're wearing?
What kind of entertainment is this?
fields.JP:
というか貴様、変わった格好をしておるな。
これはなんの余興なのだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're in sillywear. What is the meaning
of this?

fields.EN: I have something important to tell you.
fields.JP: き、今日は君に伝えたいことがあるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: I have something important to tell you.

fields.JP:
そうか、そうか！
ならば遠慮せず伝えるがよい！

fields.EN: (Oh, she doesn't get it. Makes sense...)
fields.JP:
（あ、これはわかってないな。
　予想はしてたけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Oh, she doesn't get it. Makes sense...)

fields.EN:
We've had a long relationship, but you 
haven't changed a bit.
fields.JP:
けっこう長い付き合いだけど、
君は出会ったころから変わらないね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We've had a long relationship, but you 
haven't changed a bit.

fields.EN:
You're always brimming with confidence as the Demon King,
bold, carefree, and deeply caring about your companions...
fields.JP:
いつも魔王として自信満々で、豪快で、
天真爛漫で、仲間想いなところがあって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're always so confident and carefree.
Always looking out for your friends...

fields.EN:
Bwahahaha! Damn right! I am a great 
Demon King!
fields.JP:
ふははははっ！　まあな！
ワレは立派な魔王であるからな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Bwahahaha! Damn right! I am a great 
Demon King!

fields.EN:
You may act grand, but there are times you
get lonely and want to hold hands. There's
a soft side to you.
fields.JP:
でも孤高のふりをして、ときどき
人恋しくて手を繋ぎたくなったりするような
寂しがり屋な一面もあったりして
fields.LOCALIZED:
You may act grand, but there are times you
get lonely and want to hold hands. There's
a soft side to you.

fields.EN:
And you're still honest with those feelings,
it's adorable. It makes me happy.
fields.JP:
そんな気持ちも素直にぶつけてくれるのが
愛おしくて、実はちょっと嬉しかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
And you're still honest with those feelings,
it's adorable. It makes me happy.

fields.EN: Right. This is almost embarrassing to me.
fields.JP:
そ、そうか。面と向かって言われると
みょーに照れるじょ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Right. This is almost embarrassing to me.

fields.EN:
You're so pure and you surprise me in so
many ways. You make me smile just being
you...
fields.JP:
君は純粋で、いつも予想外のことを
して驚かせてくれて、一緒にいるだけで
僕を笑顔にさせてくれる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're so pure and you surprise me in so
many ways. You make me smile just being
you...

fields.EN: A-And I thought... I'd like to become family with you.
fields.JP:
そ、そんな君と、家族になれたらって
……思ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
All of that...makes me want to start a
family with you.

fields.EN: Yeah... You and me, as husband and wife...
fields.JP: うん……。君と僕で、夫婦というか……
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. As a married a couple.

fields.EN:
A married...couple? I've seen those
in manga before!
fields.JP:
ふうふ……夫婦？
マンガで読んだことがあるぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
A married...couple? I've seen those
in manga before!

fields.EN:
Does that include the nightly deed we
performed for the first time the other
night?
fields.JP:
も、もしかしてこの間初めてやった
夜の営みだな！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Does that include the nightly deed we
performed for the first time the other
night?

fields.JP:
流石のワレもあにぇは……
その、恥ずかしかったにょ……

fields.EN:
No! That's not what I'm talking about!
That too, but don't jump the gun!
fields.JP:
ち、違うよ！
いや、違うわけじゃないけど、
なんか思考が飛躍しすぎ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No! That's not what I'm talking about!
That too, but don't jump the gun!

fields.EN:
How cyan I be calm?! We gotta do
married cyouple stuff!
fields.JP:
や、やっぱり違くないではないか！
夫婦になるとはつまりそーゆーことを
ほにゃららするのだろーが！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How cyan I be calm?! We gotta do
married cyouple stuff!

fields.EN:
I am the Demon King, you know?!
The Demon King, and yet... husband and wife?!
Wh-What even is all this?!
fields.JP:
ワレは魔王なのだぞ！？
魔王なのに……っ、夫婦だとか！
とにかくにゃんにゃのだー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I am the Demon King! Demon King!
What is gyoing on!

fields.EN: How kyan I stay calm?! GAHHHH!
fields.JP:
これが落ちついていられりゅか！
うがーーっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED: How kyan I stay calm?! GAHHHH!

fields.EN:
(Oh no, she's in a state of panic!
What do I do.... Uh, uh...)
fields.JP:
（まずい、なんかパニックになりかけてる！
　どうしよう。えーと、えーと……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh no, she's in a state of panic!
What do I do.... Uh, uh...)

fields.EN:
(I-I kissed her!
 Even if it was to make her be quiet, what a bold method...!)
fields.JP:
（つ、ついキスしちゃった！
　黙ってもらうためとはいえ、
　なんて大胆な方法を……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I-I kissed her! This is such a bold way to
silence way...!)

fields.JP: せ……接吻されて……しまった……

いきなりごめん、ハーメルン……。
僕は、その……

fields.EN:
N-No need for excuses!
...You are telling me to become your consort, are you not?
fields.JP:
い、言い訳はよい！
……ワレに貴様の妃になれというのだな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
N-no need to make excuses! 
...So I should become your princess?

fields.EN:
Consort, or rather, wife...
But yes, that's what I mean.
fields.JP:
妃というか、奥さんというか……
でもそういうことだよ

fields.EN: I-I love you. So I want you to marry me!
fields.JP:
僕は君が、す、好きなんだ。
だから結婚してほしい！
fields.LOCALIZED: I-I love you. So I want you to marry me!

fields.EN:
Hehe... Very well.
If you insist that strongly, I accept your challenge.
fields.JP:
ふふ……いいだろう。
そこまで言うのなら、受けて立とう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe... Very well. If you insist,
then I shall comply.

fields.EN:
I-I love you too, Jack.
I would not regret spending the rest of my life with you.
fields.JP:
ワ、ワレもジャックを好いておるしな。
貴様となら添い遂げても後悔はすまい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I love you too, Jack. I have no regrets
spending my love with you.

fields.EN:
Trying to take the Demon King as your wife is no half-hearted commitment.
That courage makes you worthy to be my husband!
fields.JP:
魔王を娶ろうなど、生半可な覚悟ではあるまい。
その度胸はワレの夫となるにふさわしい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Being a Demon King takes resolve!
Only you are fit to serve as my groom!

fields.EN: I shall spend my whole life witnessing your resolve!
fields.JP:
貴様の覚悟、
ワレが一生をかけて見届けてくれよう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I vow to spend my life as a witness to
your magnificent strength!

fields.JP:
ありがとう、ハーメルン。
……愛してるよ

fields.EN:
When you say it so directly, it is embarrassing.
But, well...
fields.JP:
そんなまっすぐに言われると照れるぞ。
でも、まあ、なんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your bluntness flatters me, sir.
But...

fields.EN:
I love you too, Jack.
Let's build a good family together!
fields.JP:
愛してるぞ、ジャック。
共にいい家族を作っていこうな！
fields.LOCALIZED: I love you too, Jack ! Long live our bloodline!

fields.EN:
The sea is something new to both of you, isn't it?
I'll watch from here, so go have fun.
fields.JP:
二人とも海が珍しいんですね。
わたくしはここで見ていますから、
遊んできてもいいですよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I forget none of you have seen a beach.
I'll keep watch, you go ahead!

fields.EN: Yay! Let's go into the sea!
fields.JP: わーい！　うみにはいろー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yay! Let's go in the beach!

fields.EN:
So juvenile of you to get giddy from water.
No grown-up would do that.
fields.JP:
海ではしゃぐなんて子供ね。
大人はそんなことしないのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So juvenile of you to get giddy from water.
No grown-up would do that.

fields.EN: Huh? Then what do grown-ups do for fun?
fields.JP: えー、じゃあおとなはなにしてあそぶの？
fields.LOCALIZED: What, are we supposed to play in silence?

fields.EN:
Um... We could play in the sand!
Let's make sand castles!
fields.JP:
えっと……そう、砂浜で遊ぶのよ！
砂のお城とか作るの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... We could play in the sand!
Let's make sand castles!

fields.EN:
Yeah, duh! But if you insist on joining,
I guess I won't stop you.
fields.JP:
大人なの！
あんたもやりたいって言うなら、
一緒にやらせてあげてもいいわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, duh! But if you insist on joining,
I guess I won't stop you.

fields.EN: Yay! Let's make sand castles together!
fields.JP: やるー！　いっしょにおしろつくる！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yay! Let's make sand castles together!

fields.EN:
Hehe. I wonder what makes someone
a grown-up.
fields.JP: ふふ、大人の定義ってなんなんでしょうねぇ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. I wonder what makes someone
a grown-up.

fields.EN: Hey, what kind of castle are we making?
fields.JP: ねーねー、どんなおしろつくるの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, what kind of castle are we making?

fields.EN: Let's see... If we're doing this, I want a big, magnificent castle!
fields.JP:
そうねぇ、どうせなら大きくてりっぱな
お城にしたいわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm. One thing for sure, it's gotta be
big and sturdy!

fields.EN: Big and magnificent? Hmm... Rapunzel wants a cute, delicious-looking castle.
fields.JP:
おっきくて、りっぱー？
んー、ラプンツェルはかわいくて
おいしそーなおしろがいいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Big and sturdy? Iunno... I want a cute,
yummy-looking one.

fields.EN:
A delicious-looking... castle?
I don't really get it...
fields.JP:
おいしそうなって、お城が？
よくわかんないわ……
fields.LOCALIZED: A yummy-looking sand castle? Think I'll pass...

fields.EN:
Regardless, we need to get building.
Let's collect some sand.
fields.JP:
なんにしても、お城を作るんだから
まずはたくさん砂を集めるわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Regardless, we need to get building.
Let's collect some sand.

fields.EN: Sand is grainy. How do you make a castle?
fields.JP:
ねー、すなってさらさらだよ？
どうやっておしろつくるの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Sand is grainy. How do you make a castle?

fields.EN:
...Now that you mention it, you're right.
How can we make the sand firm...?
fields.JP:
…………言われてみれば、そうね。
どうすれば砂を固くできるのかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, you're right. How do
we get it to thicken?

fields.EN: You should mix water into the sand.
fields.JP: 砂に水を混ぜるといいですよ
fields.LOCALIZED: You should mix water into the sand.

fields.JP: 水を？　そうしたら砂が固まるの？
ええ。やってみてください

fields.EN: Sukui, you're so smart! You're an adult!
fields.JP: スクイものしりー！　さすがおとな！
fields.LOCALIZED: Sukui, you're so smart! You're an adult!

fields.EN: Hmph... Well, it's worth a shot.
fields.JP: ふん……。まあ、やってみる価値はあるわね
fields.LOCALIZED: Hmph... Well, it's worth a shot.

fields.EN:
Rapu, let's move closer to the sea.
Then we'll mix seawater into the sand!
fields.JP:
ラプ、もっと海の近くに移動よ。
それで海の水を砂に混ぜるのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rappy, let's go closer to the water.
Then we'll mix seawater with the sand!

fields.EN:
Oh... Mixing water into sand really does make it nice and firm.
Looks like we can build a castle with this.
fields.JP:
へぇ……たしかに水を混ぜた砂って
いい感じに固まるのね。
これならお城が作れそうだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh... She's right. Mixing sand with water
thickens it immediately. Now we can shape
the castle.

fields.JP:
ふんふんふーん♪
ふんふーん♪

fields.EN: ...Hey, Rapu, why are you making those weird dumpling-like things when we're supposed to be building a castle?
fields.JP:
……ちょっとラプ、お城作るのに
どうして変な団子みたいなやつ作ってるのよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey Rappy, what's that weird ball for?

fields.EN:
These go around the castle.
Cute, right!
fields.JP:
これはねー、おしろのまわりにおくんだ。
かわいいでしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED: This is something ornamental. Isn't it cute?

fields.EN:
But the castle should be grand.
Don't go planning without me.
fields.JP:
シラは立派なお城がいいの。
勝手なことしないで
fields.LOCALIZED:
But the castle should be grand.
Don't go planning without me.

fields.EN:
Aw. Let's make two different ones then.
We'll ask Sukui to judge which one's
better.
fields.JP:
ぶー。じゃあべつべつのおしろつくろーよ。
そんでどっちのほうがいいか、
スクイにみてもらうの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aw. Let's make two different ones then.
We'll ask Sukui to judge which one's
better.

fields.EN: Oh, I'm going to judge? That's a big ask.
fields.JP:
あら、わたくしが審査員ですか？
責任重大ですね
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, I'm going to judge? That's a big ask.

fields.EN:
Bring it on! I'll show you how a real castle
looks!
fields.JP:
その勝負、受けて立つわ！
シラが本物のお城ってやつを教えてあげる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Bring it on! I'll show you how a real castle
looks!

fields.EN: These are sand castles, we're talking about...
fields.JP: 本物ではなく、砂のお城ですけどね……
fields.LOCALIZED: These are sand castles, we're talking about...

fields.EN:
D-Don't worry about the details!
All right, the castle-building contest starts now!
fields.JP:
こ、細かいことはいいの！
それじゃあお城づくり勝負、スタートよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Enough blabbery! Let's commence the
contest... GO!

fields.EN:
Phew. Mine's shaping up well. Things are
going to plan!
fields.JP:
ふう。だいぶ形になってきたわね。
すごくいいお城ができそうだわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Phew. Mine's shaping up well. Things are
going to plan!

fields.EN:
Rapunzel's castle is amazing too!
Look, I made five food storage rooms!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルのおしろもすごいよ！
ほら、しょくりょーこをごこもつくったの！
fields.LOCALIZED: Mine's amazing! Look! Five whole pastries!

fields.EN: It sure is amazing, but the food storage rooms are starting to look more like the main building than the castle...
fields.JP:
たしかにすごいけど、
お城よりも食糧庫のほうが
メインの建物みたいになってるわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Impressive, but your castle looks more like
a desert than a building...

fields.EN:
Look around the castle!
I put lots of round balls there. Cute, right!
fields.JP:
みてみて。おしろのまわり！
まあるいだんごをいっぱいおいたんだよ。
かわいいでしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Check out the design! I made a bunch of
those balls! Cute, huh!

fields.EN: You sure like making those things...
fields.JP: あんた砂で団子作るの好きねぇ
fields.LOCALIZED: You sure like making those things...

fields.EN: And I'll make more too... Hm?
fields.JP: これから、もっといっぱい……ん？
fields.LOCALIZED: And I'll make more too... Hm?

fields.JP: あーっ！　せっかく作ったお城が！
なみでこわれちゃったー！

fields.EN:
I can't believe it. We were right there, and
that damn wave took it all away...
fields.JP:
もう、信じられない！
あとちょっとで完成だったのに
波にさらわれちゃうなんて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe it. We were right there, and
that damn wave took it all away...

fields.EN:
Who was it who said we should move closer to the sea?!
That's right, Shira did! Sorry!
fields.JP:
誰よ海の近くに移動しようって言ったやつは！
そうよシラよ！　悪かったわねー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who's the wisecrack who suggested the
beach! Oh yeah, me! Never again!

fields.EN: How tragic. How about another game then?
fields.JP:
お二人とも、残念でしたね。
今度は違う遊びをしてみてはどうですか？
fields.LOCALIZED: How tragic. How about another game then?

fields.EN: Another one...? Nothing comes to mind.
fields.JP: 違う遊び……？　すぐには思いつかないわよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Another one...? Nothing comes to mind.

fields.EN:
Oh, right!
I heard there's a game where you bury your body in the sand!
fields.JP:
そーだ！
すなにからだをうめるあそびがあるって、
きいたことあるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, I know! Let's bury ourselves in sand!

fields.EN: Bury yourself in sand? How's that fun?
fields.JP: 砂に体を埋める？　それって楽しいの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Bury yourself in sand? How's that fun?

fields.EN:
I've never tried, so I wouldn't know!
But there's a first time for everything.
fields.JP:
やったことないから、わかんない。
だからやってみよう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've never tried, so I wouldn't know!
But there's a first time for everything.

fields.JP: はい、シラねんねしてー

fields.EN: I'm gonna bury you in sand.
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm gonna bury you in sand.

fields.EN: Huh? Why do I have to be buried?
fields.JP:
えっ？
な、なんでシラが砂をかけられる側なのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? Why do I have to be buried?

fields.EN:
...Oh, but the weight of the sand feels just right.
This might actually feel pretty nice...
fields.JP:
……あ、でも砂の重みがちょうどよくて、
けっこう気持ちいいかも……
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh...but sand is heavy. Warm too, I bet.

fields.EN:
And then, pile lots of sand right here,
and make two mounds...
fields.JP:
そんで、ここにたくさんすなをのせて、
おやまをふたつつくって……
fields.LOCALIZED: If we bury you just right, and add these...

fields.JP: ん？　なに作ってんの？

fields.EN: Hey, what the hell! Quit it!
fields.JP:
ちょっ、なによそれ！
やめなさいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, what the hell! Quit it!

fields.EN: Hrngh! I can't budge down here!
fields.JP: ぬぐぐ……！　砂の重みで動けないー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hrngh! I can't budge down here!

fields.EN:
Make the boobs even bigger... There!
Nemu-Nemu!
fields.JP:
おっぱいをもっとおっきくして……はい！
ねむねむ！
ふふ、上手にできましたね

やーめーなーさーいーよー！！
ちょっとおぉー！？

fields.EN: Aah... I couldn't eat another bite... Zzz...
fields.JP: むにゃ……もぉたべられないよぉ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Aah... I couldn't eat another bite... Zzz...

fields.EN:
Honestly, she played as hard as she could and then fell asleep.
What a child.
fields.JP:
まったく、はしゃぐだけはしゃいだら
寝ちゃうなんて子供ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gosh. Look at her. Asleep from all that
playing. Glad I'm not that childish.

fields.EN: Rapunzel-san must have had a lot of fun playing with Shira-san.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルさんはシラさんと遊べて
よっぽど楽しかったみたいですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel seems to really like your company,
Pyre.

fields.EN: Well...I had fun too, I guess.
fields.LOCALIZED: Well...I had fun too, I guess.

fields.EN:
(Hm? A figure in the distance...
 They're coming this way.)
fields.JP:
（ん？　遠くに人影が……。
　こっちに向かってくるわ）

fields.EN: Riley, Ellie. What are you guys doing here?!
fields.JP: ライリー、エリー、どうしてここに？
fields.LOCALIZED: Riley, Ellie. What are you guys doing here?!

fields.EN:
(I want to go talk to them.
 But can I really leave Rapunzel and Sukui here by themselves...?)
fields.JP:
（二人と話してきたい。
　でもラプンツェルとスクイを
　放っていっていいのかしら……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wanna catch up with them. As long as it's
cool with Rapunzel and Sukui...)

fields.EN:
Shira-san, go ahead.
I'll watch Rapunzel-san.
fields.JP:
シラさん、行ってきてください。
ラプンツェルさんはわたくしが
見ていますから
fields.LOCALIZED: Go ahead, Pyre. I'll keep an eye on Rapunzel.

fields.EN:
Rachel!
To run into you in a place like this!
fields.JP:
レイチェル！
こんなところで会えるなんて！
ヒッヒッヒッ。姉妹の麗しい再会ですねぇ

ライリー！　エリー！
それにおじさんも

fields.EN:
(After that, Riley and Ellie followed this wandering merchant
and ended up traveling around the world with him.)
fields.JP:
（ライリーとエリーはあのあと、
　この放浪商人のおじさんについていって
　世界を旅することになったのよね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Ah, that's right. They've been traveling with
that old kook.)

fields.EN:
(They wouldn't tell me why they decided to follow such a suspicious old man.
They said it was a secret of wandering merchants.)
fields.JP:
（なんでこんな胡散臭いおじさんについて
　いったかは、放浪商人との秘密だからって
　言われて教えてもらえなかったわ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They won't tell me how or why. They keep
it secret for some reason.)

fields.EN:
(I was a little lonely, but I really look forward to the times
they come back and spend time with me like this!)
fields.JP:
（少し寂しかったけど、こうしてたまに
　戻ってきて一緒に過ごしてくれるのが
　すごく楽しみなの！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I was a little lonely, but I'm excited to
catch up with them again!)

fields.EN: I take it you had a beach day too, Rachel?
fields.JP: レイチェルは海水浴に来てたんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED: I take it you had a beach day too, Rachel?

fields.EN:
Yeah, something like that. So did you guys
just get back too?
fields.JP:
まあ、そんなとこ。
ライリーたちは今戻ってきたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, something like that. So did you guys
just get back too?

fields.EN:
Yeah. This time we got hold of something rare,
so we brought it back as a souvenir.
fields.JP:
うん。
今回は珍しいものを手に入れたから
お土産に持って帰ってきたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. This time we unearthed some nice
rare souvenirs.

fields.EN:
Lookie here. This fruit is from down south.
They call it a "pineapple."
fields.JP:
これよ。
かなり南のほうで見つけた果物で、
パイナップルというらしいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lookie here. This fruit is from down south.
They call it a "pineapple."

fields.EN: Wow, it's spiky! You can eat this?
fields.JP:
わー、とげとげ！
こんなの本当に食べられるの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Wow, it's spiky! You can eat this?

fields.EN:
I'll slice you a piece. Stick the knife in here,
twist, and cut.
fields.JP:
今剥いてあげるわね。
ここにナイフを入れて、
こうして、こうして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll slice you a piece. Stick the knife in here,
twist, and cut.

fields.JP:
はい、できた。
あーんして
んー、甘い！　おいしい！

fields.EN:
I'm the one who found it.
Amazing, right!
fields.JP:
これを見つけたのはあたしなんだよ。
すごいでしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm the one that found it! Teehee!

fields.EN:
Yup. Sissy tried eating it with the rind
on because it smelled so sweet, and she
cut her mouth!
fields.JP:
おねえは甘い匂いがするからって
これをまるかじりしようとして、
口の中を切って痛い思いしたけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. Sissy tried eating it with the rind
on because it smelled so sweet, and she
cut her mouth!

fields.EN: Hey! Is this the mouth that's saying unnecessary things?!
fields.JP: こら！　余計なことを言うのはこの口か～！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey! You could've left that part out!

fields.EN: (Hehe. I'm glad they both seem to be doing well.)
fields.JP: （ふふ、二人とも元気そうでよかった）

fields.EN: Hey, you guys sticking around tonight?
fields.JP: ねえ、今日は泊まっていくの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, you guys sticking around tonight?

fields.JP: じゃあ、また冒険の話を聞かせて！

fields.EN:
Sure... I could talk all day about all of
Sissy's hilarious blunders.
fields.JP:
いいわよ。おねえの愉快な失敗談を
たくさん仕入れてきたから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure... I could talk all day about all of
Sissy's hilarious blunders.

fields.EN: Oh... How about you, old man?
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh... How about you, old man?

fields.EN:
Hihihi. The weather is nice today,
so I'll rest somewhere around here.
fields.JP:
ヒッヒッヒッ。今日はいい天気ですから、
どこかその辺で休みますよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hihihi. It's lovely out. I plan to take a long
snooze by the shore.

fields.EN:
I'm merely a recluse. Just a boring merchant who collects rare things,
so pay me no mind. Hihihi...
fields.JP:
わたしはただの世捨て人。珍しいものを
集めるだけのつまらない商人ですから、
お気遣いなく。ヒッヒッヒッ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm a vagabond. Just a humble merchant
peddling his wares. Don't mind me. Hihihi...

fields.EN:
(It's the same as when I invited him before.
The old man never comes to where we live; he always camps outside...)
fields.JP:
（前に誘ったときと同じだわ。
　おじさんはいつもシラたちの住処には来ないで、
　野宿をしている……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Just like last time, he came uninvited.
He must sleep outside...)

fields.EN:
Riley, Ellie.
Are you really okay with the old man doing that...?
fields.JP:
ライリー、エリー。
おじさんは本当にいいのかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED: Riley. Ellie. are you sure about him?

fields.EN: It might bother you, but that's just how he likes it.
fields.JP:
気になるかもしれないけど、
あの人はあれでいいんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. I know he's weird-looking. But that's
just his face.

fields.EN: Yeah. That's just the kind of person he is.
fields.JP: ええ。そういう人なのよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup. Don't pay him any mind.

fields.EN:
(He laughs like a creep... But if Riley and
Ellie trust him, I'll take their word for it.)
fields.JP:
（変な笑い方だし、なんか胡散臭いけど、
　ライリーとエリーが信頼しているんだから
　きっといい人なのよね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(He laughs like a creep... But if Riley and
Ellie trust him, I'll take their word for it.)

fields.JP: あ、ラプンツェルが起きたみたい……

fields.EN:
I'll catch you later then. We're gonna explore
a bit.
fields.JP:
じゃあ、またあとで。
あたしたちはその辺を回ってくるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll catch you later then. We're gonna explore
a bit.

fields.EN:
Go ahead and share the rest of the pineapple
with Rapunzel.
fields.JP:
パイナップルの残りは
ラプンツェルと一緒に食べるといいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Go ahead and share the rest of the pineapple
with Rapunzel.

fields.EN:
Um... You won't disappear again, will you?
Riley, Ellie...
fields.JP:
あの……もういなくなったりしないわよね？
ライリー、エリー……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... You're not leaving too soon, are
you two? Riley, Ellie...

fields.EN:
Don't worry.
There's no way we'd leave our cute little sister behind, right?
fields.JP:
大丈夫よ。
かわいい妹を置いていくわけがないでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. We'll never be too far from
our baby sister.

fields.EN: Our hearts will never grow apart again.
fields.JP:
あたしたちの心が離れることなんて、
もう二度とないよ
fields.LOCALIZED: You'll be in our hearts wherever we go.

fields.EN:
No matter how far away we go, we'll definitely come back.
I promise.
fields.JP:
たとえどんなに遠くに行ったって、
絶対にまた戻ってくる。約束するよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No matter the distance, we'll be here
when you need us. Promise.

fields.EN: Today's the perfect day to swim!
fields.JP: なんて絶好の海水浴日和なんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Today's the perfect day to swim!

fields.EN: I've really been looking forward to coming swimming at the sea with you, Otsuu-chan!
fields.JP:
わたし、おつうちゃんと海水浴に来るの
すっごく楽しみにしてたんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've been wanting a beach date with you
for a while, Otsuu!

fields.JP: 僕も楽しみにしていましたよ

fields.EN:
(Swimming at the sea means swimsuits!
Princess's swimsuit! Princess's swimsuit! How beautiful!
I'm excited... no, my heart is pounding!)
fields.JP:
（海水浴といえば水着！
　姫の水着！　姫の水着！　なんて麗しいんだ！
　興奮……じゃなくてドキドキする！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Swimming means bikinis! My princess in a
bikini! What joy! The beauty of life! I am...
Well, my heart's pounding!)

fields.EN:
(I have to burn this pure, adorable sight of her in a swimsuit
into my eyes, my brain, my soul—forever!!)
fields.JP:
（この清楚かつ愛らしい水着姿を
　僕の目に、脳に、魂に！
　永遠に焼き付けておかなければ！！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I want to burn the sight of her in these
goddess-like garbs into my brain. My soul!
Remember this for eternity!)

fields.EN: Otsuu-chan, your eyes are kind of gleaming...
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん、
なんか目つきがギラギラしてるよ……？

fields.EN:
(That line from her waist to her hips is wonderful...!
But if I said that out loud, she'd obviously be put off.)
fields.JP:
（ウエストからお尻へのラインなど、
　とても素敵です……！　なんて言ったら
　さすがに引かれるのは目に見えている）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The way it conforms to her hips... Ecstasy.
But such thoughts must stay secret, for fear
of frightening my lady.)

fields.EN:
Princess, you look so ravishing that I became
lost in thought.
fields.JP:
姫の水着姿があまりにもまぶしくて、
つい見惚れてしまいました
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess, you look so ravishing that I became
lost in thought.

fields.EN:
Oh, stop. You really know what to say.
Otsuu-chan, your swimsuit looks great on you too!
fields.JP:
やだもう、上手なんだから。
おつうちゃんも水着とっても似合ってるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, hush. You look fantastic too!

fields.EN:
I-It's not like I'm anything special...
But thank you...
fields.JP:
ぼ、僕は別にそんな……。
でも、ありがとう……

fields.EN: Otsuu-chan, let's go swimming right away!
fields.JP: おつうちゃん、さっそく泳ごう！

fields.EN:
(She's so fast! She's so fast at swimming!
And what gorgeous form...!)
fields.JP:
（姫、速い！　泳ぐのが速い！
　しかも泳ぐフォームがすごくきれいだ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's so fast! She's so fast at swimming!
And what gorgeous form...!)

fields.EN:
(I didn't realize I was this bad at swimming.
Isn't this what they call dog-paddling?
At this rate there's no way I can accompany Princess...)
fields.JP:
（それより僕ってこんなに泳げなかったのか？
　これって犬かきっていうんじゃないのか？
　このザマじゃお供なんてとても無理だ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I didn't know I couldn't swim... Is this
what they call the dog-paddle? I can't
embarrass Princess like this...)

fields.EN: Otsuu, are you tired? Should we take a break?
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん、疲れちゃった？
ちょっと休憩する？
fields.LOCALIZED: Otsuu, are you tired? Should we take a break?

fields.EN:
No, I'm fine.
But I was surprised at how good you are at swimming.
Have you been practicing?
fields.JP:
いや、大丈夫だよ。
でも姫の泳ぎが上手で驚いたな。
練習でもしてたのかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh no, it's fine. Just surprised at how
fast you can go. Have you been practicing?

fields.EN:
No, but I got so excited by the water that
I went off of instinct. It's like I've always
known..
fields.JP:
んー、なんか海に来たらワクワクして、
最初から泳ぎ方を知っていたみたいに
自然と泳げちゃったんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, but I got so excited by the water that
I went off of instinct. It's like I've always
known..

fields.EN:
(Oh... That could be her Blood Libido.
Or a natural-born gift.)
fields.JP:
（へぇ、そんな血式リビドーみたいなことが
　あるのか……。もしくは、姫が生まれつき
　持っていた能力みたいなものなのかもな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh... That could be her Blood Libido.
Or a natural-born gift.)

fields.EN:
Your way of swimming is cute, Otsuu-chan.
Like a puppy.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんの泳ぎ方はかわいいね。
わんちゃんみたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your technique is so cute, Otsuu.
You're like a puppy.

fields.EN:
Ugh...
I just don't like putting my face in the water.
fields.JP:
う……。
水に顔をつけるのが、なんか嫌なんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Rgh... I don't like water in my face.

fields.EN:
Right. We should've brought a floating
tube.
fields.JP:
そっかー。
浮き輪とか持ってくればよかったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. We should've brought a floating
tube.

fields.EN:
But if we're just lounging about, then
I can float on my back and let the waves
pass under me.
fields.JP:
でも水に浮くだけなら
できるようになってきたから、
しばらく波に揺られて楽しむとするよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if we're just lounging about, then
I can float on my back and let the waves
pass under me.

fields.EN: Then I'll go swim a little more.
fields.JP: じゃあわたしはもう少し泳いでくるね
fields.LOCALIZED: You mind if I do a few more laps?

fields.EN: Are you okay swimming alone, Princess?
fields.LOCALIZED: Are you okay swimming alone, Princess?

fields.EN:
Hehe. You're such a worrywart, Otsuu-chan.
I'll be fine, so wait around here.
fields.JP:
ふふ、おつうちゃんは心配性だね。
大丈夫だから、この辺りで待っていて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. You're such a worrywart, Otsuu.
I'll be fine. Just wait here.

fields.JP: ……やっぱり速いなぁ、姫の泳ぎ

fields.EN: (*sigh* But floating is plenty fun too...)
fields.JP:
（はー……こうして海に浮かんでるだけでも
　けっこう楽しいものだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (*sigh* But floating is plenty fun too...)

fields.EN:
(Come to think of it, it's been a while since Princess went off to swim.
Is she still not back yet?)
fields.JP:
（そういえば姫が泳ぎに行ってから
　しばらく経つけど、まだ戻ってこないのか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Come to think of it, I can't tell the last
time I saw Princess enjoy herself like this...)

fields.EN: (Oh no, I've lost sight of her.)
fields.JP: （あれ、どこだ？　姿が見当たらないぞ）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Oh no, I've lost sight of her.)

fields.JP: 姫ー！　どこですかー？

fields.EN:
Princess...! Princess, where are you?!
PRINCESS! PRINCESSSSSSSS!
fields.JP:
姫……！　姫、どこですか！？
姫！　姫ーーッ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess...! Princess, where are you?!
PRINCESS! PRINCESSSSSSSS!

fields.EN:
No way...
She couldn't have just disappeared like this...
fields.JP:
嘘だろ……？
まさか、このままいなくなったりなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED: Is this fate...? Am I never to see her again?

fields.EN: (The sea is... going to take Princess away...!)
fields.JP: （海が……姫を連れて行ってしまう……！）

fields.EN:
Princess! Oh, Princess...!
I thought you'd disappeared!
fields.JP:
姫！　ああ、姫……！
いなくなってしまったかと思った！
fields.LOCALIZED: Princess! Oh, Princess! I thought you drowned!

fields.EN:
Sorry for worrying you. That was mean of
me.
fields.JP:
不安にさせてごめんね。
少し悪戯が過ぎちゃったかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry for worrying you. That was mean of
me.

fields.JP:
本当ですよ……。
なんてひどい人だ……

fields.EN:
I fell into this illusion that Princess might simply disappear into the sea...
I was scared...
fields.JP:
このまま、姫が海に消えてしまいそうな
錯覚に陥って……不安だった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I feared for a moment that you were swept
away by the waves, beyond my grasp.

fields.EN: Don't worry. I'm not going anywhere.
fields.JP:
心配しないで。
わたしはどこにも行かないから
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't worry. I'm not going anywhere.

fields.EN:
Besides, I have this voice.
As long as I have it, even if we're far apart,
Otsuu-chan will be able to find me, right?
fields.JP:
それにわたしにはこの声があるよ。
声があれば、遠く離れていたって
おつうちゃんに見つけてもらえるでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Besides, I have my voice. As long as I call
out to you, you'll come, won't you?

fields.EN: So don't worry. We will be together forever.
fields.JP:
だから大丈夫。
わたしたちはずっと一緒だよ
fields.LOCALIZED: So don't worry. We will be together forever.

fields.JP: ふふ、わたしの王子様は泣き虫だね

fields.EN:
You misunderstand... That doesn't count.
Please forget this moment entirely.
I almost cried thinking I lost you!
fields.JP:
そ、そんなことは……！
今のは無しです。姫がいなくなって
泣きそうだった僕なんて忘れてください！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You misunderstand... That doesn't count.
Please forget this moment entirely.
I almost cried thinking I lost you!

fields.EN:
As a prince worthy of Princess,
I should always stand firm and composed!
fields.JP:
姫の王子としてふさわしく、
いつだって僕はドーンと構えていますよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: I will never let fear keep me from you again!

fields.EN: Princess, the footing is bad here, so be careful.
fields.JP: 姫、足元悪いから気をつけて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess, the road ahead is bumpy, so
watch out.

fields.JP: ありがとう、おつうちゃん

fields.EN:
This church is falling apart. How'd you
find this all the way in here...?
fields.JP:
古い教会だね……。
森の奥によくこんなところ見つけたね
fields.LOCALIZED:
This church is falling apart. How'd you
find this all the way in here...?

fields.EN:
I happened to find it while exploring with Mamoru and the others.
It's old, but it has quite an atmosphere, doesn't it?
fields.JP:
マモルたちと探索していたら
たまたま見つけたんだ。
古びてるけど、なかなか雰囲気があるだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was foraging with Mamoru. It's old but
quaint, wouldn't you say?

fields.EN:
Yeah. It feels sacred and wonderful.
I feel like our prayers might reach God from here.
fields.JP:
うん。神聖な感じがして素敵だね。
ここでなら、神様にも祈りが届きそうな気がする
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. Like a sanctuary. It's beautiful.
I can feel the spiritual energy.

fields.EN: Hime. It may not be a prayer, but would you listen to my words of vow?
fields.JP:
姫。祈りではありませんが、
僕の誓いの言葉を聞いていただけますか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Princess, permission to make a vow?

fields.EN: I, Tsuu, as your prince, vow to protect and love you.
fields.JP:
僕、つうは、姫の王子として、
あなたを守り、愛することを誓います
fields.LOCALIZED:
I, Otsuu, vow to be your prince for eternity.
To have and to hold you, and love you.

fields.EN: I, Ningyohime, as Otsuu-chan's princess, vow to support and love Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
……わたし、人魚姫は、おつうちゃんの姫として、
おつうちゃんを支え、愛することを誓います
fields.LOCALIZED:
I, Little Mermaid, vow to be Otsuu's princess.
To stand by Otsuu, and love her forever.

fields.EN: What you said means a lot to me too.
fields.JP: わたしもおつうちゃんの言葉、すごく嬉しかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED: What you said means a lot to me too.

fields.JP: やるじゃねーか、おつう！

fields.EN: How romantic. A private wedding. I'm moved!
fields.JP:
二人きりの結婚式なんてロマンチックだね。
私、感動しちゃったよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: How romantic. A private wedding. I'm moved!

fields.EN:
Well, we spoiled the moment, so I don't
know if I'd call this private anymore.
fields.JP:
ま、あたしらが乱入してる時点で
二人きりではなくなったけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we spoiled the moment, so I don't
know if I'd call this private anymore.

fields.EN:
I'm so happy for you two. Now you're
married for real!
fields.JP:
よかったなぁ～。
これで二人はホンマもんの夫婦になったんやね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm so happy for you two. Now you're
married for real!

fields.JP: なんでみんながここに……

fields.EN:
We happened to see you two head into
the forest, so we followed after.
fields.JP:
たまたまおまえらが森に入っていくのが見えて、
気になったからついてきてみたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We happened to see you two head into
the forest, so we followed after.

fields.EN:
I never thought I'd get to see a real
wedding in person.
fields.JP:
まさか結婚式を見られるとは
思わなかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I never thought I'd get to see a real
wedding in person.

fields.EN: Um, sorry. Things are still hard for everyone, and yet Otsuu-chan and I are the only ones doing something like this...
fields.JP:
あの、ごめんね。
今もまだ大変な時期なのに、
わたしとおつうちゃんばっかりこんな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, sorry. I know things have been so hectic
recently. Now we're celebrating ourselves...

fields.EN:
What? What are you talking about?
All of us just want to see you both happy.
fields.JP:
そんなこと気にしてたのか？
おまえらが幸せになるのを怒る奴なんて、
この中にはいねーよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What? What are you talking about?
All of us just want to see you both happy.

fields.EN: If anything, we're sorry for making you worry by holding such a secret wedding.
fields.JP:
こーんなこっそり結婚式やるなんて、
逆に気ぃ遣わせて悪かったでやんすね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. Buncha wedding crashers here.
Sorry for all the commotion.

fields.EN: Then even now, let's give the two of them a proper celebration... I know!
fields.JP:
それなら、今からでも私たちが
二人を祝福しようよ。
もっとちゃんとした感じで……そうだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even so, we want to celebrate your union.
Officially... Congrats!

fields.EN:
Itsuki, you be the officiant, and help them
exchange their vows.
fields.JP:
イツキが神父さん役になって、
二人が愛の誓いを立てるのはどうかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Itsuki, you be the officiant, and help them
exchange their vows.

fields.EN: Yeah, you do kind of look the part. Relatively speaking, among this group.
fields.JP:
あー、たしかにそれっぽいもんな。
このメンツでは比較的
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, you're stuffy enough to officiate.
Definitely more than anyone here.

fields.EN: Don't say "relatively"! ...Well, I don't mind pretending for a bit.
fields.JP:
比較的とか言うな！
……まあ、真似事くらいならやってもいいが
fields.LOCALIZED:
What do you mean more?
...I'll pretend I didn't hear that,
but if you insist, I'll do it.

fields.JP: でも誓いの言葉ならさっき言ったぞ？

fields.EN: You can say them as many times as you want. This time, we'll be your witnesses too.
fields.JP:
別に何回言ったっていいじゃねーか。
今度は俺らも立会人ってことでさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who cares? They should be said over and
over. With witnesses, this time.

fields.JP: 姫、ということなんだけど……

fields.EN:
I'm kind of embarrassed, but I suppose that's
fine.
fields.JP: ちょっと照れるけど、わたしはいいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm kind of embarrassed, but I suppose that's
fine.

fields.EN: Then, let's begin... Otsuu, do you swear to love Ningyohime for the rest of your life?
fields.JP:
では、さっそく……。
おつう、君は人魚姫を生涯愛することを
誓いますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then let's get started. Otsuu, do you take
Little Mermaid and promise to love her for
the rest of eternity?

fields.EN: Ningyohime, do you swear to love Otsuu for the rest of your life?
fields.JP:
人魚姫、君はおつうを生涯愛することを
誓いますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Little Mermaid, do you take Otsuu and
promise to love her for eternity as well?

fields.EN: (I never thought we'd end up having a wedding in front of Mamoru and the others...)
fields.JP:
（まさかマモルたちの前で結婚式を
　することになるとは……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I never guessed that Mamoru and Hikari
would orchestrate our ceremony...)

fields.EN: (If this is fate at work, I guess I have to be grateful.)
fields.JP:
（これが運命とかいうやつの仕業なら、
　感謝しないといけないな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If fate has conspired for us, then I accept
whatever emerges from our union!)

fields.EN: Then, the two of you may seal your vows with a kiss...
fields.JP: それでは、二人は誓いのキスを……

fields.EN: Yeah. Apparently that's what you do at weddings.
fields.JP: ああ。結婚式ではそうするものらしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Allegedly that's how the ceremony
concludes.

fields.EN: So we'll be the witness to your love!
fields.JP: 私たちが二人の愛の証人になってあげるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: So we'll be the witness to your love!

fields.EN: Otsuu-chan looks embarrassed, but Ningyo-chan already seems to be waiting for a kiss.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん照れてはるけど、
人魚ちゃんはもうキス待ち状態みたいでっせ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu's blushing, but Little Mermaid's all
ready to go.

fields.EN: (This is embarrassing... But Hime must be happy that everyone is celebrating with us.)
fields.JP:
（て、照れる……。
　でも姫はみんなに祝福してもらえるのが
　嬉しいんだろうな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't look... But with everyone here, I can't
make Princess wait.)

fields.EN:
Congratulations! I wish you two lifelong
happiness!
fields.JP: おめでとう！　お幸せに～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Congratulations! I wish you two lifelong
happiness!

fields.JP: めでたしめでたし、というやつだな

fields.EN: Somehow, I'm getting choked up too...
fields.JP: なんかこう、俺もじーんときたぜ……

fields.EN: Sob... Otsuu-chan and Ningyo-chan, you're both going off as brides now...
fields.JP:
うっ、うっ、おつうちゃんと人魚ちゃん、
二人とも、お、お嫁に行っちゃうんだね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oogh... Otsuu and Little Mermaid, the prettiest
brides there ever were.

fields.EN: Why are you crying like a parent?! And neither of them is "going off" anywhere!
fields.JP:
って、なんであんたが親みたいなノリで
泣いてるの！　しかもお嫁じゃないし！
fields.LOCALIZED: Why am I sobbing like a proud parent?

fields.EN:
Private weddings are nice, but having
everyone here to celebrate with us is
a real treat.
fields.JP:
二人きりの結婚式もよかったけど、
こうしてみんなに祝福してもらえるのって
すごく幸せだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Private weddings are nice, but having
everyone here to celebrate with us is
a real treat.

fields.EN: I'll say. We truly are blessed.
fields.JP: そうだね。……僕たちは幸せ者だ
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll say. We truly are blessed.

fields.EN: Princess. I'll never let you go.
fields.JP: 姫。僕はもう絶対にこの手を離さないよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Princess. I'll never let you go.

fields.EN: Me too. I'll always be with Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP: わたしも。おつうちゃんとずっと一緒だよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Me neither, Otsuu. You've got me forever.

fields.EN:
(Maybe I rushed proposing to Alice.
She didn't reject me, but it wasn't
exactly much to brag about.)
fields.JP:
（アリスとの結婚の話、早まったかなぁ……。
　断られたわけじゃないとはいえ、
　あんまりいい展開じゃないよね……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe I rushed proposing to Alice.
She didn't reject me, but it wasn't
exactly much to brag about.)

fields.JP:
ジャックくん！
失礼するわよ！

あ、シャーロットさん……。
どうもー……

fields.EN:
Oh. You look down in the dumps. It breaks
my heart! The whole affair with Alice must
have torn you apart.
fields.JP:
ああ、そんなヘロヘロな感じになって
痛ましい……！　アリスのことが
よっぽどショックだったのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. You look down in the dumps. It breaks
my heart! The whole affair with Alice must
have torn you apart.

fields.EN: I could more or less tell from Tsuu-kun and Ningyo-chan. So, is it true that Alice rejected Jack-kun's proposal?
fields.JP:
つうくんと人魚ちゃんの様子から、なんとなくね。
それで、アリスがジャックくんのプロポーズを
断ったっていうのは本当なの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Judging from what Otsuu and Little Mermaid
said, I had a feeling. Is it true Alice rejected 
you?

fields.EN:
(Charlotte never fails to amaze. She's
not clairvoyant anymore, but she never
lets a secret get passed her.
fields.JP:
（うーん、さすがシャーロットさんだ……。
　力がなくなっても、なんだかこの人には
　秘密を作れそうにないなぁ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Charlotte never fails to amaze. She's
not clairvoyant anymore, but she never
lets a secret get passed her.

fields.EN: Well, it's not like she rejected me. She just said it might still be too early to get married...
fields.JP:
いや、まあ、断られたわけじゃないですよ？
でも結婚はまだ早いんじゃないかと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I wouldn't call it a rejection, but she
said we could talk about it another time.

fields.EN: Ugh. What is she thinking? She's too stubborn.
fields.JP:
もう、なにをしてるのかしらあの子ったら。
本当に堅物なんだから
fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh. What is she thinking? She's too stubborn.

fields.EN:
She complains that it's too early, not knowing
that prime real estate like yourself is bound to
be taken off the market!
fields.JP:
まだ早いなんて悠長なこと言ってたら、
ジャックくんみたいな優良物件はすぐに
他の女の子にとられちゃうのに！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She complains that it's too early, not knowing
that prime real estate like yourself is bound to
be taken off the market!

fields.EN: Jack-kun, leave it to me. As her older sister, I'll make sure Alice takes responsibility!
fields.JP:
ジャックくん、私に任せてね。
姉としてアリスにしっかり責任取らせるわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, leave it to me. As her older sister,
I'll set Alice straight in no time.

fields.EN:
(Set her straight... That sounds like trouble.
I'm not sure about this.)
fields.JP:
（責任って……。
　微妙に不穏だけど、大丈夫なのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Set her straight... That sounds like trouble.
I'm not sure about this.)

fields.EN: I wonder if any fish got caught in the trap we set yesterday.
fields.JP:
さて、昨日仕掛けておいた罠に
魚はかかっているかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you think we managed to ensnare any
fish with the trap we set?

fields.EN: ...Too bad. Nothing. We caught fish under the same conditions three days ago, so we'll need to find the cause and improve the trap.
fields.JP:
……残念。入っていないわ。
三日前は同じ条件下で魚が獲れていたはずだから、
原因を探って仕掛けを改良する必要がありそうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, pity. Nothing. Three days ago, fortune
smiled. But now we must analyze what we
can to avoid another failure.

fields.EN: Now, let's check the other trap.
fields.JP: さて、次はあっちの仕掛けも見てみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED: Now, let's check the other trap.

fields.EN:
Fish is fine and all, but I prefer sweets.
Perhaps we can make a dessert from
these oceanic critters.
fields.JP:
魚は美味しいけれど、
やはり私は甘いお菓子のほうが好きだわ。
魚を使ったお菓子はないのかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fish is fine and all, but I prefer sweets.
Perhaps we can make a dessert from
these oceanic critters.

fields.EN: I heard you rejected Jack's proposal.
fields.JP: ジャックからのプロポーズを断ったそうね
fields.LOCALIZED: I heard you rejected Jack's proposal.

fields.JP: えっ！　どうして知っているの！？

fields.EN: Oh, so you did hear me. You were sitting there silently with such a gloomy look that I thought you hadn't.
fields.JP:
あら、ちゃんと聞こえていたのね。
暗い顔で黙りこくっているから、
聞こえていないのかと思ったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. So you can hear. You were brooding
over there, so I set another trap of my own.

fields.EN:
Want to know who told me? Charlotte.
I have no clue how she found out.
fields.JP:
プロポーズの情報をどうして知っているのか、
だったわね。シャーロットから聞いたのよ。
彼女がどこで知ったかはわからないけれど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Want to know who told me? Charlotte.
I have no clue how she found out.

fields.EN: It's a small community. Everyone knows. You were spacing out even during our discussion, enough that even I noticed.
fields.JP:
狭い社会ですもの、みんな知っているわ。
あなたが話し合いでもぼんやりしていたから、
私でも気になったくらいだし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ours is a small community. Word travels
quickly. You stood in a daze, so I had to ask.

fields.EN:
*sigh*... Wish everyone could mind their
business.
fields.JP:
はぁ……。
人の口には戸が立てられないってことね
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh*... Wish everyone could mind their
business.

fields.EN:
It's none of my business, but if you're
going to skirt your duty procuring food
with me, then you can just leave.
fields.JP:
プロポーズはどうでもいいけれど、
調査兼食料調達の仕事に身が入らないようなら、
あなたがいる意味がないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's none of my business, but if you're
going to skirt your duty procuring food
with me, then you can just leave.

fields.EN:
Besides, why are YOU so depressed?
You rejected him, no?
fields.JP:
そもそも、プロポーズを断った側のあなたが
なぜ落ち込んでいるのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Besides, why are YOU so depressed?
You rejected him, no?

fields.JP: ……好きで断ったわけじゃないわ

fields.EN: Then why did you turn him down?

Look at what we're doing. Can you
blame me?
fields.JP:
だって今はこんな時期だもの。
仕方ないでしょ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look at what we're doing. Can you
blame me?

fields.EN: I mean, everyone's still going through a hard time. Somehow... it just feels wrong, doesn't it?
fields.JP:
まだみんなが大変な時期ってこと。
なんか……悪いでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I mean, we're struggling to survive up
here. I...feel guilty.

fields.EN: Is getting married somehow bad for anyone?
fields.JP: 結婚するのは誰かにとって悪いものなの？

fields.EN: That's not what I mean. When everyone else is working so hard, for just the two of us to get carried away and be happy... that feels wrong.
fields.JP:
そうじゃなくて、みんなががんばっているときに
わたしたちだけ浮かれて……幸せになるのは
やっぱり悪いじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, but if everyone's working hard to make
this place livable, it would be selfish for us
to occupy ourselves with a wedding.

fields.EN: Has anyone said as much to you?
fields.JP: 誰かが悪いとでも言ってきたのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED: Has anyone said as much to you?

fields.JP: そんなことはないけど……！

fields.EN: Alice. Hasn't your logic been falling apart for a while now?
fields.JP:
アリス。さっきからあなたの話は
論理が破綻していない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice, you're stuck in that thick head of
yours. Are you really that dense?

fields.EN: Rgh... What do YOU suggest, Gretel?
fields.JP:
く……！
そ、それならグレーテルはどう思うの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Rgh... What do YOU suggest, Gretel?

fields.EN:
I could not care less, so I have no opinion.
However...
fields.JP:
その件に関しては興味がないから、
私自身の意見も特にないわ。
……ただし
fields.LOCALIZED:
I could not care less, so I have no opinion.
However...

fields.EN:
I am curious to see how marriage morphs
your current arrangement. Or if there is any
change at all.
fields.JP:
結婚した二人がどうなっていくのか、
なんらかの変化が起きるのだとすれば、
それはそれで興味深いわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I am curious to see how marriage morphs
your current arrangement. Or if there is any
change at all.

fields.EN: Charlotte? What's with that fierce look?
fields.JP:
シャーロット？
すごい剣幕でどうしたの？

fields.EN: Don't play coy. Gretel, I'm taking her.
fields.JP:
どうしたもこうしたもないわ。
グレーテルちゃん、アリスを借りていくわね
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't play coy. Gretel, I'm taking her.

fields.EN:
We were in the middle of catching fish.
What could be more important?
fields.JP:
今は食材の魚を獲っているところなんだけれど。
それよりも重要な用―
fields.LOCALIZED:
We were in the middle of catching fish.
What could be more important?

fields.JP: 行くわよ、アリス！　さあ早く！
人の話を聞いてないわね……

fields.EN: As Alice's older sister, I'm burning with a sense of mission!
fields.JP:
アリスの姉として、
私は今使命感に燃えているのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm on fire. I feel responsible for you...

fields.EN: Now then, I wonder how the other traps did. I hope some fish got caught...
fields.JP:
さてと、他の仕掛けはどうなったかしら。
魚がかかっているといいわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, back to the fish traps. I'll catch every
one of you slippery devils, just watch...

fields.JP: シャーロットさん？　来ましたけど……

fields.EN: (A church... Charlotte-san called me here, but why this place?)
fields.JP:
（教会か……。
　シャーロットさんに呼び出されて来たけど、
　どうしてこんなところに？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is this a church? Why'd Charlotte invite
me here?)

fields.JP:
隙ありっ！
捕まえたぞ！

fields.EN: Jack-san, excuse me for a moment!
fields.JP: ジャックさん、ちょっと失礼しまーす！

fields.EN:
Whoa! What are you doing? Why are you
blindfolding me!
fields.JP: わわっ！　なにこれ、目隠し！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa! What are you doing? Why are you
blindfolding me!

fields.EN:
Hehe. If you don't want to be embarrassed,
stay put.
fields.JP:
ふふふ、恥ずかしい目に遭いたくなければ
大人しくしているんだな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. If you don't want to be embarrassed,
stay put.

fields.EN: Otsuu-chan, you look like you're enjoying this...
fields.JP: おつうちゃん、なんだか楽しそう……
fields.LOCALIZED: Otsuu, I think you're enjoying this too much.

fields.EN: Ah, Hime, please look the other way! I can't let Hime see a man changing clothes!
fields.JP:
あ、姫はあっちを向いていてください！
男の着替えなんかを姫に見せるわけには
いきませんからね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh Princess, look the other way! I don't
want to sully your eyes with the sight of
a naked man!

fields.EN:
Huh? You're changing me into something?
Wait a minute. Something about this feels
familiar.
fields.JP:
えっ、僕着替えさせられるの？
っていうかこれ、どこかで考えた
シチュエーションのような……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? You're changing me into something?
Wait a minute. Something about this feels
familiar.

fields.EN: Okay, okay. Do not worry about the little details.
fields.JP: はいはい、細かいことは気にしないの
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay, okay. Stop talking and stand still.

fields.EN: Okay. That should do it. Not too shabby!
fields.JP:
よし、こんなもんだな。
なかなか決まってるじゃないか！
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay. That should do it. Not too shabby!

fields.JP: ど、どうしてこんな恰好を……

fields.EN: I asked the two of them to help me. I was a little forceful about it, though.
fields.JP:
私が二人に協力を頼んだのよ。
ちょっと強引だったけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm the one who commissioned these two.
Pardon their enthusiasm.

fields.EN:
Now that we've set the mood, we'll leave
you to it.
fields.JP:
さて、お膳立ては済んだわ。
私たちは退場することにしましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that we've set the mood, we'll leave
you to it.

fields.JP: ジャック、健闘を祈ってる

fields.EN: Otsuu-san made it for me, and Ningyohime-san helped me put it on. ...It might not suit me, though.
fields.JP:
おつうさんが作ってくれて、
人魚姫さんと一緒に着せてくれたの。
……わたしには似合わないかもしれないけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu designed it for me. Then Little Mermaid
helped fit me into it. I don't look as good as
you do...

fields.EN: Not at all. You're beautiful! It really suits you!
fields.JP:
そんなことない。すごくきれいだよ！
よく似合ってる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're kidding. You're gorgeous.
That dress is fantastic!

fields.EN: Thank you...you look quite handsome yourself.
fields.JP:
あ、ありがとう……。
あなたもその姿、とても素敵よ
fields.LOCALIZED: Thank you...you look quite handsome yourself.

fields.EN:
All Charlotte's doing. Sorry for the trouble.
I'm sure this is a big surprise.
fields.JP:
これはすべてシャーロットの計画なの。
迷惑をかけて、ごめんなさい。
驚いたでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
All Charlotte's doing. Sorry for the trouble.
I'm sure this is a big surprise.

fields.EN:
Haha. No trouble at all, but I didn't expect
this at all.
fields.JP:
あはは、迷惑だなんて……。
驚きはしたけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haha. No trouble at all, but I didn't expect
this at all.

fields.EN:
The other day, Charlotte gave me a big
talking-to. I mean, big.
fields.JP:
この間、シャーロットから
ものすごく説教されたの。
それはもう、ものすごーく
fields.LOCALIZED:
The other day, Charlotte gave me a big
talking-to. I mean, big.

fields.EN:
"Listen up, Alice! You can't wait forever
to find the perfect time because there'll
always be something in the way!"
fields.JP:
いい、アリス？　あなたの言う
「大変な時期」なんて永遠に終わらないの。
人生に大変じゃない時期なんてないのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Listen up, Alice! You can't wait forever
to find the perfect time because there'll
always be something in the way!"

fields.EN: "Marriage is all about timing and momentum! Got it?" ...she said.
fields.JP:
結婚はタイミングと勢い！　わかった？
って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Marriage is about teamwork and love!
Got that clear?!"

fields.EN: (She's really good at imitating Charlotte-san. I guess that's what you'd expect from sisters... No, more importantly, Charlotte-san really said that to Alice...)
fields.JP:
（シャーロットさんの真似うまいなぁ。
　さすが姉妹……じゃなくて、シャーロットさん
　アリスにそんなこと言ったんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's really good at impersonating Charlotte.
Guess it's a sister thing. Didn't think Charlotte
had it in her.)

fields.EN: (So Alice came here even though she wasn't really willing...?)
fields.JP:
（じゃあ、アリスは気が進まないのに
　この場に……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Does that mean...Alice came here out
of guilt?)

fields.EN: It's true that I felt bad toward everyone. But looking back, that was just an excuse. The truth is, I was simply scared...
fields.JP:
みんなに悪いと思う気持ちも嘘じゃないわ。
でも今思えばそれは口実で、
本当はわたしが臆病だっただけなの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I felt guilty for thinking of only happiness.
To tell you the truth, I felt like a coward...

fields.EN:
Everyone counts on you, Jack. You're my
best and oldest friend, and now you're my
boyfriend.
fields.JP:
ジャックはみんなに頼りにされていて、
わたしにとっては大切な幼馴染で、
今では恋人になったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone counts on you, Jack. You're my
best and oldest friend, and now you're my
boyfriend.

fields.EN: So many things happened one after another, and my relationship with you kept changing...
fields.JP:
めまぐるしくいろいろなことがあって、
あなたとの関係も変わっていって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our relationship has been stretched to
every possible place.

fields.EN:
But deep down, I was afraid I couldn't
cope with that change.
fields.JP:
その変化にいつかわたしが追いつけなく
なってしまうんじゃないかという不安が、
いつも心の奥底にあったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
But deep down, I was afraid I couldn't
cope with that change.

fields.EN: See...! I'm a stickler who can't think as flexibly as you can, Jack. So... how do I put it...
fields.JP:
ほら……！　わたしってジャックみたいに
柔軟な考え方ができない堅物じゃない。
だから……なんていうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
See! I'm not as big of a thinker as you,
Jack. So, I...

fields.EN: The thought that this comfortable relationship I have with you now might end... made me afraid to get married.
fields.JP:
今の心地いいジャックとの関係が
終わるかもしれないと思うと、
結婚するのが怖かったのよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I felt uncertain with all of the change coming
our way, which is why I got so nervous about
marriage.

fields.EN:
(I didn't know Alice was so worried.
I never noticed.)
fields.JP:
（アリスはそんな不安を抱えていたのか……。
　全然気づいてあげられなかったな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I didn't know Alice was so worried.
I never noticed.)

fields.EN: It's okay. Our relationship won't end, and it won't get worse.
fields.JP:
大丈夫だよ。
僕たちの関係は終わったりしないし、
悪くなったりもしない
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's fine. Our relationship is just fine,
better than ever.

fields.EN: If our relationship changes, it'll only become even better than it is now.
fields.JP:
僕たちの関係が変化するとすれば、
今よりももっといい関係になるだけだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can't stop things from changing, but
it's something we get to navigate together.

fields.EN: There's no way getting married will make us unhappy. I won't let that happen!
fields.JP:
結婚して幸せじゃなくなるなんて、
そんなことは絶対にない。
僕がさせない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sharing our lives together means tackling
everything as a team. I won't let anything
come between us!

fields.EN:
I'm a fool. I should have discussed this
with you from the start.
fields.JP:
……わたし、馬鹿ね。
最初からあなたに相談していれば
よかったのかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm a fool. I should have discussed this
with you from the start.

fields.EN:
Please Jack...even if the world changes
on us again, promise me you'll never
let me go.
fields.JP:
ジャックお願い……。
もしも世界が変わったとしても、
わたしを離さないでいてくれる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please Jack...even if the world changes
on us again, promise me you'll never
let me go.

fields.EN: I promise. I'll never let go of this hand.
fields.JP: 約束する。この手をずっと離さないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I promise. Our love is sealed. Nothing
will ever tear us apart.

fields.JP: これで一安心ってとこかしらね
わたしもほっとしたなぁ

fields.EN: Charlotte-san, was it really okay to use such a forceful method?
fields.JP:
それにしてもシャーロットさん、
こんな強引な方法でよかったのかい？

fields.EN:
Alice is far too shy and serious. Sometimes
all she needs is a little push. And voila.
fields.JP:
奥手で真面目なアリスが結婚するには、
これくらい後押ししてあげるくらいで
ちょうどいいのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice is far too shy and serious. Sometimes
all she needs is a little push. And voila.

fields.EN: Alice needs Jack-kun in order to be happy. I suppose this is what you call a happy ending...
fields.JP:
アリスが幸せになるにはジャックくんが必要なの。
ハッピーエンドってこういうことを言うのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack really makes her happy. They deserve
joy as much as anyone.

fields.EN:
Not to mention, Alice in her wedding gown.
I might tear up.
fields.JP:
でも改めて思い出しても、
アリスのウェディングドレス姿、
本当に綺麗だったわ……あ、ちょっと涙が
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not to mention, Alice in her wedding gown.
I might tear up.

fields.EN: Good grief. Alice really does have one troublesome older sister...
fields.JP:
やれやれ、アリスもお騒がせな姉を
持ったものだな……
fields.LOCALIZED: *sigh* Guess emotions run in the family...

fields.EN: But I'm glad Jack-san and Alice-san found happiness!
fields.JP:
でもジャックさんとアリスさんが
幸せになってよかったね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But seeing Jack and Alice tie the knot
makes it all worth it!

fields.EN: In sickness and in health, in wealth and in poverty, I swear to keep loving you.
fields.JP:
健やかなるときも病めるときも、
富めるときも貧しいときも、
君を愛し続けることを誓います
fields.LOCALIZED:
Through sickness and in health, till death
do us part. I promise to love you forever.

fields.JP: わたしも、永遠に誓います……

fields.EN: From now on, we'll always be together, Jack.
fields.JP: これからはずっと一緒よ、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED: You're the love of my life, Jack.

fields.JP: うん。愛してるよ、アリス

fields.EN:
Now this is the life! Perfect day for a beach
day with Boss.
fields.JP:
いやーいい天気っすね！
今日はまさに師匠と海水浴日和っすね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now this is the life! Perfect day for a beach
day with Boss.

fields.EN:
Perfect day, my ass. We're performin' a
land survey of the coastal topography.
fields.JP:
なにが「まさに」だ。
今日はこの海岸の岩場の地質調査に
来たんだろーが
fields.LOCALIZED:
Perfect day, my ass. We're performin' a
land survey of the coastal topography.

fields.JP: でもせっかくの海水浴日和なのに……

fields.EN: Want me to flick ya again?
fields.JP: もう一発デコピン食らいたいか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Want me to flick ya again?

fields.EN:
(*sigh* Boss needs to lighten up.
He never takes a break.)
fields.JP:
（はー。師匠は仕事熱心すぎるっすよ。
　ちょっとくらい羽目を外したくなったり
　しないんっすかね？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(*sigh* Boss needs to lighten up.
He never takes a break.)

fields.EN: I went to the trouble of changing into a pretty stylish swimsuit, but with Boss in that lame swimsuit I can't even get excited!
fields.JP:
折角自分はそれなりにおしゃれな水着に
着替えてきたのに師匠はださださ水着じゃ
テンションも上がらないっすよー
fields.LOCALIZED:
I even wore a swimsuit today. Boss doesn't
care much for appearances.

fields.EN:
We're doin' work, so quit yapping.
Stay focused. Don't hurt yourself.
fields.JP:
調査用の水着なんだから文句言うな。
俺たちは遊びに来たんじゃねぇんだ。
怪我しないよう気を引き締めろよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're doin' work, so quit yapping.
Stay focused. Don't hurt yourself.

fields.EN: Survey's all done! You okay there, Boss?
fields.JP:
地質調査終了っす！
ってか師匠、やけにお疲れっすね
fields.LOCALIZED: Survey's all done! You okay there, Boss?

fields.EN:
I'm gettin' too old for this crap.
You think I wanna be winded?
fields.JP:
この歳になるとマジで重労働がキッツイぜ……。
年寄りの体力低下っぷりを舐めんなよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm gettin' too old for this crap.
You think I wanna be winded?

fields.EN: Boss, you're not old yet! You're only at the middle-aged-man level at most, so you're fine!
fields.JP:
師匠はまだ年寄りってほどじゃないっすよ！
せいぜいおじさんってレベルっすから、
大丈夫っす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Boss, you're not that old! You're just
crotchety!

fields.EN: Make up your mind whether you're trying to cheer me up or kick me while I'm down.
fields.JP: フォローなのか追い打ちなのかはっきりしろ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hopin' for your sake that's a complinment.

fields.EN: Hey, you seem parched. Have some water.
fields.JP:
そうだ、自分水持ってきてるっすよ。
どうぞっす
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, you seem parched. Have some water.

fields.EN: *glug* AH! That's the stuff. Good as new!
fields.JP:
……、……、……ぷはーっ！
あーうまかった。生き返るぜ！
fields.LOCALIZED: *glug* AH! That's the stuff. Good as new!

fields.EN:
(Knowing Boss, he'll wanna go home now.
But I won't let him.)
fields.JP:
（師匠のことっすから、
　ここらでもう帰るとか言い出す頃合いっす。
　でもそうはさせないっすよ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Knowing Boss, he'll wanna go home now.
But I won't let him.)

fields.EN:
Hoo. Now that's done, we can... 
Hey, what are you doing?
fields.JP:
んじゃ、やることやったしとっとと……
って、なにやってんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
