Hoo. Now that's done, we can... 
Hey, what are you doing?

fields.EN: Ta-da! I brought some beach toys!
fields.JP:
じゃじゃーん！
海遊びセットを用意したっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Ta-da! I brought some beach toys!

fields.JP: どうって、おまえそんなもんいつの間に……

fields.EN: I hid them behind that rock in case something like this happened!
fields.JP:
こんなこともあろうかと、
そこの岩陰に隠していたっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Call it a hunch. I brought some toys
in case we ended early!

fields.EN: A homemade beach parasol and beach chair, plus a beach ball and a swim ring! I've got everything covered!
fields.JP:
自作のビーチパラソルにビーチチェア、
更にビーチボールに浮き輪っす！
まさに至れり尽くせりっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
A parasol, beach chair, and even a ball
and a floating tube! The whole shebang!

fields.EN:
We worked all day. Let's reward ourselves
with some fun!
fields.JP:
仕事はもう終わりっす。
今からは一緒にリフレッシュするっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We worked all day. Let's reward ourselves
with some fun!

fields.EN:
Eh, I'll pass. Sounds like work. I'd rather
head home and sit my ass in bed. But
go nuts, kid.
fields.JP:
嫌だ。疲れた。めんどい。
もう帰って昼寝したい。
遊びたいならおまえ一人で遊んでろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Eh, I'll pass. Sounds like work. I'd rather
head home and sit my ass in bed. But
go nuts, kid.

fields.EN:
Ugh. You're such a meanie, Boss!
Leaving me by myself! I wanna play, Boss!
fields.JP:
師匠のいけずー！　一人じゃ寂しいっす！
師匠も一緒がいいっすー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh. You're such a meanie, Boss!
Leaving me by myself! I wanna play, Boss!

fields.EN: I devote myself to you as your apprentice, and you're always working me like a cart horse! I'd like you to show your apprentice a little appreciation once in a while!
fields.JP:
自分は師匠の弟子として尽くしに尽くして、
いつも馬車馬のようにこき使われてるっす！
そんな弟子をたまには労わってほしいっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You work me to the bone, then you give
me grief. You should thank me more instead
of cracking the whip every five minutes!

fields.EN: What do you mean, a cart horse? I don't remember working you that hard. Don't say things that make me sound bad.
fields.JP:
なーにが馬車馬だ、
俺はそこまでこき使った覚えはねぇぞ。
人聞きの悪いことを言うな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Crack the whip, my ass. You make me
sound like some evil godmother. How
about a lil' respect?

fields.EN: *sigh*... I can't take it if you keep whining like this. Fine, I'll hang out with you for a little while.
fields.JP:
はぁ……この調子で喚かれたら
たまったもんじゃねぇな。
仕方ないから少し付き合ってやるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh*... If you really wanna, then I'll stick 
around and watch you splash or whatever.

fields.EN: Really? Yay! What should we do first?
fields.JP:
ホントっすか？　やったーっす！
なにして遊ぶっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Really? Yay! What should we do first?

fields.EN:
Nap. You go on ahead. Gonna find me
a nice shady patch.
fields.JP:
昼寝だ。俺はその辺で寝てるから、
おまえは好きに泳いでこい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nap. You go on ahead. Gonna find me
a nice shady patch.

fields.EN:
Wait, what? You're gonna nap anyway?
Lame.
fields.JP: えー、結局昼寝っすか？　つまんないっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait, what? You're gonna nap anyway?
Lame.

fields.EN: One more complaint, and I'm goin' home.
fields.JP: 文句言うなら帰って昼寝するまでだ
fields.LOCALIZED: One more complaint, and I'm goin' home.

fields.EN: You're really determined to nap no matter what... This is why middle-aged guys are such a pain.
fields.JP:
どうあっても昼寝するつもりっすね……。
これだからおじさんは困るっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you're gonna waste the day by dozing off.
Ugh. You are old.

fields.EN: Huh? Why are you still here? Go swim.
fields.JP:
ん？　なんでおまえまで隣に座ってんだ？
泳いできていいんだぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? Why are you still here? Go swim.

fields.EN: I'll do it when I feel like it.
fields.JP: 泳ぎたくなったら泳ぐっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll do it when I feel like it.

fields.JP: ふーん……？　ま、好きにしろ
なんかいいっすねー、こういうの

fields.EN: I never thought a laid-back day like this would ever come back then.
fields.JP:
こんなのんびりした日が来るなんて、
昔は思わなかったっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I never thought you and I would ever
be in a place like this together.

fields.EN: Hey Clara. You did really good.
fields.JP:
なあ、くらら。
よくがんばったな
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey Clara. You did really good.

fields.EN: Huh? Wh-What is this, all of a sudden?
fields.JP: へ？　な、なんっすか、唐突に

fields.EN:
Ya know, yer a big part of how we got here.
There'd be no peace without you. So, you
did good.
fields.JP:
今の平和な暮らしがあるのは、
おまえのおかげでもあるからな。
よくやったよ、おまえは
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ya know, yer a big part of how we got here.
There'd be no peace without you. So, you
did good.

fields.EN: Guess picking you up back then was the right choice after all.
fields.JP:
俺があのときおまえを拾ったのは
正解だったってことか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guess pluckin' you outta the slums wasn't
a bad idea after all.

fields.EN: Looking at it that way, maybe you could say this peace is partly my achievement too, huh?
fields.JP:
まあそう考えると、
この平和は俺の手柄とも言えるって
わけかもな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
In that case, maybe I should be sayin' I
saved the world, huh?

fields.JP: あはは、その理屈はずるいっすよ～！

fields.EN: Adults are unfair. That's just how we are.
fields.JP: 大人はずるいもんなんだよ

fields.EN:
Hey Boss, I wanna hear you say it again.
How good I did.
fields.JP:
……ねえ、師匠。
さっきのもう一回言ってほしいっす。
よくがんばったって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey Boss, I wanna hear you say it again.
How good I did.

fields.EN: Once is enough. You won't hear it again.
fields.JP:
んなこと一度で十分だろ。
二度も言わねぇよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Once is enough. You won't hear it again.

fields.EN: Boss, you were sort of going along with the Professor's goal... or ambition, I guess?
fields.JP:
師匠は博士の目的……いや、野望？
のために付き合っていた感じ
だったんっすよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You worked with the Professor, right...?
Helped him hatch his plan?

fields.JP: なんだ突然……。まあ、そうだけどな……

fields.EN: I knew what he was trying to do, but all I could do was watch. One way or another, we kept this sort of neither-close-nor-distant relationship...
fields.JP:
俺はあいつの目的を知りながらも
ただ見ているしかできず、なんだかんだで
付かず離れずみたいな関係だったな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I knew what he was plannin', but I could
only watch. Couldn't do much to stop him.

fields.EN: Then why'd you take me in?
fields.JP: だったら、なんで自分を拾ったんっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Then why'd you take me in?

fields.EN:
You said it was because I was crafty,
but if you were helping the Professor,
you know you didn't need an apprentice.
fields.JP:
始めは手が器用だって理由だったっすけど、
博士の目的を知ってたなら、別に弟子をとって
未来のためになにかやる必要なんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You said it was because I was crafty,
but if you were helping the Professor,
you know you didn't need an apprentice.

fields.EN: Your intuition's gotten strangely sharp... Well, I guess you were working with some pretty perceptive people.
fields.JP:
妙に勘が鋭くなったじゃねぇか。
……まあ、おまえは勘のいいやつらと
行動してたしな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look at Miss Detective, here. Well...
You're good with people.

fields.EN: You're going silent again? That's not fair!
fields.JP: まただんまりっすか？　ずるいっすよ！

fields.EN: Yeah... Back then I knew about the plan for the Dawn itself to disappear once it had served its purpose, and there were lots of orphans like you.
fields.JP:
そうだな……あのとき黎明そのものが
利用し終わったらなくなるって計画も知ってたし、
おまえみたいな孤児も大勢いた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm. Back then, I knew he'd eventually tank
what was left of the Dawn. Plus we had all
those orphans...

fields.EN: I took you under my wing 'cuz...
fields.JP: その中でおまえを選んだ理由ってのは……
fields.LOCALIZED: I took you under my wing 'cuz...

fields.EN: You had this positive drive to keep living... this initiative. Maybe that made you seem bright compared with the other orphans.
fields.JP:
生きることへの前向きさというか、
行動力があった……。そこが他の孤児と
違ってまぶしく見えたのかもな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Never saw anyone as fierce or determined
as you. You weren't like any of those other
rats down there...

fields.EN: (Worrying still makes you hungry, and crying only makes you thirsty...)
fields.JP:
（悩んでもお腹はすくし、
　泣いても喉が渇くだけ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I was just doing what I could to survive.
Had to eat, find water, and live...)

fields.EN: (So back then, I was just doing whatever I could do...)
fields.JP:
（だからあのときは、
　とにかくやれることをやってただけ
　なんっすけどね……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I didn't have a choice. I had to be tough
back then...)

fields.EN: (Though when the result was pickpocketing, it's not exactly something I can tell people about. B-But that's all in the past now!)
fields.JP:
（とはいえ、その結果がスリじゃ
　人様には言えたもんじゃないっすね。
　で、でももう過ぎたことっすよ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But that led me to steal, and commit all
sorts of crimes! That's in the past though.)

fields.JP:
えっ？　あ、どういたしまして……？
……？
あの……今のはなんのお礼っすか？
ははっ、ガキにはわかんねーよ

fields.EN: Y-You dodged the question again! Come on!
fields.JP:
な、なんかまたはぐらかされたっす！
もーっ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Stop being such a grouch! Ugh!

fields.EN:
(I should be the one thanking him for
taking me in. He changed my life.)
fields.JP:
（お礼を言いたいのは自分のほうっすよ。
　あのとき師匠が拾ってくれたおかげで、
　自分の未来は一気に変わったんっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I should be the one thanking him for
taking me in. He changed my life.)

fields.EN:
(Boss scolded me for my thievery.
But he had my back. That's why...)
fields.JP:
（師匠はスリをしてた自分に説教してくれて、
　ずっと自分のことを気にかけてくれて、
　それで自分は……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Boss scolded me for my thievery.
But he had my back. That's why...)

fields.EN:
(If I could, I'd be beside him forever...
But not as an apprentice.)
fields.JP:
（できることなら、この先もずっと
　師匠の隣にいたいっす……。
　師弟って関係だけじゃなく……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If I could, I'd be beside him forever...
But not as an apprentice.)

fields.EN: ...Hm? What are you staring at me for? You don't like that I called you a kid? See, you really are a kid.
fields.JP:
……ん？　なにじろじろ見てんだ？
ガキって言ったのが気に食わねぇのか？
やっぱガキだなー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? What's so funny? You're not mad,
are ya? Such a kid.

fields.EN: (Boss still keeps treating me like a child! He doesn't understand a maiden's heart at all!)
fields.JP:
（やっぱり師匠は相変わらず
　自分を子ども扱いしっぱなしっす！
　オトメゴコロをわかってないっす！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Ugh. He's always so patronizing!
He has no idea how to court!)

fields.EN: (But I'm not giving up. I've overcome every kind of hardship so far. Boss being a little dense is nothing!)
fields.JP:
（でも自分は諦めないっすよ。これまで
　どんな困難だって乗り越えてきたんっす。
　師匠がニブチンなくらい、屁でもないっす！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But I'll never give up. Nothing could stop
me then, and it's the same now! I don't
care if he's a big grouch.)

fields.EN:
Okay! If I got no say, then that's that!
No point in stressing!
fields.JP:
うしっ！
やるしかないなら、やるしかないっす！
悩んでても仕方ないっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay! If I got no say, then that's that!
No point in stressing!

fields.EN: Huh? Why are you yapping again?
fields.JP:
なんだぁ？　黙ってたかと思えば
急に騒がしくなりやがって……
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? Why are you yapping again?

fields.EN: Boss! Someday I'll become someone you truly acknowledge! Just you wait!
fields.JP:
師匠！　今に自分は師匠に認めてもらえる
ようになるっすよ！　覚悟しとくっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Boss! Some day, you're gonna want me!
Just you wait!

fields.EN: ...I don't really get it, but yeah. You and I both have all kinds of futures ahead of us. Maybe the day you're hoping for will come too.
fields.JP:
……よくわからんが、そうだな。
俺もおまえも、いろんな未来がある。
おまえが望むような日も来るかもな
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Great, more threats. You got a bright
future. Maybe it'll happen for you someday.

fields.EN: Don't forget you said that, okay?
fields.JP: その言葉、忘れたら駄目っすよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Gonna hold you to that one, old man.

fields.EN: All right! Since we're here, I'm gonna go swim for a bit! Full-on youth power!
fields.JP:
よーっし、せっかくだから
自分はちょっと泳いでくるっす！
若さパワー全開っすー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, time to swim. Gotta soak up all
these rays!

fields.EN: Haha... Youth. Leave me out of it.
fields.JP:
はは……若さパワーか。
俺はあんな風にはできねーな
fields.LOCALIZED: Haha... Youth. Leave me out of it.

fields.EN: Clara... There's never a dull day with you.
fields.JP:
……くらら、おまえがいれば
この先も退屈しないで済みそうだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Clara... There's never a dull day with you.

fields.EN:
(I'm too lazy to walk around. If it weren't
for Charlotte, I wouldn't be here.)
fields.JP:
（外に出るのも歩くのもめんどくせー。
　シャーロットとの待ち合わせじゃなきゃ、
　わざわざ出かけたりしねーっつの）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm too lazy to walk around. If it weren't
for Charlotte, I wouldn't be here.)

fields.EN:
(Ugh. I just wanna go home and daydream
already.)
fields.JP:
（あーあ。早く用事済ませて帰って、
　思う存分妄想に浸りたいぜ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Ugh. I just wanna go home and daydream
already.)

fields.EN: Hey, everyone! Good work out there!
fields.JP: いやー、みなさんお疲れ様っす！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey everyone! How are you guys?!

fields.EN: (Whoa! So many people! I gotta hide.)
fields.JP:
（おわっ！　なんか大勢こっちに来るぞ！？
　かか、隠れないと！）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Whoa! So many people! I gotta hide.)

fields.EN: Moving that rock was a pain. I'm beat.
fields.JP:
岩を退かすの大変だったっすね。
さすがに疲れたっすよー
fields.LOCALIZED: Moving that rock was a pain. I'm beat.

fields.JP: お前はほとんど応援しかしてなかったろーが

fields.EN:
There's 1, 2, 3... 7 of us were needed to
move the boulder.
fields.JP:
一、二、三……総勢七人でようやく
あの大きな岩を退かせたのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's 1, 2, 3... 7 of us were needed to
move the boulder.

fields.EN: When'd we get so many people?
fields.JP: いつの間にかだいぶ大所帯になってたっすね
fields.LOCALIZED: When'd we get so many people?

fields.EN: Thanks to everyone working together, we removed the rock that was blocking the road. Getting through here should be much easier now.
fields.JP:
ですがみなさんで力を合わせたおかげで、
道を塞いでいた岩を取り除けました。
これで通行もだいぶ楽になるはずです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Through the power of teamwork, we
overcame a daunting obstacle. This
will make exploring much easier.

fields.EN:
Pft. That rock's tiny. You shoulda called me
right away. This is a piece of cake! Look!
Check out these muscles!
fields.JP:
あんな岩、最初からオレを呼んでれば
ちゃちゃっと退けてやってたのにな。
見ろ、この力仕事特化型の肉体を！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Pft. That rock's tiny. You shoulda called me
right away. This is a piece of cake! Look!
Check out these muscles!

fields.EN:
Wow. So impressive! You've been working
out!
fields.JP:
わぁ、すごい筋肉ですね！
鍛えてらっしゃいますね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow. So impressive! You've been working
out!

fields.EN: Haha... A lot happened, but looking at how we live now, trusting them back then really was the right choice.
fields.JP:
はは……。
色々あったが今の生活を思えば、
あの時あいつらを信じて正解だったんだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haha... Hard not to be chiseled after putting
in all this work. I knew my strength would
come in handy.

fields.EN: Haha, it's nice that the young ones have so much energy. ...Though I never expected even I would get dragged into physical labor.
fields.JP:
はは、若者たちは元気でいいな。
……というか、私まで力仕事に
駆り出されるとは思わなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haha. The innocence of youth. I never
thought I'd see the day where the younger
generation shows me up.

fields.EN: You can say that again. I specialize in brain work, you know... Ouch.
fields.JP:
それを言うなら俺もだぜ。
こちとら頭脳労働専門なんだがなぁ……いてて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, same. Now they think we're the
brains of the operation... Ouch.

fields.EN: Is your back acting up again. Boss?
fields.JP: 師匠、腰でも痛めたんっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Is your back acting up again. Boss?

fields.EN:
Not just my back. Whole body too.
I'm gonna be sore tomorrow...
fields.JP:
腰どころか全身バキバキだぜ。
明日は筋肉痛だな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not just my back. Whole body too.
I'm gonna be sore tomorrow...

fields.EN: You should exercise more, you know? Moving rocks isn't the only physical work we have around here.
fields.JP:
もっと運動したほうがいいっすよー？
岩を退かす以外にも力仕事はあるんっすから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Try exercising more. You could do more
than physical labor to stay sharp.

fields.EN:
(They brought everyone here to move that
huge rock out of the way.)
fields.JP:
（道を塞いでいた岩を退かそうとして、
　応援を呼んでるうちにあんな大人数に
　なったってわけか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They brought everyone here to move that
huge rock out of the way.)

fields.EN:
(I wouldn't know where to begin with
working in a team that big.)
fields.JP:
（大人数で力を合わせてなにかを
　成し遂げるっていうシチュエーション、
　なんかすげー苦手だぜ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wouldn't know where to begin with
working in a team that big.)

fields.EN:
(Well, I dodged a bullet not being asked
to help. I'd hate to reject them...)
fields.JP:
（ま、俺にお声がかからなかっただけ
　ラッキーだったな。ああいうのって
　断るのもめちゃくちゃめんどくせーし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, I dodged a bullet not being asked
to help. I'd hate to reject them...)

fields.EN:
(Now to remain hidden, and wait for them
to pass.)
fields.JP:
（このままここに隠れて、
　あいつらが通り過ぎるのを待ってるか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Now to remain hidden, and wait for them
to pass.)

fields.EN: I thought I saw something in those bushes.
fields.JP: なんか今、そこの茂みになにかいたような……
fields.LOCALIZED: I thought I saw something in those bushes.

fields.JP:
（ぎくっ！
　なんでこいつは妙に勘が鋭いんだよ！）
どわあっ！？　な、ななな……っ

fields.EN:
That's where you were hiding. Feeling shy
still, huh?
fields.JP:
そんなところに隠れていたの？
相変わらず引っ込み思案ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's where you were hiding. Feeling shy
still, huh?

fields.EN: Sh-Shut up... That's none of your business. I... I mean, I have something to do, so...
fields.JP:
う、うるせ……余計なおせっかいです。
俺……あたしは用事があるから……その……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sh-Shut... Er, that's none of your business.
I, too, am busy... Um...

fields.EN:
Oh shoot. What will I do with this one?
I hope she comes out of her shell.
fields.JP:
もう……仕方のない子ね。
早く打ち解けてくれるといいんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh shoot. What will I do with this one?
I hope she comes out of her shell.

fields.EN:
Ugh. The meet-up place is so far.
This is such a pain...
fields.JP:
待ち合わせ場所はまだ先か……。
遠すぎだろ、くそぉ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh. The meet-up place is so far.
This is such a pain...

fields.EN: Whoa. It's Hikari. She startled me.
fields.JP:
って、な、なんだ。ヒカリか……。
いきなり声かけるからビビっただろーが……
fields.LOCALIZED: Whoa. It's Hikari. She startled me.

fields.JP: こんなとこで会うなんて奇遇だね
おう、なんだメアリーじゃねぇか

fields.EN: (These guys are here too?! Why do they keep coming out one after another?! I'm not mentally prepared for this!)
fields.JP:
（こ、こいつらもいたのか？
　なんでぞろぞろと出て来やがるんだ！
　こっちは心の準備ができてねーんだぞ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(He's here too?! Why is everyone in my
space?! I didn't prepare for this!)

fields.EN: Heeeeey. Lookie here, it's Mary. How ya doin'?
fields.JP:
はぁーい、メアリーじゃないの。
ごきげんいかがー？
fields.LOCALIZED: Heeeeey. Lookie here, it's Mary. How ya doin'?

fields.EN: Huh? Oh, um... Yes. Good. Hello...
fields.JP:
え、う……はい……。
ご、ごきげん、どうも……
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? Oh, um... Yes. Good. Hello...

fields.JP: あはは、相変わらずきょどってるねー

fields.EN: Hey, Kaede. Don't tease her too much.
fields.JP:
こら、カエデ。
あまりからかうものじゃない

fields.EN:
Am not. I just think it's cute how shy she
is.
fields.JP:
からかってないっての。
見ててかわいいから絡んでるだけだもーん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Am not. I just think it's cute how shy she
is.

fields.EN: That's exactly what I'm telling you to stop doing...
fields.JP: それをやめろと言っているんだろうが……
fields.LOCALIZED: That's exactly why I think you're being rude.

fields.JP: メアリー、これからどっか行くの？

fields.EN: Yeah... I'm meeting up with Charlotte.
fields.JP:
ああ……うん。
シャーロットと待ち合わせしてんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, yeah... Charlotte had something to tell
me.

fields.EN:
Suuuuure you are. Closey close close with
Charlotte.
fields.JP:
へー、そうなんや。
メアリーはシャーロットと仲ええなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Suuuuure you are. Closey close close with
Charlotte.

fields.EN: (By the way, why does this person keep changing the way they talk? Weird...)
fields.JP:
（ところで、なんでこいつはころころと
　口調が変わるんだ？　変なの……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Why is he such a weirdo all the time? Ugh.)

fields.EN:
We want to be your friends too, but we
never get to see you. It's lucky that we
ran into you here at all.
fields.JP:
あたしたちもメアリーと仲良くなりたいんだけど、
あんまり会う機会もないでしょ？
こうして偶然会えてラッキーだったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
We want to be your friends too, but we
never get to see you. It's lucky that we
ran into you here at all.

fields.JP: おまえって引きこもりだからなー
そこはインドア派って言え……

fields.EN:
Mary might seem shy at first, but she's
nice once she warms up to you.
fields.JP:
メアリーは慣れないうちは引っ込み思案だけど、
本当はいい子なんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mary might seem shy at first, but she's
nice once she warms up to you.

fields.EN: (A good kid is someone like you, isn't it? Don't call me that. It's embarrassing...)
fields.JP:
（い、いい子ってのはおまえみたいな奴の
　ことだろ？　俺のことそんな風に言うな。
　ハズいじゃねーか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Me, nice? Don't put words in my mouth.
Now I'm embarrasesed...)

fields.EN:
Say, why don't you join us for tea sometime?
We could put out some snack platters!
fields.JP:
もしよければ、今度一緒にお茶でもしようよ。
おいしいお菓子でも食べながらさ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, why don't you join us for tea sometime?
We could put out some snack platters!

fields.EN: Well, we're heading this way. See you!
fields.JP:
じゃ、俺たちはこっち行くから。
またな！
fields.LOCALIZED: Then, you know where to find us! Later!

fields.EN:
*sigh*... Talking to people exhausts me.
I hope no one else comes along.
fields.JP:
……はぁ。やっぱ人と話すのは疲れるぜ。
このあとは誰にも出くわさなきゃいいけどな
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh*... Talking to people exhausts me.
I hope no one else comes along.

fields.EN: Me, kind...? I guess it's all in how you phrase things.
fields.JP:
にしても、俺が優しいだ……？
モノは言いようだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
But they think I'm nice...? Guess that's
a silver lining.

fields.EN:
Oh, finally made it. This is where Charlotte
told me to meet her.
fields.JP:
……お、やっと着いたぜ。ここだな。
シャーロットとの待ち合わせ場所は
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, finally made it. This is where Charlotte
told me to meet her.

fields.JP: シャーロットはどこに……げっ！

fields.EN:
(What the hell! All the Blood Maidens are
here?! I thought Charlotte only invited me!)
fields.JP:
（な、なんだありゃあああ！
　血式少女たちが大勢集まってるぞ！？
　シャーロットしかいないと思ってたのに！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What the hell! All the Blood Maidens are
here?! I thought Charlotte only invited me!)

fields.EN:
(Damn it. I can't just walk in all friendly!
I should turn around before someone sees
me.)
fields.JP:
（くそ、あんな大人数で和気あいあいとした
　中になんて入れねーっつの！
　ここは見つからないうちに回れ右で……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Damn it. I can't just walk in all friendly!
I should turn around before someone sees
me.)

fields.JP: あら、メアリー！　来てくれたのね
（だああっ！　声かけるなあああ！！）
メアリーもこっちに来なよ！
みんなで一緒におしゃべりしましょ
あ、めありだー！　やっほー！

fields.EN:
Oh. Another shyeep has wandered into the
Demon King's domain.
fields.JP:
おお！　ワレの魔王っぷりに引き寄せられ、
また一人迷えるこひちゅじがやってきたと
ゆーわけだにゃっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. Another shyeep has wandered into the
Demon King's domain.

fields.EN: (I'm not a lamb. And she bit her tongue, too...)
fields.JP: （子羊じゃねぇ。しかも噛んでるし……）

fields.EN: Oh, what's going on? Did Mary come too?
fields.JP: え、なになに、メアリーも来たの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, what's going on? Did Mary come too?

fields.EN:
Oh, what a coincidence. We just got here
too. Right?
fields.JP:
へー、偶然ね。
わたしたちも今来たところなのよ。ね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, what a coincidence. We just got here
too. Right?

fields.EN: Yes. I was out walking with Oyayubi-neesama and Nemu-chan when we happened to see everyone gathered here...
fields.JP:
はい。親指姉さまとネムちゃんと
一緒にお散歩していたら、ちょうど
みなさんが集まっていたので……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. I was walking with Sister Thumbelina
and Sleepy and saw everyone gathered...

fields.EN:
You're right. If you look at the line-up, it's
all Blood Maidens!
fields.JP:
たしかにこうして見ると、
血式少女大集合ですわね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right. If you look at the line-up, it's
all Blood Maidens!

fields.EN:
(Uh. You mean former-Blood Maidens.
Now they're just a buncha girls.)
fields.JP:
（いや、「元」血式少女だろ。
　今はただの女子の集まりだろ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Uh. You mean former-Blood Maidens.
Now they're just a buncha girls.)

fields.EN:
Cinderella, need I remind you that we are
"former" Blood Maidens. This is a normal
gathering.
fields.JP:
シンデレラ、私たちは正確には「元」血式少女よ。
だからこれはただの女子の集まりよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella, need I remind you that we are
"former" Blood Maidens. This is a normal
gathering.

fields.JP:
（俺が突っ込みたかったこと
　そのまんま言われた！）

「元」でもなんでも、
細かいことはいいじゃないですか～

fields.EN: Though I think you're being too loose about it in your own way...
fields.JP:
あなたはあなたで、大ざっぱすぎると
思うけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, I think it's important to specify...

fields.EN:
Now that we're all together, the chatter
is quite lively.
fields.JP: 急にみんな集まってきて賑やかになったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that we're all together, the chatter
is quite lively.

fields.EN:
I don't know how you managed to wrangle
everyone together.
fields.JP:
元血式少女ばかりのメンツで
よくこんなに集まったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know how you managed to wrangle
everyone together.

fields.JP: 本当、ジャックさん以外は全員だもんね

fields.EN: (Everyone except Jack... If anything, maybe so many people gathered because Jack was here?)
fields.JP:
（ジャック以外全員……。
　むしろジャックがいたからこんなに
　集まってきたんじゃねぇか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Everyone but Jack... I bet that boy's here
somewhere behind the scenes.)

fields.JP: この天然ハーレム体質男め……
fields.LOCALIZED: Could this be anymore of a harem...?

fields.JP: ちょっと、聞こえてるよー？
だったら聞こえなかったふりしてろよ……
相変わらずひねくれてるなぁ

fields.EN: Hmph. I just said what I was thinking.
fields.JP: けっ、思ったことを言っただけだろ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hmph. Take it or leave it.

fields.EN: It'd be easier if you were just a little more honest. I heard you kept trying to refuse being in the group photo the other day right up to the end.
fields.JP:
もっと素直になっちゃえば楽だよ。
この間も、みんなで写真撮るのを
最後まで断ろうとしてたんだって？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You should try being honest more often.
I heard you tried sneaking out of the photo
the other day.

fields.JP:
う、うるせーよ。
そんなの俺の勝手だろ……

fields.EN: (How am I supposed to know what face to make, what pose to do, or where to stand in a photo?! Damn it, this is why extroverts are such a pain...)
fields.JP:
（写真なんてどんな顔とかポーズで、
　どの位置に入って写りゃいいのか迷うんだよ！
　くそぉ、これだから陽キャは……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Who knows how to pose in pictures?
Or where to stand, and what have you!
I really hate these goody-two-shoes...)

fields.EN: Some things never change, huh Mary?
fields.JP: メアリーったら相変わらずなんだから
fields.LOCALIZED: Some things never change, huh Mary?

fields.EN: Even still, I gotta love my adorable sister.
fields.JP:
そんな素直じゃないところも含めて、
かわいい妹なのよね
fields.LOCALIZED: Even still, I gotta love my adorable sister.

fields.EN:
Anyway, Charlotte... Didn't you call me
here? Let's get on with it.
fields.JP:
そ……そんなことよりシャーロット、
用事があるんだろ？　さっさと行こうぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyway, Charlotte... Didn't you call me
here? Let's get on with it.

fields.EN: We're heading over to Chiaki-kun for a bit.
fields.JP: ちょっと千昭くんのところにね

fields.EN:
Oh, got it. It's rare we're all together
nowadays. Wish we could see more of
each other.
fields.JP:
そっかー。こんな風にみんなが
集まることなんて珍しいから、
もっと一緒にいたかったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, got it. It's rare we're all together
nowadays. Wish we could see more of
each other.

fields.EN:
We'll make it happen soon. It would be
nice to organize a tea party.
fields.JP:
機会はまたいつでもあるわよ。
今度はみんなでお茶会を開いても楽しそうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'll make it happen soon. It would be
nice to organize a tea party.

fields.EN:
I'll be sure to invite you both, Mary and
Charlotte. Hope to see you there.
fields.JP:
そのときはメアリーとシャーロットも
招待するから、ぜひ来てね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll be sure to invite you both, Mary and
Charlotte. Hope to see you there.

fields.EN:
Great. Looking forward to it. Aren't we,
Mary?
fields.JP:
ええ、楽しみにしているわ。
ね？　メアリー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Great. Looking forward to it. Aren't we,
Mary?

fields.EN:
(I wonder why...I still feel like I don't fit
in with everyone.)
fields.JP:
（なんだろうな……。
　こいつらと一緒にいる「俺」って存在が、
　いまだに異質なものに思える……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder why...I still feel like I don't fit
in with everyone.)

fields.EN: (Honestly, there were times when I'd see everyone having fun together like this and feel jealous.)
fields.JP:
（正直、こんな風にみんなで楽しそうに
　してる光景を見て、うらやましいとか
　思ったこともあった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Honestly, I used to be jealous of people
who had friends like I do...)

fields.EN: (But now I understand. This kind of thing just doesn't suit me.)
fields.JP:
（でも、今ならわかる。
　俺にはこういうのは向いてない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But now, I feel lonelier knowing that it isn't
for me.)

fields.EN:
(Seems like most people just bite their
tongue, just to avoid upsetting other
people.)
fields.JP:
（みんな本当は、言いたいこと、やりたいこと、
　不平不満、そういうのがあっても、
　我慢していたんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Seems like most people just bite their
tongue, just to avoid upsetting other
people.)

fields.EN: (They take care not to hurt each other, and even when someone says something unpleasant, they don't get angry—they smile and accept it...)
fields.JP:
（相手を傷つけないように気を遣ったり、
　相手に嫌なことを言われても怒らずに
　笑って受け入れたり……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(How are you supposed to know who's
real or fake when people aren't truthful?
What's the right move...?)

fields.EN: (With this many people acting together, of course things wouldn't work without that kind of consideration.)
fields.JP:
（こんなに大勢の人間が一緒に行動
　するんだから、そういう気遣いがなきゃ
　そりゃうまくいかねーよな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(My head's spinning trying to keep up with
all these people at the same time.)

fields.EN:
(Spending time with other people makes
me realize how hard they work to maintain
their friendships.)
fields.JP:
（こいつらと過ごすうちに、
　みんながそういう風に努力して
　仲良くしているんだってわかった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Spending time with other people makes
me realize how hard they work to maintain
their friendships.)

fields.EN: (Their companions matter to them. Even when they get hurt, they understand each other. Even if they fall, they get back up for their companions... They can really do those things.)
fields.JP:
（仲間が大事。傷ついてもお互いを理解し合う。
　倒れても仲間のために立ち上がる……。
　こいつらはそういうのがちゃんとできるんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Friends are important. They stand up for
you, no matter how much you butt heads.
That's what they're for.)

fields.EN: (But I can't do that. I much prefer the world that appears when I close my eyes alone in my room.)
fields.JP:
（だけど俺にはそんなことできない。
　それよりも、一人の部屋で目をつぶってたときに
　現れる自分の世界のほうがずっと好きだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But that's not me. I'm better off with my
eyes closed alone in my room.)

fields.EN: (But that doesn't mean I hate people.)
fields.JP:
（だからといって、みんなのことが
　嫌いなわけじゃねぇけどさ）
fields.LOCALIZED: (But that doesn't mean I hate people.)

fields.EN:
(I just need my alone time. It should be
fine to pick and choose when you wanna.)
fields.JP:
（「たまの一人」が好きな奴がいるように、
　「たまの仲間」が好きな奴がいたって
　いいと思うんだよな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I just need my alone time. It should be
fine to pick and choose when you wanna.)

fields.EN: (A world small enough that I'm just selling matches in a little town... about the size of a four-and-a-half-tatami room. That's where I was happiest. It suited me best.)
fields.JP:
（俺は小さな町でマッチを売ってるくらいの
　世界……四畳半くらいの広さが一番幸せで、
　性に合ってたんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I used to live in an alley, selling matches.
I found everything I needed by myself.)

fields.EN: (But... I wonder if someday this wide world will start to feel comfortable to me too...?)
fields.JP:
（けど……。いつかはこの広い世界が、
　心地いいって感じる日も来るのかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But...I hope the day comes where I can
finally feel comfy in my own skin.)

fields.EN: Mary? What's the matter? You're spacing out.
fields.JP: メアリー？　どうしたの、ボーっとして
fields.LOCALIZED: Mary? What's the matter? You're spacing out.

fields.JP:
そう？
大丈夫なら、そろそろ行きましょうか
（ひつ……なんとかって奴はどこだ？）

fields.EN: Hello, Charlotte-san, Mary-san. Sorry for calling you out here again and again.
fields.JP:
やあ、シャーロットさんにメアリーさん。
たびたび呼び出してすまないね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hello Chalotte, Mary. Thank you for agreeing
to meet me here.

fields.EN:
(Seriously. Why does he keep calling us
to meet? We don't have all day...)
fields.JP:
（本当だぜ。
　ったく、いちいち呼びつけんなっての。
　こっちも暇じゃねぇんだからな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Seriously. Why does he keep calling us
to meet? We don't have all day...)

fields.EN: Mind if we pick up where we left off?
fields.JP:
それじゃあ、この間の続きから
また話を聞かせてもらえるかな
fields.LOCALIZED: Mind if we pick up where we left off?

fields.EN:
(This bastard...Hitsu-whatever.
He keeps asking us question for some...
history book? Or something.)
fields.JP:
（こいつ……えーと、ひつなんとかは、
　レキシショ？　をヘンサン？　するとか
　どーとか言ってたっけな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This bastard...Hitsu-whatever.
He keeps asking us question for some...
history book? Or something.)

fields.EN: (Apparently he wants to leave a record of everything that's happened, so he's been asking everyone about it...)
fields.JP:
（これまでに起きたこととかを記録に
　残したいとかで、みんなから話を
　聞いてるらしいけどよ……）

fields.EN:
(What's the point in all that? Sounds like
a chore. I'm bored already...)
fields.JP:
（それになんの意味があるんだ？
　こいつもよくそんなめんどくせーこと
　するよなー。もう飽きた……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What's the point in all that? Sounds like
a chore. I'm bored already...)

fields.JP: あら、もう飽きちゃったって顔してるわね

fields.EN:
I don't blame you, answering the same
questions repeatedly. I appreciate your
cooperation.
fields.JP:
何度も同じ話を確認したりすれば、
飽きても仕方ないね。協力してくれる
君たちには感謝しているよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't blame you, answering the same
questions repeatedly. I appreciate your
cooperation.

fields.EN: You really do something so troub— I mean, so difficult-looking, don't you?
fields.JP:
よく、そんなめんど……た、大変そうなこと……
やりますね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the...point in all this work?
Isn't it hard and stuff?

fields.EN: It certainly is a lot of work. But I believe this is my mission.
fields.JP:
たしかに大変だね。
でもこれは私の使命だと思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Research and compilation take time,
but this is an important process.

fields.EN: We can't let a major historical event that involved the whole world go untold to the next generation.
fields.JP:
世界を巻き込んだ大きな歴史的出来事を、
次世代に伝えないわけにはいかないからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The next generation must have some
archive of what we experienced. Our
trials and tribulations.

fields.EN:
But...do you have to put it in all in some
book? Can't you just tell them?
fields.JP:
でも……わざわざ本にしなくたって……
話して伝えれば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But...do you have to put it in all in some
book? Can't you just tell them?

fields.EN:
Writing it down immortalizes it. Sure, we
could pass these stories down verbally, but
that leaves room for misinterpretation.
fields.JP:
本という形に残すことに意味があるんだよ。
口で伝えただけだと、時代が進むにつれて
内容が変わっていってしまうことがある
fields.LOCALIZED:
Writing it down immortalizes it. Sure, we
could pass these stories down verbally, but
that leaves room for misinterpretation.

fields.EN:
Which distorts the history. Then it merely
becomes folklore or legend. That's not right.
fields.JP:
そうしていつしか歴史ではなく、
単なる言い伝え、伝説になってしまうんだ。
それではいけない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which distorts the history. Then it merely
becomes folklore or legend. That's not right.

fields.EN: To preserve what we saw and experienced as facts that truly happened, we need to compile it all into a book.
fields.JP:
自分たちが見て、体験してきたことを、
かつてあった事実として残すには、
本にまとめる必要があるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The closer we get to those who experienced
it, the closer we get to preserving the truth.

fields.EN:
(Oh... That actually makes a lot of sense.
I'd never suggest it, but I get it now.)
fields.JP:
（なんだ……そういう理由があるのか。
　俺ならめんどくさいからやんねーけど、
　まあ、納得はできたぜ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh... That actually makes a lot of sense.
I'd never suggest it, but I get it now.)

fields.EN:
Thanks to everyone's participation, I have
produced a worthy draft. But there's one
loose thread.
fields.JP:
みんなの協力のおかげで、
本の内容はだいぶまとまってきたよ。
ただ、一つ迷っていることがあるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks to everyone's participation, I have
produced a worthy draft. But there's one
loose thread.

fields.EN: I don't know how to title it.
fields.JP: タイトルをどうしようかと思ってね
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't know how to title it.

fields.EN: For now, as a provisional title, I've called it History of Blood Skelter, with the sense of a 'bloody tale of chaos,' but...
fields.JP:
今は仮のタイトルとして、「血の混乱劇」
という意味で『ブラッドスケルターの歴史』と
つけているのだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
For now, I'm calling it the "History of
Blood Skelter." I'm thinking of adding
mayhem and confusion to the subtitle.

fields.EN:
Well...I'm not sure that gives off the best
impression.
fields.JP: ああ……それはあまりいい印象がないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well...I'm not sure that gives off the best
impression.

fields.EN: I thought so. Even if the content isn't exactly cheerful, I wonder if there isn't a better title...
fields.JP:
やっぱりな。
いくら明るい内容ではないとはいえ、
もっといいタイトルはないものか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought not. But a story is only as good
as its title.

fields.EN:
(Sheesh. Sounds like a personal problem.
Just call it Random Skelter or something.)
fields.JP:
（はー、めんどくせーな。
　もうそんなの『テキトースケルター』とかで
　いいんじゃ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Sheesh. Sounds like a personal problem.
Just call it Random Skelter or something.)

fields.EN:
M...Mary Skelter! How about Mary Skelter
as the title? I mean, I was the one who kept
stumbling through it all, ya know?
fields.JP:
メ……メアリースケルター！
『メアリースケルター』ってタイトルはどうだ？
ほら、俺が混乱した話でもあったわけだし？
fields.LOCALIZED:
M...Mary Skelter! How about Mary Skelter
as the title? I mean, I was the one who kept
stumbling through it all, ya know?

fields.EN: My, my. You really do flip that switch at the strangest times.
fields.JP:
あらあら、またおかしなところで
スイッチが入っちゃうんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
There you go, producing genius at the
perfect time.

fields.EN:
(Is she being sarcastic? Damn. I should've
kept my mouth shut...)
fields.JP:
（ま、またなんか滑った、か……？
　ちくしょう、言わなきゃよかった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is she being sarcastic? Damn. I should've
kept my mouth shut...)

fields.EN:
Thanks for the suggestion. We're in no
rush to title it, so I'll sit on it.
fields.JP:
提案してくれて助かるよ。
でもタイトルは急ぐことでもないから、
またゆっくり考えてみようと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks for the suggestion. We're in no
rush to title it, so I'll sit on it.

fields.EN: More important than the title is the path everyone has walked, after all.
fields.JP:
タイトルより重要なのは、
みんなが歩んできた道なんだしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
What matters is most is what's inside
the book.

fields.EN: Now it looks like I can finally put everything together. Thank you for telling me so many stories.
fields.JP:
さて、これでようやくすべての事柄を
まとめることができそうだよ。
たくさんの話を聞かせてくれて、ありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe, with you two, everyone is finally
accounted for. Thank you for sharing your
tales.

fields.EN: (Phew... I can finally go home and dream.)
fields.JP:
（ほっ。これでやっと家に戻って
　ゆっくり妄想を楽しめるぜ……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Phew... I can finally go home and dream.)

fields.JP: メアリースケルターか……

fields.EN: Hehe. I suppose a personal name by itself doesn't really tell you what it means.
fields.JP: ふふ、流石に個人名だけじゃ意味がわからないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. Perhaps her name may endear
others to the chronicles inside.

fields.EN: Oops. Looks like I dropped this book...
fields.LOCALIZED: Oops. Looks like I dropped this book...

fields.EN:
It's the history book I'm using as a template
for my own... Hm? This page is...
fields.JP:
参考にしていた歴史書か……ん？
このページは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's the history book I'm using as a template
for my own... Hm? This page is...

fields.EN:
Say... It reads here that there was once
a queen named...Mary.
fields.JP:
ああ、そういえば……。
似たような名前で「Mary」という
名の女王がいたのだったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say... It reads here that there was once
a queen named...Mary.

fields.EN:
Mary Skelter... Mary Skelter. Yes.
That title's not so bad at all.
fields.JP:
MarySkelter……
メアリスケルター……。うん。
あながち悪いタイトルではないかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mary Skelter... Mary Skelter. Yes.
That title's not so bad at all.

fields.EN:
Each Blood Maiden is unique, but one
commonality they share is a queenly
disposition.
fields.JP:
彼女たち……血式少女はそれぞれが個性的で、
皆どこか女王のようなところがある
fields.LOCALIZED:
Each Blood Maiden is unique, but one
commonality they share is a queenly
disposition.

fields.EN: A tale of chaos woven by those 'Blood Queens' at God's Tower...
fields.JP:
そんな『血の女王たち』が神の塔で織りなす
混乱劇……
fields.LOCALIZED:
They're Blood Queens, performing acts
of mayhem and confusion at the foot of
God's tower...

fields.EN: Hehe, maybe that's a little too poetic. ...Well, that's fine too.
fields.JP:
ふふ、少し詩的すぎるかな。
……まあ、それもいいか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. I may be waxing poetic, but...
That's the good stuff.

fields.JP: ちーちゃーん！　ごはんですよー！

fields.EN: Understood, sister. I'll be right there.
fields.JP: わかったよ、姉さん。すぐ行く
fields.LOCALIZED: Understood, sister. I'll be right there.
